	<div class="bookintro"><div class=ebookintro>The words 'Ar-Rahman', 'Ar-Rahim' (i.e., the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful) are two words derived from 'Ar-Rahma' (i.e., the mercy). And the words 'Ar-Rahim' and 'Ar-Raahim' have one meaning as the words 'Al-Alim' and 'Al- 'Aleem' have one and the same
meaning (i.e., the Cognizant One).</div><div class="arabic abookintro">الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ اسْمَانِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ‏.‏ الرَّحِيمُ وَالرَّاحِمُ بِمَعْنًى وَاحِدٍ كَالْعَلِيمِ وَالْعَالِمِ‏.‏</div><div class=clear></div></div>

<a name=C1.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>What has been said about Fãtihat al-Kitab (i.e., the Opening of the Book)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب مَا جَاءَ فِي فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَسُمِّيَتْ أُمَّ الْكِتَابِ أَنَّهُ يُبْدَأُ بِكِتَابَتِهَا فِي الْمَصَاحِفِ، وَيُبْدَأُ بِقِرَاءَتِهَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ. وَالدِّينُ الْجَزَاءُ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ، كَمَا تَدِينُ تُدَانُ.<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: بِالدِّينِ بِالْحِسَابِ.<br>
<br><br>
<a href="javascript:openquran(55,86,86)">{مَدِينِينَ}</a> مُحَاسَبِينَ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178010>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=1></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4474</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178010><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178010><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id bin Al-Mu'alla:</div><div class=text_details><p>While I was praying in the Mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called me but I did not respond to him. Later I 
said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say'--"Give your response to Allah 
(by obeying Him) and to His Apostle when he calls you." (8.24) 
He then said to me, "I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an, before you leave 
the Mosque." Then he got hold of my hand, and when he intended to leave (the Mosque), I said to 
him, "Didn't you say to me, 'I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an?' He said, 
"Al-Hamdu-Li l-lah Rabbi-l-`alamin (i.e. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds) which is Al-Sab'a 
Al-Mathani (i.e. seven repeatedly recited Verses) and the Grand Qur'an which has been given to me."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَدَعَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ أُجِبْهُ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q1" name="q1" href="javascript:openquran(7,24,24)"><c_q1>{‏اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ‏}</c_q1></a>‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ سُورَةً هِيَ أَعْظَمُ السُّوَرِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِيَدِي، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَلَمْ تَقُلْ ‏"‏ لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ سُورَةً هِيَ أَعْظَمُ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏<A id="q2" name="q2" href="javascript:openquran(0,2,2)"><c_q2>{‏الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}</c_q2></a>‏ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"...Not (the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray." (V.1:7)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<a id="q3" name="q3" href="javascript:openquran(0,7,7)"><c_q3>{‏غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ‏}</c_q3></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178020>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=2></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4475</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178020><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178020><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says: 'Ghair-il-Maghdubi `alaihim Walad-Dallin (i.e. not the 
path of those who earn Your Anger, nor the path of those who went astray (1.7)), then you must say, 
'Ameen', for if one's utterance of 'Ameen' coincides with that of the angels, then his past sins will be 
forgiven."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ ‏<A id="q4" name="q4" href="javascript:openquran(0,7,7)"><c_q4>{‏غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ‏}</c_q4></a>‏ فَقُولُوا آمِينَ‏.‏ فَمَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Baqarah (The Cow)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْبَقَرَةِ</div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=C2.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: “And He taught Adam all the names (of everything)..." (V.2:31)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏<A id="q5" name="q5" href="javascript:openquran(1,31,31)"><c_q5>{‏وَعَلَّمَ آدَمَ الأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا‏}</c_q5></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178030>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=3></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4476</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178030><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178030><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection the Believers will assemble and say, 'Let us ask 
somebody to intercede for us with our Lord.' So they will go to Adam and say, 'You are the father of 
all the people, and Allah created you with His Own Hands, and ordered the angels to prostrate to you, 
and taught you the names of all things; so please intercede for us with your Lord, so that He may 
relieve us from this place of ours.' Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this (i.e. intercession for you).' Then 
Adam will remember his sin and feel ashamed thereof. He will say, 'Go to Noah, for he was the first 
Apostle, Allah sent to the inhabitants of the earth.' They will go to him and Noah will say, 
'I am not fit for this undertaking.' He will remember his appeal to his Lord to do what he had no 
knowledge of, then he will feel ashamed thereof and will say, 'Go to the Khalil--r-Rahman (i.e. 
Abraham).' They will go to him and he will say, 'I am not fit for this undertaking. Go to Moses, the 
slave to whom Allah spoke (directly) and gave him the Torah .' So they will go to him and he will say, 
'I am not fit for this undertaking.' and he will mention (his) killing a person who was not a killer, and 
so he will feel ashamed thereof before his Lord, and he will say, 'Go to Jesus, Allah's Slave, His 
Apostle and Allah's Word and a Spirit coming from Him. Jesus will say, 'I am not fit for this 
undertaking, go to Muhammad the Slave of Allah whose past and future sins were forgiven by Allah.' 
So they will come to me and I will proceed till I will ask my Lord's Permission and I will be given 
permission. When I see my Lord, I will fall down in Prostration and He will let me remain in that state 
as long as He wishes and then I will be addressed.' (Muhammad!) Raise your head. Ask, and your 
request will be granted; say, and your saying will be listened to; intercede, and your intercession will 
be accepted.' I will raise my head and praise Allah with a saying (i.e. invocation) He will teach me, 
and then I will intercede. He will fix a limit for me (to intercede for) whom I will admit into Paradise. 
Then I will come back again to Allah, and when I see my Lord, the same thing will happen to me. And 
then I will intercede and Allah will fix a limit for me to intercede whom I will let into Paradise, then I 
will come back for the third time; and then I will come back for the fourth time, and will say, 'None 
remains in Hell but those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned (in Hell) and who have been destined to an 
eternal stay in Hell.' " (The compiler) Abu `Abdullah said: 'But those whom the Qur'an has imprisoned 
in Hell,' refers to the Statement of Allah: 
"They will dwell therein forever." (16.29)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَجْتَمِعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُونَ لَوِ اسْتَشْفَعْنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ أَبُو النَّاسِ، خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ وَأَسْجَدَ لَكَ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ، وَعَلَّمَكَ أَسْمَاءَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ، فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا هَذَا‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ ذَنْبَهُ فَيَسْتَحِي ـ ائْتُوا نُوحًا فَإِنَّهُ أَوَّلُ رَسُولٍ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ‏.‏ وَيَذْكُرُ سُؤَالَهُ رَبَّهُ مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَيَسْتَحِي، فَيَقُولُ ائْتُوا خَلِيلَ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ، ائْتُوا مُوسَى عَبْدًا كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ التَّوْرَاةَ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ‏.‏ وَيَذْكُرُ قَتْلَ النَّفْسِ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ فَيَسْتَحِي مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَيَقُولُ ائْتُوا عِيسَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولَهُ، وَكَلِمَةَ اللَّهِ وَرُوحَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ، ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدًا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونِي فَأَنْطَلِقُ حَتَّى أَسْتَأْذِنَ عَلَى رَبِّي فَيُؤْذَنُ ‏{‏لِي‏}‏ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا، فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ‏.‏ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأَحْمَدُهُ بِتَحْمِيدٍ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ، ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ، فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا، فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَعُودُ إِلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي ـ مِثْلَهُ ـ ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ، فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا، فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏{‏ثُمَّ أَعُودُ الثَّالِثَةَ‏}‏ ثُمَّ أَعُودُ الرَّابِعَةَ فَأَقُولُ مَا بَقِيَ فِي النَّارِ إِلاَّ مَنْ حَبَسَهُ الْقُرْآنُ وَوَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْخُلُودُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ مَنْ حَبَسَهُ الْقُرْآنُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي قَوْلَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا‏}‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter></div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">بَابٌ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(1,14,14)" class="aya">{إِلَى شَيَاطِينِهِمْ}</a> أَصْحَابِهِمْ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ <a href="javascript:openquran(1,19,19)" class="aya">{مُحِيطٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ}</a> اللَّهُ جَامِعُهُمْ {عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ} عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَقًّا.</br>قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {بِقُوَّةٍ} يَعْمَلُ بِمَا فِيهِ.</br>وَقَالَ أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ: <a href="javascript:openquran(32,32,32)" class="aya">{مَرَضٌ}</a> شَكٌّ، <a href="javascript:openquran(1,66,66)" class="aya">{وَمَا خَلْفَهَا}</a> عِبْرَةٌ لِمَنْ بَقِيَ.</br>{لاَ شِيَةَ} لاَ بَيَاضَ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: {يَسُومُونَكُمْ} يُولُونَكُمْ.</br>{الْوَلاَيَةُ} مَفْتُوحَةٌ مَصْدَرُ الْوَلاَءِ، وَهِيَ الرُّبُوبِيَّةُ، إِذَا كُسِرَتِ الْوَاوُ فَهِيَ الإِمَارَةُ.</br>وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ: الْحُبُوبُ الَّتِي تُؤْكَلُ كُلُّهَا فُومٌ.</br>وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(1,90,90)" class="aya">{فَبَاءُوا}</a> فَانْقَلَبُوا.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(1,89,89)" class="aya">{يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ}</a> يَسْتَنْصِرُونَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(1,102,102)" class="aya">{شَرَوْا}</a> بَاعُوا.</br>{رَاعِنَا} مِنَ الرُّعُونَةِ إِذَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يُحَمِّقُوا إِنْسَانًا قَالُوا رَاعِنَا.</br>{لاَ يَجْزِي} لاَ يُغْنِي.</br>{خُطُوَاتِ} مِنَ الْخَطْوِ، وَالْمَعْنَى آثَارَهُ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "...Then do not set up rivals unto Allah (in  worship) while you know (that He Alone has the right to be worshipped)..." (V.2:22)</div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q12" name="q12" href="javascript:openquran(1,22,22)"><c_q12>{‏فَلاَ تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ‏}</c_q12></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178040>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=4></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4477</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178040><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178040><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked the Prophet, "What is the greatest sin in the Sight of Allah?" He said, "That you set up a rival 
unto Allah though He Alone created you." I said, "That is indeed a great sin." Then asked, "What is 
next?" He said, "To kill your son lest he should share your food with you." I asked, "What is next?" 
He said, "To commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَعَظِيمٌ، قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ تَخَافُ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ حَلِيلَةَ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=5></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4478</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178050><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178050><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Zaid:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Kam'a (i.e. a kind of edible fungus) is like the Manna (in that it is obtained 
without effort) and its water is a (medicine) cure for eye trouble."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ، وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=6></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4479</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178060><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178060><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It was said to the children of Israel, 'Enter the gate (of the town), prostrate (in 
humility) and say: Hittatun (i.e. repentance) i.e. O Allah! 
Forgive our sins.' But they entered by dragging themselves on their buttocks, so they did something 
different (from what they had been ordered to do) and said, 'Hittatun,' but added, "A grain in a hair."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قِيلَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏<A id="q15" name="q15" href="javascript:openquran(1,58,58)"><c_q15>{‏ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا حِطَّةٌ‏}</c_q15></a>‏ فَدَخَلُوا يَزْحَفُونَ عَلَى أَسْتَاهِهِمْ، فَبَدَّلُوا وَقَالُوا حِطَّةٌ، حَبَّةٌ فِي شَعَرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Whoever is an enemy to Jibril (Gabriel)..." (V.2:97)</div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q16" name="q16" href="javascript:openquran(1,97,97)"><c_q16>{‏مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ‏}</c_q16></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ جَبْرَ، وَمِيكَ، وَسَرَافِ عَبْدٌ. إِيلْ اللَّهُ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178070>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=7></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4480</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178070><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178070><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdullah bin Salam heard the news of the arrival of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (at Medina) while he was on a 
farm collecting its fruits. So he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I will ask you about three things which 
nobody knows unless he be a prophet. Firstly, what is the first portent of the Hour? What is the first 
meal of the people of Paradise? And what makes a baby look like its father or mother?'. The Prophet (ﷺ) 
said, "Just now Gabriel has informed me about that." `Abdullah said, "Gabriel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 
"Yes." `Abdullah said, "He, among the angels is the enemy of the Jews." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited 
this Holy Verse:-- 
"Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (let him die in his fury!) for he has brought it (i.e. Qur'an) down to 
your heart by Allah's permission." (2.97) Then he added, "As for the first portent of the Hour, it will 
be a fire that will collect the people from the East to West. And as for the first meal of the people of 
Paradise, it will be the caudite (i.e. extra) lobe of the fish liver. And if a man's discharge proceeded 
that of the woman, then the child resembles the father, and if the woman's discharge proceeded that of 
the man, then the child resembles the mother." On hearing that, `Abdullah said, "I testify that None 
has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that you are the Messenger of Allah, O, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ); the 
Jews are liars, and if they should come to know that I have embraced Islam, they would accuse me of 
being a liar." In the meantime some Jews came (to the Prophet) and he asked them, "What is 
`Abdullah's status amongst you?" They replied, "He is the best amongst us, and he is our chief and the 
son of our chief." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What would you think if `Abdullah bin Salam embraced Islam?" 
They replied, "May Allah protect him from this!" Then `Abdullah came out and said, "I testify that 
None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." The Jews 
then said, "Abdullah is the worst of us and the son of the worst of us," and disparaged him. On that 
`Abdullah said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is what I was afraid of!"</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، بِقُدُومِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي أَرْضٍ يَخْتَرِفُ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَائِلُكَ عَنْ ثَلاَثٍ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُنَّ إِلاَّ نَبِيٌّ فَمَا أَوَّلُ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا أَوَّلُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا يَنْزِعُ الْوَلَدُ إِلَى أَبِيهِ أَوْ إِلَى أُمِّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِنَّ جِبْرِيلُ آنِفًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ذَاكَ عَدُوُّ الْيَهُودِ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏<A id="q17" name="q17" href="javascript:openquran(1,97,97)"><c_q17>{‏مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَّلَهُ عَلَى قَلْبِكَ‏}</c_q17></a>‏ أَمَّا أَوَّلُ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ فَنَارٌ تَحْشُرُ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ، وَأَمَّا أَوَّلُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَزِيَادَةُ كَبِدِ حُوتٍ، وَإِذَا سَبَقَ مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ مَاءَ الْمَرْأَةِ نَزَعَ الْوَلَدَ، وَإِذَا سَبَقَ مَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ نَزَعَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ قَوْمٌ بُهُتٌ، وَإِنَّهُمْ إِنْ يَعْلَمُوا بِإِسْلاَمِي قَبْلَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَهُمْ يَبْهَتُونِي‏.‏ فَجَاءَتِ الْيَهُودُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىُّ رَجُلٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا خَيْرُنَا وَابْنُ خَيْرِنَا، وَسَيِّدُنَا وَابْنُ سَيِّدِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَسْلَمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا أَعَاذَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا شَرُّنَا وَابْنُ شَرِّنَا‏.‏ وَانْتَقَصُوهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُ أَخَافُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(7)</div><div class=englishchapter>His Statement: "Whatever a Verse (revelation) do We abrogate or cause to be forgotten, We bring a better one or similar to it..." (V.2:106)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ <a href="javascript:openquran(1, 106, 106)">‏{‏مَا نَنْسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نَنْسَأْهَا‏}‏</a> </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=8></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4481</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178080><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178080><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Umar said, "Our best Qur'an reciter is Ubai and our best judge is `Ali; and in spite of this, we leave 
some of the statements of Ubai because Ubai says, 'I do not leave anything that I have heard from 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while Allah: 
"Whatever verse (Revelations) do We abrogate or cause to be forgotten but We bring a better one or 
similar to it." (2.106)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَقْرَؤُنَا أُبَىٌّ، وَأَقْضَانَا عَلِيٌّ، وَإِنَّا لَنَدَعُ مِنْ قَوْلِ أُبَىٍّ، وَذَاكَ أَنَّ أُبَيًّا يَقُولُ لاَ أَدَعُ شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏مَا نَنْسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نَنْسَأْهَا‏}‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=9></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4482</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178090><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178090><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'The son of Adam tells a lie against me though he has no right to do so, 
and he abuses Me though he has no right to do so. As for his telling a lie against Me, it is that he 
claims that I cannot recreate him as I created him before; and as for his abusing Me, it is his statement 
that I have offspring. No! Glorified be Me! I am far from taking a wife or offspring.' "</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ كَذَّبَنِي ابْنُ آدَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، وَشَتَمَنِي وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَّا تَكْذِيبُهُ إِيَّاىَ فَزَعَمَ أَنِّي لاَ أَقْدِرُ أَنْ أُعِيدَهُ كَمَا كَانَ، وَأَمَّا شَتْمُهُ إِيَّاىَ فَقَوْلُهُ لِي وَلَدٌ، فَسُبْحَانِي أَنْ أَتَّخِذَ صَاحِبَةً أَوْ وَلَدًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=10></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4483</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178100><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178100><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Umar said, "I agreed with Allah in three things," or said, "My Lord agreed with me in three things. I 
said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Would that you took the station of Abraham as a place of prayer.' I also said, 
'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Good and bad persons visit you! Would that you ordered the Mothers of the 
believers to cover themselves with veils.' So the Divine Verses of Al-Hijab (i.e. veiling of the women) 
were revealed. I came to know that the Prophet (ﷺ) had blamed some of his wives so I entered upon them 
and said, 'You should either stop (troubling the Prophet (ﷺ) ) or else Allah will give His Apostle better 
wives than you.' When I came to one of his wives, she said to me, 'O `Umar! Does Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
haven't what he could advise his wives with, that you try to advise them?' " Thereupon Allah 
revealed:-- 
"It may be, if he divorced you (all) his Lord will give him instead of you, wives better than you 
Muslims (who submit to Allah).." (66.5)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ وَافَقْتُ اللَّهَ فِي ثَلاَثٍ ـ أَوْ وَافَقَنِي رَبِّي فِي ثَلاَثٍ ـ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوِ اتَّخَذْتَ مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرُ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحِجَابِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي مُعَاتَبَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْضَ نِسَائِهِ، فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِنَّ قُلْتُ إِنِ انْتَهَيْتُنَّ أَوْ لَيُبَدِّلَنَّ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ‏.‏ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ إِحْدَى نِسَائِهِ، قَالَتْ يَا عُمَرُ، أَمَا فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَعِظُ نِسَاءَهُ حَتَّى تَعِظَهُنَّ أَنْتَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q19" name="q19" href="javascript:openquran(65,5,5)"><c_q19>{‏عَسَى رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ‏}</c_q19></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏       
 وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا عَنْ عُمَرَ.</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=11></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4484</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178120><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178120><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>(The wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Don't you see that when your people built the Ka`ba, 
they did not build it on all Abraham's foundations?" I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why don't you rebuild 
it on Abraham's foundations?" He said, "Were your people not so close to (the period of Heathenism, 
i.e. the Period between their being Muslims and being infidels), I would do so." The sub-narrator, 
`Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Aisha had surely heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying that, for I do not think that 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left touching the two corners of the Ka`ba facing Al-Hijr except because the Ka`ba 
was not built on all Abraham's foundations."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَىْ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ بَنَوُا الْكَعْبَةَ وَاقْتَصَرُوا عَنْ قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ تَرُدُّهَا عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ حِدْثَانُ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ لَئِنْ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ سَمِعَتْ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أُرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرَكَ اسْتِلاَمَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ اللَّذَيْنِ يَلِيَانِ الْحِجْرَ، إِلاَّ أَنَّ الْبَيْتَ لَمْ يُتَمَّمْ عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4485</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178130><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178130><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The people of the Scripture (Jews) used to recite the Torah in Hebrew and they used to explain it in 
Arabic to the Muslims. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not believe the people of the Scripture or 
disbelieve them, but say:-- "We believe in Allah and what is revealed to us." (2.136)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَقْرَءُونَ التَّوْرَاةَ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ، وَيُفَسِّرُونَهَا بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ لأَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُصَدِّقُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلاَ تُكَذِّبُوهُمْ، وَقُولُوا ‏<A id="q22" name="q22" href="javascript:openquran(1,136,136)"><c_q22>{‏آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ‏}</c_q22></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=13></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4486</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178140><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178140><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed facing Bait-ulMaqdis (i.e. Jerusalem) for sixteen or seventeen months but he 
wished that his Qibla would be the Ka`ba (at Mecca). (So Allah Revealed (2.144) and he offered `Asr 
prayers(in his Mosque facing Ka`ba at Mecca) and some people prayed with him. A man from among 
those who had prayed with him, went out and passed by some people offering prayer in another 
mosque, and they were in the state of bowing. He said, "I, (swearing by Allah,) testify that I have 
prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) facing Mecca." Hearing that, they turned their faces to the Ka`ba while they 
were still bowing. Some men had died before the Qibla was changed towards the Ka`ba. They had 
been killed and we did not know what to say about them (i.e. whether their prayers towards Jerusalem 
were accepted or not). So Allah revealed:-- "And Allah would never make your faith (i.e. prayer) to be 
lost (i.e. your prayers offered (towards Jerusalem). Truly Allah is Full of Pity, Most Merciful towards 
mankind." (2.143)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، سَمِعَ زُهَيْرًا، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا أَوْ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا، وَكَانَ يُعْجِبُهُ أَنْ تَكُونَ قِبْلَتُهُ قِبَلَ الْبَيْتِ، وَإِنَّهُ صَلَّى ـ أَوْ صَلاَّهَا ـ صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ، وَصَلَّى مَعَهُ قَوْمٌ، فَخَرَجَ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ كَانَ صَلَّى مَعَهُ، فَمَرَّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُمْ رَاكِعُونَ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ بِاللَّهِ لَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِبَلَ مَكَّةَ، فَدَارُوا كَمَا هُمْ قِبَلَ الْبَيْتِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي مَاتَ عَلَى الْقِبْلَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَوَّلَ قِبَلَ الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ قُتِلُوا لَمْ نَدْرِ مَا نَقُولُ فِيهِمْ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q24" name="q24" href="javascript:openquran(1,143,143)"><c_q24>{‏وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ ‏}</c_q24></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(13)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah Jt: "Thus We have made of you [true Muslims— real believers of Islamic Monotheism, true followers of Prophet Muhammad jR and his Sunna (legal ways)], a just (and the best) nation, that you may be witnesses over mankind, and the Messenger (Muhammad ) will be a witness over you..." (V.2:143)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q25" name="q25" href="javascript:openquran(1,143,143)"><c_q25>{‏وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا‏}</c_q25></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=14></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4487</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178150><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178150><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Noah will be called on the Day of Resurrection and he will say, 'Labbaik and 
Sa`daik, O my Lord!' Allah will say, 'Did you convey the Message?' Noah will say, 'Yes.' His nation 
will then be asked, 'Did he convey the Message to you?' They will say, 'No Warner came to us.' Then 
Allah will say (to Noah), 'Who will bear witness in your favor?' He will say, 'Muhammad and his 
followers. So they (i.e. Muslims) will testify that he conveyed the Message. And the Apostle 
(Muhammad) will be a witness over yourselves, and that is what is meant by the Statement of Allah 
"Thus We have made of you a just and the best nation that you may be witnesses over mankind and 
the Apostle (Muhammad) will be a witness over yourselves." 
(2.143)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ـ وَاللَّفْظُ لِجَرِيرٍ ـ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، وَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُدْعَى نُوحٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ بَلَّغْتَ فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لأُمَّتِهِ هَلْ بَلَّغَكُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَا أَتَانَا مِنْ نَذِيرٍ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ فَيَقُولُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأُمَّتُهُ‏.‏ فَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏<A id="q26" name="q26" href="javascript:openquran(1,143,143)"><c_q26>{‏وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا‏}</c_q26></a>‏ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ ‏<A id="q27" name="q27" href="javascript:openquran(1,143,143)"><c_q27>{‏وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا‏}</c_q27></a>‏ وَالْوَسَطُ الْعَدْلُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=15></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4488</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178160><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178160><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While some people were offering Fajr prayer in the Quba' mosque, some-one came and said, "Allah 
has revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) Qur'anic instructions that you should face the Ka`ba (while praying) so 
you too, should face it." Those people then turned towards the Ka`ba.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ بَيْنَا النَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ الصُّبْحَ فِي مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ إِذْ جَاءَ جَاءٍ فَقَالَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُرْآنًا أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا‏.‏ فَتَوَجَّهُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=17></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4490</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178180><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178180><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While some people were offering morning prayer at Quba' a man came to them and said, "A Qur'anic 
Order has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tonight that he should face the Ka`ba at Mecca (in prayer), 
so you too should turn your faces towards it." At that moment their faces were towards Sham (i.e. 
Jerusalem) (and on hearing that) they turned towards the Ka`ba (at Mecca).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِقُبَاءٍ جَاءَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلَةَ قُرْآنٌ، وَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ أَلاَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا‏.‏ وَكَانَ وَجْهُ النَّاسِ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا بِوُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=18></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4491</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178190><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178190><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While some people were offering Fajr prayer at Quba' (mosque), some-one came to them and said, 
"Tonight some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he has been ordered to face the 
Ka`ba (at Mecca) (during prayers), so you too should turn your faces towards it." At that time their 
faces were towards Sham (Jerusalem) so they turned towards the Ka`ba (at Mecca).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَيْنَا النَّاسُ بِقُبَاءٍ فِي صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلَةَ قُرْآنٌ، وَقَدْ أُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=19></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4492</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178200><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178200><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>We prayed along with the Prophet (ﷺ) facing Jerusalem for sixteen or seventeen months. Then Allah 
ordered him to turn his face towards the Qibla (in Mecca):-- 
"And from whence-so-ever you start forth (for prayers) turn your face in the direction of (the Sacred 
Mosque of Mecca) Al-Masjid-ul Haram.." (2.149)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّيْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ ـ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ ـ شَهْرًا، ثُمَّ صَرَفَهُ نَحْوَ الْقِبْلَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=20></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4493</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178210><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178210><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While some people were at Quba (offering) morning prayer, a man came to them and said, "Last night 
Qur'anic Verses have been revealed whereby the Prophet (ﷺ) has been ordered to face the Ka`ba (at 
Mecca), so you too should face it." So they, keeping their postures, turned towards the Ka`ba. 
Formerly the people were facing Sham (Jerusalem) (Allah said):-- 
"And from whence-so-ever you start forth (for prayers), turn your face in the direction of the Sacred 
Mosque of Mecca (Al-Masjid-ul-Haram), and whence-so-ever you are, turn your face towards it 
(when you pray)" (2.150)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ بَيْنَا النَّاسُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِقُبَاءٍ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ أُنْزِلَ اللَّيْلَةَ قُرْآنٌ، فَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ، فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا‏.‏ وَاسْتَدَارُوا كَهَيْئَتِهِمْ، فَتَوَجَّهُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ وَكَانَ وَجْهُ النَّاسِ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=21></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4494</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178220><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178220><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While some people were offering Fajr prayer at Quba mosque, someone came to them and said, 
"Qur'anic literature" has been revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tonight, and he has been ordered to face the 
Ka`ba (of Mecca) so you too, should turn your faces towards it. Their faces were then towards Sham 
(Jerusalem), so they turned towards the Qibla (i.e. Ka`ba of Mecca).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ فِي صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ بِقُبَاءٍ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلَةَ، وَقَدْ أُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ، فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(21)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "Verily! A-afã and Al-Marwa (two mountains in Makkah) are of the Symbols of Allah..." (V.2:158)</div>
<div class=achapno>(21)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q38" name="q38" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q38>{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا وَمَنْ تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ‏}</c_q38></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">شَعَائِرُ عَلاَمَاتٌ، وَاحِدَتُهَا شَعِيرَةٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الصَّفْوَانُ الْحَجَرُ‏.‏ وَيُقَالُ الْحِجَارَةُ الْمُلْسُ الَّتِي لاَ تُنْبِتُ شَيْئًا، وَالْوَاحِدَةُ صَفْوَانَةٌ بِمَعْنَى الصَّفَا، وَالصَّفَا لِلْجَمِيعِ‏.‏</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178230>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=22></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4495</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178230><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178230><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa:</div><div class=text_details><p>I said to `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, and I was at that time a young boy, "How do you interpret the 
Statement of Allah: 
"Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah." 
So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj to the House of Allah) or perform the Umra, to 
ambulate (Tawaf) between them. In my opinion it is not sinful for one not to ambulate (Tawaf) 
between them." `Aisha said, "Your interpretation is wrong for as you say, the Verse should have been: 
"So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj or Umra to the House, not to ambulate (Tawaf) 
between them.' This Verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar who (during the Pre-Islamic 
Period) used to visit Manat (i.e. an idol) after assuming their Ihram, and it was situated near Qudaid 
(i.e. a place at Mecca), and they used to regard it sinful to ambulate between Safa and Marwa after 
embracing Islam. When Islam came, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah revealed:-- 
"Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah. So it is not 
harmful of those who perform the Hajj of the House (of Allah) or perform the Umra, to ambulate 
(Tawaf) between them." (2.158)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ حَدِيثُ السِّنِّ أَرَأَيْتِ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى ‏<A id="q39" name="q39" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q39>{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا‏}</c_q39></a>‏ فَمَا أُرَى عَلَى أَحَدٍ شَيْئًا أَنْ لاَ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كَلاَّ لَوْ كَانَتْ كَمَا تَقُولُ كَانَتْ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لاَ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا، إِنَّمَا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي الأَنْصَارِ، كَانُوا يُهِلُّونَ لِمَنَاةَ، وَكَانَتْ مَنَاةُ حَذْوَ قُدَيْدٍ، وَكَانُوا يَتَحَرَّجُونَ أَنْ يَطُوفُوا بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الإِسْلاَمُ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q40" name="q40" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q40>{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا‏}</c_q40></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=23></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4496</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178240><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178240><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Asim bin Sulaiman:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Anas bin Malik about Safa and Marwa. Anas replied, "We used to consider (i.e. going around) 
them a custom of the Pre-islamic period of Ignorance, so when Islam came, we gave up going around 
them. Then Allah revealed" "Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the 
Symbols of Allah. So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj of the House (of Allah) or 
perform the Umra to ambulate (Tawaf) between them." (2.158)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ الصَّفَا، وَالْمَرْوَةِ،‏.‏ فَقَالَ كُنَّا نَرَى أَنَّهُمَا مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الإِسْلاَمُ أَمْسَكْنَا عَنْهُمَا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q41" name="q41" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q41>{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ ‏}</c_q41></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q42" name="q42" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q42>{‏أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا‏}</c_q42></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(22)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah :"And of mankind are some who take (for worship) others besides Allah as rivals (to Allah). They love them as they love Allah..." (V.2:165)</div>
<div class=achapno>(22)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q43" name="q43" href="javascript:openquran(1,165,165)"><c_q43>{‏وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْدَادًا‏}</c_q43></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">أَضْدَادًا، وَاحِدُهَا نِدٌّ‏.‏</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=24></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4497</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178250><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178250><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said one statement and I said another. The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Whoever dies while still 
invoking anything other than Allah as a rival to Allah, will enter Hell (Fire)." And I said, "Whoever 
dies without invoking anything as a rival to Allah, will enter Paradise."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَلِمَةً وَقُلْتُ أُخْرَى قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَنْ مَاتَ وَهْوَ يَدْعُو مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ نِدًّا دَخَلَ النَّارَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ وَقُلْتُ أَنَا مَنْ مَاتَ وَهْوَ لاَ يَدْعُو لِلَّهِ نِدًّا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(23)</div><div class=englishchapter>"O you who believe! Al- Qisas (the Law of Equality in punishment) is prescribed for you..." (V.2:178)</div>
<div class=achapno>(23)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q44" name="q44" href="javascript:openquran(1,178,178)"><c_q44>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى الْحُرُّ بِالْحُرِّ‏}</c_q44></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">‏{‏عُفِيَ‏}‏ تُرِكَ‏.‏</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178260>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=25></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4498</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178260><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178260><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The law of Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment) was prescribed for the children of Israel, but the Diya 
(i.e. blood money was not ordained for them). So Allah said to this Nation (i.e. Muslims): 
"O you who believe! The law of Al-Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment) is prescribed for you in cases 
of murder: The free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. But if the 
relatives (or one of them) of the killed (person) forgive their brother (i.e. the killers something of 
Qisas (i.e. not to kill the killer by accepting blood money in the case of intentional murder)----then the 
relatives (of the killed person) should demand blood-money in a reasonable manner and the killer 
must pay with handsome gratitude. This is an allevitation and a Mercy from your Lord, (in 
comparison to what was prescribed for the nations before you). 
So after this, whoever transgresses the limits (i.e. to kill the killer after taking the blood-money) shall 
have a painful torment." (2.178)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْقِصَاصُ، وَلَمْ تَكُنْ فِيهِمُ الدِّيَةُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِهَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏{‏كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى الْحُرُّ بِالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ وَالأُنْثَى بِالأُنْثَى فَمَنْ عُفِيَ لَهُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏ فَالْعَفْوُ أَنْ يَقْبَلَ الدِّيَةَ فِي الْعَمْدِ ‏<A id="q45" name="q45" href="javascript:openquran(1,178,178)"><c_q45>{‏فَاتِّبَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَأَدَاءٌ إِلَيْهِ بِإِحْسَانٍ‏}</c_q45></a>‏ يَتَّبِعُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيُؤَدِّي بِإِحْسَانٍ، ‏<A id="q46" name="q46" href="javascript:openquran(1,178,178)"><c_q46>{‏ذَلِكَ تَخْفِيفٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ‏}</c_q46></a>‏ وَرَحْمَةٌ مِمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ‏.‏ ‏<A id="q47" name="q47" href="javascript:openquran(1,178,178)"><c_q47>{‏فَمَنِ اعْتَدَى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَهُ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}</c_q47></a>‏ قَتَلَ بَعْدَ قَبُولِ الدِّيَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=26></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4499</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178270><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178270><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=27></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4500</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178280><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178280><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>That his aunt, Ar-Rubai' broke an incisor tooth of a girl. My aunt's family requested the girl's relatives 
for forgiveness but they refused; then they proposed a compensation, but they refused. Then they went 
to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and refused everything except Al-Qisas (i.e. equality in punishment). So Allah's 
Apostle passed the judgment of Al-Qisas (i.e. equality of punishment). Anas bin Al-Nadr said, "O 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will the incisor tooth of Ar-Rubai be broken? No, by Him Who sent you with the 
Truth, her incisor tooth will not be broken." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Anas! The prescribed law of 
Allah is equality in punishment (i.e. Al-Qisas.)" Thereupon those people became satisfied and forgave 
her. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Among Allah's Worshippers there are some who, if they took Allah's 
Oath (for something), Allah fulfill their oaths."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ بَكْرٍ السَّهْمِيَّ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ الرُّبَيِّعَ، عَمَّتَهُ كَسَرَتْ ثَنِيَّةَ جَارِيَةٍ، فَطَلَبُوا إِلَيْهَا الْعَفْوَ فَأَبَوْا، فَعَرَضُوا الأَرْشَ فَأَبَوْا، فَأَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَوْا إِلاَّ الْقِصَاصَ، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْقِصَاصِ، فَقَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَتُكْسَرُ ثَنِيَّةُ الرُّبَيِّعِ لاَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لاَ تُكْسَرُ ثَنِيَّتُهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَنَسُ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ الْقِصَاصُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَضِيَ الْقَوْمُ فَعَفَوْا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(24)</div><div class=englishchapter>“O you who believe! Observing As-Saum (the fasting) is prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you that you, may become Al- Muttaqun (V.2:183).</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q48" name="q48" href="javascript:openquran(1,183,183)"><c_q48>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ‏}</c_q48></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=28></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4501</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178290><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178290><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>Fasting was observed on the day of 'Ashura' (i.e. 10th of Muharram) by the people of the Pre-lslamic 
Period. But when (the order of compulsory fasting) in the month of Ramadan was revealed, the 
Prophet said, "It is up to one to fast on it (i.e. day of 'Ashura') or not."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ عَاشُورَاءُ يَصُومُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ رَمَضَانُ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ، وَمَنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَصُمْهُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<a name=29></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4502</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178300><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178300><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<a name=30></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4503</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178310><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178310><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>That Al-Ash'ath entered upon him while he was eating. Al-Ash'ath said, "Today is 'Ashura." I said (to 
him), "Fasting had been observed (on such a day) before (the order of compulsory fasting in) 
Ramadan was revealed. But when (the order of fasting in) Ramadan was revealed, fasting (on 
'Ashura') was given up, so come and eat."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ الأَشْعَثُ وَهْوَ يَطْعَمُ فَقَالَ الْيَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَانَ يُصَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ رَمَضَانُ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ رَمَضَانُ تُرِكَ، فَادْنُ فَكُلْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=31></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4504</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178320><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178320><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>During the Pre-lslamic Period of ignorance the Quraish used to observe fasting on the day of 'Ashura', 
and the Prophet (ﷺ) himself used to observe fasting on it too. But when he came to Medina, he fasted on 
that day and ordered the Muslims to fast on it. When (the order of compulsory fasting in ) Ramadan 
was revealed, fasting in Ramadan became an obligation, and fasting on 'Ashura' was given up, and 
who ever wished to fast (on it) did so, and whoever did not wish to fast on it, did not fast.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ تَصُومُهُ قُرَيْشٌ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصُومُهُ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ صَامَهُ وَأَمَرَ بِصِيَامِهِ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ رَمَضَانُ كَانَ رَمَضَانُ الْفَرِيضَةَ، وَتُرِكَ عَاشُورَاءُ، فَكَانَ مَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ، وَمَنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَصُمْهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="clear"></div><div class=bottomItems>
<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4504">Sahih al-Bukhari 4504</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 31</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 31</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(41860, 'h178320')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4504')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><a name=C2.25></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(25)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "[Observing Saum (fasts)] for a fixed number of days but if any of you is ill, or on a journey, the same number (should be made up) from other days. And as for those who can fast with difficulty (e.g., an old man, etc.) they have (a choice, either to fast or) to feed a Miskin (poor person) (for every day). But whoever does good of his own accord, it is better for him. And that you fast is better for you, if only you know." (V.2:184)</div>
<div class=achapno>(25)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q49" name="q49" href="javascript:openquran(1,184,184)"><c_q49>{‏أَيَّامًا مَعْدُودَاتٍ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ فَمَنْ تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ وَأَنْ تَصُومُوا خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ‏}</c_q49></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ يُفْطِرُ مِنَ الْمَرَضِ كُلِّهِ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ فِي الْمُرْضِعِ وَالْحَامِلِ إِذَا خَافَتَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا أَوْ وَلَدِهِمَا تُفْطِرَانِ ثُمَّ تَقْضِيَانِ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا الشَّيْخُ الْكَبِيرُ إِذَا لَمْ يُطِقِ الصِّيَامَ، فَقَدْ أَطْعَمَ أَنَسٌ بَعْدَ مَا كَبِرَ عَامًا أَوْ عَامَيْنِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِينًا خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا وَأَفْطَرَ‏.‏ قِرَاءَةُ الْعَامَّةِ ‏{‏يُطِيقُونَهُ‏}‏ وَهْوَ أَكْثَرُ‏.‏</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178330>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=32></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4505</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178330><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178330><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated 'Ata:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he heard Ibn `Abbas reciting the Divine Verse:-- 
"And for those who can fast they had a choice either fast, or feed a poor for every day.." (2.184) Ibn 
`Abbas said, "This Verse is not abrogated, but it is meant for old men and old women who have no 
strength to fast, so they should feed one poor person for each day of fasting (instead of fasting).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقْرَأُ ‏<A id="q50" name="q50" href="javascript:openquran(1,184,184)"><c_q50>{‏وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطَوَّقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ ‏}</c_q50></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لَيْسَتْ بِمَنْسُوخَةٍ، هُوَ الشَّيْخُ الْكَبِيرُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ الْكَبِيرَةُ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعَانِ أَنْ يَصُومَا، فَلْيُطْعِمَانِ مَكَانَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِينًا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=34></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4507</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178350><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178350><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Salama:</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Divine Revelation: 
"For those who can fast, they had a choice either fast, or feed a poor for every day," (2.184) was 
revealed, it was permissible for one to give a ransom and give up fasting, till the Verse succeeding it 
was revealed and abrogated it.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q53" name="q53" href="javascript:openquran(1,184,184)"><c_q53>{‏وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ‏}</c_q53></a>‏ كَانَ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ وَيَفْتَدِيَ حَتَّى نَزَلَتِ الآيَةُ الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا فَنَسَخَتْهَا‏.‏ مَاتَ بُكَيْرٌ قَبْلَ يَزِيدَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(27)</div><div class=englishchapter>"It is made lawful for you to have sexual relation with your wives on the night of As-Saum (the fasts) ... (till) ... and seek that which Allah has ordained for you (offspring).. ." (V.2:187)</div>
<div class=achapno>(27)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q54" name="q54" href="javascript:openquran(1,187,187)"><c_q54>{‏أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَى نِسَائِكُمْ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَهُنَّ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنْكُمْ فَالآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ‏}</c_q54></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=35></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4508</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178360><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178360><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara':</div><div class=text_details><p>When the order of compulsory fasting of Ramadan was revealed, the people did not have sexual 
relations with their wives for the whole month of Ramadan, but some men cheated themselves (by 
violating that restriction). So Allah revealed: "Allah is aware that you were deceiving yourselves but 
He accepted your repentance and forgave you.." (3.187)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُرَيْحُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏ لَمَّا نَزَلَ صَوْمُ رَمَضَانَ كَانُوا لاَ يَقْرَبُونَ النِّسَاءَ رَمَضَانَ كُلَّهُ، وَكَانَ رِجَالٌ يَخُونُونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q55" name="q55" href="javascript:openquran(1,187,187)"><c_q55>{‏عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنْكُمْ‏}</c_q55></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=36></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4509</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178370><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178370><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Adi took a white rope (or thread) and a black one, and when some part of the night had passed, he 
looked at them but he could not distinguish one from the other. The next morning he said, "O Allah's 
Apostle! I put (a white thread and a black thread) underneath my pillow." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then 
your pillow is too wide if the white thread (of dawn) and the black thread (of the night) are underneath 
your pillow! "</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ أَخَذَ عَدِيٌّ عِقَالاً أَبْيَضَ وَعِقَالاً أَسْوَدَ حَتَّى كَانَ بَعْضُ اللَّيْلِ نَظَرَ فَلَمْ يَسْتَبِينَا، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، جَعَلْتُ تَحْتَ وِسَادَتِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ إِنَّ وِسَادَكَ إِذًا لَعَرِيضٌ أَنْ كَانَ الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ وَالأَسْوَدُ تَحْتَ وِسَادَتِكَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=37></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4510</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178380><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178380><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:</div><div class=text_details><p>I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the meaning of the white thread distinct from the black thread? Are 
these two threads?" He said, "You are not intelligent if you watch the two threads." He then added, 
"No, it is the darkness of the night and the whiteness of the day.''</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ أَهُمَا الْخَيْطَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَعَرِيضُ الْقَفَا إِنْ أَبْصَرْتَ الْخَيْطَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ هُوَ سَوَادُ اللَّيْلِ وَبَيَاضُ النَّهَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=38></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4511</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178390><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178390><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d The Verse "And eat and drink until the white thread appears to you distinct:</div><div class=text_details><p>from the black thread." was revealed, but: '... of dawn' was not revealed (along with it) so some men, 
when intending to fast, used to tie their legs, one with white thread and the other with black thread and 
would keep on eating till they could distinguish one thread from the other. Then Allah revealed' ... of 
dawn,' whereupon they understood that meant the night and the day.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ وَأُنْزِلَتْ ‏<A id="q57" name="q57" href="javascript:openquran(1,187,187)"><c_q57>{‏وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ‏}</c_q57></a>‏ وَلَمْ يُنْزَلْ ‏<A id="q58" name="q58" href="javascript:openquran(1,187,187)"><c_q58>{‏مِنَ الْفَجْرِ‏}</c_q58></a>‏ وَكَانَ رِجَالٌ إِذَا أَرَادُوا الصَّوْمَ رَبَطَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رِجْلَيْهِ الْخَيْطَ الأَبْيَضَ وَالْخَيْطَ الأَسْوَدَ، وَلاَ يَزَالُ يَأْكُلُ حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُ رُؤْيَتُهُمَا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بَعْدَهُ ‏<A id="q59" name="q59" href="javascript:openquran(1,187,187)"><c_q59>{‏مِنَ الْفَجْرِ‏}</c_q59></a>‏ فَعَلِمُوا أَنَّمَا يَعْنِي اللَّيْلَ مِنَ النَّهَارِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=39></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4512</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178400><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178400><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>In the Pre-lslamic Period when the people assumed Ihram, they would enter their houses from the 
back. So Allah revealed:-- 
"And it is not righteousness that you enter houses from the back, but the righteous man is he who fears 
Allah, obeys His Orders and keeps away from what He has forbidden. So enter houses through their 
doors." (2.189)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ كَانُوا إِذَا أَحْرَمُوا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَتَوُا الْبَيْتَ مِنْ ظَهْرِهِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q61" name="q61" href="javascript:openquran(1,189,189)"><c_q61>{‏وَلَيْسَ الْبِرُّ بِأَنْ تَأْتُوا الْبُيُوتَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهَا وَلَكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنِ اتَّقَى وَأْتُوا الْبُيُوتَ مِنْ أَبْوَابِهَا‏}</c_q61></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(30)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "And fight them until there is no more Fitnah (disbelief and worshipping of others along with Allah) and (all and every kind of) worship is for Allah (Alone). But if they cease, let there be no transgression except against Az-Zalimün (the polytheists and wrong-doers) ." (V.2:193)</div>
<div class=achapno>(30)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q62" name="q62" href="javascript:openquran(1,193,193)"><c_q62>{‏وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّى لاَ تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ انْتَهَوْا فَلاَ عُدْوَانَ إِلاَّ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ‏}</c_q62></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
