<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter> "By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, righteousness; it means here Allah's Reward, i.e., Paradise) unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love..." (V.3:92)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q18" name="q18" href="javascript:openquran(2,92,92)"><c_q18>{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}</c_q18></a>‏ إِلَى ‏{‏بِهِ عَلِيمٌ‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178830>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=76></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4554</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178830><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178830><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>Out of all the Ansar, living in Medina, Abu Talha had the largest number of (date palm trees) gardens, 
and the most beloved of his property to him was Bairuha garden which was standing opposite the 
Mosque (of the Prophet). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to enter it and drink of its good water. When the 
Verse:--"By no means shall you attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you 
love." (3.92) Abu Talha got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Allah says:--"By no means shall you 
attain righteousness unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love." (3.92) and the most beloved 
of my property to me is the Bairuha garden, so I give it (as a charitable gift) in Allah's Cause and hope 
to receive good out of it, and to have it stored for me with Allah. So, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Dispose it of 
(i.e. utilize it) in the way Allah orders you (to dispose it of)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bravo! That is a 
fruitful property! That is a fruitful property! I have heard what you have said and I think that you 
should distribute that (garden) amongst your relatives." The Abu Talha distributed that garden 
amongst his relatives and his cousins.
<p>
Narrated Yahya bin Yahya:
<p>
I learnt from Malik, "..a fruitful property."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ نَخْلاً، وَكَانَ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرُحَاءٍ، وَكَانَتْ مُسْتَقْبِلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٍ، فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏<A id="q19" name="q19" href="javascript:openquran(2,92,92)"><c_q19>{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}</c_q19></a>‏ قَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏<A id="q20" name="q20" href="javascript:openquran(2,92,92)"><c_q20>{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}</c_q20></a>‏ وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِي إِلَىَّ بَيْرُحَاءٍ وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ لِلَّهِ، أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَضَعْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَيْثُ أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَخْ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا فِي الأَقْرَبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَفْعَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَسَمَهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي أَقَارِبِهِ وَبَنِي عَمِّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَرَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ مَالٌ رَايِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=77></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4555</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178840><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178840><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>

<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Say (O Muḥammad pbuh): Bring here the Taurāt (Torah) and recite it, if you are truthful." (V.3:93)</div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q21" name="q21" href="javascript:openquran(2,93,93)"><c_q21>{‏قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ‏}</c_q21></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178850>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=78></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4556</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178850><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178850><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Jews brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) a man and a woman from among them who had committed illegal 
sexual intercourse. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to them, "How do you usually punish the one amongst you who 
has committed illegal sexual intercourse?" They replied, "We blacken their faces with coal and beat 
them," He said, "Don't you find the order of Ar-Rajm (i.e. stoning to death) in the Torah?" They 
replied, "We do not find anything in it." `Abdullah bin Salam (after hearing this conversation) said to 
them. "You have told a lie! Bring here the Torah and recite it if you are truthful." (So the Jews brought 
the Torah). And the religious teacher who was teaching it to them, put his hand over the Verse of Ar- 
Rajm and started reading what was written above and below the place hidden with his hand, but he did 
not read the Verse of Ar-Rajm. `Abdullah bin Salam removed his (i.e. the teacher's) hand from the 
Verse of Ar-Rajm and said, "What is this?" So when the Jews saw that Verse, they said, "This is the 
Verse of Ar-Rajm." So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the two adulterers to be stoned to death, and they were 
stoned to death near the place where biers used to be placed near the Mosque. I saw her companion 
(i.e. the adulterer) bowing over her so as to protect her from the stones.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، جَاءُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَفْعَلُونَ بِمَنْ زَنَى مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نُحَمِّمُهُمَا وَنَضْرِبُهُمَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ الرَّجْمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ نَجِدُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ كَذَبْتُمْ ‏<A id="q22" name="q22" href="javascript:openquran(2,93,93)"><c_q22>{‏فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ‏}</c_q22></a>‏ فَوَضَعَ مِدْرَاسُهَا الَّذِي يُدَرِّسُهَا مِنْهُمْ كَفَّهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَطَفِقَ يَقْرَأُ مَا دُونَ يَدِهِ وَمَا وَرَاءَهَا، وَلاَ يَقْرَأُ آيَةَ الرَّجْمِ، فَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ عَنْ آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ فَقَالَ مَا هَذِهِ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِكَ قَالُوا هِيَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا فَرُجِمَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ حَيْثُ مَوْضِعُ الْجَنَائِزِ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَرَأَيْتُ صَاحِبَهَا يَجْنَأُ عَلَيْهَا يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=79></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4557</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178860><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178860><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Verse:--"You (true Muslims) are the best of peoples ever raised up for mankind." means, the best 
of peoples for the people, as you bring them with chains on their necks till they embrace Islam.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَة َ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏<A id="q24" name="q24" href="javascript:openquran(2,110,110)"><c_q24>{‏كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ‏}</c_q24></a>‏ قَالَ خَيْرَ النَّاسِ لِلنَّاسِ، تَأْتُونَ بِهِمْ فِي السَّلاَسِلِ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلُوا فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=80></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4558</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178870><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178870><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Verse:--"When two parties from among you were about to lose heart, but Allah was their 
Protector," (3.122) was revealed concerning us, and we were the two parties, i.e. Banu Haritha and 
Banu Salama, and we do not wish (that it had not been revealed) or I would not have been pleased (if 
it had not been revealed), for Allah says:--"...Allah was their Protector."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّه ِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ فِينَا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q26" name="q26" href="javascript:openquran(2,122,122)"><c_q26>{‏إِذْ هَمَّتْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ تَفْشَلاَ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا‏}</c_q26></a>‏ قَالَ نَحْنُ الطَّائِفَتَانِ بَنُو حَارِثَةَ وَبَنُو سَلِمَةَ، وَمَا نُحِبُّ ـ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً وَمَا يَسُرُّنِي ـ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تُنْزَلْ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏<A id="q27" name="q27" href="javascript:openquran(2,122,122)"><c_q27>{‏وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا‏}</c_q27></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=81></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4559</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178880><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178880><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Salim's father:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on raising his head from the bowing in the last rak`a in the Fajr prayer, 
saying, "O Allah, curse such-and-such person and such-and-such person, and such-and-such person," 
after saying, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him, O our Lord, all praise is for you." So 
Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision, verily they are indeed 
wrongdoers." (3.128)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ بَعْدَ مَا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q28" name="q28" href="javascript:openquran(2,128,128)"><c_q28>{‏فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ‏}</c_q28></a>‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=82></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4560</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178890><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178890><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to invoke evil upon somebody or invoke good upon somebody, he 
used to invoke (Allah after bowing (in the prayer). Sometimes after saying, "Allah hears him who 
sends his praises to Him, all praise is for You, O our Lord," he would say, "O Allah. Save Al-Walid 
bin Al-Walid and Salama bin Hisham, and `Aiyash bin Abu Rabi`a. O Allah! Inflict Your Severe 
Torture on Mudar (tribe) and strike them with (famine) years like the years of Joseph." The Prophet (ﷺ) 
used to say in a loud voice, and he also used to say in some of his Fajr prayers, "O Allah! Curse soand- 
so and so-and-so." naming some of the Arab tribes till Allah revealed:--"Not for you (O 
Muhammad) (but for Allah) is the decision." (3.128)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ أَوْ يَدْعُوَ لأَحَدٍ قَنَتَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ، فَرُبَّمَا قَالَ إِذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَعَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ وَاجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَجْهَرُ بِذَلِكَ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي بَعْضِ صَلاَتِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ لأَحْيَاءٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=83></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4561</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178900><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178900><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed `Abdullah bin Jubair as the commander of the infantry during the battle of 
Uhud. They returned defeated, and that is what is meant by:-- 
"And the Apostle was calling them back in the rear. None remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) then, but twelve 
men."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الرَّجَّالَةِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، وَأَقْبَلُوا مُنْهَزِمِينَ، فَذَاكَ إِذْ يَدْعُوهُمُ الرَّسُولُ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ، وَلَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=85></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4563</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178920><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178920><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>'Allah is Sufficient for us and He Is the Best Disposer of affairs," was said by Abraham when he was 
thrown into the fire; and it was said by Muhammad when they (i.e. hypocrites) said, "A great army is 
gathering against you, therefore, fear them," but it only increased their faith and they said: "Allah is 
Sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs, for us)." (3.173)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ ـ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ـ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏<A id="q34" name="q34" href="javascript:openquran(2,173,173)"><c_q34>{‏حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}</c_q34></a>‏ قَالَهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ حِينَ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ، وَقَالَهَا مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالُوا ‏<A id="q35" name="q35" href="javascript:openquran(2,173,173)"><c_q35>{‏إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}</c_q35></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=87></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4565</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178940><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178940><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone whom Allah has given wealth but he does not pay its Zakat, then, on 
the Day of Resurrection, his wealth will be presented to him in the shape of a bald-headed poisonous 
male snake with two poisonous glands in its mouth and it will encircle itself round his neck and bite 
him over his cheeks and say, "I am your wealth; I am your treasure." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited this 
Divine Verse:-- 
"And let not those who covetously withhold of that which Allah has bestowed upon them of His 
Bounty." (3.180)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَلَمْ يُؤَدِّ زَكَاتَهُ، مُثِّلَ لَهُ مَالُهُ شُجَاعًا أَقْرَعَ، لَهُ زَبِيبَتَانِ يُطَوَّقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، يَأْخُذُ بِلِهْزِمَتَيْهِ ـ يَعْنِي بِشِدْقَيْهِ ـ يَقُولُ أَنَا مَالُكَ أَنَا كَنْزُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَلاَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏<A id="q37" name="q37" href="javascript:openquran(2,180,180)"><c_q37>{‏وَلاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ‏}</c_q37></a>‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(15)</div><div class=englishchapter>"...And you shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who received the Scripture before you (Jews and Christians) and from those who ascribe partners to Allāh.. ." (V.3:186)</div>
<div class=achapno>(15)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q38" name="q38" href="javascript:openquran(2,186,186)"><c_q38>{‏وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا أَذًى كَثِيرًا‏}</c_q38></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178950>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=88></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4566</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178950><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178950><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Usama bin Zaid:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey, equipped with a thick cloth-covering made in Fadak and was riding 
behind him. He was going to pay visit to Sa`d bin Ubada in Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj; and this 
incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah 
bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that was before `Abdullah bin Ubai embraced Islam. Behold in 
that gathering there were people of different religions: there were Muslims, pagans, idol-worshippers 
and Jews, and in that gathering `Abdullah bin Rawaha was also present. When a cloud of dust raised 
by the donkey reached that gathering, `Abdullah bin Ubai covered his nose with his garment and then 
said, "Do not cover us with dust." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greeted them and stopped and dismounted and 
invited them to Allah (i.e. to embrace Islam) and recited to them the Holy Qur'an. On that, `Abdullah 
bin Ubai bin Saluil said, "O man ! There is nothing better than that what you say. If it is the truth, then 
do not trouble us with it in our gatherings. Return to your mount (or residence) and if somebody 
comes to you, relate (your tales) to him." On that `Abdullah bin Rawaha said, "Yes, O Allah's 
Apostle! Bring it (i.e. what you want to say) to us in our gathering, for we love that." 
So the Muslims, the pagans and the Jews started abusing one another till they were on the point of 
fighting with one another. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became quiet, whereupon the 
Prophet rode his animal (mount) and proceeded till he entered upon Sa`d bin Ubada. The Prophet (ﷺ) said 
to Sa`d, "Did you not hear what 'Abu Hub-b said?" He meant `Abdullah bin Ubai. "He said so-andso." 
On that Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Excuse and forgive him, for by Him Who 
revealed the Book to you, Allah brought the Truth which was sent to you at the time when the people 
of this town (i.e. Medina) had decided unanimously to crown him and tie a turban on his head 
(electing him as chief). But when Allah opposed that (decision) through the Truth which Allah gave to 
you, he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Ubai) was grieved with jealously. and that caused him to do what you have 
seen." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) excused him, for the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions used to forgive the pagans 
and the people of Scripture as Allah had ordered them, and they used to put up with their mischief 
with patience. Allah said: "And you shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who 
received the Scripture before you and from the pagans........'(3.186) And Allah also said:--"Many of 
the people of the Scripture wish if they could turn you away as disbelievers after you have believed, 
from selfish envy.." (2.109) 
So the Prophet (ﷺ) used to stick to the principle of forgiveness for them as long as Allah ordered him to do 
so till Allah permitted fighting them. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the battle of Badr and Allah 
killed the nobles of Quraish infidels through him, Ibn Ubai bin Salul and the pagans and idolaters who 
were with him, said, "This matter (i.e. Islam) has appeared (i.e. became victorious)." So they gave the 
pledge of allegiance (for embracing Islam) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and became Muslims.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ عَلَى قَطِيفَةٍ فَدَكِيَّةٍ، وَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَرَاءَهُ، يَعُودُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ فِي بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ قَبْلَ وَقْعَةِ بَدْرٍ ـ قَالَ ـ حَتَّى مَرَّ بِمَجْلِسٍ فِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ، ابْنُ سَلُولَ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ فَإِذَا فِي الْمَجْلِسِ أَخْلاَطٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ عَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ وَالْيَهُودِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَفِي الْمَجْلِسِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ، فَلَمَّا غَشِيَتِ الْمَجْلِسَ عَجَاجَةُ الدَّابَّةِ خَمَّرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ أَنْفَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ تُغَبِّرُوا عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ فَسَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ وَقَفَ فَنَزَلَ فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ أَيُّهَا الْمَرْءُ، إِنَّهُ لاَ أَحْسَنَ مِمَّا تَقُولُ، إِنْ كَانَ حَقًّا، فَلاَ تُؤْذِينَا بِهِ فِي مَجْلِسِنَا، ارْجِعْ إِلَى رَحْلِكَ، فَمَنْ جَاءَكَ فَاقْصُصْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَاغْشَنَا بِهِ فِي مَجَالِسِنَا، فَإِنَّا نُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَاسْتَبَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْيَهُودُ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَتَثَاوَرُونَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخَفِّضُهُمْ حَتَّى سَكَنُوا، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَابَّتَهُ فَسَارَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا سَعْدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالَ أَبُو حُبَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ ‏"‏ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اعْفُ عَنْهُ وَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُ، فَوَالَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ، لَقَدْ جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ، لَقَدِ اصْطَلَحَ أَهْلُ هَذِهِ الْبُحَيْرَةِ عَلَى أَنْ يُتَوِّجُوهُ فَيُعَصِّبُونَهُ بِالْعِصَابَةِ، فَلَمَّا أَبَى اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ شَرِقَ بِذَلِكَ، فَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ بِهِ ما رَأَيْتَ‏.‏ فَعَفَا عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ يَعْفُونَ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ كَمَا أَمَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ، وَيَصْبِرُونَ عَلَى الأَذَى قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q39" name="q39" href="javascript:openquran(2,186,186)"><c_q39>{‏وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا أَذًى كَثِيرًا ‏}</c_q39></a>‏ الآيَةَ، وَقَالَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q40" name="q40" href="javascript:openquran(1,109,109)"><c_q40>{‏وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}</c_q40></a>‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَأَوَّلُ الْعَفْوَ مَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ، حَتَّى أَذِنَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ، فَلَمَّا غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَدْرًا، فَقَتَلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ صَنَادِيدَ كُفَّارِ قُرَيْشٍ قَالَ ابْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ، وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَعَبَدَةِ الأَوْثَانِ هَذَا أَمْرٌ قَدْ تَوَجَّهَ‏.‏ فَبَايَعُوا الرَّسُولَ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ فَأَسْلَمُوا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(16)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Think not that those who rejoice in what they have done (or brought about)..." (V.3:188)</div>
<div class=achapno>(16)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏{‏لاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178960>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=89></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4567</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178960><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178960><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:</div><div class=text_details><p>During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), some men among the hypocrites used to remain behind him 
(i.e. did not accompany him) when he went out for a Ghazwa and they would be pleased to stay at 
home behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned (from the battle) they would put forward 
(false) excuses and take oaths, wishing to be praised for what they had not done. So there was 
revealed:-- 
"Think not that those who rejoice in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have 
not done.." (3.188)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رِجَالاً مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْغَزْوِ تَخَلَّفُوا عَنْهُ، وَفَرِحُوا بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلاَفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَذَرُوا إِلَيْهِ وَحَلَفُوا، وَأَحَبُّوا أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا، فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏لاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=90></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4568</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178970><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178970><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Alqama bin Waqqas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Marwan said to his gatekeeper, "Go to Ibn `Abbas, O Rafi`, and say, 'If everybody who rejoices in 
what he has done, and likes to be praised for what he has not done, will be punished, then all of us will 
be punished." Ibn `Abbas said, "What connection have you with this case? It was only that the Prophet (ﷺ) 
called the Jews and asked them about something, and they hid the truth and told him something else, 
and showed him that they deserved praise for the favor of telling him the answer to his question, and 
they became happy with what they had concealed. 
Then Ibn `Abbas recited:-- 
"(And remember) when Allah took a Covenant from those who were given the Scripture..and those 
who rejoice in what they have done and love to be praised for what they have not done.' " (3.187-188)

<p><i>
Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf narrated that Marwan had told him (the above narration).</i></b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَقَّاصٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ لِبَوَّابِهِ اذْهَبْ يَا رَافِعُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْ لَئِنْ كَانَ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ فَرِحَ بِمَا أُوتِيَ، وَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلْ، مُعَذَّبًا، لَنُعَذَّبَنَّ أَجْمَعُونَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ وَلِهَذِهِ إِنَّمَا دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَهُودَ فَسَأَلَهُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، فَكَتَمُوهُ إِيَّاهُ، وَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِغَيْرِهِ، فَأَرَوْهُ أَنْ قَدِ اسْتَحْمَدُوا إِلَيْهِ بِمَا أَخْبَرُوهُ عَنْهُ فِيمَا سَأَلَهُمْ، وَفَرِحُوا بِمَا أُوتُوا مِنْ كِتْمَانِهِمْ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏<A id="q41" name="q41" href="javascript:openquran(2,187,187)"><c_q41>{‏وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ‏}</c_q41></a>‏ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q42" name="q42" href="javascript:openquran(2,188,188)"><c_q42>{‏يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا‏}</c_q42></a>‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ‏.‏       <br><p>
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بِهَذَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(17)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "Verily! In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding." (V.3:190)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q43" name="q43" href="javascript:openquran(2,190,190)"><c_q43>{‏إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ‏}</c_q43></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h178990>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=91></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4569</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc178990><div class="englishcontainer" id=t178990><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked with his wife for a while 
and then went to bed. When it was the last third of the night, he got up and looked towards the sky and 
said: 
"Verily! In the creation of the Heavens and the Earth and in the alteration of night and day, there are 
indeed signs for men of understanding." (3.190) 
Then he stood up, performed ablution, brushed his teeth with a Siwak, and then prayed eleven rak`at. 
Then Bilal pronounced the Adhan (i.e. call for the Fajr prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) then offered two rak`at 
(Sunna) prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ، فَتَحَدَّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَقَدَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ قَعَدَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏<A id="q44" name="q44" href="javascript:openquran(2,190,190)"><c_q44>{‏إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لآيَاتٍ لأُولِي الأَلْبَابِ‏}</c_q44></a>‏، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَاسْتَنَّ، فَصَلَّى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=92></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4570</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179000><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179000><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(One night) I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna, and said to myself, "I will watch the 
prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) " My aunt placed a cushion for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he slept on it in its 
length-wise direction and (woke-up) rubbing the traces of sleep off his face and then he recited the last 
ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran till he finished it. Then he went to a hanging water skin and took it, 
performed the ablution and then stood up to offer the prayer. I got up and did the same as he had done, 
and stood beside him. He put his hand on my head and held me by the ear and twisted it. He offered 
two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, and 
finally the witr (i.e. one rak`a) prayer.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَقُلْتُ لأَنْظُرَنَّ إِلَى صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطُرِحَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وِسَادَةٌ، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طُولِهَا، فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الآيَاتِ الْعَشْرَ الأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ حَتَّى خَتَمَ، ثُمَّ أَتَى شَنًّا مُعَلَّقًا، فَأَخَذَهُ فَتَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِي، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي، فَجَعَلَ يَفْتِلُهَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(19)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him and never will the Ẓalimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers) find any helpers." (V.3:192)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q46" name="q46" href="javascript:openquran(2,191,191)"><c_q46>{‏رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ‏}</c_q46></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179010>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=93></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4571</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179010><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179010><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>That once he stayed overnight (in the house) of his aunt Maimuna. the wife of the Prophet. He added: 
I lay on the cushion transversely and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise 
direction of the pillow. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit 
after it, and then woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands and then he recited the 
last ten Verses of Surat-al-`Imran, got up and went to a hanging water skin. He then performed the 
ablution from it, and it was perfect ablution, and then stood up to offer the prayer. I too did the same 
as he had done, and then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and 
held and twisted my right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two 
rak`at, then two rak`at. then two rak`at, and finally one rak`a, the witr. Then he lay down again till the 
Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two-rak`at 
prayer, and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ، أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(20)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Our Lord! Verily, we have heard the call of one (i.e., Muḥammad pbuh) calling to Faith..." (V.3:193) </div>
<div class=achapno>(20)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q47" name="q47" href="javascript:openquran(2,191,191)"><c_q47>{‏رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا، يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ‏}</c_q47></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179020>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=94></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4572</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179020><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179020><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>That once he stayed overnight in the house of his aunt, the wife of the Prophet. He added: I lay on the 
cushion transversely while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lay along with his wife in the lengthwise direction of 
cushion. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it, and then 
woke up rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands, and then recited the last ten Verses of 
Suratal-`Imran. Then he got up and went to a hanging water skin, performed ablution from it ---- and 
performed it perfectly. Then he stood up to perform the prayer. I also did the same as he had done and 
then went to stand beside him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head and held and twisted my 
right ear. He then offered two rak`at, then two rak`at then two rak`at, then two then two rak`at, then 
two rak`at, and finally, one rak`a witr. Then lay down again till the Muadhdhin (i.e. the call-maker) 
came to him, whereupon he got up and offered a light two rak`at prayer and went out (to the Mosque) 
and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ، أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَلَسَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ ثُمَّ، اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْتَنْكِفُ يَسْتَكْبِرُ      <br>
<br><br>
قِوَامًا قِوَامُكُمْ مِنْ مَعَايِشِكُمْ‏.‏ ‏<a id="q48" name="q48" href="javascript:openquran(3,15,15)"><c_q48>{‏لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً‏}</c_q48></a>‏ يَعْنِي الرَّجْمَ لِلثَّيِّبِ وَالْجَلْدَ لِلْبِكْرِ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ ‏{‏مَثْنَى وَثُلاَثَ‏}‏ يَعْنِي اثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَلاَثًا وَأَرْبَعًا، وَلاَ تُجَاوِزُ الْعَرَبُ رُبَاعَ‏.‏</div>

<a name=C4.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And if you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (V.4:3)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179030>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=95></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4573</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179030><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179030><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>There was an orphan (girl) under the care of a man. He married her and she owned a date palm 
(garden). He married her just because of that and not because he loved her. So the Divine Verse came 
regarding his case: "If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) 
The sub-narrator added: I think he (i.e. another sub-narrator) said, "That orphan girl was his partner in 
that datepalm (garden) and in his property."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، كَانَتْ لَهُ يَتِيمَةٌ فَنَكَحَهَا، وَكَانَ لَهَا عَذْقٌ، وَكَانَ يُمْسِكُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا مِنْ نَفْسِهِ شَىْءٌ فَنَزَلَتْ فِيهِ ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ كَانَتْ شَرِيكَتَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْعَذْقِ وَفِي مَالِهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4573">Sahih al-Bukhari 4573</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 95</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 97</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(42520, 'h179030')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4573')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179040>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=96></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4574</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179040><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179040><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he asked `Aisha regarding the Statement of Allah: 
"If you fear that you shall not be able to deal justly with the orphan girls..." (4.3) She said, "O son of 
my sister! An Orphan girl used to be under the care of a guardian with whom she shared property. Her 
guardian, being attracted by her wealth and beauty, would intend to marry her without giving her a 
just Mahr, i.e. the same Mahr as any other person might give her (in case he married her). So such 
guardians were forbidden to do that unless they did justice to their female wards and gave them the 
highest Mahr their peers might get. They were ordered (by Allah, to marry women of their choice 
other than those orphan girls." `Aisha added," The people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) his instructions after 
the revelation of this Divine Verse whereupon Allah revealed: 
"They ask your instruction regarding women " (4.127) `Aisha further said, "And the Statement of 
Allah: "And yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) as anyone of you refrains from marrying an 
orphan girl (under his guardianship) when she is lacking in property and beauty." `Aisha added, "So 
they were forbidden to marry those orphan girls for whose wealth and beauty they had a desire unless 
with justice, and that was because they would refrain from marrying them if they were lacking in 
property and beauty."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ، تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي، هَذِهِ الْيَتِيمَةُ تَكُونُ فِي حَجْرِ وَلِيِّهَا، تَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ وَيُعْجِبُهُ مَالُهَا وَجَمَالُهَا، فَيُرِيدُ وَلِيُّهَا أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا، بِغَيْرِ أَنْ يُقْسِطَ فِي صَدَاقِهَا، فَيُعْطِيَهَا مِثْلَ مَا يُعْطِيهَا غَيْرُهُ، فَنُهُوا عَنْ أَنْ يَنْكِحُوهُنَّ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقْسِطُوا لَهُنَّ، وَيَبْلُغُوا لَهُنَّ أَعْلَى سُنَّتِهِنَّ فِي الصَّدَاقِ، فَأُمِرُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَهُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ سِوَاهُنَّ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَإِنَّ النَّاسَ اسْتَفْتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q49" name="q49" href="javascript:openquran(3,127,127)"><c_q49>{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ‏}</c_q49></a>‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَقَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي آيَةٍ أُخْرَى ‏<A id="q50" name="q50" href="javascript:openquran(3,127,127)"><c_q50>{‏وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}</c_q50></a>‏ رَغْبَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ عَنْ يَتِيمَتِهِ حِينَ تَكُونُ قَلِيلَةَ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ قَالَتْ فَنُهُوا أَنْ يَنْكِحُوا عَنْ مَنْ رَغِبُوا فِي مَالِهِ وَجَمَالِهِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ، إِلاَّ بِالْقِسْطِ، مِنْ أَجْلِ رَغْبَتِهِمْ عَنْهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ قَلِيلاَتِ الْمَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"...But if he (the guardian) is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable (according to his work). And when you release their property to them, take witness in their presence; and Allah is All-Sufficient in taking account." (V.4:6)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q51" name="q51" href="javascript:openquran(3,6,6)"><c_q51>{‏وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ‏}</c_q51></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">‏{‏وَبِدَارًا‏}:‏ مُبَادَرَةً. ‏{‏أَعْتَدْنَا‏}:‏ أَعْدَدْنَا، أَفْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْعَتَادِ‏.‏</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179050>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=97></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4575</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179050><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179050><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>regarding the Statement of Allah: "And whoever amongst the guardian is rich, he should take no 
wages, but if he is poor, let him have for himself what is just and reasonable (according to his work). 
This Verse was revealed regarding the orphan's property. If the guardian is poor, he can take from the 
property of the orphan, what is just and reasonable according to his work and the time he spends on 
managing it.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q52" name="q52" href="javascript:openquran(3,6,6)"><c_q52>{‏وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ‏}</c_q52></a>‏ أَنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ إِذَا كَانَ فَقِيرًا، أَنَّهُ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ مَكَانَ قِيَامِهِ عَلَيْهِ، بِمَعْرُوفٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=99></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4577</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179070><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179070><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came on foot to pay me a visit (during my illness) at Banu Salama's 
(dwellings). The Prophet (ﷺ) found me unconscious, so he asked for water and performed the ablution 
from it and sprinkled some water over it. I came to my senses and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do 
you order me to do as regards my wealth?" So there was revealed:-- 
"Allah commands you as regards your children's (inheritance):" (4.11)</b></div>

<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مُنْكَدِرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ عَادَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ مَاشِيَيْنِ فَوَجَدَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ أَعْقِلُ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ رَشَّ عَلَىَّ، فَأَفَقْتُ فَقُلْتُ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَصْنَعَ فِي مَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q56" name="q56" href="javascript:openquran(3,11,11)"><c_q56>{‏يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلاَدِكُمْ‏}</c_q56></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=100></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4578</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179080><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179080><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(In the Pre-Islamic Period ) the children used to inherit all the property but the parents used to inherit 
only through a will. So Allah cancelled that which He liked to cancel and put decreed that the share of 
a son was to be twice the share of a daughter, and for the parents one-sixth for each one of them, or 
one third, and for the wife one-eighth or one-fourth, and for the husband one-half, or one-fourth.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الْمَالُ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَكَانَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ، فَنَسَخَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا أَحَبَّ، فَجَعَلَ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلَ حَظِّ الأُنْثَيَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ لِلأَبَوَيْنِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسَ وَالثُّلُثَ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الثُّمُنَ وَالرُّبُعَ، وَلِلزَّوْجِ الشَّطْرَ وَالرُّبُعَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=101></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4579</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179090><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179090><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>regarding the Divine Verse: "O you who believe! You are forbidden to inherit women against their 
will, and you should not treat them with harshness that you may take back part of the (Mahr) dower 
you have given them." (4.19) (Before this revelation) if a man died, his relatives used to have the 
right to inherit his wife, and one of them could marry her if he would, or they would give her in 
marriage if they wished, or, if they wished, they would not give her in marriage at all, and they would 
be more entitled to dispose her, than her own relatives. So the above Verse was revealed in this 
connection.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَسْبَاطُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ وَذَكَرَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ السُّوَائِيُّ وَلاَ أَظُنُّهُ ذَكَرَهُ إِلاَّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏<A id="q59" name="q59" href="javascript:openquran(3,19,19)"><c_q59>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا وَلاَ تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ لِتَذْهَبُوا بِبَعْضِ مَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ‏}</c_q59></a>‏ قَالَ كَانُوا إِذَا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ كَانَ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ أَحَقَّ بِامْرَأَتِهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ بَعْضُهُمْ تَزَوَّجَهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءُوا زَوَّجُوهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءُوا لَمْ يُزَوِّجُوهَا، فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا، فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(7)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And to everyone, We have appointed heirs of that (property) left by parents and relatives. To those, also, with whom you have made a pledge (brotherhood), give them their due portion [by Wasiya (wills)]. Truly, Allah is Ever a Witness over all things." (V.4:33)</div>
<div class=achapno>(7)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q60" name="q60" href="javascript:openquran(3,33,33)"><c_q60>{‏وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالأَقْرَبُونَ‏}</c_q60></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ ‏{‏مَوَالِيَ‏}‏ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَرَثَةً‏.‏ ‏{‏عَاقَدَتْ‏}‏ هُوَ مَوْلَى الْيَمِينِ، وَهْوَ الْحَلِيفُ، وَالْمَوْلَى أَيْضًا ابْنُ الْعَمِّ‏.‏ وَالْمَوْلَى الْمُنْعِمُ الْمُعْتِقُ‏.‏ وَالْمَوْلَى الْمُعْتَقُ‏.‏ وَالْمَوْلَى الْمَلِيكُ‏.‏ وَالْمَوْلَى مَوْلًى فِي الدِّينِ‏.‏</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179100>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=102></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4580</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179100><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179100><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse: "To everyone, We have appointed heirs." (4.33) 'Mawali' means heirs. And 
regarding:-- "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." 
When the Emigrants came to Medina, an Emigrant used to be the heir of an Ansari with the exclusion 
of the latter's relatives, and that was because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet (ﷺ) had 
established between them (i.e. the Emigrants and the Ansar). So when the Verses:-- "To everyone We 
have appointed heirs." was revealed, (the inheritance through bond of brotherhood) was cancelled. Ibn 
`Abbas then said: "And those to whom your right hands have pledged." is concerned with the 
covenant of helping and advising each other. So allies are no longer to be the heir of each other, but 
they can bequeath each other some of their property by means of a will.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاس ٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q61" name="q61" href="javascript:openquran(3,33,33)"><c_q61>{‏وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ‏}</c_q61></a>‏ قَالَ وَرَثَةً‏.‏ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ عَاقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ‏}‏ كَانَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ لَمَّا قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَرِثُ الْمُهَاجِرُ الأَنْصَارِيَّ دُونَ ذَوِي رَحِمِهِ لِلأُخُوَّةِ الَّتِي آخَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q62" name="q62" href="javascript:openquran(3,33,33)"><c_q62>{‏وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ‏}</c_q62></a>‏ نُسِخَتْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ عَاقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ‏}‏ مِنَ النَّصْرِ، وَالرِّفَادَةِ وَالنَّصِيحَةِ، وَقَدْ ذَهَبَ الْمِيرَاثُ وَيُوصِي لَهُ‏.‏ سَمِعَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ إِدْرِيسَ، وَسَمِعَ إِدْرِيسُ طَلْحَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(8)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Surely! Allah wrongs not even of the weight of an atom (or a small ant)..." (V.4:40)</div>
<div class=achapno>(8)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q63" name="q63" href="javascript:openquran(3,27,27)"><c_q63>{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ‏}</c_q63></a>‏ يَعْنِي زِنَةَ ذَرَّةٍ  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179110>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=103></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4581</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179110><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179110><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:</div><div class=text_details><p>During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) some people said, : O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the 
Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes; do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun at midday 
when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" They replied, "No." He said, "Do you have any 
difficulty in seeing the moon on a full moon night when it is bright and there is no cloud in the sky?" 
They replied, "No." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(Similarly) you will have no difficulty in seeing Allah on the 
Day of Resurrection as you have no difficulty in seeing either of them. On the Day of Resurrection, a 
call-maker will announce, "Let every nation follow that which they used to worship." 
Then none of those who used to worship anything other than Allah like idols and other deities but will 
fall in Hell (Fire), till there will remain none but those who used to worship Allah, both those who 
were obedient (i.e. good) and those who were disobedient (i.e. bad) and the remaining party of the 
people of the Scripture. Then the Jews will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who do you use 
to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Ezra, the son of Allah.' It will be said to them, 'You 
are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son. What do you want now?' They will say, 
'O our Lord! We are thirsty, so give us something to drink.' 
They will be directed and addressed thus, 'Will you drink,' whereupon they will be gathered unto Hell 
(Fire) which will look like a mirage whose different sides will be destroying each other. Then they 
will fall into the Fire. Afterwards the Christians will be called upon and it will be said to them, 'Who 
do you use to worship?' They will say, 'We used to worship Jesus, the son of Allah.' It will be said to 
them, 'You are liars, for Allah has never taken anyone as a wife or a son,' Then it will be said to them, 
'What do you want?' They will say what the former people have said. Then, when there remain (in the 
gathering) none but those who used to worship Allah (Alone, the real Lord of the Worlds) whether 
they were obedient or disobedient. Then (Allah) the Lord of the worlds will come to them in a shape 
nearest to the picture they had in their minds about Him. It will be said, 'What are you waiting for?' 
Every nation have followed what they used to worship.' They will reply, 'We left the people in the 
world when we were in great need of them and we did not take them as friends. Now we are waiting 
for our Lord Whom we used to worship.' Allah will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say twice or 
thrice, 'We do not worship any besides Allah.' "</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ، حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أُنَاسًا فِي زَمَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ بِالظَّهِيرَةِ، ضَوْءٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، ضَوْءٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، إِلاَّ كَمَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ أَحَدِهِمَا، إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ تَتْبَعُ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ‏.‏ فَلاَ يَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الأَصْنَامِ وَالأَنْصَابِ إِلاَّ يَتَسَاقَطُونَ فِي النَّارِ، حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ، بَرٌّ أَوْ فَاجِرٌ وَغُبَّرَاتُ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، فَيُدْعَى الْيَهُودُ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ عُزَيْرَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ كَذَبْتُمْ، مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ صَاحِبَةٍ وَلاَ وَلَدٍ، فَمَاذَا تَبْغُونَ فَقَالُوا عَطِشْنَا رَبَّنَا فَاسْقِنَا‏.‏ فَيُشَارُ أَلاَ تَرِدُونَ، فَيُحْشَرُونَ إِلَى النَّارِ كَأَنَّهَا سَرَابٌ، يَحْطِمُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضًا فَيَتَسَاقَطُونَ فِي النَّارِ، ثُمَّ يُدْعَى النَّصَارَى، فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ كَذَبْتُمْ، مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ صَاحِبَةٍ وَلاَ وَلَدٍ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَاذَا تَبْغُونَ فَكَذَلِكَ مِثْلَ الأَوَّلِ، حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَرٍّ أَوْ فَاجِرٍ، أَتَاهُمْ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ فِي أَدْنَى صُورَةٍ مِنَ الَّتِي رَأَوْهُ فِيهَا، فَيُقَالُ مَاذَا تَنْتَظِرُونَ تَتْبَعُ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَارَقْنَا النَّاسَ فِي الدُّنْيَا عَلَى أَفْقَرِ مَا كُنَّا إِلَيْهِمْ، وَلَمْ نُصَاحِبْهُمْ، وَنَحْنُ نَنْتَظِرُ رَبَّنَا الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ لاَ نُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q64" name="q64" href="javascript:openquran(3,41,41)"><c_q64>{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}</c_q64></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">الْمُخْتَالُ وَالْخَتَّالُ وَاحِدٌ، ‏{‏نَطْمِسَ‏}‏ نُسَوِّيَهَا حَتَّى تَعُودَ كَأَقْفَائِهِمْ‏.‏ طَمَسَ الْكِتَابَ مَحَاهُ ‏{‏سَعِيرًا‏}‏ وُقُودًا‏.‏</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=104></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4582</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179120><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179120><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me, "Recite (of the Qur'an) for me," I said, "Shall I recite it to you although it 
had been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear (the Qur'an) from others." So I recited Surat-an- 
Nisa' till I reached: "How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring 
you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people?" (4.41) Then he said, "Stop!" And behold, his 
eyes were overflowing with tears."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بَعْضُ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ آقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ ‏<A id="q65" name="q65" href="javascript:openquran(3,41,41)"><c_q65>{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}</c_q65></a>‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسِكْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِذَا عَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(10)</div><div class=englishchapter>"...And if you are ill, or on a journey, or one of you comes after answering the call of nature..." (V.4:43)</div>
<div class=achapno>(10)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q66" name="q66" href="javascript:openquran(3,43,43)"><c_q66>{‏وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ‏}</c_q66></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">{صَعِيدًا} وَجْهَ الأَرْضِ.<br>
وَقَالَ جَابِرٌ كَانَتِ الطَّوَاغِيتُ الَّتِي يَتَحَاكَمُونَ إِلَيْهَا فِي جُهَيْنَةَ وَاحِدٌ، وَفِي أَسْلَمَ وَاحِدٌ، وَفِي كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَاحِدٌ، كُهَّانٌ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ.<br>
وَقَالَ عُمَرُ الْجِبْتُ السِّحْرُ. وَالطَّاغُوتُ الشَّيْطَانُ.<br>
وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ الْجِبْتُ بِلِسَانِ الْحَبَشَةِ شَيْطَانٌ، وَالطَّاغُوتُ الْكَاهِنُ.</div>

<a name=105></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4583</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179130><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179130><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>The necklace of Asma' was lost, so the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some men to look for it. The time for the prayer 
became due and they had not performed ablution and could not find water, so they offered the prayer 
without ablution. Then Allah revealed (the Verse of Tayammum).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ هَلَكَتْ قِلاَدَةٌ لأَسْمَاءَ فَبَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَلَبِهَا، رِجَالاً فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى وُضُوءٍ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا مَاءً، فَصَلَّوْا وَهُمْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يَعْنِي آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=106></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4584</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179140><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179140><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Verse: "Obey Allah and Obey the Apostle and those of you (Muslims) who are in authority." 
(4.59) was revealed in connection with `Abdullah bin Hudhafa bin Qais bin `Adi' when the Prophet (ﷺ) 
appointed him as the commander of a Sariyya (army detachment).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q68" name="q68" href="javascript:openquran(3,45,45)"><c_q68>{‏أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الأَمْرِ مِنْكُمْ‏}</c_q68></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، إِذْ بَعَثَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَرِيَّةٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(12)</div><div class=englishchapter>"But no, by your Lord, they can have no Faith, until they make you (Muhammad ﷺ ) judge in all disputes between them..." (V.4:65)</div>
<div class=achapno>(12)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q69" name="q69" href="javascript:openquran(3,65,65)"><c_q69>{‏فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ‏}</c_q69></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=107></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4585</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179150><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179150><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa:</div><div class=text_details><p>Az-Zubair quarrelled with a man from the Ansar because of a natural mountainous stream at Al-Harra. 
The Prophet (ﷺ) said "O Zubair! Irrigate (your lands and the let the water flow to your neighbor The 
Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (This is because) he (Zubair) is your cousin?" At that, the Prophet's 
face became red (with anger) and he said "O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then withhold the water 
till it fills the land up to the walls and then let it flow to your neighbor." So the Prophet (ﷺ) enabled Az- 
Zubair to take his full right after the Ansari provoked his anger. The Prophet (ﷺ) had previously given a 
order that was in favor of both of them Az-Zubair said, "I don't think but the Verse was revealed in 
this connection: "But no, by your Lord, they can have no faith, until they make you judge in all 
disputes between them." (4.65)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ خَاصَمَ الزُّبَيْرُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فِي شَرِيجٍ مِنَ الْحَرَّةِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَمَّتِكَ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ احْبِسِ الْمَاءَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الْجَدْرِ، ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَاسْتَوْعَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلزُّبَيْرِ حَقَّهُ فِي صَرِيحِ الْحُكْمِ حِينَ أَحْفَظَهُ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، كَانَ أَشَارَ عَلَيْهِمَا بِأَمْرٍ لَهُمَا فِيهِ سَعَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ فَمَا أَحْسِبُ هَذِهِ الآيَاتِ إِلاَّ نَزَلَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏<A id="q70" name="q70" href="javascript:openquran(3,65,65)"><c_q70>{‏فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ‏}</c_q70></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(13)</div><div class=englishchapter>"...Then they will be in the company of those on whom A11ah has bestowed His Grace, of the Prophets..." (V.4:69)</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=108></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4586</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179160><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179160><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "No prophet gets sick but he is given the choice to select either this 
world or the Hereafter." `Aisha added: During his fatal illness, his voice became very husky and I 
heard him saying: "In the company of those whom is the Grace of Allah, of the prophets, the Siddiqin 
(those followers of the prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them), the martyrs and the 
pious.' (4.69) And from this I came to know that he has been given the option.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ يَمْرَضُ إِلاَّ خُيِّرَ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ أَخَذَتْهُ بُحَّةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏<A id="q72" name="q72" href="javascript:openquran(3,69,69)"><c_q72>{‏مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ‏}</c_q72></a>‏ فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ خُيِّرَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=109></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4587</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179170><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179170><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>My mother and I were among the weak and oppressed (Muslims at Mecca).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأُمِّي، مِنَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=110></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4588</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179180><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179180><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:</div><div class=text_details><p>Ibn `Abbas recited:-- "Except the weak ones among men women and children," (4.98) and said, "My 
mother and I were among those whom Allah had excused."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، تَلاَ ‏<A id="q75" name="q75" href="javascript:openquran(3,98,98)"><c_q75>{‏ِلاَّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ‏}</c_q75></a>‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأُمِّي مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏حَصِرَتْ‏}‏ ضَاقَتْ ‏{‏تَلْوُوا‏}‏ أَلْسِنَتَكُمْ بِالشَّهَادَةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ الْمُرَاغَمُ الْمُهَاجَرُ‏.‏ رَاغَمْتُ هَاجَرْتُ قَوْمِي‏.‏ ‏{‏مَوْقُوتًا‏}‏ مُوَقَّتًا وَقْتَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(15)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites? Allah has cast them back (to disbelief) because of what they have earned..." (V.4:88)</div>
<div class=achapno>(15)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q76" name="q76" href="javascript:openquran(3,88,88)"><c_q76>{‏فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ أَرْكَسَهُمْ‏}</c_q76></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بَدَّدَهُمْ، فِئَةٌ جَمَاعَةٌ</div>
