<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179190>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=111></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4589</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179190><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179190><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse:-- "Then what is the matter with you that you are divided into two parties about 
the hypocrites?" (4.88) Some of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from the battle of Uhud (i.e. 
refused to fight) whereupon the Muslims got divided into two parties; one of them was in favor of 
their execution and the other was not in favour of it. So there ware revealed: "Then what is the matter 
with you that you are divided into two parties about the hypocrites?" (4.88). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said 
"It (i.e. Medina) is aTayyaboh (good), it expels impurities as the fire expels the impurities of silver."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِت ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏<A id="q77" name="q77" href="javascript:openquran(3,88,88)"><c_q77>{‏فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ‏}</c_q77></a>‏ رَجَعَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أُحُدٍ، وَكَانَ النَّاسُ فِيهِمْ فِرْقَتَيْنِ فَرِيقٌ يَقُولُ اقْتُلْهُمْ‏.‏ وَفَرِيقٌ يَقُولُ لاَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q78" name="q78" href="javascript:openquran(3,88,88)"><c_q78>{‏فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ‏}</c_q78></a>‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا طَيْبَةُ تَنْفِي الْخَبَثَ كَمَا تَنْفِي النَّارُ خَبَثَ الْفِضَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=112></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4590</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179200><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179200><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>The people of Kufa disagreed (disputed) about the above Verse. So I went to Ibn `Abbas and asked 
him about it. He said, "This Verse:-- "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is 
Hell." was revealed last of all (concerning premeditated murder) and nothing abrogated it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ ‏{‏آيَةٌ‏}‏ اخْتَلَفَ فِيهَا أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ، فَرَحَلْتُ فِيهَا إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏<A id="q82" name="q82" href="javascript:openquran(3,93,93)"><c_q82>{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}</c_q82></a>‏ هِيَ آخِرُ مَا نَزَلَ وَمَا نَسَخَهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(17)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And say not to anyone who greets you (by embracing Islam), 'You are not a believer..." (V.4:94)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q83" name="q83" href="javascript:openquran(3,94,94)"><c_q83>{‏وَلاَ تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا‏}</c_q83></a>‏ السِّلْمُ وَالسَّلَمُ وَالسَّلاَمُ وَاحِدٌ‏.‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179210>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=113></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4591</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179210><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179210><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse: "And say not to anyone who offers you peace (by accepting Islam), You are not 
a believer." There was a man amidst his sheep. The Muslims pursued him, and he said (to them) 
"Peace be on you." But they killed him and took over his sheep. Thereupon Allah revealed in that 
concern, the above Verse up to:-- "...seeking the perishable good of this life." (4.94) i.e. those sheep.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q84" name="q84" href="javascript:openquran(3,94,94)"><c_q84>{‏وَلاَ تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا‏}</c_q84></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَانَ رَجُلٌ فِي غُنَيْمَةٍ لَهُ فَلَحِقَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَقَتَلُوهُ وَأَخَذُوا غُنَيْمَتَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q85" name="q85" href="javascript:openquran(3,94,94)"><c_q85>{‏عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا‏}</c_q85></a>‏ تِلْكَ الْغُنَيْمَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَرَأَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ السَّلاَمَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب {لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ}</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179220>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=114></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4592</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179220><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179220><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:</div><div class=text_details><p>That the Prophet (ﷺ) dictated to him: "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) and those 
who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." 
Zaid added: Ibn Um Maktum came while the Prophet (ﷺ) was dictating to me and said, "O Allah's 
Apostle! By Allah, if I had the power to fight (in Allah's Cause), I would," and he was a blind man. So 
Allah revealed to his Apostle while his thigh was on my thigh, and his thigh became so heavy that I 
was afraid it might fracture my thigh. Then that state of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed and Allah revealed:-- 
"Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَقْبَلْتُ حَتَّى جَلَسْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَأَخْبَرَنَا أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْلَى عَلَيْهِ لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَجَاءَهُ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ وَهْوَ يُمِلُّهَا عَلَىَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَسْتَطِيعُ الْجِهَادَ لَجَاهَدْتُ ـ وَكَانَ أَعْمَى ـ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفَخِذُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي، فَثَقُلَتْ عَلَىَّ حَتَّى خِفْتُ أَنْ تُرَضَّ فَخِذِي، ثُمَّ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q86" name="q86" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q86>{‏غَيْرَ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ‏}</c_q86></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=115></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4593</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179230><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179230><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Verse:-- "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)" (4.95) was revealed, 
Allah Apostle called for Zaid who wrote it. In the meantime Ibn Um Maktum came and complained of 
his blindness, so Allah revealed: "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame..." 
etc.) (4.95)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q87" name="q87" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q87>{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}</c_q87></a>‏ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْدًا فَكَتَبَهَا، فَجَاءَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَشَكَا ضَرَارَتَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q88" name="q88" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q88>{‏غَيْرَ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ‏}</c_q88></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=116></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4594</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179240><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179240><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home)," (4.95) was revealed, the 
Prophet said, "Call so-and-so." That person came to him with an ink-pot and a wooden board or a 
shoulder scapula bone. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Write: 'Not equal are those believers who sit (at 
home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Ibn Um Maktum who was sitting behind 
the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am a blind man." So there was revealed in the place of 
that Verse, the Verse:--"Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) except those who are 
disabled (by injury, or are blind or lame etc.) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." 
(4.95)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q89" name="q89" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q89>{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}</c_q89></a>‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ادْعُوا فُلاَنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَهُ وَمَعَهُ الدَّوَاةُ وَاللَّوْحُ أَوِ الْكَتِفُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَخَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا ضَرِيرٌ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ مَكَانَهَا ‏<A id="q90" name="q90" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q90>{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏}</c_q90></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=117></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4595</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179250><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179250><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Not equal are those believers who sat (at home) and did not join the Badr battle and those who joined 
the Badr battle.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ، أَنَّ مِقْسَمًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ ‏<A id="q91" name="q91" href="javascript:openquran(3,95,95)"><c_q91>{‏لاَ يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏}</c_q91></a>‏ عَنْ بَدْرٍ وَالْخَارِجُونَ إِلَى بَدْرٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=118></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4596</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179260><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179260><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Muhammad bin `Abdur-Rahman Abu Al-Aswad:</div><div class=text_details><p>The people of Medina were forced to prepare an army (to fight against the people of Sham during the 
caliphate of `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair at Mecca), and I was enlisted in it; Then I met `Ikrima, the freed 
slave of Ibn `Abbas, and informed him (about it), and he forbade me strongly to do so (i.e. to enlist in 
that army), and then said, "Ibn `Abbas informed me that some Muslim people were with the pagans, 
increasing the number of the pagans against Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). An arrow used to be shot which would 
hit one of them (the Muslims in the company of the pagans) and kill him, or he would be struck and 
killed (with a sword)." Then Allah revealed:-- 
"Verily! as for those whom the angels take (in death) while they are wronging themselves (by staying 
among the disbelievers)" (4.97) Abu AlAswad also narrated it.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، وَغَيْرُهُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قُطِعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ بَعْثٌ فَاكْتُتِبْتُ فِيهِ، فَلَقِيتُ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَنَهَانِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَشَدَّ النَّهْىِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَانُوا مَعَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يُكَثِّرُونَ سَوَادَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِي السَّهْمُ فَيُرْمَى بِهِ، فَيُصِيبُ أَحَدَهُمْ فَيَقْتُلُهُ أَوْ يُضْرَبُ فَيُقْتَلُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q93" name="q93" href="javascript:openquran(3,45,45)"><c_q93>{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}</c_q93></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=119></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4597</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179270><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179270><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏{‏إِلاَّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمِّي مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=120></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4598</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179280><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179280><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>While the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the `Isha' prayer, he said, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to 
Him," and then said before falling in prostration, "O Allah, save `Aiyash bin Rabi`a. O Allah, save 
Salama bin Hisham. O Allah, save Al-Walid bin Al-Wahd. O Allah, save the weak ones among the 
believers. O Allah, let Your punishment be severe on the tribe of Mudar. O Allah, inflict upon them 
years (of famine) like the years of Joseph."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الْعِشَاءَ إِذْ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ عَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَجِّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=121></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4599</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179290><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179290><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse: "Because of the inconvenience of rain or because you are ill." (4.102) (It was 
revealed in connection with) `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf who was wounded.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q97" name="q97" href="javascript:openquran(3,45,45)"><c_q97>{‏إِنْ كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِنْ مَطَرٍ أَوْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى‏}</c_q97></a>‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفِ كَانَ جَرِيحًا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(23)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "They ask your legal instruction concerning women, say: Allah instructs you about them, and about what is recited unto you in the Book concerning orphan girls.. ." (V.4:127)</div>
<div class=achapno>(23)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q98" name="q98" href="javascript:openquran(3,127,127)"><c_q98>{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ‏}</c_q98></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179300>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=122></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4600</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179300><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179300><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse:--"They ask your instruction concerning the women. Say: Allah instructs you 
about them and yet whom you desire to marry." (4.127) (has been revealed regarding the case of) a 
man who has an orphan girl, and he is her guardian and her heir. The girl shares with him all his 
property, even a date-palm (garden), but he dislikes to marry her and dislikes to give her in marriage 
to somebody else who would share with him the property she is sharing with him, and for this reason 
that guardian prevents that orphan girl from marrying. So, this Verse was revealed: (And Allah's 
statement:) "If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part." (4.128)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ ‏<A id="q99" name="q99" href="javascript:openquran(3,127,127)"><c_q99>{‏وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ‏}</c_q99></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q100" name="q100" href="javascript:openquran(3,127,127)"><c_q100>{‏وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ‏}</c_q100></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ هُوَ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْيَتِيمَةُ، هُوَ وَلِيُّهَا وَوَارِثُهَا، فَأَشْرَكَتْهُ فِي مَالِهِ حَتَّى فِي الْعِذْقِ، فَيَرْغَبُ أَنْ يَنْكِحَهَا، وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهَا رَجُلاً، فَيَشْرَكُهُ فِي مَالِهِ بِمَا شَرِكَتْهُ فَيَعْضُلَهَا فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(24)</div><div class=englishchapter>"If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part..." (V.4:128)</div>
<div class=achapno>(24)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q101" name="q101" href="javascript:openquran(3,128,128)"><c_q101>{‏وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا‏}</c_q101></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ شِقَاقٌ: تَفَاسُدٌ ‏<br><a id="q102" name="q102" href="javascript:openquran(3,128,128)"><c_q102>{‏وَأُحْضِرَتِ الأَنْفُسُ الشُّحَّ‏}</c_q102></a>‏ <br>
<br><br>
قَالَ هَوَاهُ فِي الشَّىْءِ يَحْرِصُ عَلَيْهِ<br>
<br><br>
‏{‏كَالْمُعَلَّقَةِ‏}:‏ لاَ هِيَ أَيِّمٌ وَلاَ ذَاتُ زَوْجٍ<br>
<br><br>
‏{‏نُشُوزًا‏}:‏ بُغْضًا‏.‏</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=123></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4601</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179310><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179310><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse:--"If a woman fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part." (4.128) It is 
about a man who has a woman (wife) and he does not like her and wants to divorce her but she says to 
him, "I make you free as regards myself." So this Verse was revealed in this connection.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ ‏<A id="q103" name="q103" href="javascript:openquran(3,128,128)"><c_q103>{‏وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا‏}</c_q103></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَتِ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ لَيْسَ بِمُسْتَكْثِرٍ مِنْهَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُفَارِقَهَا فَتَقُولُ أَجْعَلُكَ مِنْ شَأْنِي فِي حِلٍّ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(25)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Verily, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths (grade) of the Fire..." (V.4:145)</div>
<div class=achapno>(25)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q104" name="q104" href="javascript:openquran(3,45,45)"><c_q104>{‏إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرَكِ الأَسْفَلِ‏}</c_q104></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَسْفَلَ النَّارِ، ‏{‏نَفَقًا‏}‏ سَرَبًا‏.‏</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179320>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=124></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4602</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179320><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179320><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Aswad:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were sitting in a circle in `Abdullah's gathering, Hudhaifa came and stopped before us, and 
greeted us and then said, "People better than you became hypocrites." Al-Aswad said: I testify the 
uniqueness of Allah! Allah says: "Verily! The hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire." 
(4.145) 
On that `Abdullah smiled and Hudhaifa sat somewhere in the Mosque. `Abdullah then got up and his 
companions (sitting around him) dispersed. Hudhaifa then threw a pebble at me (to attract my 
attention). I went to him and he said, "I was surprised at `Abdullah's smile though he understood what 
I said. Verily, people better than you became hypocrite and then repented and Allah forgave them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي حَلْقَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَجَاءَ حُذَيْفَةُ حَتَّى قَامَ عَلَيْنَا، فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ النِّفَاقُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْكُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَسْوَدُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ ‏<A id="q105" name="q105" href="javascript:openquran(3,145,145)"><c_q105>{‏إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرَكِ الأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ‏}</c_q105></a>‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، وَجَلَسَ حُذَيْفَةُ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَتَفَرَّقَ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَرَمَانِي بِالْحَصَا، فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ عَجِبْتُ مِنْ ضَحِكِهِ، وَقَدْ عَرَفَ مَا قُلْتُ، لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ النِّفَاقُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ كَانُوا خَيْرًا مِنْكُمْ، ثُمَّ تَابُوا فَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(26)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "Verily, We have sent revelation to you, (O Muhammad ﷺ ) ... (till) ... as We sent revelation to Nuh (Noah) and Yunus (Jonah), Hãrün (Aaron) and Sulaimãn (Solomon)..." (V.4:163)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏إِنَّا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q106" name="q106" href="javascript:openquran(3,163,163)"><c_q106>{‏وَيُونُسَ وَهَارُونَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ‏}</c_q106></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=125></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4603</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179330><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179330><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None has the right to say that I am better than Jonah bin Matta."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَا يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<a name=126></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4604</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179340><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179340><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says that I am better than Jonah bin Matta, is a liar."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَنْ قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(27)</div><div class=englishchapter>"They ask you for a legal verdict. Say: 'Allah directs (thus) about Al-Kalal,a (those who leave neither descendants nor ascendants as heirs). If it is a man that dies, leaving a sister, but no child, she shall have half the inheritance. If (such a deceased was) a woman who left no child, her brother takes her inheritance..." (V.4:176)</div>
<div class=achapno>(27)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب {‏يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ إِنِ امْرُؤٌ هَلَكَ لَيْسَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَلَهُ أُخْتٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا وَلَدٌ‏}</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَالْكَلاَلَةُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرِثْهُ أَبٌ أَوِ ابْنٌ وَهْوَ مَصْدَرٌ مِنْ تَكَلَّلَهُ النَّسَبُ‏.‏</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"[Game (also) being unlawful] when you assume Ihrãm for Hail or Umra (pilgrimage)"... (V.5:1) "So, because of their breach of their covenant "... (V.5 :13)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic"> باب</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">{‏حُرُمٌ‏}‏ وَاحِدُهَا حَرَامٌ<br>
<br>{فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ} بِنَقْضِهِمْ <a href="javascript:openquran(4,21,21)">{الَّتِي كَتَبَ اللَّهُ}</a> جَعَلَ اللَّهُ <a href="javascript:openquran(4,29,29)">{تَبُوءَ}</a> تَحْمِلُ <a href="javascript:openquran(4,52,52)">{دَائِرَةٌ}</a> دَوْلَةٌ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: الإِغْرَاءُ التَّسْلِيطُ.<br>
<br>{أُجُورَهُنَّ} مُهُورَهُنَّ. الْمُهَيْمِنُ الأَمِينُ، الْقُرْآنُ أَمِينٌ عَلَى كُلِّ كِتَابٍ قَبْلَهُ.</div>

<a name=C5.02></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "This day, I have perfected your religion for you..." (V.5:3)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q2" name="q2" href="javascript:openquran(4,3,3)"><c_q2>{‏الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ‏}</c_q2></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"> وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مَخْمَصَةٌ مَجَاعَةٌ</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179360>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=128></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4606</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179360><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179360><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Tariq bin Shihab:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Jews said to `Umar, "You (i.e. Muslims) recite a Verse, and had it been revealed to us, we would 
have taken the day of its revelation as a day of celebration." `Umar said, "I know very well when and 
where it was revealed, and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was when it was revealed. (It was revealed on) the 
day of `Arafat (Hajj Day), and by Allah, I was at `Arafat" Sufyan, a sub-narrator said: I am in doubt 
whether the Verse:-- "This day I have perfected your religion for you." was revealed on a Friday or 
not.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ لِعُمَرَ إِنَّكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَ آيَةً لَوْ نَزَلَتْ فِينَا لاَتَّخَذْنَاهَا عِيدًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ أُنْزِلَتْ، وَأَيْنَ أُنْزِلَتْ، وَأَيْنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أُنْزِلَتْ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ، وَإِنَّا وَاللَّهِ بِعَرَفَةَ ـ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَأَشُكُّ كَانَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَمْ لاَ – ‏<A id="q3" name="q3" href="javascript:openquran(4,3,3)"><c_q3>{‏الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ‏}</c_q3></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "...And you find no water, then perform Tayammum with clean earth..." (V.5:6)</div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q4" name="q4" href="javascript:openquran(4,6,6)"><c_q4>{‏فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا‏}</c_q4></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">تَيَمَّمُوا تَعَمَّدُوا.<br>
<br><a href="javascript:openquran(4,2,2)">{آمِّينَ}</a> عَامِدِينَ. أَمَّمْتُ وَتَيَمَّمْتُ وَاحِدٌ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لَمَسْتُمْ وَتَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَاللاَّتِي دَخَلْتُمْ بِهِنَّ وَالإِفْضَاءُ النِّكَاحُ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179370>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=129></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4607</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179370><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179370><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>The wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) : We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of his journeys, and when we were at 
Baida' or at Dhat-al-Jaish, a necklace of mine was broken (and lost). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed there to 
look for it, and so did the people along with him. Neither were they at a place of water, nor did they 
have any water with them. So the people went to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and said, "Don't you see what 
`Aisha has done? She has made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people, stay where there is no water and they 
have no water with them." Abu Bakr came while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my 
thigh. He said (to me), "You have detained Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people where there is no water, 
and they have no water with them." So he admonished me and said what Allah wished him to say, and 
he hit me on my flanks with his hand. Nothing prevented me from moving (because of pain! but the 
position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my thigh. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when dawn broke and there was no 
water, so Allah revealed the Verse of Tayammum. Usaid bin Hudair said, "It is not the first blessing of 
yours, O the family of Abu Bakr." Then we made the camel on which I was riding, got up, and found 
the necklace under it.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْبَيْدَاءِ أَوْ بِذَاتِ الْجَيْشِ انْقَطَعَ عِقْدٌ لِي، فَأَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْتِمَاسِهِ، وَأَقَامَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ، وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ فَأَتَى النَّاسُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ فَقَالُوا أَلاَ تَرَى مَا صَنَعَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَقَامَتْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِالنَّاسِ، وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ، فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاضِعٌ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي قَدْ نَامَ، فَقَالَ حَبَسْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسَ، وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ، وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَعَاتَبَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَقَالَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ، وَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُنِي بِيَدِهِ فِي خَاصِرَتِي، وَلاَ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ التَّحَرُّكِ إِلاَّ مَكَانُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى فَخِذِي، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَاءٍ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ مَا هِيَ بِأَوَّلِ بَرَكَتِكُمْ يَا آلَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَبَعَثْنَا الْبَعِيرَ الَّذِي كُنْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا الْعِقْدُ تَحْتَهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=130></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4608</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179380><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179380><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>A necklace of mine was lost at Al-Baida' and we were on our way to Medina. The Prophet (ﷺ) made his 
camel kneel down and dismounted and laid his head on my lap and slept. Abu Bakr came to me and 
hit me violently on the chest and said, "You have detained the people because of a necklace." I kept as 
motionless as a dead person because of the position of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; (on my lap) although Abu 
Bakr had hurt me (with the slap). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) woke up and it was the time for the morning 
(prayer). Water was sought, but in vain; so the following Verse was revealed:-- 
"O you who believe! When you intend to offer prayer.." (5.6) Usaid bin Hudair said, "Allah has 
blessed the people for your sake, O the family of Abu Bakr. You are but a blessing for them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ سَقَطَتْ قِلاَدَةٌ لِي بِالْبَيْدَاءِ وَنَحْنُ دَاخِلُونَ الْمَدِينَةَ، فَأَنَاخَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَزَلَ، فَثَنَى رَأْسَهُ فِي حَجْرِي رَاقِدًا، أَقْبَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَلَكَزَنِي لَكْزَةً شَدِيدَةً وَقَالَ حَبَسْتِ النَّاسَ فِي قِلاَدَةٍ‏.‏ فَبِي الْمَوْتُ لِمَكَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَوْجَعَنِي، ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَيْقَظَ وَحَضَرَتِ الصُّبْحُ فَالْتُمِسَ الْمَاءُ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q5" name="q5" href="javascript:openquran(4,6,6)"><c_q5>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏}</c_q5></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ لَقَدْ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ فِيكُمْ يَا آلَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، مَا أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ بَرَكَةٌ لَهُمْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah:"...So go you and your Lord and fight you two, we are sitting right here." (V.5:24)</div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q6" name="q6" href="javascript:openquran(4,24,24)"><c_q6>{‏فَاذْهَبْ أَنْتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلاَ إِنَّا هَا هُنَا قَاعِدُونَ‏}</c_q6></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=131></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4609</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179390><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179390><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah (bin Masud):</div><div class=text_details><p>On the day of Badr, Al-Miqdad said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We do not say to you as the children of 
Israel said to Moses, 'Go you and your Lord and fight you two; we are sitting here, (5.24) but (we 
say). "Proceed, and we are with you." That seemed to delight Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) greatly.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مُخَارِقٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ مِنَ الْمِقْدَادِ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَمْدَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ حَدَّثَنَا الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مُخَارِقٍ عَنْ طَارِقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ الْمِقْدَادُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لاَ نَقُولُ لَكَ كَمَا قَالَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ لِمُوسَى ‏<A id="q7" name="q7" href="javascript:openquran(4,24,24)"><c_q7>{‏فَاذْهَبْ أَنْتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلاَ إِنَّا هَا هُنَا قَاعِدُونَ‏}</c_q7></a>‏ وَلَكِنِ امْضِ وَنَحْنُ مَعَكَ‏.‏ فَكَأَنَّهُ سُرِّيَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ وَكِيعٌ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مُخَارِقٍ عَنْ طَارِقٍ أَنَّ الْمِقْدَادَ قَالَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter>"The recompense of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger, and do mischief in the land is only that they shall be killed or crucified or their hands and feet be cut off from opposite sides..." (V.5:33)</div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q8" name="q8" href="javascript:openquran(4,33,33)"><c_q8>{‏إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ الَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَنْ يُقَتَّلُوا أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوا‏}</c_q8></a>‏  إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<a href="javascript:openquran(4,33,33)">{‏أَوْ يُنْفَوْا مِنَ الأَرْضِ‏}</a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">الْمُحَارَبَةُ لِلَّهِ الْكُفْرُ بِهِ‏.‏</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179400>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=132></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4610</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179400><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179400><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Qilaba:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he was sitting behind `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz and the people mentioned and mentioned (about 
at-Qasama) and they said (various things), and said that the Caliphs had permitted it. `Umar bin 
`Abdul `Aziz turned towards Abu Qilaba who was behind him and said. "What do you say, O 
`Abdullah bin Zaid?" or said, "What do you say, O Abu Qilaba?" Abu Qilaba said, "I do not know that 
killing a person is lawful in Islam except in three cases: a married person committing illegal sexual 
intercourse, one who has murdered somebody unlawfully, or one who wages war against Allah and 
His Apostle." 'Anbasa said, "Anas narrated to us such-and-such." Abu Qilaba said, "Anas narrated to 
me in this concern, saying, some people came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and they spoke to him saying, 'The 
climate of this land does not suit us.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'These are camels belonging to us, and they are 
to be taken out to the pasture. So take them out and drink of their milk and urine.' So they took them 
and set out and drank of their urine and milk, and having recovered, they attacked the shepherd, killed 
him and drove away the camels.' Why should there be any delay in punishing them as they murdered 
(a person) and waged war against Allah and His Apostle and frightened Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" Anbasa 
said, "I testify the uniqueness of Allah!" Abu Qilaba said, "Do you suspect me?" 'Anbasa said, "No, 
Anas narrated that (Hadith) to us." Then 'Anbasa added, "O the people of such-and-such (country), 
you will remain in good state as long as Allah keeps this (man) and the like of this (man) amongst 
you."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَلْمَانُ أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ جَالِسًا خَلْفَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، فَذَكَرُوا وَذَكَرُوا فَقَالُوا وَقَالُوا قَدْ أَقَادَتْ بِهَا الْخُلَفَاءُ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ وَهْوَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ، فَقَالَ مَا تَقُولُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ أَوْ قَالَ مَا تَقُولُ يَا أَبَا قِلاَبَةَ قُلْتُ مَا عَلِمْتُ نَفْسًا حَلَّ قَتْلُهَا فِي الإِسْلاَمِ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ زَنَى بَعْدَ إِحْصَانٍ، أَوْ قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ، أَوْ حَارَبَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَنْبَسَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِيَّاىَ حَدَّثَ أَنَسٌ قَالَ قَدِمَ قَوْمٌ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَلَّمُوهُ فَقَالُوا قَدِ اسْتَوْخَمْنَا هَذِهِ الأَرْضَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ هَذِهِ نَعَمٌ لَنَا تَخْرُجُ، فَاخْرُجُوا فِيهَا، فَاشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجُوا فِيهَا فَشَرِبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا وَاسْتَصَحُّوا، وَمَالُوا عَلَى الرَّاعِي فَقَتَلُوهُ، وَاطَّرَدُوا النَّعَمَ، فَمَا يُسْتَبْطَأُ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ قَتَلُوا النَّفْسَ وَحَارَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، وَخَوَّفُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ تَتَّهِمُنِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بِهَذَا أَنَسٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ يَا أَهْلَ كَذَا إِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَزَالُوا بِخَيْرٍ مَا أُبْقِيَ هَذَا فِيكُمْ أَوْ مِثْلُ هَذَا‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=133></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4611</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179410><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179410><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas (bin Malik):</div><div class=text_details><p>Ar-Rubai (the paternal aunt of Anas bin Malik) broke the incisor tooth of young Ansari girl. Her 
family demanded the Qisas and they came to the Prophet (ﷺ) who passed the judgment of Qisas. Anas bin 
An-Nadr (the paternal uncle of Anas bin Malik) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, her tooth will not 
be broken." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Anas! (The law prescribed in) Allah's Book is Qisas." But the 
people (i.e. the relatives of the girl) gave up their claim and accepted a compensation. On that Allah's 
Apostle said, "Some of Allah's worshippers are such that if they take an oath, Allah will fulfill it for 
them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَسَرَتِ الرُّبَيِّعُ ـ وَهْىَ عَمَّةُ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ ثَنِيَّةَ جَارِيَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَطَلَبَ الْقَوْمُ الْقِصَاصَ، فَأَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْقِصَاصِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ عَمُّ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ تُكْسَرْ سِنُّهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَنَسُ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ الْقِصَاصُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَضِيَ الْقَوْمُ وَقَبِلُوا الأَرْشَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=134></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4612</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179420><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179420><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Whoever tells that Muhammad concealed part of what was revealed to him, is a liar, for Allah says:-- 
"O Apostle (Muhammad)! Proclaim (the Message) which has been sent down to you from your Lord." 
(5.67)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم كَتَمَ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَدْ كَذَبَ، وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ ‏<A id="q12" name="q12" href="javascript:openquran(4,67,67)"><c_q12>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ‏}</c_q12></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(8)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths..." (V.5:89)</div>
<div class=achapno>(8)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q13" name="q13" href="javascript:openquran(1,225,225)"><c_q13>{‏لاَ يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ‏}</c_q13></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179430>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=135></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4613</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179430><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179430><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>This Verse: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths." (5.89) was revealed 
about a man's state men (during his talk), "No, by Allah," and "Yes, by Allah."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ سُعَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏<A id="q14" name="q14" href="javascript:openquran(1,225,225)"><c_q14>{‏لاَ يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ‏}</c_q14></a>‏ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لاَ وَاللَّهِ، وَبَلَى وَاللَّهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="clear"></div><div class=bottomItems>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=136></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4614</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179440><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179440><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>That her father (Abu Bakr) never broke his oath till Allah revealed the order of the legal expiation for 
oath. Abu Bakr said, "If I ever take an oath (to do something) and later find that to do something else 
is better, then I accept Allah's permission and do that which is better, (and do the legal expiation for 
my oath ) ".</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ أَبَاهَا، كَانَ لاَ يَحْنَثُ فِي يَمِينٍ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ كَفَّارَةَ الْيَمِينِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لاَ أَرَى يَمِينًا أُرَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا، إِلاَّ قَبِلْتُ رُخْصَةَ اللَّهِ، وَفَعَلْتُ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(9)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: "O you who believe! Make not unlawful the Tayyibãt (all that is good as regards foods, things, deeds, beliefs, persons) which Allah has made lawful to you..." (V.5:87)</div>
<div class=achapno>(9)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q15" name="q15" href="javascript:openquran(4,87,87)"><c_q15>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّمُوا طَيِّبَاتِ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ‏}</c_q15></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179450>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=137></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4615</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179450><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179450><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>We used to participate in the holy wars carried on by the Prophet (ﷺ) and we had no women (wives) with 
us. So we said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ). "Shall we castrate ourselves?" But the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us to do that 
and thenceforth he allowed us to marry a woman (temporarily) by giving her even a garment, and then 
he recited: "O you who believe! Do not make unlawful the good things which Allah has made lawful 
for you."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا نِسَاءٌ فَقُلْنَا أَلاَ نَخْتَصِي فَنَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَرَخَّصَ لَنَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ نَتَزَوَّجَ الْمَرْأَةَ بِالثَّوْبِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q16" name="q16" href="javascript:openquran(4,87,87)"><c_q16>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تُحَرِّمُوا طَيِّبَاتِ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ‏}</c_q16></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(10)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "Intoxicants (all kinds of alcoholic drinks), gambling, Al-Ansab  and Al-AzIam (arrows for seeking luck or a decision) are an abomination of Satan's handiwork..." (V.5:90)</div>
<div class=achapno>(10)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q17" name="q17" href="javascript:openquran(4,90,90)"><c_q17>{‏إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالأَنْصَابُ وَالأَزْلاَمُ رِجْسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ‏}</c_q17></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179460>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=138></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4616</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179460><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179460><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>(The Verse of) prohibiting alcoholic drinks was revealed when there were in Medina five kinds of 
(alcoholic) drinks none of which was produced from grapes.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ وَإِنَّ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَمْسَةَ أَشْرِبَةٍ، مَا فِيهَا شَرَابُ الْعِنَبِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=139></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4617</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179470><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179470><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>We had no alcoholic drink except that which was produced from dates and which you call Fadikh. 
While I was standing offering drinks to Abu Talh and so-and-so and so-and-so, a man cam and said, 
"Has the news reached you? They said, "What is that?" He said. "Alcoholic drinks have been 
prohibited. They said, "Spill (the contents of these pots, O Anas! "Then they neither asked about it 
(alcoholic drinks) nor returned it after the news from that man.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ مَا كَانَ لَنَا خَمْرٌ غَيْرُ فَضِيخِكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي تُسَمُّونَهُ الْفَضِيخَ‏.‏ فَإِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ أَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ وَهَلْ بَلَغَكُمُ الْخَبَرُ فَقَالُوا وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ‏.‏ قَالُوا أَهْرِقْ هَذِهِ الْقِلاَلَ يَا أَنَسُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا سَأَلُوا عَنْهَا وَلاَ رَاجَعُوهَا بَعْدَ خَبَرِ الرَّجُلِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=140></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4618</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179480><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179480><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir:</div><div class=text_details><p>Some people drank alcoholic beverages in the morning (of the day) of the Uhud battle and on the 
same day they were killed as martyrs, and that was before wine was prohibited.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ صَبَّحَ أُنَاسٌ غَدَاةَ أُحُدٍ الْخَمْرَ فَقُتِلُوا مِنْ يَوْمِهِمْ جَمِيعًا شُهَدَاءَ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ تَحْرِيمِهَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=141></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4619</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179490><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179490><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard `Umar while he was on the pulpit of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Now then O people! The revelation 
about the prohibition of alcoholic drinks was revealed; and alcoholic drinks are extracted from five 
things: Grapes, dates, honey, wheat and barley. And the alcoholic drink is that which confuses and 
stupefies the mind."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَلَى مِنْبَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّهُ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ وَهْىَ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ، مِنَ الْعِنَبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْعَسَلِ وَالْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالْخَمْرُ مَا خَامَرَ الْعَقْلَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(11)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Those who believe and do righteous good deeds, there is no sin on them for what they ate (in the past)..." (V.5:93)</div>
<div class=achapno>(11)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب <A id="q18" name="q18" href="javascript:openquran(4,93,93)"><c_q18>‏{‏لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا‏}‏</c_q18></a> إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q19" name="q19" href="javascript:openquran(4,93,93)"><c_q19>{‏وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ‏}</c_q19></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179500>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=142></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4620</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179500><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179500><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The alcoholic drink which was spilled was Al-Fadikh. I used to offer alcoholic drinks to the people at 
the residence of Abu Talha. Then the order of prohibiting Alcoholic drinks was revealed, and the 
Prophet ordered somebody to announce that: Abu Talha said to me, "Go out and see what this voice 
(this announcement ) is." I went out and (on coming back) said, "This is somebody announcing that 
alcoholic beverages have been prohibited." Abu Talha said to me, "Go and spill it (i.e. the wine)," 
Then it (alcoholic drinks) was seen flowing through the streets of Medina. At that time the wine was 
Al-Fadikh. The people said, "Some people (Muslims) were killed (during the battle of Uhud) while 
wine was in their stomachs." So Allah revealed: "On those who believe and do good deeds there is no 
blame for what they ate (in the past)." (5.93)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ الْخَمْرَ، الَّتِي أُهْرِيقَتِ الْفَضِيخُ‏.‏ وَزَادَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ أَبِي النُّعْمَانِ قَالَ كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ فَنَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ، فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ مَا هَذَا الصَّوْتُ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فَقُلْتُ هَذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي أَلاَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي اذْهَبْ فَأَهْرِقْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَتْ خَمْرُهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْفَضِيخَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ قُتِلَ قَوْمٌ وَهْىَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ <A id="q20" name="q20" href="javascript:openquran(4,93,93)"><c_q20>‏{‏لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا‏}</c_q20></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(12)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "...Ask not about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you trouble..." (V.5:101)</div>
<div class=achapno>(12)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q21" name="q21" href="javascript:openquran(4,101,101)"><c_q21>{‏لاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ، إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ‏}</c_q21></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179510>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=143></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4621</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179510><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179510><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon the like of which I had never heard before. He said, "If you but knew 
what I know then you would have laughed little and wept much." On hearing that, the companions of 
the Prophet (ﷺ) covered their faces and the sound of their weeping was heard. A man said, "Who is my 
father?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "So-and-so." So this Verse was revealed: "Ask not about things which, if 
made plain to you, may cause you trouble." (5.101)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُنْذِرُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَارُودِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خُطْبَةً مَا سَمِعْتُ مِثْلَهَا قَطُّ، قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَطَّى أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُجُوهَهُمْ لَهُمْ خَنِينٌ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَنْ أَبِي قَالَ فُلاَنٌ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏<A id="q22" name="q22" href="javascript:openquran(4,101,101)"><c_q22>{‏لاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ‏}</c_q22></a>‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ النَّضْرُ وَرَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=144></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4622</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179520><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179520><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Some people were asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) questions mockingly. A man would say, "Who is my 
father?" Another man whose she-camel had gone astray would say, "Where is my she-camel? "So 
Allah revealed this Verse in this connection: "O you who believe! Ask not about things which, if 
made plain to you, may cause you trouble." (5.101)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجُوَيْرِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ قَوْمٌ يَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتِهْزَاءً، فَيَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ مَنْ أَبِي وَيَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ تَضِلُّ نَاقَتُهُ أَيْنَ نَاقَتِي فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏<A id="q23" name="q23" href="javascript:openquran(4,101,101)"><c_q23>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ‏}</c_q23></a>‏ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ الآيَةِ كُلِّهَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(13)</div><div class=englishchapter>'Allah has not instituted things like Bahirah or a Sã'ibah, or a Wasilah or a Ham..." (V.5:103)</div>
<div class=achapno>(13)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q24" name="q24" href="javascript:openquran(4,103,103)"><c_q24>{‏مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَحِيرَةٍ وَلاَ سَائِبَةٍ وَلاَ وَصِيلَةٍ وَلاَ حَامٍ‏}</c_q24></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a href="javascript:openquran(4,116,116)">{وَإِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ}</a> يَقُولُ: قَالَ اللَّهُ. وَإِذْ هَاهُنَا صِلَةٌ، الْمَائِدَةُ أَصْلُهَا مَفْعُولَةٌ كَعِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ وَتَطْلِيقَةٍ بَائِنَةٍ وَالْمَعْنَى مِيدَ بِهَا صَاحِبُهَا مِنْ خَيْرٍ، يُقَالُ مَادَنِي يَمِيدُنِي.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(2,55,55)">{مُتَوَفِّيكَ}</a> مُمِيتُكَ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=145></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4623</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179530><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179530><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:</div><div class=text_details><p>Bahira is a she-camel whose milk is kept for the idols and nobody is allowed to milk it; Sa'iba was the 
she-camel which they used to set free for their gods and nothing was allowed to be carried on it. Abu 
Huraira said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw `Amr bin 'Amir Al-Khuza`i (in a dream) dragging his 
intestines in the Fire, and he was the first person to establish the tradition of setting free the animals 
(for the sake of their deities)," Wasila is the she-camel which gives birth to a she-camel as its first 
delivery, and then gives birth to another she-camel as its second delivery. People (in the Pre-lslamic 
periods of ignorance) used to let that she camel loose for their idols if it gave birth to two she-camels 
successively without giving birth to a male camel in between. 'Ham' was the male camel which was 
used for copulation. When it had finished the number of copulations assigned for it, they would let it 
loose for their idols and excuse it from burdens so that nothing would be carried on it, and they called 
it the 'Hami.' Abu Huraira said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying so."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ الْبَحِيرَةُ الَّتِي يُمْنَعُ دَرُّهَا لِلطَّوَاغِيتِ فَلاَ يَحْلُبُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ‏.‏ وَالسَّائِبَةُ كَانُوا يُسَيِّبُونَهَا لآلِهَتِهِمْ لاَ يُحْمَلُ عَلَيْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ رَأَيْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ يَجُرُّ قُصْبَهُ فِي النَّارِ، كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَيَّبَ السَّوَائِبَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ وَالْوَصِيلَةُ النَّاقَةُ الْبِكْرُ تُبَكِّرُ فِي أَوَّلِ نِتَاجِ الإِبِلِ، ثُمَّ تُثَنِّي بَعْدُ بِأُنْثَى‏.‏ وَكَانُوا يُسَيِّبُونَهُمْ لِطَوَاغِيتِهِمْ إِنْ وَصَلَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا بِالأُخْرَى لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا ذَكَرٌ‏.‏ وَالْحَامِ فَحْلُ الإِبِلِ يَضْرِبُ الضِّرَابَ الْمَعْدُودَ، فَإِذَا قَضَى ضِرَابَهُ وَدَعُوهُ لِلطَّوَاغِيتِ وَأَعْفَوْهُ مِنَ الْحَمْلِ فَلَمْ يُحْمَلْ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَسَمَّوْهُ الْحَامِيَ‏.‏       
وَقَالَ لي أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدًا، قَالَ يُخْبِرُهُ بِهَذَا قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْهَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=146></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4624</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179550><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179550><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I saw Hell and its different portions were consuming each other and saw `Amr 
dragging his intestines (in it), and he was the first person to establish the tradition of letting animals 
loose (for the idols).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْكَرْمَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ رَأَيْتُ جَهَنَّمَ يَحْطِمُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضًا، وَرَأَيْتُ عَمْرًا يَجُرُّ قُصْبَهُ، وَهْوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ سَيَّبَ السَّوَائِبَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(14)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them; but when You took me up, You were the Watcher over them, and You are a Witness to all things." (V.5:117)</div>
<div class=achapno>(14)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏{‏وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي كُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h179560>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=147></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4625</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179560><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179560><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "O people! You will be gathered before Allah barefooted, 
naked and not circumcised." Then (quoting Qur'an) he said:-- 
"As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. A promise We have undertaken: Truly we shall do 
it.." (21.104) 
The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "The first of the human beings to be dressed on the Day of Resurrection, will 
be Abraham. Lo! Some men from my followers will be brought and then (the angels) will drive them 
to the left side (Hell-Fire). I will say. 'O my Lord! (They are) my companions!' Then a reply will come 
(from Almighty), 'You do not know what they did after you.' I will say as the pious slave (the Prophet (ﷺ) 
Jesus) said: And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them. When You took me up. You 
were the Watcher over them and You are a Witness to all things.' (5.117) Then it will be said, "These 
people have continued to be apostates since you left them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّكُمْ مَحْشُورُونَ إِلَى اللَّهِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ ‏<A id="q26" name="q26" href="javascript:openquran(20,104,104)"><c_q26>{‏كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ‏}</c_q26></a>‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ الْخَلاَئِقِ يُكْسَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ، أَلاَ وَإِنَّهُ يُجَاءُ بِرِجَالٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي فَيُؤْخَذُ بِهِمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ، فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُصَيْحَابِي‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ ‏<A id="q27" name="q27" href="javascript:openquran(4,117,117)"><c_q27>{‏وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي كُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ‏}</c_q27></a>‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ لَمْ يَزَالُوا مُرْتَدِّينَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ مُنْذُ فَارَقْتَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(15)</div><div class=englishchapter>Allah's Statement: "If You punish them, they are Your slaves."(V.5:118)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q28" name="q28" href="javascript:openquran(4,118,118)"><c_q28>{‏إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ‏}</c_q28></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=148></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4626</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179570><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179570><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You will be gathered (on the Day of Resurrection) and some people will be driven 
(by the angels) to the left side (and taken to Hell) whereupon I will say as the pious slave (Jesus) said:- 
- "And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them...the ALMIGHTY, the All Wise." 
(5.117-118)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ مَحْشُورُونَ، وَإِنَّ نَاسًا يُؤْخَذُ بِهِمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ، فَأَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ ‏<A id="q29" name="q29" href="javascript:openquran(4,117,117)"><c_q29>{‏وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ‏}</c_q29></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ‏}‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-An’am (Cattle)</div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الأَنْعَامِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {فِتْنَتَهُمْ} مَعْذِرَتَهُمْ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(5,141,141)" class="aya">{مَعْرُوشَاتٍ}</a> مَا يُعْرَشُ مِنَ الْكَرْمِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(5,142,142)" class="aya">{حَمُولَةً}</a> مَا يُحْمَلُ عَلَيْهَا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(5,9,9)" class="aya">{وَلَلَبَسْنَا}</a> لَشَبَّهْنَا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَنْأَوْنَ}</a> يَتَبَاعَدُونَ. تُبْسَلُ تُفْضَحُ <a href="javascript:openquran(5,70,70)" class="aya">{أُبْسِلُوا}</a> أُفْضِحُوا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{بَاسِطُو أَيْدِيهِمْ}</a> الْبَسْطُ الضَّرْبُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{اسْتَكْثَرْتُمْ}</a> أَضْلَلْتُمْ كَثِيرًا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{ذَرَأَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ}</a> جَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتِهِمْ وَمَالِهِمْ نَصِيبًا، وَلِلشَّيْطَانِ وَالأَوْثَانِ نَصِيبًا.</br><a name='5,143,143wwwwww5,144,144wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ}</a> يَعْنِي هَلْ تَشْتَمِلُ إِلاَّ عَلَى ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى فَلِمَ تُحَرِّمُونَ بَعْضًا وَتُحِلُّونَ بَعْضًا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَسْفُوحًا}</a> مُهْرَاقًا <a href="javascript:openquran(5,157,157)" class="aya">{صَدَفَ}</a> أَعْرَضَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أُبْلِسُوا}</a> أُويِسُوا وَ<a href="javascript:openquran(5,70,70)" class="aya">{أُبْسِلُوا}</a> أُسْلِمُوا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{سَرْمَدًا}</a> دَائِمًا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(5,71,71)" class="aya">{اسْتَهْوَتْهُ}</a> أَضَلَّتْهُ.</br><a name='14,63,63wwwwww18,34,34wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَمْتَرُونَ}</a> يَشُكُّونَ.</br><a name='40,5,5wwwwww40,44,44wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَقْرٌ}</a> صَمَمٌ، وَأَمَّا الْوِقْرُ الْحِمْلُ.</br><a name='5,25,25wwwwww7,31,31wwwwww15,24,24wwwwww22,83,83wwwwww24,5,5wwwwww26,68,68wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَسَاطِيرُ}</a> وَاحِدُهَا أُسْطُورَةٌ وَإِسْطَارَةٌ وَهِيَ التُّرَّهَاتُ. الْبَأْسَاءُ مِنَ الْبَأْسِ وَيَكُونُ مِنَ الْبُؤْسِ.</br><a name='1,55,55wwwwww3,153,153wwwwww5,47,47wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{جَهْرَةً}</a> مُعَايَنَةً. الصُّوَرُ جَمَاعَةُ صُورَةٍ، كَقَوْلِهِ سُورَةٌ وَسُوَرٌ. مَلَكُوتٌ مُلْكٌ، مِثْلُ رَهَبُوتٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ رَحَمُوتٍ، وَيَقُولُ تُرْهَبُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تُرْحَمَ.</br><a name='1,25,25wwwwww1,35,35wwwwww1,82,82wwwwww1,111,111wwwwww1,214,214wwwwww1,221,221wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{جَنَّ}</a> أَظْلَمَ. يُقَالُ عَلَى اللَّهِ حُسْبَانُهُ أَيْ حِسَابُهُ، وَيُقَالُ حُسْبَانًا مَرَامِيَ. وَرُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ، مُسْتَقَرٌّ فِي الصُّلْبِ وَ<a href="javascript:openquran(5,98,98)" class="aya">{مُسْتَوْدَعٌ}</a> فِي الرَّحِمِ. الْقِنْوُ الْعِذْقُ، وَالاِثْنَانِ قِنْوَانِ، وَالْجَمَاعَةُ أَيْضًا قِنْوَانٌ، مِثْلُ صِنْوٍ وَصِنْوَانٍ</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q31" name="q31" href="javascript:openquran(5,59,59)"><c_q31>{‏وَعِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا إِلاَّ هُوَ‏}</c_q31></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=149></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4627</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc179580><div class="englishcontainer" id=t179580><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The key of the Unseen are five: Verily with Allah (Alone) is the knowledge of 
the Hour He sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. No soul knows what it will earn 
tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. Verily, Allah is All-Knower, All-Aware." 
(31.34)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ، وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ، وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الأَرْحَامِ، وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا، وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
