<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=213></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4691</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180250><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180250><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Um Ruman:</div><div class=text_details><p>Who was `Aisha's mother: While I was with `Aisha, `Aisha got fever, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 
"Probably her fever is caused by the story related by the people (about her)." I said, "Yes." Then 
`Aisha sat up and said, "My example and your example is similar to that of Jacob and his sons:--'Nay, 
but your minds have made up a tale. So (for me) patience is most fitting. It is Allah (alone) Whose 
help can be sought against that which you assert.' (12.18)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَسْرُوقُ بْنُ الأَجْدَعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ رُومَانَ، وَهْىَ أُمُّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ بَيْنَا أَنَا وَعَائِشَةُ أَخَذَتْهَا الْحُمَّى، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ لَعَلَّ فِي حَدِيثٍ تُحُدِّثَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ وَقَعَدَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَالَتْ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَيَعْقُوبَ وَبَنِيهِ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: "And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him (to do an evil act). She closed the doors and said, 'Come on, O you.' He said: 'I seek refuge in Allah (or Allah forbid)'..." (V.12:23)</div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q40" name="q40" href="javascript:openquran(11,23,23)"><c_q40>{‏وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ‏}</c_q40></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ هَيْتَ لَكَ بِالْحَوْرَانِيَّةِ هَلُمَّ.<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ تَعَالَهْ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=214></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4692</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180260><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180260><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Wail:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdullah bin Mas`ud recited "Haita laka (Come you)," and added, "We recite it as we were taught 
it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ هَيْتَ لَكَ قَالَ وَإِنَّمَا نَقْرَؤُهَا كَمَا عُلِّمْنَاهَا ‏{‏مَثْوَاهُ‏}‏ مُقَامُهُ ‏{‏أَلْفَيَا‏}‏ وَجَدَا ‏<A id="q41" name="q41" href="javascript:openquran(36,69,69)"><c_q41>{‏أَلْفَوْا آبَاءَهُمْ‏}</c_q41></a>‏ ‏{‏أَلْفَيْنَا‏}‏ وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ‏<A id="q42" name="q42" href="javascript:openquran(36,8,8)"><c_q42>{‏بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ‏}</c_q42></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=215></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4693</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180270><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180270><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud):</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Prophet (ﷺ) realized that the Quraish had delayed in embracing Islam, he said, "O Allah! 
Protect me against their evil by afflicting them with seven (years of famine) like the seven years of 
(Prophet) Joseph." So they were struck with a year of famine that destroyed everything till they had to 
eat bones, and till a man would look towards the sky and see something like smoke between him and 
it. Allah said:-- 
"Then watch you (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce a kind of smoke plainly 
visible." (44.10) And Allah further said:-- "Verily! We shall withdraw the punishment a little, Verily 
you will return (to disbelief)." (44.15) (Will Allah relieve them from torture on the Day of 
Resurrection?) (The punishment of) the smoke had passed and Al-Baltsha (the destruction of the 
pagans in the Badr battle) had passed too.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا لَمَّا أَبْطَئُوا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالإِسْلاَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏ فَأَصَابَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَصَّتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْعِظَامَ حَتَّى جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَيَرَى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا مِثْلَ الدُّخَانِ قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q43" name="q43" href="javascript:openquran(43,10,10)"><c_q43>{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}</c_q43></a>‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَقَدْ مَضَى الدُّخَانُ وَمَضَتِ الْبَطْشَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: "But when the messenger came to him, [Yusuf (Joseph)] said, 'Return to your lord..(up to).. the women said: Allah forbid." (V.12:50,51)</div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ <A id="q44" name="q44" href="javascript:openquran(11,50,51)"><c_q44>‏{‏فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَى رَبِّكَ فَاسْأَلْهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسْوَةِ اللاَّتِي قَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٌ * قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَاوَدْتُنَّ يُوسُفَ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قُلْنَ حَاشَى لِلَّهِ‏}‏</c_q44></a></div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَحَاشَ وَحَاشَى تَنْزِيهٌ وَاسْتِثْنَاءٌ ‏{‏حَصْحَصَ‏}‏ وَضَحَ‏.‏ </div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=216></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4694</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180280><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180280><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah bestow His Mercy on (Prophet) Lot. (When his nation troubled him) 
he wished if he could betake himself to some powerful support; and if I were to remain in prison for 
the period Joseph had remained, I would surely respond to the call; and we shall have more right (to 
be in doubt) than Abraham: When Allah said to him, "Don't you believe?' Abraham said, 'Yes, (I do 
believe) but to be stronger in faith; (2.260)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ تَلِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ لُوطًا، لَقَدْ كَانَ يَأْوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ، وَلَوْ لَبِثْتُ فِي السِّجْنِ مَا لَبِثَ يُوسُفُ لأَجَبْتُ الدَّاعِيَ، وَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ ‏{‏أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِنْ قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنْ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي‏}‏‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=217></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4695</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180290><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180290><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>That when he asked `Aisha about the statement of Allah "Until when the Apostles gave up hope (of 
their people)." (12.110) she told him (its meaning), `Urwa added, "I said, 'Did they (Apostles) suspect 
that they were betrayed (by Allah) or that they were treated as liars by (their people)?' `Aisha said, 
'(They suspected) that they were treated as liars by (their people),' I said, 'But they were sure that their 
people treated them as liars and it was not a matter of suspicion.' She said, 'Yes, upon my life they 
were sure about it.' I said to her. 'So they (Apostles) suspected that they were betrayed (by Allah).' She 
said, "Allah forbid! The Apostles never suspected their Lord of such a thing.' I said, 'What about this 
Verse then?' She said, 'It is about the Apostles' followers who believed in their Lord and trusted their 
Apostles, but the period of trials was prolonged and victory was delayed till the Apostles gave up all 
hope of converting those of the people who disbelieved them and the Apostles thought that their 
followers treated them as liars; thereupon Allah's help came to them.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q46" name="q46" href="javascript:openquran(11,110,110)"><c_q46>{‏حَتَّى إِذَا اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ‏}</c_q46></a>‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَكُذِبُوا أَمْ كُذِّبُوا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كُذِّبُوا‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَنُوا أَنَّ قَوْمَهُمْ كَذَّبُوهُمْ فَمَا هُوَ بِالظَّنِّ قَالَتْ أَجَلْ لَعَمْرِي لَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَنُوا بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا قَالَتْ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ لَمْ تَكُنِ الرُّسُلُ تَظُنُّ ذَلِكَ بِرَبِّهَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا هَذِهِ الآيَةُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هُمْ أَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَصَدَّقُوهُمْ، فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَلاَءُ، وَاسْتَأْخَرَ عَنْهُمُ النَّصْرُ حَتَّى اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَهُمْ مِنْ قَوْمِهِمْ وَظَنَّتِ الرُّسُلُ أَنَّ أَتْبَاعَهُمْ قَدْ كَذَّبُوهُمْ جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=218></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4696</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180300><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180300><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa:</div><div class=text_details><p>"I told her (`Aisha): (Regarding the above narration), they (Apostles) were betrayed (by Allah)." She 
said: Allah forbid or said similarly.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، فَقُلْتُ لَعَلَّهَا ‏{‏كُذِبُوا‏}‏ مُخَفَّفَةً‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ‏ نَحْوَهُ.</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(13)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat ar-Ra’d (Thunder)</div>
<div class=achapno>(13)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الرَّعْدِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(12,14,14)" class="aya">{كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ}</a> مَثَلُ الْمُشْرِكِ الَّذِي عَبَدَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا غَيْرَهُ كَمَثَلِ الْعَطْشَانِ الَّذِي يَنْظُرُ إِلَى خَيَالِهِ فِي الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ، وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهُ وَلاَ يَقْدِرُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='6,54,54wwwwww12,2,2wwwwww13,32,32wwwwww13,33,33wwwwww15,12,12wwwwww15,14,14wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{سَخَّرَ}</a> ذَلَّلَ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُتَجَاوِرَاتٌ}</a> مُتَدَانِيَاتٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمَثُلاَتُ}</a> وَاحِدُهَا مَثُلَةٌ وَهْيَ الأَشْبَاهُ وَالأَمْثَالُ، وَقَالَ: <a href="javascript:openquran(9,102,102)" class="aya">{إِلاَّ مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا}</a>.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(12,8,8)" class="aya">{بِمِقْدَارٍ}</a> بِقَدَرٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(12,11,11)" class="aya">{مُعَقِّبَاتٌ}</a> مَلاَئِكَةٌ حَفَظَةٌ تُعَقِّبُ الأُولَى مِنْهَا الأُخْرَى، وَمِنْهُ قِيلَ الْعَقِيبُ. يُقَالُ عَقَّبْتُ فِي إِثْرِهِ، الْمِحَالُ الْعُقُوبَةُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى الْمَاءِ}</a> لِيَقْبِضَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رَابِيًا}</a> مِنْ رَبَا يَرْبُو.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(12,17,17)" class="aya">{أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ}</a> الْمَتَاعُ مَا تَمَتَّعْتَ بِهِ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(12,17,17)" class="aya">{جُفَاءً}</a> أَجْفَأَتِ الْقِدْرُ إِذَا غَلَتْ فَعَلاَهَا الزَّبَدُ، ثُمَّ تَسْكُنُ فَيَذْهَبُ الزَّبَدُ بِلاَ مَنْفَعَةٍ، فَكَذَلِكَ يُمَيِّزُ الْحَقَّ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمِهَادُ}</a> الْفِرَاشُ.</br><a name='12,22,22wwwwww27,54,54wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَدْرَءُونَ}</a> يَدْفَعُونَ دَرَأْتُهُ دَفَعْتُهُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ}</a> أَيْ يَقُولُونَ سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(12,30,30)" class="aya">{وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ}</a> تَوْبَتِي.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسْ}</a> لَمْ يَتَبَيَّنْ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(12,31,31)" class="aya">{قَارِعَةٌ}</a> دَاهِيَةٌ <a name='12,32,32wwwwww21,44,44wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَأَمْلَيْتُ}</a> أَطَلْتُ مِنَ الْمَلِيِّ وَالْمُلاَوَةُ وَمِنْهُ مَلِيًّا، وَيُقَالُ لِلْوَاسِعِ الطَّوِيلِ مِنَ الأَرْضِ مَلًى مِنَ الأَرْضِ <a href="javascript:openquran(12,34,34)" class="aya">{أَشَقُّ}</a> أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْمَشَقَّةِ <a name='12,11,11wwwwww12,41,41wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُعَقِّبَ}</a> مُغَيِّرٌ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُتَجَاوِرَاتٌ}</a> طَيِّبُهَا، وَخَبِيثُهَا السِّبَاخُ، <a href="javascript:openquran(12,4,4)" class="aya">{صِنْوَانٌ}</a> النَّخْلَتَانِ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ فِي أَصْلٍ وَاحِدٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(12,4,4)" class="aya">{وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ}</a> وَحْدَهَا <a href="javascript:openquran(12,4,4)" class="aya">{بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ}</a> كَصَالِحِ بَنِي آدَمَ وَخَبِيثِهِمْ أَبُوهُمْ وَاحِدٌ السَّحَابُ الثِّقَالُ الَّذِي فِيهِ الْمَاءُ <a href="javascript:openquran(12,14,14)" class="aya">{كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ}</a> يَدْعُو الْمَاءَ بِلِسَانِهِ وَيُشِيرُ إِلَيْهِ فَلاَ يَأْتِيهِ أَبَدًا <a href="javascript:openquran(12,17,17)" class="aya">{سَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا}</a> تَمْلأُ بَطْنَ وَادٍ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{زَبَدًا رَابِيًا}</a> زَبَدُ السَّيْلِ خَبَثُ الْحَدِيدِ وَالْحِلْيَةِ.</div>

<a name=C13.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: "Allah knows what every female bears, and by how much the wombs fall short (of their time or number)..." (V.13:8)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q58" name="q58" href="javascript:openquran(12,8,8)"><c_q58>{‏اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ‏}</c_q58></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">غِيضَ: نُقِصَ</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180310>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=219></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4697</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180310><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180310><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The keys of Unseen are five which none knows but Allah: None knows what 
will happen tomorrow but Allah; none knows what is in the wombs (a male child or a female) but 
Allah; none knows when it will rain but Allah; none knows at what place one will die; none knows 
when the Hour will be established but Allah." (See The Qur'an 31:34.")</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غَدٍ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَتَى يَأْتِي الْمَطَرُ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَتَى تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='8,24,24wwwwww12,7,7wwwwww12,33,33wwwwww38,23,23wwwwww38,36,36wwwwww39,33,33wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{هَادٍ}</a> دَاعٍ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ صَدِيدٌ قَيْحٌ وَدَمٌ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ: <a name='4,7,7wwwwww4,20,20wwwwww13,6,6wwwwww32,9,9wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ}</a> أَيَادِيَ اللَّهِ عِنْدَكُمْ وَأَيَّامَهُ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مِنْ كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ}</a> رَغِبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ فِيهِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا}</a> يَلْتَمِسُونَ لَهَا عِوَجًا <a href="javascript:openquran(13,7,7)" class="aya">{وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ}</a> أَعْلَمَكُمْ آذَنَكُمْ <a href="javascript:openquran(13,9,9)" class="aya">{رَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ}</a> هَذَا مَثَلٌ كَفُّوا عَمَّا أُمِرُوا بِهِ <a href="javascript:openquran(13,14,14)" class="aya">{مَقَامِي}</a> حَيْثُ يُقِيمُهُ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مِنْ وَرَائِهِ}</a> قُدَّامِهِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَكُمْ تَبَعًا}</a> وَاحِدُهَا تَابِعٌ مِثْلُ غَيَبٍ وَغَائِبٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(13,22,22)" class="aya">{بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ}</a> اسْتَصْرَخَنِي اسْتَغَاثَنِي يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ مِنَ الصُّرَاخِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَلاَ خِلاَلَ}</a> مَصْدَرُ خَالَلْتُهُ خِلاَلاً، وَيَجُوزُ أَيْضًا جَمْعُ خُلَّةٍ وَخِلاَلٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(13,26,26)" class="aya">{اجْتُثَّتْ}</a> اسْتُؤْصِلَتْ.</div>

<a name=C14.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "... As a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed..." (V.14:24)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q64" name="q64" href="javascript:openquran(13,24,25)"><c_q64>{‏كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ * تُؤْتِي أُكْلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ‏}</c_q64></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180320>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=220></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4698</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180320><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180320><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said, "Tell me of a tree which resembles a Muslim man. Its 
leaves do not fall and it does not, and does not, and does not, and it gives its fruits every now and 
then." It came to my mind that such a tree must be the date palm, but seeing Abu Bakr and `Umar 
saying nothing, I disliked to speak. So when they did not say anything, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It is the 
date-palm tree." When we got up (from that place), I said to `Umar, "O my father! By Allah, it came 
to my mind that it must be the date palm tree." `Umar said, "What prevented you from speaking" I 
replied, "I did not see you speaking, so I misliked to speak or say anything." `Umar then said, "If you 
had said it, it would have been dearer to me than so-and-so."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُونِي بِشَجَرَةٍ تُشْبِهُ أَوْ كَالرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَتَحَاتُّ وَرَقُهَا وَلاَ وَلاَ وَلاَ، تُؤْتِي أُكْلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ، وَرَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ لاَ يَتَكَلَّمَانِ، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ، فَلَمَّا لَمْ يَقُولُوا شَيْئًا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قُمْنَا قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ يَا أَبَتَاهُ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَانَ وَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَكَلَّمَ قَالَ لَمْ أَرَكُمْ تَكَلَّمُونَ، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=221></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4699</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180330><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180330><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a Muslim is questioned in his grave, he will testify that none has the right 
to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and that is what is meant by 
Allah's Statement:-- 
"Allah will keep firm those who believe with a Word that stands firm in this world and in the 
Hereafter." (14.27)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمُسْلِمُ إِذَا سُئِلَ فِي الْقَبْرِ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q66" name="q66" href="javascript:openquran(13,27,27)"><c_q66>{‏يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ‏}</c_q66></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(14,41,41)" class="aya">{صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ}</a> الْحَقُّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَلَيْهِ طَرِيقُهُ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(14,72,72)" class="aya">{لَعَمْرُكَ}</a> لَعَيْشُكَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ}</a> أَنْكَرَهُمْ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{كِتَابٌ مَعْلُومٌ}</a> أَجَلٌ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَوْمَا تَأْتِينَا}</a> هَلاَّ تَأْتِينَا شِيَعٌ أُمَمٌ وَلِلأَوْلِيَاءِ أَيْضًا شِيَعٌ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='10,78,78wwwwww36,70,70wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{يُهْرَعُونَ}</a> مُسْرِعِينِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ}</a> لِلنَّاظِرِينَ <a href="javascript:openquran(14,15,15)" class="aya">{سُكِّرَتْ}</a> غُشِّيَتْ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{بُرُوجًا}</a> مَنَازِلَ لِلشَّمْسِ وَالْقَمَرِ <a href="javascript:openquran(14,22,22)" class="aya">{لَوَاقِحَ}</a> مَلاَقِحَ مُلْقَحَةً <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{حَمَإٍ}</a> جَمَاعَةُ حَمْأَةٍ وَهْوَ الطِّينُ الْمُتَغَيِّرُ وَالْمَسْنُونُ الْمَصْبُوبِ <a href="javascript:openquran(14,53,53)" class="aya">{تَوْجَلْ}</a> تَخَفْ <a name='6,72,72wwwwww7,7,7wwwwww14,66,66wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{دَابِرَ}</a> آخِرَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَبِإِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ}</a> الإِمَامُ كُلُّ مَا ائْتَمَمْتَ وَاهْتَدَيْتَ بِهِ <a name='10,67,67wwwwww10,94,94wwwwww14,73,73wwwwww14,83,83wwwwww22,41,41wwwwww28,40,40wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{الصَّيْحَةُ}</a> الْهَلَكَةُ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah: "Except him (devil) that gains hearing by stealing, he is pursued by a clear flaming fire." (V.15:18)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<a id="q74" name="q74" href="javascript:openquran(14,18,18)">{‏إِلاَّ مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ‏}</a></div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180350>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=223></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4701</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180350><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180350><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah has ordained some affair in the Heaven, the angels beat with their 
wings in obedience to His statement, which sounds like a chain dragged over a rock." (`Ali and other 
sub-narrators said, "The sound reaches them.") "Until when fear is banished from their (angels) hearts, 
they (angels) say, 'What was it that your Lord said? They say, 'The truth; And He is the Most High, 
the Most Great.' (34.23) Then those who gain a hearing by stealing (i.e. devils) will hear Allah's 
Statement:-- 'Those who gain a hearing by stealing, (stand one over the other like this). 
(Sufyan, to illustrate this, spread the fingers of his right hand and placed them one over the other 
horizontally.) A flame may overtake and burn the eavesdropper before conveying the news to the one 
below him; or it may not overtake him till he has conveyed it to the one below him, who in his turn, 
conveys it to the one below him, and so on till they convey the news to the earth. (Or probably Sufyan 
said, "Till the news reaches the earth.") Then the news is inspired to a sorcerer who would add a 
hundred lies to it. His prophecy will prove true (as far as the heavenly news is concerned). The people 
will say. 'Didn't he tell us that on such-and-such a day, such-and-such a thing will happen? We have 
found that is true because of the true news heard from heaven."
<p>
<i>The above hadith is also narrated by Abu Huraira</i>, starting: 'When Allah has ordained some affair...') In this narration the word foreteller is added to the word wizard.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ضَرَبَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا خُضْعَانًا لِقَوْلِهِ كَالسِّلْسِلَةِ عَلَى صَفْوَانٍ ـ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ صَفْوَانٍ ـ يَنْفُذُهُمْ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ، قَالُوا لِلَّذِي قَالَ الْحَقَّ وَهْوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ، فَيَسْمَعُهَا مُسْتَرِقُو السَّمْعِ، وَمُسْتَرِقُو السَّمْعِ هَكَذَا وَاحِدٌ فَوْقَ آخَرَ ـ وَوَصَفَ سُفْيَانُ بِيَدِهِ، وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِ يَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى، نَصَبَهَا بَعْضَهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ ـ فَرُبَّمَا أَدْرَكَ الشِّهَابُ الْمُسْتَمِعَ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْمِيَ بِهَا إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ، فَيُحْرِقَهُ وَرُبَّمَا لَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ حَتَّى يَرْمِيَ بِهَا إِلَى الَّذِي يَلِيهِ إِلَى الَّذِي هُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يُلْقُوهَا إِلَى الأَرْضِ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ إِلَى الأَرْضِ ـ فَتُلْقَى عَلَى فَمِ السَّاحِرِ، فَيَكْذِبُ مَعَهَا مِائَةَ كَذْبَةٍ فَيَصْدُقُ، فَيَقُولُونَ أَلَمْ يُخْبِرْنَا يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا يَكُونُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَوَجَدْنَاهُ حَقًّا لِلْكَلِمَةِ الَّتِي سُمِعَتْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏       <br><p>
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ‏.‏ وَزَادَ الْكَاهِنِ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ فَقَالَ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ وَقَالَ عَلَى فَمِ السَّاحِرِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ إِنَّ إِنْسَانًا رَوَى عَنْكَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَيَرْفَعُهُ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ فُزِّعَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ هَكَذَا قَرَأَ عَمْرٌو‏.‏ فَلاَ أَدْرِي سَمِعَهُ هَكَذَا أَمْ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَهْىَ قِرَاءَتُنَا‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=224></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4702</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180370><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180370><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>(While we were going for the Battle of Tabuk and when we reached the places of the dwellers of Al- 
Hijr), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about the dwellers of Al-Hijr (to us). "Do not enter (the dwelling places) of 
these people unless you enter weeping, but if you weep not, then do not enter upon them, lest you be 
afflicted with what they were afflicted with."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأَصْحَابِ الْحِجْرِ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْقَوْمِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven Al-Mathãni (i.e., seven repeatedly recited Verses i.e., Sürat AI-Fatiha) and the Grand Qur'an." (V.15:87)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q76" name="q76" href="javascript:openquran(14,87,87)"><c_q76>{‏وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ‏}</c_q76></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=225></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4703</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180380><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180380><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Mualla:</div><div class=text_details><p>While I was praying, the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by and called me, but I did not go to him till I had finished 
my prayer. When I went to him, he said, "What prevented you from coming?" I said, "I was praying." 
He said, "Didn't Allah say" "O you who believes Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and 
to His Apostle." (8.24) Then he added, "Shall I tell you the most superior Sura in the Qur'an before I 
go out of the mosque?" When the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go out (of the Mosque), I reminded him and he 
said, "That is: "Al hamdu-li l-lahi Rabbil-`alamin (Surat-al-fatiha)' which is the seven oft repeated 
verses (Al-Mathani) and the Grand Qur'an which has been given to me."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، قَالَ مَرَّ بِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي فَدَعَانِي فَلَمْ آتِهِ حَتَّى صَلَّيْتُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q77" name="q77" href="javascript:openquran(7,24,24)"><c_q77>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ‏}</c_q77></a>‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏ فَذَهَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَذَكَّرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏‏<A id="q78" name="q78" href="javascript:openquran(0,2,2)"><c_q78>{‏الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}</c_q78></a>‏ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=226></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4704</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180390><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180390><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أُمُّ الْقُرْآنِ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah "Who have made the Qur'an into parts (i.e., believed in one part and disbelieved in the other) ." (V.15:91)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q79" name="q79" href="javascript:openquran(14,91,91)"><c_q79>{‏الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ‏}</c_q79></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ}</a> الَّذِينَ حَلَفُوا وَمِنْهُ: <a name='55,75,75wwwwww68,38,38wwwwww69,40,40wwwwww74,2,2wwwwww80,15,15wwwwww83,16,16wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ أُقْسِمُ}</a> أَيْ أُقْسِمُ وَتُقْرَأُ لأُقْسِمُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(6,21,21)" class="aya">{قَاسَمَهُمَا}</a> حَلَفَ لَهُمَا وَلَمْ يَحْلِفَا لَهُ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(26,49,49)" class="aya">{تَقَاسَمُوا}</a> تَحَالَفُوا.</div>

<a name=227></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4705</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180400><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180400><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Those who have made their Scripture into parts are the people of the Scripture who divided it into 
portions and believed in a part of it and disbelieved the other.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما ‏<A id="q80" name="q80" href="javascript:openquran(14,91,91)"><c_q80>{‏الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ‏}</c_q80></a>‏ قَالَ هُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ، جَزَّءُوهُ أَجْزَاءً، فَآمَنُوا بِبَعْضِهِ وَكَفَرُوا بِبَعْضِهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة النَّحْلِ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ}</a> جِبْرِيلُ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,193,193)" class="aya">{نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الأَمِينُ}</a>، <a name='15,127,127wwwwww26,70,70wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{فِي ضَيْقٍ}</a> يُقَالُ أَمْرٌ ضَيْقٌ وَضَيِّقٌ، مِثْلُ هَيْنٍ وَهَيِّنٍ وَلَيْنٍ وَلَيِّنٍ، وَمَيْتٍ وَمَيِّتٍ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(15,46,46)" class="aya">{فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ}</a> اخْتِلاَفِهِمْ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: تَمِيدُ تَكَفَّأُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُفْرَطُونَ}</a> مَنْسِيُّونَ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ}</a> هَذَا مُقَدَّمٌ وَمُؤَخَّرٌ وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ الاِسْتِعَاذَةَ قَبْلَ الْقِرَاءَةِ وَمَعْنَاهَا الاِعْتِصَامُ بِاللَّهِ <a href="javascript:openquran(15,9,9)" class="aya">{قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ}</a> الْبَيَانُ الدِّفْءُ مَا اسْتَدْفَأْتَ <a href="javascript:openquran(15,6,6)" class="aya">{تُرِيحُونَ}</a> بِالْعَشِيِّ وَتَسْرَحُونَ بِالْغَدَاةِ <a href="javascript:openquran(15,7,7)" class="aya">{بِشِقِّ}</a> يَعْنِي الْمَشَقَّةَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(15,47,47)" class="aya">{عَلَى تَخَوُّفٍ}</a> تَنَقُّصٍ <a name='15,66,66wwwwww22,21,21wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{الأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً}</a> وَهْيَ تُؤَنَّثُ وَتُذَكَّرُ، كَذَلِكَ النَّعَمُ لِلأَنْعَامِ جَمَاعَةُ النَّعَمِ <a href="javascript:openquran(15,81,81)" class="aya">{سَرَابِيلَ}</a> قُمُصٌ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ}</a> وَأَمَّا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمْ بَأْسَكُمْ}</a> فَإِنَّهَا الدُّرُوعُ.</br><a name='15,92,92wwwwww15,94,94wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{دَخَلاً بَيْنَكُمْ}</a> كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لَمْ يَصِحَّ فَهْوَ دَخَلٌ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(15,72,72)" class="aya">{حَفَدَةً}</a> مَنْ وَلَدَ الرَّجُلُ. السَّكَرُ مَا حُرِّمَ مِنْ ثَمَرَتِهَا، وَالرِّزْقُ الْحَسَنُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ صَدَقَةَ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَنْكَاثًا}</a> هِيَ خَرْقَاءُ، كَانَتْ إِذَا أَبْرَمَتْ غَزْلَهَا نَقَضَتْهُ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: الأُمَّةُ مُعَلِّمُ الْخَيْرِ.</div>

<a name=229></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4707</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180420><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180420><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke thus: "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from miserliness, laziness; 
from old geriatric age the punishment in the grave; from the affliction of Ad-Dajjal; and from the 
afflictions of life and death.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَعْوَرُ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<a name=230></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4708</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180430><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180430><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:</div><div class=text_details><p>Surat Bani Israel and Al-Kahf and Mary are among my first old property.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَالْكَهْفِ وَمَرْيَمَ إِنَّهُنَّ مِنَ الْعِتَاقِ الأُوَلِ، وَهُنَّ مِنْ تِلاَدِي‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ‏}‏ يَهُزُّونَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ نَغَضَتْ سِنُّكَ أَىْ تَحَرَّكَتْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And we decreed for the Children of Israel." (17:4)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">‏<a id="q91" name="q91" href="javascript:openquran(16,4,4)"><c_q91>{‏وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ‏}</a></div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"></p>أَخْبَرْنَاهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ سَيُفْسِدُونَ، وَالْقَضَاءُ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(16,23,23)" class="aya">{وَقَضَى رَبُّكَ}</a> أَمَرَ رَبُّكَ، وَمِنْهُ الْحُكْمُ: <a name='9,93,93wwwwww44,17,17wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ}</a>، وَمِنْهُ الْخَلْقُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(40,12,12)" class="aya">{فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَوَاتٍ}</a>.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{نَفِيرًا}</a> مَنْ يَنْفِرُ مَعَهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(16,7,7)" class="aya">{وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا}</a> يُدَمِّرُوا <a href="javascript:openquran(16,7,7)" class="aya">{مَا عَلَوْا}</a>.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{حَصِيرًا}</a> مَحْبِسًا مَحْصَرًا <a name='1,42,42wwwwww1,121,121wwwwww1,146,146wwwwww2,71,71wwwwww2,102,102wwwwww3,171,171wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{حَقَّ}</a> وَجَبَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَيْسُورًا}</a> لَيِّنًا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{خِطْئًا}</a> إِثْمًا، وَهْوَ اسْمٌ مِنْ خَطِئْتُ، وَالْخَطَأُ مَفْتُوحٌ مَصْدَرُهُ مِنَ الإِثْمِ، خَطِئْتُ بِمَعْنَى أَخْطَأْتُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(16,37,37)" class="aya">{تَخْرِقَ}</a> تَقْطَعَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(16,47,47)" class="aya">{وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَى}</a> مَصْدَرٌ مِنْ نَاجَيْتُ، فَوَصَفَهُمْ بِهَا، وَالْمَعْنَى يَتَنَاجَوْنَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رُفَاتًا}</a> حُطَامًا <a href="javascript:openquran(16,64,64)" class="aya">{وَاسْتَفْزِزْ}</a> اسْتَخِفَّ <a href="javascript:openquran(16,64,64)" class="aya">{بِخَيْلِكَ}</a> الْفُرْسَانِ، وَالرَّجْلُ الرَّجَّالَةُ وَاحِدُهَا رَاجِلٌ مِثْلُ صَاحِبٍ وَصَحْبٍ، وَتَاجِرٍ وَتَجْرٍ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{حَاصِبًا}</a> الرِّيحُ الْعَاصِفُ، وَالْحَاصِبُ أَيْضًا مَا تَرْمِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ وَمِنْهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(20,98,98)" class="aya">{حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ}</a> يُرْمَى بِهِ فِي جَهَنَّمَ، وَهْوَ حَصَبُهَا، وَيُقَالُ حَصَبَ فِي الأَرْضِ ذَهَبَ، وَالْحَصَبُ مُشْتَقٌّ مِنَ الْحَصْبَاءِ وَالْحِجَارَةِ.</br><a name='16,69,69wwwwww19,55,55wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَارَةً}</a> مَرَّةً وَجَمَاعَتُهُ تِيَرَةٌ وَتَارَاتٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(16,62,62)" class="aya">{لأَحْتَنِكَنَّ}</a> لأَسْتَأْصِلَنَّهُمْ يُقَالُ احْتَنَكَ فُلاَنٌ مَا عِنْدَ فُلاَنٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ اسْتَقْصَاهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(16,13,13)" class="aya">{طَائِرَهُ}</a> حَظُّهُ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كُلُّ سُلْطَانٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ فَهُوَ حُجَّةٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ}</a> لَمْ يُحَالِفْ أَحَدًا.</div>

<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Glorified (and Exalted) is He (Allah) [above all that (evil) they associate with Him], Who took His slave (Muḥammad pbuh) for a Journey by Night from Al-Masjid-al-Ḥarām (at Makkah) to Al-Masjid-al-Aqsā (in Jerusalem)..." (V.17:1)</div>

<a name=231></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4709</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180440><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180440><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented with two cups one containing wine and the other milk on the night of 
his night journey at Jerusalem. He looked at it and took the milk. Gabriel said, "Thanks to Allah Who 
guided you to the Fitra (i.e. Islam); if you had taken the wine, your followers would have gone astray.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ بِإِيلِيَاءَ بِقَدَحَيْنِ مِنْ خَمْرٍ وَلَبَنٍ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمَا فَأَخَذَ اللَّبَنَ قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَاكَ لِلْفِطْرَةِ، لَوْ أَخَذْتَ الْخَمْرَ غَوَتْ أُمَّتُكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=232></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4710</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180450><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180450><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Quraish disbelieved me (concerning my night journey), I stood up in Al- 
Hijr (the unroofed portion of the Ka`ba) and Allah displayed Bait-ul-Maqdis before me, and I started 
to inform them (Quraish) about its signs while looking at it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَمَّا كَذَّبَنِي قُرَيْشٌ قُمْتُ فِي الْحِجْرِ، فَجَلَّى اللَّهُ لِي بَيْتَ الْمَقْدِسِ فَطَفِقْتُ أُخْبِرُهُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ زَادَ يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ ‏"‏ لَمَّا كَذَّبَنِي قُرَيْشٌ حِينَ أُسْرِيَ بِي إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏قَاصِفًا‏}‏ رِيحٌ تَقْصِفُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=233></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4711</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180460><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180460><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>During the Pre-lslamic period of ignorance if any tribe became great in number, we used to say, 
"Amira the children of so-and-so." Narrated Al-Humaidi: Sufyan narrated to us something and used the word 'Amira'.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَقُولُ لِلْحَىِّ إِذَا كَثُرُوا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَمِرَ بَنُو فُلاَنٍ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ وَقَالَ أَمِرَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180470>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=234></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4712</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180470><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180470><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Some (cooked) meat was brought to Allah Apostle and the meat of a forearm was presented to him as 
he used to like it. He ate a morsel of it and said, "I will be the chief of all the people on the Day of 
Resurrection. Do you know the reason for it? 
Allah will gather all the human being of early generations as well as late generation on one plain so 
that the announcer will be able to make them all-hear his voice and the watcher will be able to see all 
of them. The sun will come so close to the people that they will suffer such distress and trouble as 
they will not be able to bear or stand. 
Then the people will say, 'Don't you see to what state you have reached? Won't you look for someone 
who can intercede for you with your Lord' Some people will say to some others, 'Go to Adam.' So 
they will go to Adam and say to him. 'You are the father of mankind; Allah created you with His Own 
Hand, and breathed into you of His Spirit (meaning the spirit which he created for you); and ordered 
the angels to prostrate before you; so (please) intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what 
state we are? Don't you see what condition we have reached?' Adam will say, 'Today my Lord has 
become angry as He has never become before, nor will ever become thereafter. He forbade me (to eat 
of the fruit of) the tree, but I disobeyed Him . Myself! Myself! Myself! (I am preoccuied with my own 
problems). Go to someone else; go to Noah.' 
So they will go to Noah and say (to him), 'O Noah! You are the first (of Allah's Messengers) to the 
people of the earth, and Allah has named you a thankful slave; please intercede for us with your Lord. 
Don't you see in what state we are?' He will say.' Today my Lord has become angry as He has never 
become nor will ever become thereafter. I had (in the world) the right to make one definitely accepted 
invocation, and I made it against my nation. Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to 
Abraham.' 
They will go to Abraham and say, 'O Abraham! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and His Khalil from among 
the people of the earth; so please intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?' 
He will say to them, 'My Lord has today become angry as He has never become before, nor will ever 
become thereafter. I had told three lies (Abu Haiyan (the sub-narrator) mentioned them in the Hadith) 
Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Moses.' 
The people will then go to Moses and say, 'O Moses! You art Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah gave you 
superiority above the others with this message and with His direct Talk to you; (please) intercede for 
us with your Lord Don't you see in what state we are?' Moses will say, 'My Lord has today become 
angry as He has never become before, nor will become thereafter, I killed a person whom I had not 
been ordered to kill. Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Jesus.' 
So they will go to Jesus and say, 'O Jesus! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and His Word which He sent to 
Mary, and a superior soul created by Him, and you talked to the people while still young in the cradle. 
Please intercede for us with your Lord. Don't you see in what state we are?' Jesus will say. 'My Lord 
has today become angry as He has never become before nor will ever become thereafter. Jesus will 
not mention any sin, but will say, 'Myself! Myself! Myself! Go to someone else; go to Muhammad.' 
So they will come to me and say, 'O Muhammad ! You are Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the last of the 
prophets, and Allah forgave your early and late sins. (Please) intercede for us with your Lord. Don't 
you see in what state we are?" 
The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then I will go beneath Allah's Throne and fall in prostration before my Lord. 
And then Allah will guide me to such praises and glorification to Him as He has never guided 
anybody else before me. Then it will be said, 'O Muhammad Raise your head. Ask, and it will be 
granted. Intercede and It (your intercession) will be accepted.' So I will raise my head and Say, 'My 
followers, O my Lord! My followers, O my Lord'. It will be said, 'O Muhammad! Let those of your 
followers who have no accounts, enter through such a gate of the gates of Paradise as lies on the right; 
and they will share the other gates with the people." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "By Him in Whose 
Hand my soul is, the distance between every two gate-posts of Paradise is like the distance between 
Mecca and Busra (in Sham).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلَحْمٍ، فَرُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ الذِّرَاعُ، وَكَانَتْ تُعْجِبُهُ، فَنَهَسَ مِنْهَا نَهْسَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَهَلْ تَدْرُونَ مِمَّ ذَلِكَ يُجْمَعُ النَّاسُ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ، يُسْمِعُهُمُ الدَّاعِي، وَيَنْفُذُهُمُ الْبَصَرُ، وَتَدْنُو الشَّمْسُ، فَيَبْلُغُ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَالْكَرْبِ مَا لاَ يُطِيقُونَ وَلاَ يَحْتَمِلُونَ فَيَقُولُ النَّاسُ أَلاَ تَرَوْنَ مَا قَدْ بَلَغَكُمْ أَلاَ تَنْظُرُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَكُمْ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ فَيَقُولُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لِبَعْضٍ عَلَيْكُمْ بِآدَمَ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ عليه السلام فَيَقُولُونَ لَهُ أَنْتَ أَبُو الْبَشَرِ خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ‏.‏ وَنَفَخَ فِيكَ مِنْ رُوحِهِ، وَأَمَرَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَسَجَدُوا لَكَ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ، أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ آدَمُ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَإِنَّهُ نَهَانِي عَنِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَصَيْتُهُ، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى نُوحٍ، فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا فَيَقُولُونَ يَا نُوحُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَوَّلُ الرُّسُلِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ، وَقَدْ سَمَّاكَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ، أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَتْ لِي دَعْوَةٌ دَعَوْتُهَا عَلَى قَوْمِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَيَقُولُونَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، أَنْتَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ وَخَلِيلُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَإِنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ كَذَبْتُ ثَلاَثَ كَذَبَاتٍ ـ فَذَكَرَهُنَّ أَبُو حَيَّانَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ـ نَفْسِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُوسَى، فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى، فَيَقُولُونَ يَا مُوسَى أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَضَّلَكَ اللَّهُ بِرِسَالَتِهِ وَبِكَلاَمِهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَإِنِّي قَدْ قَتَلْتُ نَفْسًا لَمْ أُومَرْ بِقَتْلِهَا، نَفْسِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى عِيسَى، فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُونَ يَا عِيسَى أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ، وَكَلَّمْتَ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا اشْفَعْ لَنَا أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ فَيَقُولُ عِيسَى إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ـ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَنْبًا ـ نَفْسِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي، اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَأْتُونَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُونَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، وَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَآتِي تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ، فَأَقَعُ سَاجِدًا لِرَبِّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ مِنْ مَحَامِدِهِ وَحُسْنِ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْتَحْهُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ قَبْلِي ثُمَّ يُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، سَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي، فَأَقُولُ أُمَّتِي يَا رَبِّ، أُمَّتِي يَا رَبِّ فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَدْخِلْ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ مَنْ لاَ حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْبَابِ الأَيْمَنِ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ النَّاسِ فِيمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الأَبْوَابِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ الْمِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَحِمْيَرَ، أَوْ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَبُصْرَى ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=235></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4713</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180480><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180480><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The recitation of Psalms (David's Qur'an) was made light and easy for David that 
he used to have his ridding animal be saddled while he would finish the recitation before the servant 
had saddled it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ خُفِّفَ عَلَى دَاوُدَ الْقِرَاءَةُ، فَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِدَابَّتِهِ لِتُسْرَجَ، فَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(7)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Say (O Muḥammad pbuh): 'Call upon those besides Him whom you pretend (to be gods)..." (V.17:56)</div>
<div class=achapno>(7)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q110" name="q110" href="javascript:openquran(16,56,56)"><c_q110>{‏قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ فَلاَ يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَحْوِيلاً‏}</c_q110></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180490>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=236></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4714</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180490><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180490><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the explanation of the Verse: 'Those whom they call upon (worship) (like Jesus the Son of 
Mary, angels etc.) desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah) as to which of them 
should be the nearer and they hope for His Mercy and fear His torment.' (17.57) They themselves (e.g. 
Angels, saints, Apostles, Jesus, etc.,) worshipped Allah, Those Jinns who were worshipped by some 
Arabs became Muslims (embraced Islam), but those human beings stuck to their (old) religion. Al- 
A`mash said extra: 'Say, (O Muhammad): Call unto those besides Him whom you assume (to be 
gods).' (17.56)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ‏<A id="q111" name="q111" href="javascript:openquran(16,2,2)"><c_q111>{‏إِلَى رَبِّهِمِ الْوَسِيلَةَ‏}</c_q111></a>‏ قَالَ كَانَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الإِنْسِ يَعْبُدُونَ نَاسًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ، فَأَسْلَمَ الْجِنُّ، وَتَمَسَّكَ هَؤُلاَءِ بِدِينِهِمْ‏.‏ زَادَ الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏ ‏<A id="q112" name="q112" href="javascript:openquran(16,56,56)"><c_q112>{‏قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ‏}</c_q112></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(8)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Those whom they call upon [like 'Isa (Jesus) the son of Maryam (Mary), 'Uzair (Ezra) angels, etc.] desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah)..." (V.17:57)</div>
<div class=achapno>(8)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q113" name="q113" href="javascript:openquran(16,2,2)"><c_q113>{‏أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمِ الْوَسِيلَةَ‏}</c_q113></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=237></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4715</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180500><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180500><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verse: 'Those whom they call upon (worship) (like Jesus the Son of Mary or angels 
etc.) desire (for themselves) means of access, to their Lord....' (17.57) (It was revealed regarding) 
some Jinns who used to be worshipped (by human beings). They later embraced Islam (while those 
people kept on worshipping them).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فِي هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏<A id="q114" name="q114" href="javascript:openquran(16,2,2)"><c_q114>{‏الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَى رَبِّهِمِ الْوَسِيلَةَ‏}</c_q114></a>‏ قَالَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ ‏{‏كَانُوا‏}‏ يُعْبَدُونَ فَأَسْلَمُوا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(9)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And We made not the vision which We showed you (O Muḥammad [pbuh] as an actual eye-witness and not as a dream on the night of Al-Isrā') , but a trial for mankind..." (V.17:60) </div>

<a name=238></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4716</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180510><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180510><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding: 'And We granted the vision (Ascension to the Heaven "Miraj") which We showed you (O 
Muhammad as an actual eye witness) but as a trial for mankind.' (17.60) It was an actual eyewitness 
which was shown to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the night he was taken on a journey (through the 
heavens). And the cursed tree is the tree of Az-Zaqqum (a bitter pungent tree which grows at the 
bottom of Hell).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏<A id="q116" name="q116" href="javascript:openquran(16,60,60)"><c_q116>{‏وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّؤْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ إِلاَّ فِتْنَةً لِلنَّاسِ‏}</c_q116></a>‏ قَالَ هِيَ رُؤْيَا عَيْنٍ أُرِيَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ ‏<A id="q117" name="q117" href="javascript:openquran(16,60,60)"><c_q117>{‏وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُونَةَ‏}</c_q117></a>‏ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(10)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "Verily, the recitation of the Qur'ān in the early dawn (i.e. the morning - Fajr prayer) is ever witnessed (attended by the angels in charge of mankind of the day and the night) ." (V.17:78)</div>
<div class=achapno>(10)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q118" name="q118" href="javascript:openquran(16,2,2)"><c_q118>{‏إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا‏}</c_q118></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ.</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180520>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=239></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4717</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180520><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180520><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn Al-Musaiyab:</div><div class=text_details><p>Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'A prayer performed in congregation is twenty-five times more 
superior in reward to a prayer performed by a single person. The angels of the night and the angels of 
the day are assembled at the time of the Fajr (Morning) prayer." Abu Huraira added, "If you wish, 
you can recite:-- 'Verily! The recitation of the Qur'an in the early dawn (Morning prayer) is ever 
witnessed (attended by the angels of the day and the night).' (17.78)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ فَضْلُ صَلاَةِ الْجَمِيعِ عَلَى صَلاَةِ الْوَاحِدِ خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ دَرَجَةً، وَتَجْتَمِعُ مَلاَئِكَةُ اللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ النَّهَارِ فِي صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏<A id="q119" name="q119" href="javascript:openquran(16,78,78)"><c_q119>{‏وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا‏}</c_q119></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(11)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "It may be that your Lord will raise you to Maqām Mahmūd (a station of praise and glory, i.e., the honour of intercession on the Day of Resurrection) ." (V.17:79)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q120" name="q120" href="javascript:openquran(16,79,79)"><c_q120>{‏عَسَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا‏}</c_q120></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=240></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4718</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180530><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180530><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>On the Day of Resurrection the people will fall on their knees and every nation will follow their 
prophet and they will say, "O so-and-so! Intercede (for us with Allah), "till (the right) intercession is 
given to the Prophet (Muhammad) and that will be the day when Allah will raise him into a station of 
praise and glory (i.e. Al-Maqam -al-Mahmud).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ آدَمَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما يَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصِيرُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ جُثًا، كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تَتْبَعُ نَبِيَّهَا، يَقُولُونَ يَا فُلاَنُ اشْفَعْ، حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ الشَّفَاعَةُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَلِكَ يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُ اللَّهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=241></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4719</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180540><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180540><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever, after listening to the Adhan (for the prayer) says, 'O Allah, the Lord 
of this complete call and of this prayer, which is going to be established! Give Muhammad Al-Wasila 
and Al-Fadila and raise him to Al-Maqam-al-Mahmud which You have promised him,' will be granted 
my intercession for him on the Day of Resurrection."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ النِّدَاءَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، حَلَّتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(12)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And say 'Truth (i.e., Islamic Monotheism or this Qur'ān or Jihād against polytheists) has come and Bāṭil (falsehood i.e., Satan or polytheism, etc.) has vanished...'" (V.17:81)</div>

<a name=242></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4720</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180550><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180550><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Masud:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca (in the year of the Conquest) and there were three-hundred and sixty 
idols around the Ka`ba. He then started hitting them with a stick in his hand and say: 'Truth (i.e. 
Islam) has come and falsehood (disbelief) vanished. Truly falsehood (disbelief) is ever bound to 
vanish.' (17.81) 'Truth has come and falsehood (Iblis) can not create anything.' (34.49)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ وَحَوْلَ الْبَيْتِ سِتُّونَ وَثَلاَثُمِائَةِ نُصُبٍ فَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُهَا بِعُودٍ فِي يَدِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏<A id="q122" name="q122" href="javascript:openquran(16,81,81)"><c_q122>{‏جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا‏}</c_q122></a>‏ ‏<A id="q123" name="q123" href="javascript:openquran(33,49,49)"><c_q123>{‏جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ‏}</c_q123></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(13)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And they ask you (O Muḥammad pbuh) concerning the Rūḥ (the Spirit)..." (V.17:85)</div>
<div class=achapno>(13)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q124" name="q124" href="javascript:openquran(16,85,85)"><c_q124>{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ‏}</c_q124></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180560>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=243></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4721</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180560><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180560><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>While I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a farm and he was reclining on a palm leave stalk, some 
Jews passed by. Some of them said to the others. "Ask him (the Prophet (ﷺ) about the spirit." Some of 
them said, "What urges you to ask him about it" Others said, "(Don't) lest he should give you a reply 
which you dislike." But they said, "Ask him." So they asked him about the Spirit. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept 
quiet and did not give them any answer. I knew that he was being divinely inspired so I stayed at my 
place. When the divine inspiration had been revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) said. "They ask you (O, 
Muhammad) concerning the Spirit, Say: "The spirit," its knowledge is with my Lord; and of 
knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a Little." (17.85)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرْثٍ وَهْوَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ إِذْ مَرَّ الْيَهُودُ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ، فَقَالَ مَا رَابَكُمْ إِلَيْهِ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ يَسْتَقْبِلُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ تَكْرَهُونَهُ فَقَالُوا سَلُوهُ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ فَأَمْسَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا، فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ، فَقُمْتُ مَقَامِي، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ الْوَحْىُ قَالَ ‏<A id="q125" name="q125" href="javascript:openquran(16,85,85)"><c_q125>{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}</c_q125></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(14)</div><div class=englishchapter> "...And offer your Salāt (prayer) neither aloud nor in a low voice..." (V.17:110)</div>
<div class=achapno>(14)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q126" name="q126" href="javascript:openquran(16,110,110)"><c_q126>{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}</c_q126></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h180570>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=244></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4722</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180570><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180570><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(regarding): 'Neither say your, prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) This Verse was 
revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca. When he prayed with his companions, he 
used to raise his voice with the recitation of Qur'an, and if the pagans happened to hear him, they 
would abuse the Qur'an, the One who revealed it and the one who brought it. Therefore Allah said to 
His Prophet : 'Neither say your prayer aloud.' (17.110) i.e. do not recite aloud lest the pagans should 
hear you, but follow a way between.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q127" name="q127" href="javascript:openquran(16,110,110)"><c_q127>{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}</c_q127></a>‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُخْتَفٍ بِمَكَّةَ، كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَإِذَا سَمِعَهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ سَبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ أَنْزَلَهُ، وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏<A id="q128" name="q128" href="javascript:openquran(16,110,110)"><c_q128>{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ‏}</c_q128></a>‏ أَىْ بِقِرَاءَتِكَ، فَيَسْمَعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ، فَيَسُبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ، ‏<A id="q129" name="q129" href="javascript:openquran(16,110,110)"><c_q129>{‏وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}</c_q129></a>‏ عَنْ أَصْحَابِكَ فَلاَ تُسْمِعُهُمْ ‏<A id="q130" name="q130" href="javascript:openquran(16,110,110)"><c_q130>{‏وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلاً‏}</c_q130></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(18)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Kahf (The Cave)</div>
<div class=achapno>(18)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْكَهْفِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَقْرِضُهُمْ}</a> تَتْرُكُهُمْ، <a href="javascript:openquran(17,34,34)" class="aya">{وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ}</a> ذَهَبٌ وَفِضَّةٌ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: جَمَاعَةُ الثَّمَرِ.</br><a name='17,6,6wwwwww25,3,3wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{بَاخِعٌ}</a> مُهْلِكٌ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَسَفًا}</a> نَدَمًا. الْكَهْفُ الْفَتْحُ فِي الْجَبَلِ. وَالرَّقِيمُ الْكِتَابُ، مَرْقُومٌ مَكْتُوبٌ مِنَ الرَّقْمِ <a href="javascript:openquran(17,14,14)" class="aya">{رَبَطْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ}</a> أَلْهَمْنَاهُمْ صَبْرًا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَوْلاَ أَنْ رَبَطْنَا عَلَى قَلْبِهَا}</a>، <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{شَطَطًا}</a> إِفْرَاطًا. الْوَصِيدُ الْفِنَاءُ جَمْعُهُ وَصَائِدُ وَوُصُدٌ وَيُقَالُ الْوَصِيدُ الْبَابُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُؤْصَدَةٌ}</a> مُطْبَقَةٌ آصَدَ الْبَابَ وَأَوْصَدَ <a name='17,12,12wwwwww17,19,19wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{بَعَثْنَاهُمْ}</a> أَحْيَيْنَاهُمْ <a name='1,232,232wwwwww17,19,19wwwwww23,28,28wwwwww23,30,30wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَزْكَى}</a> أَكْثَرُ، وَيُقَالُ أَحَلُّ وَيُقَالُ أَكْثَرُ رَيْعًا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أُكْلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ}</a> لَمْ تَنْقُصْ.</br>وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: الرَّقِيمُ اللَّوْحُ مِنْ رَصَاصٍ، كَتَبَ عَامِلُهُمْ أَسْمَاءَهُمْ ثُمَّ طَرَحَهُ فِي خِزَانَتِهِ، فَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى آذَانِهِمْ فَنَامُوا.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ وَأَلَتْ تَئِلُ تَنْجُو.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(17,58,58)" class="aya">{مَوْئِلاً}</a> مَحْرِزًا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا}</a> لاَ يَعْقِلُونَ.</div>
