<a name=285></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4763</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180980><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180980><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>The people of Kufa differed as regards the killing of a believer so I entered upon Ibn `Abbas (and 
asked him) about that. Ibn `Abbas said, "The Verse (in Surat-An-Nisa', 4:93) was the last thing 
revealed in this respect and nothing cancelled its validity."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ فِي قَتْلِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، فَرَحَلْتُ فِيهِ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي آخِرِ مَا نَزَلَ وَلَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=286></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4764</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc180990><div class="englishcontainer" id=t180990><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Ibn `Abbas about Allah's saying:-- 
'.. this reward is Hell Fire.' (4.93) He said, "No repentance is accepted from him (i.e. the murderer of a 
believer)." I asked him regarding the saying of Allah: 
'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' ...(25.68) 
He said, "This Verse was revealed concerning the pagans of the pre-lslamic period."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q121" name="q121" href="javascript:openquran(3,93,93)"><c_q121>{‏فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}</c_q121></a>‏ قَالَ لاَ تَوْبَةَ لَهُ‏.‏ وَعَنْ قَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ ‏<A id="q122" name="q122" href="javascript:openquran(24,68,68)"><c_q122>{‏لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ‏}</c_q122></a>‏ قَالَ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace." (V.25:69)</div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q123" name="q123" href="javascript:openquran(24,69,69)"><c_q123>{‏يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَانًا‏}</c_q123></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=287></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4765</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181000><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181000><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>Ibn Abza said to me, "Ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the Statement of Allah: 
'And whoever murders a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell.' (4.69) 
And also His Statement: '...nor kill such life as Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause .....except 
those who repent, believe, and do good deeds.' " (25.68-70) So I asked Ibn `Abbas and he said, "When 
this (25.68-69) was revealed, the people of Mecca said, "We have invoked other gods with Allah, and 
we have murdered such lives which Allah has made sacred, and we have committed illegal sexual 
intercourse. So Allah revealed: 
'Except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.' 
(25.70)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبْزَى سَلِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q124" name="q124" href="javascript:openquran(3,93,93)"><c_q124>{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ‏}</c_q124></a>‏ وَقَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q125" name="q125" href="javascript:openquran(24,68,68)"><c_q125>{‏لاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ‏}</c_q125></a>‏ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏{‏إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ‏}‏ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ قَالَ أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ فَقَدْ عَدَلْنَا بِاللَّهِ وَقَتَلْنَا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَتَيْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ <A id="q126" name="q126" href="javascript:openquran(24,70,70)"><c_q126>‏{‏إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا‏}</c_q126></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا‏}‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Except those who repent and believe (in the Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, for those, Allah will change their sins into good deeds, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful." (V.25:70)</div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب <A id="q127" name="q127" href="javascript:openquran(24,70,70)"><c_q127>‏{‏إِلاَّ مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا‏}‏</c_q127></a> </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=288></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4766</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181010><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181010><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ordered me to ask Ibn `Abbas regarding the two Verses (the first of which 
was ): 
"And whosoever murders a believer intentionally." (4.93) So I asked him, and he said, "Nothing has 
abrogated this Verse." About (the other Verse): 'And those who invoke not with Allah any other god.' 
he said, "It was revealed concerning the pagans."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبْزَى أَنْ أَسْأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الآيَتَيْنِ، ‏<A id="q128" name="q128" href="javascript:openquran(3,93,93)"><c_q128>{‏وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُتَعَمِّدًا‏}</c_q128></a>‏، فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَىْءٌ‏.‏ وَعَنْ ‏<A id="q129" name="q129" href="javascript:openquran(24,68,68)"><c_q129>{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ‏}</c_q129></a>‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=289></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4767</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181020><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181020><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Five (great events) have passed: the Smoke, the Moon, the Romans, the Mighty grasp and the constant 
Punishment which occurs in 'So the torment will be yours forever.' (25.77)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ خَمْسٌ قَدْ مَضَيْنَ الدُّخَانُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ ‏<A id="q131" name="q131" href="javascript:openquran(24,77,77)"><c_q131>{‏فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا‏}</c_q131></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(26)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat ash-Shu’ara’ (The Poets)</div>
<div class=achapno>(26)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الشُّعَرَاءِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(25,128,128)" class="aya">{تَعْبَثُونَ}</a> تَبْنُونَ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,148,148)" class="aya">{هَضِيمٌ}</a> يَتَفَتَّتُ إِذَا مُسَّ مُسَحَّرِينَ الْمَسْحُورِينَ. لَيْكَةُ وَالأَيْكَةُ جَمْعُ أَيْكَةٍ، وَهْيَ جَمْعُ شَجَرٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,189,189)" class="aya">{يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ}</a> إِظْلاَلُ الْعَذَابِ إِيَّاهُمْ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَوْزُونٍ}</a> مَعْلُومٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,63,63)" class="aya">{كَالطَّوْدِ}</a> الْجَبَلِ. الشِّرْذِمَةُ طَائِفَةٌ قَلِيلَةٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,219,219)" class="aya">{فِي السَّاجِدِينَ}</a> الْمُصَلِّينَ.</br>قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(25,129,129)" class="aya">{لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ}</a> كَأَنَّكُمْ. الرِّيعُ الأَيْفَاعُ مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَجَمْعُهُ رِيعَةٌ وَأَرْيَاعٌ، وَاحِدُ الرِّيَعَةِ <a href="javascript:openquran(25,129,129)" class="aya">{مَصَانِعَ}</a> كُلُّ بِنَاءٍ فَهْوَ مَصْنَعَةٌ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَرِهِينَ}</a> مَرِحِينَ، فَارِهِينَ بِمَعْنَاهُ وَيُقَالُ فَارِهِينَ حَاذِقِينَ <a name='1,60,60wwwwww6,74,74wwwwww10,85,85wwwwww25,183,183wwwwww28,36,36wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَعْثَوْا}</a> أَشَدُّ الْفَسَادِ عَاثَ يَعِيثُ عَيْثًا. الْجِبِلَّةُ الْخَلْقُ، جُبِلَ خُلِقَ، وَمِنْهُ جُبُلاً وَجِبِلاً وَجُبْلاً، يَعْنِي الْخَلْقَ.</div>

<a name=C26.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And disgrace me not on the day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected." (V.26:87)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q4" name="q4" href="javascript:openquran(25,87,87)"><c_q4>{‏وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ‏}</c_q4></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181030>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=290></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4768</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181030><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181030><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection Abraham will see his father covered with Qatara and 
Ghabara. (i.e. having a dark face).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ـ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ ـ رَأَى أَبَاهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَيْهِ الْغَبَرَةُ وَالْقَتَرَةُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ الْغَبَرَةُ هِيَ الْقَتَرَةُ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=291></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4769</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181040><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181040><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Abraham will meet his father (on the Day of Resurrection) and will say, 'O my 
Lords You promised me that You would not let me in disgrace on the Day when people will be 
resurrected.' Allah will say, 'I have forbidden Paradise to the non-believers."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَخِي، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ يَلْقَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبَاهُ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّكَ وَعَدْتَنِي أَنْ لاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="clear"></div><div class=bottomItems>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And warn your tribe (O Muḥammad pbuh) of near kindred. And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.. ." (V.26:214-215) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q5" name="q5" href="javascript:openquran(25,214,215)"><c_q5>{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ * وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ‏}</c_q5></a>‏ أَلِنْ جَانِبَكَ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181050>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=292></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4770</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181050><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181050><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa 
(mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani `Adi!" addressing various tribes of Quraish till 
they were assembled. Those who could not come themselves, sent their messengers to see what was 
there. Abu Lahab and other people from Quraish came and the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Suppose I told you 
that there is an (enemy) cavalry in the valley intending to attack you, would you believe me?" They 
said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a 
warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands 
perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" Then it was revealed: "Perish the 
hands of Abu Lahab (one of the Prophet's uncles), and perish he! His wealth and his children will not 
profit him...." (111.1-5)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q6" name="q6" href="javascript:openquran(25,214,214)"><c_q6>{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}</c_q6></a>‏ صَعِدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الصَّفَا فَجَعَلَ يُنَادِي ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي فِهْرٍ، يَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِبُطُونِ قُرَيْشٍ حَتَّى اجْتَمَعُوا، فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولاً لِيَنْظُرَ مَا هُوَ، فَجَاءَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ وَقُرَيْشٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَوْ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً بِالْوَادِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُغِيرَ عَلَيْكُمْ، أَكُنْتُمْ مُصَدِّقِيَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ، مَا جَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ صِدْقًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ تَبًّا لَكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ، أَلِهَذَا جَمَعْتَنَا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q7" name="q7" href="javascript:openquran(110,1,2)"><c_q7>{‏تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ * مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ‏}</c_q7></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4770">Sahih al-Bukhari 4770</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 292</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 293</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(44480, 'h181050')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4770')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181060>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=293></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4771</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181060><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181060><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up when the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near kindred...." (26.214) was 
revealed and said, "O Quraish people! (or he said a similar word) Buy yourselves! I cannot save you 
from Allah (if you disobey Him) O Bani Abu Manaf! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey 
Him). O `Abbas! The son of `Abdul Muttalib! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him) O 
Safiya, (the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Fatima, the 
daughter of Muhammad ! Ask what you wish from my property, but I cannot save you from Allah (if 
you disobey Him).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q8" name="q8" href="javascript:openquran(25,214,214)"><c_q8>{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}</c_q8></a>‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ ـ أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ـ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا عَبَّاسُ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَيَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَيَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَلِينِي مَا شِئْتِ مِنْ مَالِي، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَصْبَغُ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَالْخَبْءُ مَا خَبَأْتَ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ قِبَلَ}</a> لاَ طَاقَةَ. الصَّرْحُ كُلُّ مِلاَطٍ اتُّخِذَ مِنَ الْقَوَارِيرِ، وَالصَّرْحُ الْقَصْرُ، وَجَمَاعَتُهُ صُرُوحٌ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(26,23,23)" class="aya">{وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ}</a> سَرِيرٌ <a name='7,4,4wwwwww7,74,74wwwwww11,31,31wwwwww21,50,50wwwwww23,26,26wwwwww26,29,29wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{كَرِيمٌ}</a> حُسْنُ الصَّنْعَةِ، وَغَلاَءُ الثَّمَنِ <a name='5,163,163wwwwww6,126,126wwwwww9,72,72wwwwww9,90,90wwwwww14,2,2wwwwww15,89,89wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْلِمِينَ}</a> طَائِعِينَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(26,72,72)" class="aya">{رَدِفَ}</a> اقْتَرَبَ <a href="javascript:openquran(26,88,88)" class="aya">{جَامِدَةً}</a> قَائِمَةً <a name='26,19,19wwwwww45,15,15wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَوْزِعْنِي}</a> اجْعَلْنِي.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(26,41,41)" class="aya">{نَكِّرُوا}</a> غَيِّرُوا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ}</a> يَقُولُهُ سُلَيْمَانُ. الصَّرْحُ بِرْكَةُ مَاءٍ ضَرَبَ عَلَيْهَا سُلَيْمَانُ قَوَارِيرَ، أَلْبَسَهَا إِيَّاهُ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Verily! You (O Muḥammad pbuh) guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills..." (V.28:56)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q12" name="q12" href="javascript:openquran(27,56,56)"><c_q12>{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ‏}</c_q12></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181070>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=294></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4772</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181070><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181070><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Musaiyab:</div><div class=text_details><p>When Abu Talib was on his death bed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and found with him, Abu Jahl and 
`Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to 
be worshipped except Allah, a sentence with which I will defend you before Allah." On that Abu Jahl 
and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said to Abu Talib, "Will you now leave the religion of `Abdul 
Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on inviting him to say that sentence while the other two kept on 
repeating their sentence before him till Abu Talib said as the last thing he said to them, "I am on the 
religion of `Abdul Muttalib," and refused to say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. 
On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am 
forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed:-- 
'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness 
for pagans.' (9.113) And then Allah revealed especially about Abu Talib:--'Verily! You (O, 
Muhammad) guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He will.' (28.56)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ أَبَا طَالِبٍ الْوَفَاةُ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهِ أَبَا جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَىْ عَمِّ قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، كَلِمَةً أُحَاجُّ لَكَ بِهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ أَتَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْرِضُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَيُعِيدَانِهِ بِتِلْكَ الْمَقَالَةِ حَتَّى قَالَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ آخِرَ مَا كَلَّمَهُمْ عَلَى مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ مَا لَمْ أُنْهَ عَنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q13" name="q13" href="javascript:openquran(8,113,113)"><c_q13>{‏مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ‏}</c_q13></a>‏ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَقَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏<A id="q14" name="q14" href="javascript:openquran(27,56,56)"><c_q14>{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ‏}</c_q14></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏<A id="q15" name="q15" href="javascript:openquran(27,76,76)"><c_q15>{‏أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ‏}</c_q15></a>‏ لاَ يَرْفَعُهَا الْعُصْبَةُ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ‏.‏ ‏{‏لَتَنُوءُ‏}‏ لَتُثْقِلُ‏.‏ ‏{‏فَارِغًا‏}‏ إِلاَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِ مُوسَى‏.‏ ‏{‏الْفَرِحِينَ‏}‏ الْمَرِحِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏قُصِّيهِ‏}‏ اتَّبِعِي أَثَرَهُ، وَقَدْ يَكُونُ أَنْ يَقُصَّ الْكَلاَمَ ‏<A id="q16" name="q16" href="javascript:openquran(17,13,13)"><c_q16>{‏نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ‏}</c_q16></a>‏‏.‏ ‏<A id="q17" name="q17" href="javascript:openquran(27,11,11)"><c_q17>{‏عَنْ جُنُبٍ‏}</c_q17></a>‏ عَنْ بُعْدٍ عَنْ جَنَابَةٍ وَاحِدٌ، وَعَنِ اجْتِنَابٍ أَيْضًا، يَبْطِشُ وَيَبْطُشُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يَأْتَمِرُونَ‏}‏ يَتَشَاوَرُونَ‏.‏ الْعُدْوَانُ وَالْعَدَاءُ وَالتَّعَدِّي وَاحِدٌ‏.‏ ‏{‏آنَسَ‏}‏ أَبْصَرَ‏.‏ الْجِذْوَةُ قِطْعَةٌ غَلِيظَةٌ مِنَ الْخَشَبِ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا لَهَبٌ، وَالشِّهَابُ فِيهِ لَهَبٌ‏.‏ وَالْحَيَّاتُ أَجْنَاسٌ الْجَانُّ وَالأَفَاعِي وَالأَسَاوِدُ‏.‏ ‏{‏رِدْءًا‏}‏ مُعِينًا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏يُصَدِّقُنِي‏}‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ ‏{‏سَنَشُدُّ‏}‏ سَنُعِينُكَ كُلَّمَا عَزَّزْتَ شَيْئًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ عَضُدًا‏.‏ مَقْبُوحِينَ مُهْلَكِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏وَصَّلْنَا‏}‏ بَيَّنَّاهُ وَأَتْمَمْنَاهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يُجْبَى‏}‏ يُجْلَبُ ‏.‏‏{‏بَطِرَتْ‏}‏ أَشِرَتْ‏.‏ ‏<A id="q18" name="q18" href="javascript:openquran(27,59,59)"><c_q18>{‏فِي أُمِّهَا رَسُولاً‏}</c_q18></a>‏ أُمُّ الْقُرَى مَكَّةُ وَمَا حَوْلَهَا‏.‏ ‏{‏تُكِنُّ‏}‏ تُخْفِي‏.‏ أَكْنَنْتُ الشَّىْءَ أَخْفَيْتُهُ، وَكَنَنْتُهُ أَخْفَيْتُهُ وَأَظْهَرْتُهُ‏.‏ ‏<A id="q19" name="q19" href="javascript:openquran(27,82,82)"><c_q19>{‏وَيْكَأَنَّ اللَّهَ‏}</c_q19></a>‏ مِثْلُ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ ‏<A id="q20" name="q20" href="javascript:openquran(12,26,26)"><c_q20>{‏يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‏}</c_q20></a>‏ يُوَسِّعُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُضَيِّقُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=295></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4773</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181080><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181080><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Qur'an 28.85'...will bring you home' means to Mecca.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الْعُصْفُرِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏<A id="q22" name="q22" href="javascript:openquran(27,85,85)"><c_q22>{‏لَرَادُّكَ إِلَى مَعَادٍ‏}</c_q22></a>‏ قَالَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(30)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat ar-Rum (The Romans)</div>
<div class=achapno>(30)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الرُّومِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a href="javascript:openquran(29,39,39)" class="aya">{فَلاَ يَرْبُو}</a> مَنْ أَعْطَى يَبْتَغِي أَفْضَلَ فَلاَ أَجْرَ لَهُ فِيهَا. قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(29,15,15)" class="aya">{يُحْبَرُونَ}</a> يُنَعَّمُونَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(29,44,44)" class="aya">{يَمْهَدُونَ}</a> يُسَوُّونَ الْمَضَاجِعَ، الْوَدْقُ الْمَطَرُ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{هَلْ لَكُمْ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ}</a> فِي الآلِهَةِ، وَفِيهِ: <a href="javascript:openquran(29,28,28)" class="aya">{تَخَافُونَهُمْ}</a> أَنْ يَرِثُوكُمْ كَمَا يَرِثُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(29,43,43)" class="aya">{يَصَّدَّعُونَ}</a> يَتَفَرَّقُونَ، <a href="javascript:openquran(14,94,94)" class="aya">{فَاصْدَعْ}</a> وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ ضُعْفٌ وَضَعْفٌ لُغَتَانِ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(29,10,10)" class="aya">{السُّوأَى}</a> الإِسَاءَةُ، جَزَاءُ الْمُسِيئِينَ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=296></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4774</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181090><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181090><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Masruq:</div><div class=text_details><p>While a man was delivering a speech in the tribe of Kinda, he said, "Smoke will prevail on the Day of 
Resurrection and will deprive the hypocrites their faculties of hearing and seeing. The believers will 
be afflicted with something like cold only thereof." That news scared us, so I went to (Abdullah) Ibn 
Mas`ud while he was reclining (and told him the story) whereupon he became angry, sat up and said, 
"He who knows a thing can say, it, but if he does not know, he should say, 'Allah knows best,' for it is 
an aspect of knowledge to say, 'I do not know,' if you do not know a certain thing. Allah said to His 
prophet. 'Say (O Muhammad): No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor I am one of the 
pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist.)' (38.86) 
The Qur'aish delayed in embracing Islam for a period, so the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked evil on them, saying, 'O 
Allah! Help me against them by sending seven years of (famine) like those of Joseph.' So they were 
afflicted with such a severe year of famine that they were destroyed therein and ate dead animals and 
bones. They started seeing something like smoke between the sky and the earth (because of severe 
hunger). Abu Sufyan then came (to the Prophet) and said, "O Muhammad! You came to order us for 
to keep good relations with Kith and kin, and your kinsmen have now perished, so please invoke 
Allah (to relieve them).' Then Ibn Mas`ud recited:-- 'Then watch you for the day that the sky will 
bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible....but truly you will return! (to disbelief) (44.10-15) 
Ibn Mas`ud added, Then the punishment was stopped, but truly, they reverted to heathenism (their old 
way). So Allah (threatened them thus): 'On the day when we shall seize you with a mighty grasp.' 
(44.16) And that was the day of the Battle of Badr. Allah's saying- "Lizama" (the punishment) refers 
to the day of Badr Allah's Statement: 
Alif-Lam-Mim, the Romans have been defeated, and they, after their defeat, will be victorious,' (30.1- 
3) (This verse): Indicates that the defeat of Byzantine has already passed.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يُحَدِّثُ فِي كِنْدَةَ فَقَالَ يَجِيءُ دُخَانٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَأْخُذُ بِأَسْمَاعِ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ، يَأْخُذُ الْمُؤْمِنَ كَهَيْئَةِ الزُّكَامِ‏.‏ فَفَزِعْنَا، فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا، فَغَضِبَ فَجَلَسَ فَقَالَ مَنْ عَلِمَ فَلْيَقُلْ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ يَعْلَمُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏<A id="q29" name="q29" href="javascript:openquran(37,86,86)"><c_q29>{‏قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}</c_q29></a>‏ وَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَبْطَئُوا عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ، فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَتَّى هَلَكُوا فِيهَا، وَأَكَلُوا الْمَيْتَةَ وَالْعِظَامَ وَيَرَى الرَّجُلُ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ ‏"‏، فَجَاءَهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ جِئْتَ تَأْمُرُنَا بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ، وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ، فَقَرَأَ ‏<A id="q30" name="q30" href="javascript:openquran(43,10,10)"><c_q30>{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}</c_q30></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَنْهُمْ عَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ إِذَا جَاءَ ثُمَّ عَادُوا إِلَى كُفْرِهِمْ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q31" name="q31" href="javascript:openquran(43,16,16)"><c_q31>{‏يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى‏}</c_q31></a>‏ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَلِزَامًا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏<A id="q32" name="q32" href="javascript:openquran(29,1,2)"><c_q32>{‏الم * غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ‏}</c_q32></a>‏ إِلَى ‏{‏سَيَغْلِبُونَ‏}‏ وَالرُّومُ قَدْ مَضَى‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=297></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4775</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181100><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181100><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No child is born except on Al-Fitra (Islam) and then his parents make him 
Jewish, Christian or Magian, as an animal produces a perfect young animal: do you see any part of its 
body amputated?" Then he rec 
'The religion of pure Islamic Faith (Hanifa),(i.e. to worship none but Allah), The pure Allah's Islamic 
nature with which He (Allah) has created mankind. Let There be no change in Allah's religion (i.e. to 
join none in Allah's worship). That is the straight religion; but most of men know not..." (30.30)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ أَوْ يُنَصِّرَانِهِ أَوْ يُمَجِّسَانِهِ، كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ بَهِيمَةً جَمْعَاءَ، هَلْ تُحِسُّونَ فِيهَا مِنْ جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏<A id="q35" name="q35" href="javascript:openquran(29,30,30)"><c_q35>{‏فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذَلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ‏}</c_q35></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=298></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4776</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181110><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181110><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>When there was revealed: 'It is those who believe and confuse not their beliefs with wrong.' (6.82) It 
was very hard for the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so they said, "Which of us has not confused his 
belief with wrong?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Verse does not mean this. Don't you hear Luqman's 
statement to his son: 'Verily! Joining others in worship, with Allah is a great wrong indeed.' (31.13)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏<A id="q37" name="q37" href="javascript:openquran(5,82,82)"><c_q37>{‏الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ‏}</c_q37></a>‏ شَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالُوا أَيُّنَا لَمْ يَلْبِسْ إِيمَانَهُ بِظُلْمٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِذَاكَ، أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ إِلَى قَوْلِ لُقْمَانَ لاِبْنِهِ ‏<A id="q38" name="q38" href="javascript:openquran(30,13,13)"><c_q38>{‏إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}</c_q38></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Verily, Allah! With Him (Alone) is the knowledge of the Hour..." (V.31:34) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q39" name="q39" href="javascript:openquran(30,34,34)"><c_q39>{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ‏}</c_q39></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181120>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=299></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4777</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181120><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181120><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>One day while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting with the people, a man came to him walking and said, "O 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What is Belief?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Belief is to believe in Allah, His Angels, His 
Books, His Apostles, and the meeting with Him, and to believe in the Resurrection." The man asked, 
"O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Islam?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Islam is to worship Allah and not worship 
anything besides Him, to offer prayers perfectly, to pay the (compulsory) charity i.e. Zakat and to fast 
the month of Ramadan." The man again asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) What is Ihsan (i.e. perfection or 
Benevolence)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him, and if you do not 
achieve this state of devotion, then (take it for granted that) Allah sees you." The man further asked, 
"O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) When will the Hour be established?" 
The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "The one who is asked about it does not know more than the questioner does, but 
I will describe to you its portents. When the lady slave gives birth to her mistress, that will be of its 
portents; when the bare-footed naked people become the chiefs of the people, that will be of its 
portents. The Hour is one of five things which nobody knows except Allah. Verily, the knowledge of 
the Hour is with Allah (alone). He sends down the rain, and knows that which is in the wombs." 
(31.34) Then the man left. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Call him back to me." They went to call him back but 
could not see him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was Gabriel who came to teach the people their religion." 
(See Hadith No. 47 Vol 1)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَوْمًا بَارِزًا لِلنَّاسِ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الإِيمَانُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانُ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلِقَائِهِ وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْبَعْثِ الآخِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الإِسْلاَمُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِسْلاَمُ أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ الْمَفْرُوضَةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا الإِحْسَانُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِحْسَانُ أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا الْمَسْئُولُ عَنْهَا بِأَعْلَمَ مِنَ السَّائِلِ، وَلَكِنْ سَأُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا إِذَا وَلَدَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ رَبَّتَهَا، فَذَاكَ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا، وَإِذَا كَانَ الْحُفَاةُ الْعُرَاةُ رُءُوسَ النَّاسِ فَذَاكَ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِهَا فِي خَمْسٍ لا يَعْلَمُهُنَّ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q40" name="q40" href="javascript:openquran(30,34,34)"><c_q40>{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الأَرْحَامِ‏}</c_q40></a>‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذُوا لِيَرُدُّوا فَلَمْ يَرَوْا شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ جَاءَ لِيُعَلِّمَ النَّاسَ دِينَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=300></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4778</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181130><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181130><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The keys of the Unseen are five." And then he recited: 
'Verily, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone).' (31.34)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏"‏ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q41" name="q41" href="javascript:openquran(30,34,34)"><c_q41>{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ‏}</c_q41></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(32)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat as-Sajdah (The Prostration)</div>
<div class=achapno>(32)</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {مَهِينٍ} ضَعِيفٍ، نُطْفَةُ الرَّجُلِ.<br>
<br><a href="javascript:openquran(31,10,10)">{ضَلَلْنَا}</a> هَلَكْنَا.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرُزُ الَّتِي لاَ تُمْطَرُ إِلاَّ مَطَرًا <br>لاَ يُغْنِي عَنْهَا شَيْئًا.<br>
<br>{يَهْدِ} يُبَيِّنُ.</div>

<a name=C32.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "No person knows what is kept hidden for them of joy..." (V.32:17) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q42" name="q42" href="javascript:openquran(31,17,17)"><c_q42>{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ‏ مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ}</c_q42></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181140>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=301></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4779</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181140><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181140><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for my pious worshipers such things as no eye has 
ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of." Abu Huraira added: If you wish 
you can read:-- 'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as reward for what 
they used to do.' 32.17.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏<A id="q43" name="q43" href="javascript:openquran(31,17,17)"><c_q43>{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ‏}</c_q43></a>‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ قِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ رِوَايَةً‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ قَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ قَرَأَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قُرَّاتِ أَعْيُنٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=302></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4780</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181150><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181150><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet, said, "Allah said, 'I have prepared for My pious worshipers such things as no eye has 
ever seen, no ear has ever heard of, and nobody has ever thought of. All that is reserved, besides 
which, all that you have seen, is nothing." Then he recited:-- 
'No soul knows what is kept hidden (in reserve) for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do.' 
(32.17)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، ذُخْرًا، بَلْهَ مَا أُطْلِعْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q44" name="q44" href="javascript:openquran(31,17,17)"><c_q44>{‏فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}</c_q44></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter></div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181160>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=303></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4781</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181160><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181160><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no believer but I, of all the people, I am the closest to him both in this 
world and in the Hereafter. Recite if you wish: 'The Prophet (ﷺ) is closer to the believers than their own 
selves.' (33.6) so if a believer (dies) leaves some property then his relatives will inherit that property; 
but if he is in debt or he leaves poor children, let those (creditors and children) come to me (that I may 
pay the debt and provide for the children), for them I am his sponsor (surely).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُلَيْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏<A id="q45" name="q45" href="javascript:openquran(32,5,5)"><c_q45>{‏النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}</c_q45></a>‏ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلْيَرِثْهُ عَصَبَتُهُ مَنْ كَانُوا، فَإِنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضِيَاعًا فَلْيَأْتِنِي وَأَنَا مَوْلاَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Call them (adopted sons) by (the names of) their fathers. That is more just with Allah..." (V.33:5) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q46" name="q46" href="javascript:openquran(32,5,5)"><c_q46>{‏ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ‏}</c_q46></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=304></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4782</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181170><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181170><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>We used not to call Zaid bin Haritha the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except Zaid bin Muhammad till 
the Qu'anic Verse was revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) by (the names of) their fathers. That is 
more than just in the Sight of Allah." (33.5)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ حَارِثَةَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا كُنَّا نَدْعُوهُ إِلاَّ زَيْدَ ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ ‏<A id="q47" name="q47" href="javascript:openquran(32,5,5)"><c_q47>{‏ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ‏}</c_q47></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Of them, some have fulfilled their obligations (i.e ., have been martyred) and some of them are still waiting, but they have never changed (i.e., they never proved treacherous to their covenant which they concluded with Allah) in the least." (V.33:23) </div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q48" name="q48" href="javascript:openquran(32,23,23)"><c_q48>{‏فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا تَبْدِيلاً‏}</c_q48></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=305></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4783</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181180><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181180><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>We think that the Verse: 'Among the Believers are men who have been true to their covenant with 
Allah.' was revealed in favor of Anas bin An-Nadir.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نُرَى هَذِهِ الآيَةَ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَنَسِ بْنِ النَّضْرِ ‏<A id="q50" name="q50" href="javascript:openquran(32,23,23)"><c_q50>{‏مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ‏}</c_q50></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=306></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4784</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181190><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181190><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:</div><div class=text_details><p>When we collected the fragramentary manuscripts of the Qur'an into copies, I missed one of the 
Verses of Surat al-Ahzab which I used to hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reading. Finally I did not find it with 
anybody except Khuza`ima Al-Ansari, whose witness was considered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) equal to the 
witness of two men. (And that Verse was:) 
'Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي خَارِجَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَسَخْنَا الصُّحُفَ فِي الْمَصَاحِفِ فَقَدْتُ آيَةً مِنْ سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ، كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا، لَمْ أَجِدْهَا مَعَ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ خُزَيْمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، الَّذِي جَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهَادَتَهُ شَهَادَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ ‏<A id="q51" name="q51" href="javascript:openquran(32,23,23)"><c_q51>{‏مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ‏}</c_q51></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah (the Exalted): "O Prophet! (Muḥammad pbuh)! Say to your wives: 'If you desire the life of this world and its glitter, - then come! I will make a provision for you and set you free in a handsome manner (divorce)'." (V.33:28)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q52" name="q52" href="javascript:openquran(32,28,28)"><c_q52>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلاً‏}</c_q52></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: التَّبَرُّجُ أَنْ تُخْرِجَ مَحَاسِنَهَا.<br>
<br><br>
{سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ} اسْتَنَّهَا جَعَلَهَا.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=307></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4785</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181200><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181200><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me when Allah ordered him to give option to his 
wives. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started with me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something but you 
should not hasten (to give your reply) unless you consult your parents.' He knew that my parents 
would not order me to leave him. Then he said, "Allah says:-- 
"O Prophet! Say to your wives..." (33.28-29) 
On that I said to him, "Then why should I consult my parents? Verily, I seek Allah, His Apostle and 
the Home of the Hereafter."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهَا حِينَ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُخَيِّرَ أَزْوَاجَهُ، فَبَدَأَ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي ذَاكِرٌ لَكِ أَمْرًا فَلاَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ تَسْتَعْجِلِي حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرِي أَبَوَيْكِ ‏"‏، وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ أَبَوَىَّ لَمْ يَكُونَا يَأْمُرَانِي بِفِرَاقِهِ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ ‏<A id="q53" name="q53" href="javascript:openquran(32,28,28)"><c_q53>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ‏}</c_q53></a>‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ إِلَى تَمَامِ الآيَتَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَفِي أَىِّ هَذَا أَسْتَأْمِرُ أَبَوَىَّ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "But if you desire Allah and His Messenger, and the home of the Hereafter, then verily, Allah has prepared for Al-Muhsināt (good-doers) amongst you an enormous reward." (V.33:29)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q54" name="q54" href="javascript:openquran(32,29,29)"><c_q54>{‏وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا‏}</c_q54></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(32,34,34)">{وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَى فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ}</a> الْقُرْآنُ وَالسُّنَّةُ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=308></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4786</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181210><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181210><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>(the wife of the Prophet) when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was ordered to give option to his wives, he started with 
me, saying, "I am going to mention to you something, but you shall not hasten (to give your reply) 
unless you consult your parents." The Prophet (ﷺ) knew that my parents would not order me to leave him. 
Then he said, "Allah says: 'O Prophet (Muhammad)! Say to your wives: If you desire the life of this 
world and its glitter........a great reward." (33.28-29) I said, "Then why I consult my parents? Verily, I 
seek Allah, His Apostle and the Home of the Hereafter." Then all the other wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did 
the same as I did.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُمِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَخْيِيرِ أَزْوَاجِهِ بَدَأَ بِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي ذَاكِرٌ لَكِ أَمْرًا فَلاَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ لاَ تَعْجَلِي حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرِي أَبَوَيْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ أَبَوَىَّ لَمْ يَكُونَا يَأْمُرَانِي بِفِرَاقِهِ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ قَالَ ‏<A id="q56" name="q56" href="javascript:openquran(32,28,29)"><c_q56>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا‏}</c_q56></a>‏ إِلَى <A id="q57" name="q57" href="javascript:openquran(32,29,29)"><c_q57>‏{‏أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا‏}‏</c_q57></a> ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ فَفِي أَىِّ هَذَا أَسْتَأْمِرُ أَبَوَىَّ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ، قَالَتْ ثُمَّ فَعَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُوسَى بْنُ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ الْمَعْمَرِيُّ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "And (remember) when you said to him (Zaid bin Haritha [may Allah be pleased with him] - the freed slave of the Prophet pbuh) on whom Allah has bestowed grace (by guiding him to Islam) and you (O Muḥammad pbuh too) have done favour (by manumitting him): 'Keep your wife to yourself and fear Allah.' But you did hide in yourself (i.e., what Allah has already made known to you that He will give her to you in marriage) that which Allah will make manifest, you did fear people (i.e., Muḥammad pbuh married the divorced wife of his manumitted slave) whereas Allah had a better right that you should fear Him..." (V.33:37) </div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q58" name="q58" href="javascript:openquran(32,37,37)"><c_q58>{‏وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشَاهُ‏}</c_q58></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>

<a name=309></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4787</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181220><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181220><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Verse: 'But you did hide in your mind that which Allah was about to make manifest.' (33.37) 
was revealed concerning Zainab bint Jahsh and Zaid bin Haritha.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ هَذِهِ، الآيَةَ ‏<A id="q59" name="q59" href="javascript:openquran(32,37,37)"><c_q59>{‏وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ‏}</c_q59></a>‏ نَزَلَتْ فِي شَأْنِ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ وَزَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(7)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "You (O Muḥammad pbuh) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive whom you will. And whomsoever you desire of those whom you have set aside (her turn temporarily), it is no sin on you (to receive her again)..." (V.33:51)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(7)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ <A id="q60" name="q60" href="javascript:openquran(32,51,51)"><c_q60>‏{‏تُرْجِئُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏</c_q60></a> </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {تُرْجِئُ} تُؤَخِّرُ. أَرْجِئْهُ أَخِّرْهُ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=310></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4788</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181230><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181230><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>I used to look down upon those ladies who had given themselves to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I used to say, 
"Can a lady give herself (to a man)?" But when Allah revealed: "You (O Muhammad) can postpone 
(the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive any of them whom you will; 
and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily).' (33.51) I 
said (to the Prophet), "I feel that your Lord hastens in fulfilling your wishes and desires."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغَارُ عَلَى اللاَّتِي وَهَبْنَ أَنْفُسَهُنَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَقُولُ أَتَهَبُ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَلَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏تُرْجِئُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏ قُلْتُ مَا أُرَى رَبَّكَ إِلاَّ يُسَارِعُ فِي هَوَاكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=311></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4789</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181240><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181240><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Mu`adha:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take the permission of that wife with whom he was supposed to 
stay overnight if he wanted to go to one other than her, after this Verse was revealed:-- 
"You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives) and you may 
receive any (of them) whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you 
have set aside (temporarily). (33.51) I asked Aisha, "What did you use to say (in this case)?" She 
said, "I used to say to him, "If I could deny you the permission (to go to your other wives) I would not 
allow your favor to be bestowed on any other person."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي يَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ مِنَّا بَعْدَ أَنْ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏تُرْجِئُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَا كُنْتِ تَقُولِينَ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَقُولُ لَهُ إِنْ كَانَ ذَاكَ إِلَىَّ فَإِنِّي لاَ أُرِيدُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ أُوثِرَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدًا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ سَمِعَ عَاصِمًا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(8)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "...O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's houses, except when leave is given to you for a meal... (up to) ... Verily! With Allah that shall be an enormity." (V.33:53) </div>
<div class=achapno>(8)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<a href="javascript:openquran(32,53,53)">{‏لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوا وَلاَ مُسْتَأْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيِي مِنْكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَاسْأَلُوهُنَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ ذَلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْذُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوا أَزْوَاجَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا‏}‏</a></div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ ‏{‏إِنَاهُ‏}‏ إِدْرَاكُهُ، أَنَى يَأْنِي أَنَاةً ‏<a href="javascript:openquran(32,63,63)">{‏لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا‏}‏</a> إِذَا وَصَفْتَ صِفَةَ الْمُؤَنَّثِ قُلْتَ قَرِيبَةً وَإِذَا جَعَلْتَهُ ظَرْفًا وَبَدَلاً، وَلَمْ تُرِدِ الصِّفَةَ نَزَعْتَ الْهَاءَ مِنَ الْمُؤَنَّثِ، وَكَذَلِكَ لَفْظُهَا فِي الْوَاحِدِ وَالاِثْنَيْنِ وَالْجَمِيعِ لِلذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏.‏</div>

<a name=312></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4790</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181250><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181250><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Good and bad persons enter upon you, so I suggest that you order the 
mothers of the Believers (i.e. your wives) to observe veils." Then Allah revealed the Verses of Al- 
Hijab.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرُ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحِجَابِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=313></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4791</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181260><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181260><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people to a meal. They took the meal 
and remained sitting and talking. Then the Prophet (showed them) as if he is ready to get up, yet they 
did not get up. When he noticed that (there was no response to his movement), he got up, and the 
others too, got up except three persons who kept on sitting. The Prophet (ﷺ) came back in order to enter 
his house, but he went away again. Then they left, whereupon I set out and went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to tell 
him that they had departed, so he came and entered his house. I wanted to enter along with him, but he 
put a screen between me and him. Then Allah revealed: 
'O you who believe! Do not enter the houses of the Prophet...' (33.53)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ دَعَا الْقَوْمَ، فَطَعِمُوا ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ وَإِذَا هُوَ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْقِيَامِ فَلَمْ يَقُومُوا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَامَ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ مَنْ قَامَ، وَقَعَدَ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَدْخُلَ فَإِذَا الْقَوْمُ جُلُوسٌ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ قَامُوا، فَانْطَلَقْتُ فَجِئْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَدِ انْطَلَقُوا، فَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ، فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ فَأَلْقَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q63" name="q63" href="javascript:openquran(32,53,53)"><c_q63>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ‏}</c_q63></a>‏ الآيَةَ</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=314></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4792</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181270><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181270><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>I of all the people know best this verse of Al-Hijab. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh 
she was with him in the house and he prepared a meal and invited the people (to it). They sat down 
(after finishing their meal) and started chatting. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went out and then returned several 
times while they were still sitting and talking. So Allah revealed the Verse: 
'O you who believe! Enter not the Prophet's houses until leave is given to you for a meal, (and then) 
not (so early as) to wait for its preparation .....ask them from behind a screen.' (33.53) So the screen 
was set up and the people went away.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ، بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ آيَةِ الْحِجَابِ، لَمَّا أُهْدِيَتْ زَيْنَبُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَتْ مَعَهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ، صَنَعَ طَعَامًا، وَدَعَا الْقَوْمَ، فَقَعَدُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ، فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْرُجُ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ، وَهُمْ قُعُودٌ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q64" name="q64" href="javascript:openquran(32,53,53)"><c_q64>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ‏}</c_q64></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q65" name="q65" href="javascript:openquran(32,53,53)"><c_q65>{‏مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ‏}</c_q65></a>‏ فَضُرِبَ الْحِجَابُ، وَقَامَ الْقَوْمُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=315></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4793</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181280><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181280><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>A banquet of bread and meat was held on the occasion of the marriage of the Prophet (ﷺ) to Zainab bint 
Jahsh. I was sent to invite the people (to the banquet), and so the people started coming (in groups); 
They would eat and then leave. Another batch would come, eat and leave. So I kept on inviting the 
people till I found nobody to invite. Then I said, "O Allah's Prophet! I do not find anybody to invite." 
He said, "Carry away the remaining food." Then a batch of three persons stayed in the house chatting. 
The Prophet (ﷺ) left and went towards the dwelling place of Aisha and said, "Peace and Allah's Mercy be 
on you, O the people of the house!" She replied, "Peace and the mercy of Allah be on you too. How 
did you find your wife? May Allah bless you. Then he went to the dwelling places of all his other 
wives and said to them the same as he said to Aisha and they said to him the same as Aisha had said to 
him. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) returned and found a group of three persons still in the house chatting. The 
Prophet was a very shy person, so he went out (for the second time) and went towards the dwelling 
place of `Aisha. I do not remember whether I informed him that the people have gone away. So he 
returned and as soon as he entered the gate, he drew the curtain between me and him, and then the 
Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بُنِيَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِزَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ بِخُبْزٍ وَلَحْمٍ فَأُرْسِلْتُ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ دَاعِيًا فَيَجِيءُ قَوْمٌ فَيَأْكُلُونَ وَيَخْرُجُونَ، ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ قَوْمٌ فَيَأْكُلُونَ وَيَخْرُجُونَ، فَدَعَوْتُ حَتَّى مَا أَجِدُ أَحَدًا أَدْعُو فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَا أَجِدُ أَحَدًا أَدْعُوهُ قَالَ ارْفَعُوا طَعَامَكُمْ، وَبَقِيَ ثَلاَثَةُ رَهْطٍ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، كَيْفَ وَجَدْتَ أَهْلَكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فَتَقَرَّى حُجَرَ نِسَائِهِ كُلِّهِنَّ، يَقُولُ لَهُنَّ كَمَا يَقُولُ لِعَائِشَةَ، وَيَقُلْنَ لَهُ كَمَا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا ثَلاَثَةُ رَهْطٍ فِي الْبَيْتِ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَدِيدَ الْحَيَاءِ، فَخَرَجَ مُنْطَلِقًا نَحْوَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ فَمَا أَدْرِي آخْبَرْتُهُ أَوْ أُخْبِرَ أَنَّ الْقَوْمَ خَرَجُوا، فَرَجَعَ حَتَّى إِذَا وَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فِي أُسْكُفَّةِ الْبَابِ دَاخِلَةً وَأُخْرَى خَارِجَةً أَرْخَى السِّتْرَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، وَأُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=316></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4794</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181290><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181290><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he made the people eat meat and bread to their fill 
(by giving a Walima banquet). Then he went out to the dwelling places of the mothers of the believers 
(his wives), as he used to do in the morning of his marriage. He would greet them and invoke good on 
them, and they (too) would return his greeting and invoke good on him. When he returned to his 
house, he found two men talking to each other; and when he saw them, he went out of his house again. 
When those two men saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): going out of his house, they quickly got up (and departed). 
I do not remember whether I informed him of their departure, or he was informed (by somebody else). 
So he returned, and when he entered the house, he lowered the curtain between me and him. Then the 
Verse of Al-Hijab was revealed.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَكْرٍ السَّهْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوْلَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ بَنَى بِزَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ فَأَشْبَعَ النَّاسَ خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى حُجَرِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كَمَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ صَبِيحَةَ بِنَائِهِ فَيُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَيَدْعُو لَهُنَّ وَيُسَلِّمْنَ عَلَيْهِ وَيَدْعُونَ لَهُ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ رَأَى رَجُلَيْنِ جَرَى بِهِمَا الْحَدِيثُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُمَا رَجَعَ عَنْ بَيْتِهِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى الرَّجُلاَنِ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَعَ عَنْ بَيْتِهِ وَثَبَا مُسْرِعَيْنِ، فَمَا أَدْرِي أَنَا أَخْبَرْتُهُ بِخُرُوجِهِمَا أَمْ أُخْبِرَ فَرَجَعَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ، وَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَأُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=317></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4795</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181300><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181300><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Sauda (the wife of the Prophet) went out to answer the call of nature after it was made obligatory (for 
all the Muslims ladies) to observe the veil. She had a large frame and everybody who knew her 
before could recognize her. So `Umar bin Al-Khattab saw her and said, "O Sauda! By Allah, you 
cannot hide yourself from us, so think of a way by which you should not be recognized on going out. 
Sauda returned while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in my house taking his supper and a bone covered with 
meat was in his hand. She entered and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I went out to answer the call of nature 
and `Umar said to me so-and-so." Then Allah inspired him (the Prophet) and when the state of 
inspiration was over and the bone was still in his hand as he had not put in down, he said (to Sauda), 
"You (women) have been allowed to go out for your needs."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ خَرَجَتْ سَوْدَةُ بَعْدَ مَا ضُرِبَ الْحِجَابُ لِحَاجَتِهَا، وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً جَسِيمَةً لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَى مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا، فَرَآهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ يَا سَوْدَةُ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا تَخْفَيْنَ عَلَيْنَا، فَانْظُرِي كَيْفَ تَخْرُجِينَ، قَالَتْ فَانْكَفَأَتْ رَاجِعَةً، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِي، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَتَعَشَّى‏.‏ وَفِي يَدِهِ عَرْقٌ فَدَخَلَتْ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ لِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِي فَقَالَ لِي عُمَرُ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ رُفِعَ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّ الْعَرْقَ فِي يَدِهِ مَا وَضَعَهُ فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أُذِنَ لَكُنَّ أَنْ تَخْرُجْنَ لِحَاجَتِكُنَّ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->
