<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181580>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=343></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4821</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181580><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181580><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>It (i.e., the imagined smoke) was because, when the Quraish refused to obey the Prophet, he asked 
Allah to afflict them with years of famine similar to those of (Prophet) Joseph. So they were stricken 
with famine and fatigue, so much so that they ate even bones. A man would look towards the sky and 
imagine seeing something like smoke between him and the sky because of extreme fatigue. So Allah 
revealed:-- 
'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the 
people; this is a painfull of torment.' (44.10-11) 
Then someone (Abu Sufyan) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah to 
send rain for the tribes of Mudar for they are on the verge of destruction." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said 
(astonishingly) "Shall I invoke Allah) for the tribes of Mudar? Verily, you are a brave man!" But the 
Prophet prayed for rain and it rained for them. Then the Verse was revealed. 
'But truly you will return (to disbelief).' (44.15) (When the famine was over and) they restored 
prosperity and welfare, they reverted to their ways (of heathenism) whereupon Allah revealed: 
'On the Day when We shall seize you with a Mighty Grasp. We will indeed (then) exact retribution.' 
(44.16) The narrator said, "That was the day of the Battle of Badr."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ هَذَا لأَنَّ قُرَيْشًا لَمَّا اسْتَعْصَوْا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ بِسِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ، فَأَصَابَهُمْ قَحْطٌ وَجَهْدٌ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْعِظَامَ، فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَيَرَى مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ مِنَ الْجَهْدِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q193" name="q193" href="javascript:openquran(43,10,11)"><c_q193>{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ * يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}</c_q193></a>‏ قَالَ فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اسْتَسْقِ اللَّهَ لِمُضَرَ، فَإِنَّهَا قَدْ هَلَكَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِمُضَرَ إِنَّكَ لَجَرِيءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاسْتَسْقَى فَسُقُوا‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q194" name="q194" href="javascript:openquran(43,15,15)"><c_q194>{‏إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}</c_q194></a>‏ فَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْهُمُ الرَّفَاهِيَةُ عَادُوا إِلَى حَالِهِمْ حِينَ أَصَابَتْهُمُ الرَّفَاهِيَةُ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q195" name="q195" href="javascript:openquran(43,16,16)"><c_q195>{‏يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ‏}</c_q195></a>‏ قَالَ يَعْنِي يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "(They will say) Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!" (V.44:12) </div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<a id="q196" name="q196" href="javascript:openquran(43,12,12)">{‏رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ‏}</a></div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181590>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=344></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4822</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181590><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181590><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>It is a sign of having knowledge that, when you do not know something, you say: 'Allah knows better.' 
Allah said to his Prophet: 
'Say: No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I one of the pretenders (a person who pretends 
things which do not exist)' (38.86) When the Quraish troubled and stood against the Prophet (ﷺ) he said, 
"O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine like the seven years of 
Joseph." So they were stricken with a year of famine during which they ate bones and dead animals 
because of too much suffering, and one of them would see something like smoke between him and the 
sky because of hunger. Then they said: Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we are 
believers. (44.12) And then it was said to the Prophet (by Allah), "If we remove it from them. they 
will revert to their ways (of heathenism)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked his Lord, who removed the 
punishment from them, but later they reverted (to heathenism), whereupon Allah punished them on 
the day of the Battle of Badr, and that is what Allah's Statement indicates: 
'Then watch for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible...we will indeed 
(then) exact retribution.' (44.10).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ تَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ تَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏<A id="q197" name="q197" href="javascript:openquran(37,86,86)"><c_q197>{‏قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}</c_q197></a>‏          
إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا لَمَّا غَلَبُوا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاسْتَعْصَوْا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ أَكَلُوا فِيهَا الْعِظَامَ وَالْمَيْتَةَ مِنْ الْجَهْدِ حَتَّى جَعَلَ أَحَدُهُمْ يَرَى مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ مِنْ الْجُوعِ قَالُوا ￼ رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ ￼ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنْ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَادُوا فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ فَكَشَفَ عَنْهُمْ فَعَادُوا فَانْتَقَمَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ￼ فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ.</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> "How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly, has already come to them?" (V.44:13)</div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q201" name="q201" href="javascript:openquran(43,13,13)"><c_q201>{‏أَنَّى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَى وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ‏}</c_q201></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181600>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=345></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4823</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181600><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181600><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Masruq:</div><div class=text_details><p>I came upon `Abdullah and he said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invited Quraish (to Islam), they 
disbelieved him and stood against him. So he (the Prophet) said, "O Allah! Help me against them by 
afflicting them with seven years of famine similar to the seven years of Joseph.' So they were stricken 
with a year of drought that destroyed everything, and they started eating dead animals, and if one of 
them got up he would see something like smoke between him and the sky from the severe fatigue and 
hunger." `Abdullah then recited:-- 
'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the 
people. This is a painful torment... (till he reached) ........ We shall indeed remove the punishment for a 
while, but truly you will revert (to heathenism): (44.10-15) `Abdullah added: "Will the punishment be 
removed from them on the Day of Resurrection?" He added," The severe grasp" was the Day of the 
Battle of Badr."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا دَعَا قُرَيْشًا كَذَّبُوهُ وَاسْتَعْصَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَصَابَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَصَّتْ ـ يَعْنِي ـ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى كَانُوا يَأْكُلُونَ الْمَيْتَةَ فَكَانَ يَقُومُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَكَانَ يَرَى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ مِثْلَ الدُّخَانِ مِنَ الْجَهْدِ وَالْجُوعِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q202" name="q202" href="javascript:openquran(43,10,15)"><c_q202>{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ * يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}</c_q202></a>‏ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏<A id="q203" name="q203" href="javascript:openquran(43,15,15)"><c_q203>{‏إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}</c_q203></a>‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ وَالْبَطْشَةُ الْكُبْرَى يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muḥammad PBUH) and said: (He is) taught (by a human being), a madman!" (V.44:14) </div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q204" name="q204" href="javascript:openquran(43,14,14)"><c_q204>{‏ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجْنُونٌ‏}</c_q204></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=346></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4824</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181610><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181610><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah sent (the Prophet) Muhammad and said:-- 
'Say, No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an) nor am I one of the pretenders (i.e. a person who 
pretends things which do not exist). (38.68) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw Quraish standing against him, 
he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine similar to the 
seven years (of famine) of Joseph. So they were afflicted with a year of drought that destroyed 
everything, and they ate bones and hides. (One of them said), "And they ate hides and dead animals, 
and (it seemed to them that) something like smoke was coming out of the earth. So Abu Sufyan came 
to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! Your people are on the verge of destruction! Please invoke 
Allah to relieve them." So the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for them (and the famine disappeared). He said 
to them. "You will revert (to heathenism) after that." `Abdullah then recited: 
'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible.......but truly 
you will revert (to disbelief).' He added, "Will the punishment be removed from them in the 
Hereafter? The smoke and the grasp and the Al-Lizam have all passed." One of the sub-narrater said, 
"The splitting of the moon." And another said, "The defeat of the Romans (has passed).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏<A id="q205" name="q205" href="javascript:openquran(37,86,86)"><c_q205>{‏قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}</c_q205></a>‏ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا رَأَى قُرَيْشًا اسْتَعْصَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَبْعٍ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ السَّنَةُ حَتَّى حَصَّتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْعِظَامَ وَالْجُلُودَ ـ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْجُلُودَ وَالْمَيْتَةَ ـ وَجَعَلَ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الأَرْضِ كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ أَىْ مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَكْشِفَ عَنْهُمْ فَدَعَا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعُودُوا بَعْدَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ مَنْصُورٍ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q206" name="q206" href="javascript:openquran(43,10,10)"><c_q206>{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}</c_q206></a>‏ إِلَى ‏{‏عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ أَيُكْشَفُ عَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ فَقَدْ مَضَى الدُّخَانُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ الْقَمَرُ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ الرُّومُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=348></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4826</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181630><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181630><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'The son of Adam hurts me for he abuses Time though I am Time: in 
My Hands are all things, and I cause the revolution of day and night.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُؤْذِينِي ابْنُ آدَمَ، يَسُبُّ الدَّهْرَ وَأَنَا الدَّهْرُ، بِيَدِي الأَمْرُ، أُقَلِّبُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<div class=echapno>(46)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Ahqaf (The Sand-Hills)</div>
<div class=achapno>(46)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الأَحْقَافِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {تُفِيضُونَ} تَقُولُونَ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَثَرَةٍ وَأُثْرَةٍ وَأَثَارَةٍ بَقِيَّةُ عِلْمٍ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ} لَسْتُ بِأَوَّلِ الرُّسُلِ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: {أَرَأَيْتُمْ} هَذِهِ الأَلِفُ إِنَّمَا هِيَ تَوَعُّدٌ إِنْ صَحَّ مَا تَدَّعُونَ لاَ يَسْتَحِقُّ أَنْ يُعْبَدَ، وَلَيْسَ قَوْلُهُ: {أَرَأَيْتُمْ} بِرُؤْيَةِ الْعَيْنِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَبَلَغَكُمْ أَنَّ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ خَلَقُوا شَيْئًا.</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q3" name="q3" href="javascript:openquran(45,17,17)"><c_q3>{‏وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ آمِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَذَا إِلاَّ أَسَاطِيرُ الأَوَّلِينَ‏}</c_q3></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181640>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=349></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4827</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181640><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181640><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:</div><div class=text_details><p>Marwan had been appointed as the governor of Hijaz by Muawiya. He delivered a sermon and 
mentioned Yazid bin Muawiya so that the people might take the oath of allegiance to him as the 
successor of his father (Muawiya). Then `Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr told him something 
whereupon Marwan ordered that he be arrested. But `Abdur-Rahman entered `Aisha's house and they 
could not arrest him. Marwan said, "It is he (`AbdurRahman) about whom Allah revealed this Verse:-- 
'And the one who says to his parents: 'Fie on you! Do you hold out the promise to me..?'" 
On that, `Aisha said from behind a screen, "Allah did not reveal anything from the Qur'an about us 
except what was connected with the declaration of my innocence (of the slander).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، قَالَ كَانَ مَرْوَانُ عَلَى الْحِجَازِ اسْتَعْمَلَهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ، فَخَطَبَ فَجَعَلَ يَذْكُرُ يَزِيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، لِكَىْ يُبَايِعَ لَهُ بَعْدَ أَبِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ خُذُوهُ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ بَيْتَ عَائِشَةَ فَلَمْ يَقْدِرُوا ‏{‏عَلَيْهِ‏}‏ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ إِنَّ هَذَا الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ ‏<A id="q4" name="q4" href="javascript:openquran(45,17,17)"><c_q4>{‏وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي‏}</c_q4></a>‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحِجَابِ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِينَا شَيْئًا مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ عُذْرِي‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "Then, when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys..." (V.46:24) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q5" name="q5" href="javascript:openquran(45,24,24)"><c_q5>{‏فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}</c_q5></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181651>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=350></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4828, 4829</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181651><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181651><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>(the wife of the Prophet), I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughing loudly enough to enable me to see his 
uvula, but he used to smile only. And whenever he saw clouds or winds, signs of deep concern would 
appear on his face. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! When people see clouds they usually feel happy, hoping 
that it would rain, while I see that when you see clouds, one could notice signs of dissatisfaction on 
your face." He said, "O `Aisha! What is the guarantee for me that there will be no punishment in it, 
since some people were punished with a wind? Verily, some people saw (received) the punishment, 
but (while seeing the cloud) they said, 'This cloud will give us rain.' "</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَاحِكًا حَتَّى أَرَى مِنْهُ لَهَوَاتِهِ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَتَبَسَّمُ‏.‏         قَالَتْ وَكَانَ إِذَا رَأَى غَيْمًا أَوْ رِيحًا عُرِفَ فِي وَجْهِهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ إِذَا رَأَوُا الْغَيْمَ فَرِحُوا، رَجَاءَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِ الْمَطَرُ، وَأَرَاكَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ عُرِفَ فِي وَجْهِكَ الْكَرَاهِيَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ مَا يُؤْمِنِّي أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عُذِّبَ قَوْمٌ بِالرِّيحِ، وَقَدْ رَأَى قَوْمٌ الْعَذَابَ فَقَالُوا ‏<A id="q6" name="q6" href="javascript:openquran(45,24,24)"><c_q6>{‏هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا‏}</c_q6></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=351></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4830</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181670><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181670><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created His creation, and when He had finished it, the womb, got up and 
caught hold of Allah whereupon Allah said, "What is the matter?' On that, it said, 'I seek refuge with 
you from those who sever the ties of Kith and kin.' On that Allah said, 'Will you be satisfied if I 
bestow My favors on him who keeps your ties, and withhold My favors from him who severs your 
ties?' On that it said, 'Yes, O my Lord!' Then Allah said, 'That is for you.' " Abu Huraira added: If you 
wish, you can recite: "Would you then if you were given the authority. do mischief in the land and 
sever your ties of kinship. (47. 22)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرَّدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ فَأَخَذَتْ بِحَقْوِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ لَهَا مَهْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ بَلَى يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَاكِ لَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏<A id="q11" name="q11" href="javascript:openquran(46,22,22)"><c_q11>{‏فهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ‏}</c_q11></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(48)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Fath (The Triumph)</div>
<div class=achapno>(48)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْفَتْحِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ}</a> السَّحْنَةُ.</br>وَقَالَ مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ التَّوَاضُعُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(47,29,29)" class="aya">{شَطْأَهُ}</a> فِرَاخَهُ <a href="javascript:openquran(47,29,29)" class="aya">{فَاسْتَغْلَظَ}</a> غَلُظَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(47,29,29)" class="aya">{سُوقِهِ}</a> السَّاقُ حَامِلَةُ الشَّجَرَةِ. وَيُقَالُ: <a name='8,98,98wwwwww47,6,6wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ}</a> كَقَوْلِكَ رَجُلُ السَّوْءِ. وَدَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ الْعَذَابُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(47,9,9)" class="aya">{تُعَزِّرُوهُ}</a> تَنْصُرُوهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(47,29,29)" class="aya">{شَطْأَهُ}</a> شَطْءُ السُّنْبُلِ، تُنْبِتُ الْحَبَّةُ عَشْرًا أَوْ ثَمَانِيًا وَسَبْعًا، فَيَقْوَى بَعْضُهُ بِبَعْضٍ فَذَاكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: <a href="javascript:openquran(47,29,29)" class="aya">{فَآزَرَهُ}</a> قَوَّاهُ، وَلَوْ كَانَتْ وَاحِدَةً لَمْ تَقُمْ عَلَى سَاقٍ، وَهُوَ مَثَلٌ ضَرَبَهُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذْ خَرَجَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ قَوَّاهُ بِأَصْحَابِهِ، كَمَا قَوَّى الْحَبَّةَ بِمَا يَنْبُتُ مِنْهَا.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<a name=C48.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "Verily, We have given you (O Muḥammad pbuh) a manifest victory." (V.48:1)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q16" name="q16" href="javascript:openquran(47,1,1)"><c_q16>{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}</c_q16></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h181700>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=354></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4833</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181700><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181700><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aslam:</div><div class=text_details><p>While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night during one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al-Khattab 
was traveling beside him, `Umar asked him about something but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not reply. He 
asked again, but he did not reply, and then he asked (for the third time) but he did not reply. On that, 
`Umar bin Al-Khattab said to himself, "Thakilat Ummu `Umar (May `Umar's mother lose her son)! I 
asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) three times but he did not reply." `Umar then said, "I made my camel run faster 
and went ahead of the people, and I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verses might be revealed about me. 
But before getting involved in any other matter. I heard somebody calling me. I said to myself, 'I fear 
that some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed about me,' and so I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted 
him. 
He (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) said, 'Tonight a Sura has been revealed to me, and it is dearer to me than that on 
which the sun rises (i.e. the world)' Then he recited: "Verily, We have given you a manifest victory." 
(48.1)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فُلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثَكِلَتْ أُمُّ عُمَرَ، نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَمَامَ النَّاسِ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يُنْزَلَ فِيَّ الْقُرْآنُ، فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ بِي فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏"‏‏<A id="q17" name="q17" href="javascript:openquran(47,1,1)"><c_q17>{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}</c_q17></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=355></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4834</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181710><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181710><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ‏<A id="q18" name="q18" href="javascript:openquran(47,1,1)"><c_q18>{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}</c_q18></a>‏ قَالَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=356></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4835</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181720><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181720><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:</div><div class=text_details><p>On the Day of the Conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) recited Surat Al-Fath in a vibrating and pleasant 
voice. (Muawaiya, the subnarrator said, "If I could imitate the recitation of the Prophet (ﷺ) I would do 
so.")</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ قَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ فَرَجَّعَ فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَحْكِيَ لَكُمْ قِرَاءَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَفَعَلْتُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=357></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4836</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181730><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181730><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Mughira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer night prayers till his feet became swollen. Somebody said, to him," "Allah 
has forgiven you, your faults of the past and those to follow." On that, he said, "Shouldn't I be a 
thankful slave of Allah)?"</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تَوَرَّمَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=358></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4837</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181740><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181740><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer prayer at night (for such a long time) that his feet used to crack. I said, "O 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why do you do it since Allah has forgiven you your faults of the past and those to 
follow?" He said, "Shouldn't I love to be a thankful slave (of Allah)?' When he became old, he prayed 
while sitting, but if he wanted to perform a bowing, he would get up, recite (some other verses) and 
then perform the bowing.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَتَفَطَّرَ قَدَمَاهُ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لِمَ تَصْنَعُ هَذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَفَلاَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَثُرَ لَحْمُهُ صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَامَ، فَقَرَأَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q20" name="q20" href="javascript:openquran(32,11,11)"><c_q20>{‏إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا‏}</c_q20></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=359></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4838</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181750><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181750><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-As:</div><div class=text_details><p>This Verse: 
'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner.' 
(48.8) 
which is in the Qur'an, appears in the Torah thus: 'Verily We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a 
witness, as a bringer of glad tidings and as a warner, and as a protector for the illiterates (i.e., the 
Arabs.) You are my slave and My Apostle, and I have named you Al-Mutawakkil (one who depends 
upon Allah). You are neither hard-hearted nor of fierce character, nor one who shouts in the markets. 
You do not return evil for evil, but excuse and forgive. Allah will not take you unto Him till He guides 
through you a crocked (curved) nation on the right path by causing them to say: "None has the right to 
be worshipped but Allah." With such a statement He will cause to open blind eyes, deaf ears and 
hardened hearts.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ هَذِهِ، الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي الْقُرْآنِ ‏<A id="q21" name="q21" href="javascript:openquran(32,45,45)"><c_q21>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا‏}</c_q21></a>‏ قَالَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَحِرْزًا لِلأُمِّيِّينَ، أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَرَسُولِي سَمَّيْتُكَ الْمُتَوَكِّلَ لَيْسَ بِفَظٍّ وَلاَ غَلِيظٍ وَلاَ سَخَّابٍ بِالأَسْوَاقِ وَلاَ يَدْفَعُ السَّيِّئَةَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَصْفَحُ وَلَنْ يَقْبِضَهُ اللَّهُ حَتَّى يُقِيمَ بِهِ الْمِلَّةَ الْعَوْجَاءَ بِأَنْ يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ فَيَفْتَحَ بِهَا أَعْيُنًا عُمْيًا وَآذَانًا صُمًّا وَقُلُوبًا غُلْفًا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=360></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4839</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181760><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181760><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>While a man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was reciting (Qur'an) and his horse was tied in the 
house, the horse got startled and started jumping. The man came out, looked around but could not find 
anything, yet the horse went on jumping. The next morning he mentioned that to the Prophet. 
The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That was the tranquility (calmness) which descended because of the recitation of 
the Qur'an."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ، وَفَرَسٌ لَهُ مَرْبُوطٌ فِي الدَّارِ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْفِرُ، فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ فَنَظَرَ فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا، وَجَعَلَ يَنْفِرُ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ تِلْكَ السَّكِينَةُ تَنَزَّلَتْ بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<a name=362></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4841</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181780><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181780><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Uqba bin Sahban:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani who was one of those who witnessed (the event of) the tree, said, 
"The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the throwing of small stones (with two fingers)."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ صُهْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، إِنِّي مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ الشَّجَرَةَ، نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَذْفِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=364></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4843</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181800><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181800><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=365></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4844</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181810><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181810><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Habib bin Abi Thabit:</div><div class=text_details><p>I went to Abu Wail to ask him (about those who had rebelled against `Ali). On that Abu Wail said, 
"We were at Siffin (a city on the bank of the Euphrates, the place where me battle took place between 
`Ali and Muawiya) A man said, "Will you be on the side of those who are called to consult Allah's 
Book (to settle the dispute)?" `Ali said, 'Yes (I agree that we should settle the matter in the light of the 
Qur'an)." ' Some people objected to `Ali's agreement and wanted to fight. On that Sahl bin Hunaif 
said, 'Blame yourselves! I remember how, on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (i.e. the peace treaty between 
the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Quraish pagans), if we had been allowed to choose fighting, we would have 
fought (the pagans). At that time `Umar came (to the Prophet) and said, "Aren't we on the right (path) 
and they (pagans) in the wrong? Won't our killed persons go to Paradise, and theirs in the Fire?" The 
Prophet replied, "Yes." `Umar further said, "Then why should we let our religion be degraded and 
return before Allah has settled the matter between us?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! 
No doubt, I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah will never neglect me." So `Umar left the place angrily and 
he was so impatient that he went to Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr! Aren't we on the right (path) 
and they (pagans) on the wrong?" Abu Bakr said, "O the son of Al-Khattab! He is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and 
Allah will never neglect him." Then Sura Al-Fath (The Victory) was revealed."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ السُّلَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ سِيَاهٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ أَسْأَلُهُ فَقَالَ كُنَّا بِصِفِّينَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ اتَّهِمُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ ـ يَعْنِي الصُّلْحَ الَّذِي كَانَ بَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ ـ وَلَوْ نَرَى قِتَالاً لَقَاتَلْنَا، فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهُمْ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ أَلَيْسَ قَتْلاَنَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَقَتْلاَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَفِيمَ أُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِي دِينِنَا، وَنَرْجِعُ وَلَمَّا يَحْكُمِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَنِي اللَّهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ مُتَغَيِّظًا، فَلَمْ يَصْبِرْ حَتَّى جَاءَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهُمْ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ قَالَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَهُ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(48,1,1)" class="aya">{لاَ تُقَدِّمُوا}</a> لاَ تَفْتَاتُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِهِ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(48,3,3)" class="aya">{امْتَحَنَ}</a> أَخْلَصَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(48,11,11)" class="aya">{تَنَابَزُوا}</a> يُدْعَى بِالْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ الإِسْلاَمِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَلِتْكُمْ}</a> يَنْقُصْكُمْ، أَلَتْنَا نَقَصْنَا.</div>

<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> "O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet pbuh ..." (V.49:2)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q25" name="q25" href="javascript:openquran(48,2,2)"><c_q25>{‏لاَ تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ‏}</c_q25></a>‏ الآيَةَ  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">{تَشْعُرُونَ} تَعْلَمُونَ وَمِنْهُ الشَّاعِرُ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=366></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4845</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181820><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181820><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:</div><div class=text_details><p>The two righteous persons were about to be ruined. They were Abu Bakr and `Umar who raised their 
voices in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ) when a mission from Bani Tamim came to him. One of the two 
recommended Al-Aqra' bin Habeas, the brother of Bani Mujashi (to be their governor) while the other 
recommended somebody else. (Nafi`, the sub-narrator said, I do not remember his name). Abu Bakr 
said to `Umar, "You wanted nothing but to oppose me!" `Umar said, "I did not intend to oppose you." 
Their voices grew loud in that argument, so Allah revealed: 
'O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet.' (49.2) Ibn Az-Zubair 
said, "Since the revelation of this Verse, `Umar used to speak in such a low tone that the Prophet (ﷺ) had 
to ask him to repeat his statements." But Ibn Az-Zubair did not mention the same about his (maternal) 
grandfather (i.e. Abu Bakr).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَسَرَةُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ اللَّخْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ كَادَ الْخَيِّرَانِ أَنْ يَهْلِكَا ـ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ رَفَعَا أَصْوَاتَهُمَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ رَكْبُ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، فَأَشَارَ أَحَدُهُمَا بِالأَقْرَعِ بْنِ حَابِسٍ أَخِي بَنِي مُجَاشِعٍ، وَأَشَارَ الآخَرُ بِرَجُلٍ آخَرَ ـ قَالَ نَافِعٌ لاَ أَحْفَظُ اسْمَهُ ـ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِعُمَرَ مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلاَّ خِلاَفِي‏.‏ قَالَ مَا أَرَدْتُ خِلاَفَكَ‏.‏ فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا فِي ذَلِكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q26" name="q26" href="javascript:openquran(48,2,2)"><c_q26>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ‏}</c_q26></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَمَا كَانَ عُمَرُ يُسْمِعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ حَتَّى يَسْتَفْهِمَهُ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَعْنِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=367></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4846</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181830><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181830><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) missed Thabit bin Qais for a period (So he inquired about him). A man said. "O Allah's 
Apostle! I will bring you his news." So he went to Thabit and found him sitting in his house and 
bowing his head. The man said to Thabit, " 'What is the matter with you?" Thabit replied that it was an 
evil affair, for he used to raise his voice above the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds had 
been annulled, and he considered himself as one of the people of the Fire. Then the man returned to 
the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him that Thabit had said, so-and-so. (Musa bin Anas) said: The man returned to 
Thabit with great glad tidings. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the man. "Go back to him and say to him: "You are 
not from the people of the Hell Fire, but from the people of Paradise."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم افْتَقَدَ ثَابِتَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ لَكَ عِلْمَهُ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَوَجَدَهُ جَالِسًا فِي بَيْتِهِ مُنَكِّسًا رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا شَأْنُكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ شَرٌّ‏.‏ كَانَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ، وَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَأَتَى الرَّجُلُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ـ فَقَالَ مُوسَى ـ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَرَّةَ الآخِرَةَ بِبِشَارَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَسْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَلَكِنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"Verily! Those who call you from behind the dwellings, most of them have no sense." (V.49:4) </div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q27" name="q27" href="javascript:openquran(48,4,4)"><c_q27>{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لاَ يَعْقِلُونَ‏}</c_q27></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=368></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4847</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181840><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181840><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>A group of Bani Tamim came to the Prophet (and requested him to appoint a governor for them). Abu 
Bakr said, "Appoint Al-Qaqa bin Mabad." `Umar said, "Appoint Al-Aqra' bin Habeas." On that Abu 
Bakr said (to `Umar). "You did not want but to oppose me!" `Umar replied "I did not intend to oppose 
you!" So both of them argued till their voices grew loud. So the following Verse was revealed: 
'O you who believe! Be not forward......' (49.1)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُ، قَدِمَ رَكْبٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمِّرِ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ مَعْبَدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بَلْ أَمِّرِ الأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلَى ـ أَوْ إِلاَّ ـ خِلاَفِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ مَا أَرَدْتُ خِلاَفَكَ‏.‏ فَتَمَارَيَا حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا، فَنَزَلَ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَىِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ‏}‏ حَتَّى انْقَضَتِ الآيَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q36" name="q36" href="javascript:openquran(49,30,30)"><c_q36>{‏وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ‏}</c_q36></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=369></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4848</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181850><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181850><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will be thrown into the (Hell) Fire and it will say: "Are there any more 
(to come)?' (50.30) till Allah puts His Foot over it and it will say, 'Qati! Qati! (Enough Enough!)'"</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ‏.‏ حَتَّى يَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ فَتَقُولُ قَطِ قَطِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<a name=370></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4849</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181860><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181860><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رَفَعَهُ وَأَكْثَرُ مَا كَانَ يُوقِفُهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ يُقَالُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ فَيَضَعُ الرَّبُّ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَدَمَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَقُولُ قَطِ قَطِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=371></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4850</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181870><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181870><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Paradise and the Fire (Hell) argued, and the Fire (Hell) said, "I have been given the 
privilege of receiving the arrogant and the tyrants.' Paradise said, 'What is the matter with me? Why 
do only the weak and the humble among the people enter me?' On that, Allah said to Paradise. 'You 
are My Mercy which I bestow on whoever I wish of my servants.' Then Allah said to the (Hell) Fire, 
'You are my (means of) punishment by which I punish whoever I wish of my slaves. And each of you 
will have its fill.' As for the Fire (Hell), it will not be filled till Allah puts His Foot over it whereupon 
it will say, 'Qati! Qati!' At that time it will be filled, and its different parts will come closer to each 
other; and Allah will not wrong any of His created beings. As regards Paradise, Allah will create a 
new creation to fill it with."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ تَحَاجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَقَالَتِ النَّارُ أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ وَالْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ مَا لِي لاَ يَدْخُلُنِي إِلاَّ ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى لِلْجَنَّةِ أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ عَذَابٌ أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي‏.‏ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا مِلْؤُهَا، فَأَمَّا النَّارُ فَلاَ تَمْتَلِئُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فَتَقُولُ قَطٍ قَطٍ قَطٍ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ تَمْتَلِئُ وَيُزْوَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ، وَلاَ يَظْلِمُ اللَّهُ ـ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ أَحَدًا، وَأَمَّا الْجَنَّةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُنْشِئُ لَهَا خَلْقًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "...And glorify the praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e., the Fajr, Ẓuhr and 'Aṣr prayers) ." (V.50:39) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q37" name="q37" href="javascript:openquran(49,39,39)"><c_q37>{‏وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ‏}</c_q37></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=372></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4851</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181880><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181880><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a fourteenth night (of the lunar month), and he looked at 
the (full) moon and said, "You will see your Lord as you see this moon, and you will have no trouble 
in looking at Him. So, whoever can, should not miss the offering of prayers before sunrise (Fajr 
prayer) and before sunset (`Asr prayer)." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 
'And celebrate the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.' (50.39)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا لَيْلَةً مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا، لاَ تُضَامُونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُغْلَبُوا عَلَى صَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا فَافْعَلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q38" name="q38" href="javascript:openquran(49,39,39)"><c_q38>{‏وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ‏}</c_q38></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=373></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4852</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181890><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181890><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4852">Sahih al-Bukhari 4852</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 373</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 375</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(45300, 'h181890')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4852')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><a name=C51.00></a>
<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(51)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat adh-Dhariyat (Scattering Winds)</div>
<div class=achapno>(51)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة وَالذَّارِيَاتِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الرِّيَاحُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: تَذْرُوهُ تُفَرِّقُهُ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ}</a> تَأْكُلُ وَتَشْرَبُ فِي مَدْخَلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ مَوْضِعَيْنِ.</br><a name='36,91,91wwwwww36,93,93wwwwww50,26,26wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَرَاغَ}</a> فَرَجَعَ <a href="javascript:openquran(50,29,29)" class="aya">{فَصَكَّتْ}</a> فَجَمَعَتْ أَصَابِعَهَا فَضَرَبَتْ جَبْهَتَهَا. وَالرَّمِيمُ نَبَاتُ الأَرْضِ إِذَا يَبِسَ وَدِيسَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(50,47,47)" class="aya">{لَمُوسِعُونَ}</a> أَيْ لَذُو سَعَةٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{عَلَى الْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُ}</a> يَعْنِي الْقَوِيَّ <a name='10,40,40wwwwww12,3,3wwwwww22,27,27wwwwww50,49,49wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{زَوْجَيْنِ}</a> الذَّكَرَ وَالأُنْثَى، وَاخْتِلاَفُ الأَلْوَانِ حُلْوٌ وَحَامِضٌ فَهُمَا زَوْجَانِ <a href="javascript:openquran(50,50,50)" class="aya">{فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ}</a> مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَيْهِ <a href="javascript:openquran(50,56,56)" class="aya">{إِلاَّ لِيَعْبُدُونِ}</a> مَا خَلَقْتُ أَهْلَ السَّعَادَةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ إِلاَّ لِيُوَحِّدُونِ.</br>وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ خَلَقَهُمْ لِيَفْعَلُوا، فَفَعَلَ بَعْضٌ وَتَرَكَ بَعْضٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ حُجَّةٌ لأَهْلِ الْقَدَرِ، وَالذَّنُوبُ الدَّلْوُ الْعَظِيمُ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(50,29,29)" class="aya">{صَرَّةٍ}</a> صَيْحَةٍ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{ذَنُوبًا}</a> سَبِيلاً. الْعَقِيمُ الَّتِي لاَ تَلِدُ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَالْحُبُكُ اسْتِوَاؤُهَا وَحُسْنُهَا <a name='22,63,63wwwwww50,11,11wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{فِي غَمْرَةٍ}</a> فِي ضَلاَلَتِهِمْ يَتَمَادَوْنَ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ تَوَاصَوْا تَوَاطَئُوا وَقَالَ: <a name='10,83,83wwwwww50,34,34wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسَوَّمَةً}</a> مُعَلَّمَةً مِنَ السِّيمَا.</div>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(52)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat at-Tur (Mount Tur)</div>
<div class=achapno>(52)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة وَالطُّورِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَسْطُورٍ}</a> مَكْتُوبٍ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: الطُّورُ الْجَبَلُ بِالسُّرْيَانِيَّةِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ}</a> صَحِيفَةٍ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ}</a> سَمَاءٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمَسْجُورِ}</a> الْمُوقَدِ.</br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ تُسْجَرُ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ مَاؤُهَا فَلاَ يَبْقَى فِيهَا قَطْرَةٌ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَلَتْنَاهُمْ}</a> نَقَصْنَا.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='51,9,9wwwwww66,16,16wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَمُورُ}</a> تَدُورُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَحْلاَمُهُمْ}</a> الْعُقُولُ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْبَرُّ}</a> اللَّطِيفُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{كِسْفًا}</a> قِطْعًا. الْمَنُونُ الْمَوْتُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='17,21,21wwwwww51,23,23wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{يَتَنَازَعُونَ}</a> يَتَعَاطَوْنَ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=374></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4853</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181900><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181900><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Um Salama:</div><div class=text_details><p>I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick, so he said, "Perform the Tawaf (of Ka`ba at Mecca) 
while riding behind the people (who are performing the Tawaf on foot)." So I performed the Tawaf 
while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer by the side of the Ka`ba and was reciting: 'By the Mount 
(Saini) and by a Decree Inscribed.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ شَكَوْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي أَشْتَكِي فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ طُوفِي مِنْ وَرَاءِ النَّاسِ، وَأَنْتِ رَاكِبَةٌ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ فَطُفْتُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي إِلَى جَنْبِ الْبَيْتِ يَقْرَأُ بِالطُّورِ وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=375></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4854</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181910><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181910><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tur in the Maghrib prayer, and when he reached the Verse: 
'Were they created by nothing, Or were they themselves the creators, Or did they create the Heavens 
and the Earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief Or do they own the treasures of Your Lord? Or have 
they been given the authority to do as they like...' (52.35-37) my heart was about to fly (when I 
realized this firm argument).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثُونِي عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ <A id="q47" name="q47" href="javascript:openquran(51,35,37)"><c_q47>‏{‏أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ * أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ بَلْ لاَ يُوقِنُونَ * أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُسَيْطِرُونَ‏}‏</c_q47></a> كَادَ قَلْبِي أَنْ يَطِيرَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَأَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ‏.‏ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ زَادَ الَّذِي قَالُوا لِي‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة وَالنَّجْمِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(52,6,6)" class="aya">{ذُو مِرَّةٍ}</a> ذُو قُوَّةٍ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(52,9,9)" class="aya">{قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ}</a> حَيْثُ الْوَتَرُ مِنَ الْقَوْسِ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(52,22,22)" class="aya">{ضِيزَى}</a> عَوْجَاءُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(52,34,34)" class="aya">{وَأَكْدَى}</a> قَطَعَ عَطَاءَهُ <a href="javascript:openquran(52,49,49)" class="aya">{رَبُّ الشِّعْرَى}</a> هُوَ مِرْزَمُ الْجَوْزَاءِ <a href="javascript:openquran(52,37,37)" class="aya">{الَّذِي وَفَّى}</a> وَفَّى مَا فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ <a href="javascript:openquran(52,57,57)" class="aya">{أَزِفَتِ الآزِفَةُ}</a> اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ <a href="javascript:openquran(52,61,61)" class="aya">{سَامِدُونَ}</a> الْبَرْطَمَةُ.</br>وَقَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ يَتَغَنَّوْنَ بِالْحِمْيَرِيَّةِ.</br>وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(52,12,12)" class="aya">{أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ}</a> أَفَتُجَادِلُونَهُ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ أَفَتَمْرُونَهُ يَعْنِي أَفَتَجْحَدُونَهُ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ}</a> بَصَرُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ <a href="javascript:openquran(52,17,17)" class="aya">{وَمَا طَغَى}</a> وَلاَ جَاوَزَ مَا رَأَى.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(53,36,36)" class="aya">{فَتَمَارَوْا}</a> كَذَّبُوا.</br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(52,1,1)" class="aya">{إِذَا هَوَى}</a> غَابَ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(52,48,48)" class="aya">{أَغْنَى وَأَقْنَى}</a> أَعْطَى فَأَرْضَى.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=376></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4855</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181920><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181920><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Masruq:</div><div class=text_details><p>I said to `Aisha, "O Mother! Did Prophet Muhammad see his Lord?" Aisha said, "What you have said 
makes my hair stand on end ! Know that if somebody tells you one of the following three things, he is 
a liar: Whoever tells you that Muhammad saw his Lord, is a liar." Then Aisha recited the Verse: 
'No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision. He is the Most Courteous Well-Acquainted 
with all things.' (6.103) 'It is not fitting for a human being that Allah should speak to him except by 
inspiration or from behind a veil.' (42.51) `Aisha further said, "And whoever tells you that the 
Prophet knows what is going to happen tomorrow, is a liar." She then recited: 
'No soul can know what it will earn tomorrow.' (31.34) She added: "And whoever tell you that he 
concealed (some of Allah's orders), is a liar." Then she recited: 'O Apostle! Proclaim (the Message) 
which has been sent down to you from your Lord..' (5.67) `Aisha added. "But the Prophet (ﷺ) saw Gabriel 
in his true form twice."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ يَا أُمَّتَاهْ هَلْ رَأَى مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَبَّهُ فَقَالَتْ لَقَدْ قَفَّ شَعَرِي مِمَّا قُلْتَ، أَيْنَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَهُنَّ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ، مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَبَّهُ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏<A id="q57" name="q57" href="javascript:openquran(5,102,102)"><c_q57>{‏لاَ تُدْرِكُهُ الأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الأَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ‏}</c_q57></a>‏ ‏<A id="q58" name="q58" href="javascript:openquran(41,51,51)"><c_q58>{‏وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ‏}</c_q58></a>‏ وَمَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غَدٍ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏<A id="q59" name="q59" href="javascript:openquran(30,34,34)"><c_q59>{‏وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا‏}</c_q59></a>‏ وَمَنْ حَدَّثَكَ أَنَّهُ كَتَمَ فَقَدْ كَذَبَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏<A id="q60" name="q60" href="javascript:openquran(4,67,67)"><c_q60>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ‏}</c_q60></a>‏ الآيَةَ، وَلَكِنَّهُ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فِي صُورَتِهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=377></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4856</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181930><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181930><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the Verses: 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer; So did (Allah) 
convey the Inspiration to His slave (Gabriel) and then he Gabriel) conveyed (that to Muhammad...' 
(53.9-10) Ibn Mas`ud narrated to us that the Prophet (ﷺ) had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زِرًّا، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ‏<A id="q62" name="q62" href="javascript:openquran(52,9,10)"><c_q62>{‏فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى * فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى‏}</c_q62></a>‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّهُ رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=378></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4857</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181940><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181940><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ash-Shaibani:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Zirr about the Statement of Allah: 
'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer. So did Allah convey the Inspiration to 
His slave (Gabriel) and then he (Gabriel) conveyed that to Muhammad.' (53.10) He said, "Abdullah 
(bin Mas`ud) informed us that Muhammad had seen Gabriel with six hundred wings."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ زِرًّا عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q64" name="q64" href="javascript:openquran(52,9,10)"><c_q64>{‏فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى * فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى‏}</c_q64></a>‏ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى جِبْرِيلَ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=379></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4858</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181950><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181950><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>(regarding the revelation) Truly he (Muhammad) did see of the signs of his Lord; the Greatest!' 
(53.18) The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a green screen covering the horizon.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه – ‏<A id="q66" name="q66" href="javascript:openquran(52,18,18)"><c_q66>{‏لَقَدْ رَأَى مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَى‏}</c_q66></a>‏ قَالَ رَأَى رَفْرَفًا أَخْضَرَ قَدْ سَدَّ الأُفُقَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Have you then considered Al-Lat and AI-'Uzza? (1) " (V.53:19)  (1) :(Ch. 2) Lat and 'Uzza were two idols worshipped by the pagan Arabs during the Pre-Islamic Period of Ignorance.   </div>

<a name=381></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4860</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181970><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181970><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

'Come along, let us gamble' must give alms (as an expiation).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ فَقَالَ فِي حَلِفِهِ وَاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى‏.‏ فَلْيَقُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ وَمَنْ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ تَعَالَ أُقَامِرْكَ‏.‏ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=382></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4861</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181980><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181980><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked `Aisha (regarding the Sai between As Safa and Al-Marwa). She said, "Out of reverence to the 
idol Manat which was placed in Al-Mushailal, those who used to assume Ihram in its name, used not 
to perform Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, so Allah revealed: 
'Verily! The As-Safa and Al-Marwa (two mountains at Mecca) are among the symbols of Allah.' 
(2.158). 
Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims used to perform Sai (between them)." Sufyan said: The 
(idol) Manat was at Al-Mushailal in Qudaid. `Aisha added, "The Verse was revealed in connection 
with the Ansar. They and (the tribe of) Ghassan used to assume lhram in the name of Manat before 
they embraced Islam." `Aisha added, "There were men from the Ansar who used to assume lhram in 
the name of Manat which was an idol between Mecca and Medina. They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We 
used not to perform the Tawaf (Sai) between As-Safa and Al-Marwa out of reverence to Manat."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ، قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا كَانَ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِمَنَاةَ الطَّاغِيَةِ الَّتِي بِالْمُشَلَّلِ لاَ يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q70" name="q70" href="javascript:openquran(1,158,158)"><c_q70>{‏إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ‏}</c_q70></a>‏ فَطَافَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَنَاةُ بِالْمُشَلَّلِ مِنْ قُدَيْدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ نَزَلَتْ فِي الأَنْصَارِ كَانُوا هُمْ وَغَسَّانُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمُوا يُهِلُّونَ لِمَنَاةَ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِمَّنْ كَانَ يُهِلُّ لِمَنَاةَ ـ وَمَنَاةُ صَنَمٌ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ـ قَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ كُنَّا لاَ نَطُوفُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ تَعْظِيمًا لِمَنَاةَ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=383></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4862</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc181990><div class="englishcontainer" id=t181990><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) performed a prostration when he finished reciting Surat-an-Najm, and all the Muslims 
and pagans and Jinns and human beings prostrated along with him.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّجْمِ وَسَجَدَ مَعَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=384></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4863</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182000><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182000><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The first Sura in which a prostration was mentioned, was Sura An-Najm (The Star). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
prostrated (while reciting it), and everybody behind him prostrated except a man whom I saw taking a 
hand-full of dust in his hand and prostrated on it. Later I saw that man killed as an infidel, and he was 
Umaiya bin Khalaf.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ سُورَةٍ أُنْزِلَتْ فِيهَا سَجْدَةٌ ‏{‏وَالنَّجْمِ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَجَدَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ، إِلاَّ رَجُلاً رَأَيْتُهُ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ تُرَابٍ فَسَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ، فَرَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا، وَهْوَ أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(54)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Qamar (The Moon)</div>
<div class=achapno>(54)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْتَمِرٌّ}</a> ذَاهِبٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(53,4,4)" class="aya">{مُزْدَجَرٌ}</a> مُتَنَاهٍ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(53,9,9)" class="aya">{وَازْدُجِرَ}</a> فَاسْتُطِيرَ جُنُونًا <a href="javascript:openquran(53,13,13)" class="aya">{دُسُرٍ}</a> أَضْلاَعُ السَّفِينَةِ، <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ}</a> يَقُولُ كُفِرَ لَهُ جَزَاءً مِنَ اللَّهِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُحْتَضَرٌ}</a> يَحْضُرُونَ الْمَاءَ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ: <a name='13,43,43wwwwww53,8,8wwwwww69,36,36wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُهْطِعِينَ}</a> النَّسَلاَنُ، الْخَبَبُ السِّرَاعُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(53,29,29)" class="aya">{فَتَعَاطَى}</a> فَعَاطَهَا بِيَدِهِ فَعَقَرَهَا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمُحْتَظِرِ}</a> كَحِظَارٍ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ مُحْتَرِقٍ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(53,9,9)" class="aya">{ازْدُجِرَ}</a> افْتُعِلَ مِنْ زَجَرْتُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(53,14,14)" class="aya">{كُفِرَ}</a> فَعَلْنَا بِهِ وَبِهِمْ مَا فَعَلْنَا جَزَاءً لِمَا صُنِعَ بِنُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابِهِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْتَقِرٌّ}</a> عَذَابٌ حَقٌّ، يُقَالُ الأَشَرُ الْمَرَحُ وَالتَّجَبُّرُ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> "...And the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muḥammad pbuh to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon). And if they see a sign, they turn away..." (V.54:1,2)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q73" name="q73" href="javascript:openquran(53,1,2)"><c_q73>{‏وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ * وَإِنْ يَرَوْا آيَةً يُعْرِضُوا‏}</c_q73></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182010>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=385></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4864</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182010><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182010><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn Masud:</div><div class=text_details><p>During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts; one part remained over the 
mountain, and the other part went beyond the mountain. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Witness this 
miracle."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، وَسُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِرْقَتَيْنِ، فِرْقَةً فَوْقَ الْجَبَلِ وَفِرْقَةً دُونَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->
