<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=386></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4865</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182020><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182020><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The moon was cleft asunder while we were in the company of the Prophet, and it became two parts. 
The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Witness, witness (this miracle).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَارَ فِرْقَتَيْنِ، فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ اشْهَدُوا، اشْهَدُوا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=387></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4866</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182030><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182030><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The moon was cleft asunder during the lifetime of the Prophet.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ فِي زَمَانِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=388></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4867</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182040><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182040><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The people of Mecca asked the Prophet (ﷺ) to show them a sign (miracle). So he showed them (the 
miracle) of the cleaving of the moon.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلَ أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يُرِيَهُمْ آيَةً فَأَرَاهُمُ انْشِقَاقَ الْقَمَرِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q74" name="q74" href="javascript:openquran(53,14,15)"><c_q74>{‏تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ* وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}</c_q74></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=390></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4869</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182060><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182060><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=392></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4871</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182080><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182080><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:</div><div class=text_details><p>A man asked Al-Aswad, 'is it 'Fahal min-Muddakir' or'..Mudhdhakir?" Al Aswad replied, 'I have 
heard `Abdullah bin Masud reciting it, 'Fahal-min Muddakir'; I too, heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting it 
'Fahal-min-Muddakir' with 'd'.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ الأَسْوَدَ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ أَوْ مُذَّكِرٍ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ يَقْرَؤُهَا ‏<A id="q79" name="q79" href="javascript:openquran(53,15,15)"><c_q79>{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}</c_q79></a>‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا ‏<A id="q80" name="q80" href="javascript:openquran(53,15,15)"><c_q80>{‏فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ‏}</c_q80></a>‏ دَالاً‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "Their multitude will be put to flight." (V.54:45)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q87" name="q87" href="javascript:openquran(53,45,45)"><c_q87>{‏سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ‏}</c_q87></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182120>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=396></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4875</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182120><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182120><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while in a tent on the day of the Battle of Badr, said, "O Allah! I request you (to 
fulfill) Your promise and contract! O Allah! If You wish that you will not be worshipped henceforth.." 
On that Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) You have 
appealed to your Lord too pressingly," while the Prophet (ﷺ) was putting on his armor. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
went out, reciting Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.' (54.45)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهْوَ فِي قُبَّةٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ لاَ تُعْبَدْ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ حَسْبُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلْحَحْتَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ‏.‏ وَهْوَ يَثِبُ فِي الدِّرْعِ، فَخَرَجَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏<A id="q88" name="q88" href="javascript:openquran(53,45,45)"><c_q88>{‏سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ‏}</c_q88></a>‏‏.‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q89" name="q89" href="javascript:openquran(53,46,46)"><c_q89>{‏بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}</c_q89></a>‏ يَعْنِي مِنَ الْمَرَارَةِ  </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=397></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4876</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182130><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182130><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Yusuf bin Mahik:</div><div class=text_details><p>I was in the house of `Aisha, the mother of the Believers. She said, "This revelation: "Nay, but the 
Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense); and the Hour will be more previous and most 
bitter." (54.46) was revealed to Muhammad at Mecca while I was a playfull little girl."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ مَاهَكَ، قَالَ إِنِّي عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَتْ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ، وَإِنِّي لَجَارِيَةٌ أَلْعَبُ ‏<A id="q90" name="q90" href="javascript:openquran(53,46,46)"><c_q90>{‏بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}</c_q90></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=398></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4877</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182140><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182140><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>While in his tent on the day the Battle of Badr, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! I request You (to fulfill) 
Your promise and contract. O Allah! It You wish that the Believers be destroyed). You will never be 
worshipped henceforth." On that, Abu Bakr held the Prophet (ﷺ) by the hand and said, "That is enough, O 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have appealed to your Lord too pressingly" The Prophet (ﷺ) was wearing his armor 
and then went out reciting: 
'Their multitude will be put to flight and they will show their backs. Nay, but the Hour is their 
appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more previous and most bitter.' 
(54.45-46)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهْوَ فِي قُبَّةٍ لَهُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏ أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تُعْبَدْ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ حَسْبُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ أَلْحَحْتَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ‏.‏ وَهْوَ فِي الدِّرْعِ فَخَرَجَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏<A id="q91" name="q91" href="javascript:openquran(53,45,46)"><c_q91>{‏سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ * بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ‏}</c_q91></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(55)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat ar-Rahman (The Most Compassionate)</div>
<div class=achapno>(55)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الرَّحْمَنِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ}</a> يُرِيدُ لِسَانَ الْمِيزَانِ، وَالْعَصْفُ بَقْلُ الزَّرْعِ إِذَا قُطِعَ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَ فَذَلِكَ الْعَصْفُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(54,12,12)" class="aya">{وَالرَّيْحَانُ}</a> رِزْقُهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(54,12,12)" class="aya">{وَالْحَبُّ}</a> الَّذِي يُؤْكَلُ مِنْهُ، وَالرَّيْحَانُ فِي كَلاَمِ الْعَرَبِ الرِّزْقُ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ وَالْعَصْفُ يُرِيدُ الْمَأْكُولَ مِنَ الْحَبِّ، وَالرَّيْحَانُ النَّضِيجُ الَّذِي لَمْ يُؤْكَلْ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ الْعَصْفُ وَرَقُ الْحِنْطَةِ.</br>وَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ الْعَصْفُ التِّبْنُ.</br>وَقَالَ أَبُو مَالِكٍ الْعَصْفُ أَوَّلُ مَا يَنْبُتُ تُسَمِّيهِ النَّبَطُ هَبُورًا.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ الْعَصْفُ وَرَقُ الْحِنْطَةِ. وَالرَّيْحَانُ الرِّزْقُ، وَالْمَارِجُ اللَّهَبُ الأَصْفَرُ وَالأَخْضَرُ الَّذِي يَعْلُو النَّارَ إِذَا أُوقِدَتْ.</br>وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ}</a> لِلشَّمْسِ فِي الشِّتَاءِ مَشْرِقٌ، وَمَشْرِقٌ فِي الصَّيْفِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ}</a> مَغْرِبُهَا فِي الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ يَبْغِيَانِ}</a> لاَ يَخْتَلِطَانِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمُنْشَآتُ}</a> مَا رُفِعَ قِلْعُهُ مِنَ السُّفُنِ، فَأَمَّا مَا لَمْ يُرْفَعْ قَلْعُهُ فَلَيْسَ بِمُنْشَأَةٍ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(54,35,35)" class="aya">{وَنُحَاسٌ}</a> الصُّفْرُ يُصَبُّ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ، يُعَذَّبُونَ بِهِ.</br><a name='54,46,46wwwwww78,40,40wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ}</a> يَهُمُّ بِالْمَعْصِيَةِ فَيَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَيَتْرُكُهَا، الشُّوَاظُ لَهَبٌ مِنْ نَارٍ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(54,64,64)" class="aya">{مُدْهَامَّتَانِ}</a> سَوْدَاوَانِ مِنَ الرِّيِّ.</br><a name='14,26,26wwwwww14,28,28wwwwww14,33,33wwwwww54,14,14wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{صَلْصَالٍ}</a> طِينٌ خُلِطَ بِرَمْلٍ، فَصَلْصَلَ كَمَا يُصَلْصِلُ الْفَخَّارُ. وَيُقَالُ مُنْتِنٌ، يُرِيدُونَ بِهِ صَلَّ، يُقَالُ صَلْصَالٌ، كَمَا يُقَالُ صَرَّ الْبَابُ عِنْدَ الإِغْلاَقِ، وَصَرْصَرَ مِثْلُ كَبْكَبْتُهُ يَعْنِي كَبَبْتُهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(54,68,68)" class="aya">{فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ}</a> وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَيْسَ الرُّمَّانُ وَالنَّخْلُ بِالْفَاكِهَةِ، وَأَمَّا الْعَرَبُ فَإِنَّهَا تَعُدُّهَا فَاكِهَةً كَقَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى}</a> فَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَى كُلِّ الصَّلَوَاتِ، ثُمَّ أَعَادَ الْعَصْرَ تَشْدِيدًا لَهَا، كَمَا أُعِيدَ النَّخْلُ وَالرُّمَّانُ، وَمِثْلُهَا: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ}</a> ثُمَّ قَالَ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَكَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابُ}</a> وَقَدْ ذَكَرَهُمْ فِي أَوَّلِ قَوْلِهِ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَنْ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ}</a> وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(54,48,48)" class="aya">{أَفْنَانٍ}</a> أَغْصَانٍ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ}</a> مَا يُجْتَنَى قَرِيبٌ.</br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَبِأَيِّ آلاَءِ}</a> نِعَمِهِ.</br>وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ: <a name='54,13,13wwwwww54,16,16wwwwww54,18,18wwwwww54,21,21wwwwww54,23,23wwwwww54,25,25wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{رَبِّكُمَا}</a> يَعْنِي الْجِنَّ وَالإِنْسَ.</br>وَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: <a href="javascript:openquran(54,29,29)" class="aya">{كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ}</a> يَغْفِرُ ذَنْبًا، وَيَكْشِفُ كَرْبًا، وَيَرْفَعُ قَوْمًا، وَيَضَعُ آخَرِينَ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='22,100,100wwwwww54,20,20wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{بَرْزَخٌ}</a> حَاجِزٌ، الأَنَامُ الْخَلْقُ <a href="javascript:openquran(54,66,66)" class="aya">{نَضَّاخَتَانِ}</a> فَيَّاضَتَانِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{ذُو الْجَلاَلِ}</a> ذُو الْعَظَمَةِ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ مَارِجٌ خَالِصٌ مِنَ النَّارِ، يُقَالُ مَرَجَ الأَمِيرُ رَعِيَّتَهُ إِذَا خَلاَّهُمْ يَعْدُو بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ. مَرَجَ أَمْرُ النَّاسِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَرِيجٍ}</a> مُلْتَبِسٌ <a name='24,53,53wwwwww54,19,19wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَرَجَ}</a> اخْتَلَطَ الْبَحْرَانِ، مِنْ مَرَجْتَ دَابَّتَكَ تَرَكْتَهَا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(54,31,31)" class="aya">{سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ}</a> سَنُحَاسِبُكُمْ، لاَ يَشْغَلُهُ شَيْءٌ عَنْ شَيْءٍ وَهْوَ مَعْرُوفٌ فِي كَلاَمِ الْعَرَبِ يُقَالُ لأَتَفَرَّغَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا بِهِ شُغْلٌ يَقُولُ لآخُذَنَّكَ عَلَى غِرَّتِكَ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<a name=C55.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "And besides these two, there are two other gardens (i.e., in Paradise) ." (V.55:62)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q106" name="q106" href="javascript:openquran(54,62,62)"><c_q106>{‏وَمِنْ دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ‏}</c_q106></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182150>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=399></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4878</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182150><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182150><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Two gardens, the utensils and the contents of which are of silver, and two other 
gardens, the utensils and contents of which are of gold. And nothing will prevent the people who will 
be in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the curtain of Majesty over His Face."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ جَنَّتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Ḥūr (beautiful fair females) guarded in pavilions." (V.55:72)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q107" name="q107" href="javascript:openquran(54,72,72)"><c_q107>{‏حُورٌ مَقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ‏}</c_q107></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {حُورٌ} سُودُ الْحَدَقِ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {مَقْصُورَاتٌ} مَحْبُوسَاتٌ، قُصِرَ طرفهنَّ وَأَنْفُسُهُنَّ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ، قَاصِرَاتٌ لاَ يَبْغِينَ غَيْرَ أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182161>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=400></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4879, 4880</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182161><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182161><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Qais:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "In Paradise there is a pavilion made of a single hollow pearl sixty miles wide, in 
each corner of which there are wives who will not see those in the other corners; and the believers will 
visit and enjoy them. And there are two gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of silver; 
and two other gardens, the utensils and contents of which are made of so-and-so (i.e. gold) and 
nothing will prevent the people staying in the Garden of Eden from seeing their Lord except the 
curtain of Majesty over His Face."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْمَةً مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ، عَرْضُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً، فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ، مَا يَرَوْنَ الآخَرِينَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏         ‏"‏ وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ كَذَا آنِيَتُهُمَا، وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(56)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Waqi’ah (The Inevitable Event)</div>
<div class=achapno>(56)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْوَاقِعَةِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رُجَّتْ}</a> زُلْزِلَتْ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{بُسَّتْ}</a> فُتَّتْ لُتَّتْ كَمَا يُلَتُّ السَّوِيقُ، الْمَخْضُودُ الْمُوقَرُ حَمْلاً، وَيُقَالُ أَيْضًا لاَ شَوْكَ لَهُ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَنْضُودٍ}</a> الْمَوْزُ، وَالْعُرُبُ الْمُحَبَّبَاتُ إِلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ <a name='55,13,13wwwwww55,39,39wwwwww55,40,40wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{ثُلَّةٌ}</a> أُمَّةٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,43,43)" class="aya">{يَحْمُومٍ}</a> دُخَانٌ أَسْوَدُ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,46,46)" class="aya">{يُصِرُّونَ}</a> يُدِيمُونَ. الْهِيمُ الإِبِلُ الظِّمَاءُ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,66,66)" class="aya">{لَمُغْرَمُونَ}</a> لَمُلْزَمُونَ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,89,89)" class="aya">{رَوْحٌ}</a> جَنَّةٌ وَرَخَاءٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,89,89)" class="aya">{وَرَيْحَانٌ}</a> الرِّزْقُ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَنَنْشَأَكُمْ}</a> فِي أَيِّ خَلْقٍ نَشَاءُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(55,65,65)" class="aya">{تَفَكَّهُونَ}</a> تَعْجَبُونَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{عُرُبًا}</a> مُثَقَّلَةً وَاحِدُهَا عَرُوبٌ مِثْلُ صَبُورٍ وَصُبُرٍ، يُسَمِّيهَا أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ الْعَرِبَةَ، وَأَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ الْغَنِجَةَ، وَأَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ الشَّكِلَةَ.</br>وَقَالَ فِي <a href="javascript:openquran(55,3,3)" class="aya">{خَافِضَةٌ}</a> لِقَوْمٍ إِلَى النَّارِ، وَ<a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{رَافِعَةٌ}</a> إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَوْضُونَةٍ}</a> مَنْسُوجَةٍ، وَمِنْهُ وَضِينُ النَّاقَةِ، وَالْكُوبُ لاَ آذَانَ لَهُ وَلاَ عُرْوَةَ، وَالأَبَارِيقُ ذَوَاتُ الآذَانِ وَالْعُرَى.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَسْكُوبٍ}</a> جَارٍ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ}</a> بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,45,45)" class="aya">{مُتْرَفِينَ}</a> مُتَمَتِّعِينَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَا تُمْنُونَ}</a> هِيَ النُّطْفَةُ فِي أَرْحَامِ النِّسَاءِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لِلْمُقْوِينَ}</a> لِلْمُسَافِرِينَ، وَالْقِيُّ الْقَفْرُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(55,75,75)" class="aya">{بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ}</a> بِمُحْكَمِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَيُقَالُ بِمَسْقِطِ النُّجُومِ إِذَا سَقَطْنَ، وَمَوَاقِعُ وَمَوْقِعٌ وَاحِدٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُدْهِنُونَ}</a> مُكَذِّبُونَ مِثْلُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(67,9,9)" class="aya">{لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ}</a>.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَسَلاَمٌ لَكَ}</a> أَيْ مُسَلَّمٌ لَكَ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ، وَأُلْغِيَتْ إِنَّ وَهْوَ مَعْنَاهَا كَمَا تَقُولُ أَنْتَ مُصَدَّقٌ مُسَافِرٌ عَنْ قَلِيلٍ، إِذَا كَانَ قَدْ قَالَ: إِنِّي مُسَافِرٌ عَنْ قَلِيلٍ. وَقَدْ يَكُونُ كَالدُّعَاءِ لَهُ كَقَوْلِكَ فَسَقْيًا مِنَ الرِّجَالِ. إِنْ رَفَعْتَ السَّلاَمَ فَهْوَ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ <a href="javascript:openquran(55,71,71)" class="aya">{تُورُونَ}</a> تَسْتَخْرِجُونَ. أَوْرَيْتُ أَوْقَدْتُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَغْوًا}</a> بَاطِلاً.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَأْثِيمًا}</a> كَذِبًا</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=402></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4882</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182190><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182190><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Ibn `Abbas about Surat Al-Tauba, and he said, "Surat Al-Tauba? It is exposure (of all the evils 
of the infidels and the hypocrites). And it continued revealing (that the oft-repeated expression): '...and 
of them ...and of them.' till they started thinking that none would be left unmentioned therein." I said, 
"What about) Surat Al-Anfal?" He replied, "Surat Al-Anfal was revealed in connection with the Badr 
Battle." I said, "(What about) Surat Al-Hashr?" He replied, "It was revealed in connection with Bani 
an-Nadir."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ قَالَ التَّوْبَةُ هِيَ الْفَاضِحَةُ، مَا زَالَتْ تَنْزِلُ وَمِنْهُمْ وَمِنْهُمْ، حَتَّى ظَنُّوا أَنَّهَا لَمْ تُبْقِ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ ذُكِرَ فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ سُورَةُ الأَنْفَالِ‏.‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي بَدْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ سُورَةُ الْحَشْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي بَنِي النَّضِيرِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "What you (O Muslims) cut down of the palm-trees (of the enemy)..." (V.59:5)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q119" name="q119" href="javascript:openquran(58,5,5)"><c_q119>{‏مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ‏}</c_q119></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">نَخْلَةٍ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ عَجْوَةً أَوْ بَرْنِيَّةً.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=404></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4884</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182210><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182210><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) burnt and cut down the palm trees of Bani An-Nadir which were at Al-Buwair (a 
place near Medina). There upon Allah revealed: 
'What you (O Muslims) cut down of the palm trees (of the enemy) or you left them standing on their 
stems, it was by the leave of Allah, so that He might cover with shame the rebellious.' (59.5)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَرَّقَ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَقَطَعَ، وَهْىَ الْبُوَيْرَةُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q120" name="q120" href="javascript:openquran(58,5,5)"><c_q120>{‏مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَى أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ‏}</c_q120></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "What Allah gave as booty (Fai') to His Messenger . . ." (V.59:7) </div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q121" name="q121" href="javascript:openquran(58,6,6)"><c_q121>{‏مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ‏}</c_q121></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182220>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=405></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4885</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182220><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182220><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>The properties of Bam An-Nadir were among the booty that Allah gave to His Apostle such Booty 
were not obtained by any expedition on the part of Muslims, neither with cavalry, nor with camelry. 
So those properties were for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) only, and he used to provide thereof the yearly 
expenditure for his wives, and dedicate the rest of its revenues for purchasing arms and horses as war 
material to be used in Allah's Cause.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَان ُ ـ غَيْرَ مَرَّةٍ ـ عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَتْ أَمْوَالُ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّا لَمْ يُوجِفِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عَلَيْهِ بِخَيْلٍ وَلاَ رِكَابٍ، فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاصَّةً، يُنْفِقُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ مِنْهَا نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِ، ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ مَا بَقِيَ فِي السِّلاَحِ وَالْكُرَاعِ، عُدَّةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And whatsoever the Messenger (Muḥammad pbuh) gives you take it..." (V.59:7)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q122" name="q122" href="javascript:openquran(58,7,7)"><c_q122>{‏وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ‏}</c_q122></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182230>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=406></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4886</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182230><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182230><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Alqama:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdullah (bin Masud) said. "Allah curses those ladies who practice tattooing and those who get 
themselves tattooed, and those ladies who remove the hair from their faces and those who make 
artificial spaces between their teeth in order to look more beautiful whereby they change Allah's 
creation." His saying reached a lady from Bani Asd called Um Yaqub who came (to `Abdullah) and 
said, "I have come to know that you have cursed such-and-such (ladies)?" He replied, "Why should I 
not curse these whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed and who are (cursed) in Allah's Book!" Um Yaqub 
said, "I have read the whole Qur'an, but I did not find in it what you say." He said, "Verily, if you have 
read it (i.e. the Qur'an), you have found it. Didn't you read: 
'And whatsoever the Apostle gives you take it and whatsoever he forbids you, you abstain (from it). 
(59.7) 
She replied, "Yes, I did," He said, "Verily, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade such things." "She said, "But I see 
your wife doing these things?" He said, "Go and watch her." She went and watched her but could not 
see anything in support of her statement. On that he said, "If my wife was as you thought, I would not 
keep her in my company."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُوتَشِمَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ، فَجَاءَتْ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ لَعَنْتَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَمَا لِي لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ هُوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَتْ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ اللَّوْحَيْنِ فَمَا وَجَدْتُ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ‏.‏ قَالَ لَئِنْ كُنْتِ قَرَأْتِيهِ لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ، أَمَا قَرَأْتِ ‏<A id="q123" name="q123" href="javascript:openquran(58,7,7)"><c_q123>{‏وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا‏}</c_q123></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَهْلَكَ يَفْعَلُونَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاذْهَبِي فَانْظُرِي‏.‏ فَذَهَبَتْ فَنَظَرَتْ فَلَمْ تَرَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهَا شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ لَوْ كَانَتْ كَذَلِكَ مَا جَامَعْتُها.</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=407></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4887</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182240><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182240><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah (bin Mus'ud):</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has cursed the lady who uses false hair.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ ذَكَرْتُ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ حَدِيثَ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاصِلَةَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مَنْصُورٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=408></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4888</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182250><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182250><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>I recommend that my successor should take care of and secure the rights of the early emigrants; and I 
also advise my successor to be kind to the Ansar who had homes (in Medina) and had adopted the 
Faith, before the Prophet (ﷺ) migrated to them, and to accept the good from their good ones and excuse 
their wrong doers.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ رضى الله عنه أُوصِي الْخَلِيفَةَ بِالْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ لَهُمْ حَقَّهُمْ، وَأُوصِي الْخَلِيفَةَ بِالأَنْصَارِ الَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُهَاجِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقْبَلَ مِنْ مُحْسِنِهِمْ وَيَعْفُوَ عَنْ مُسِيئِهِمْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "...And give them (emigrants) preference over themselves..." (V.59:9)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q125" name="q125" href="javascript:openquran(58,9,9)"><c_q125>{‏وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏}</c_q125></a>‏ الآيَةَ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">الْخَصَاصَةُ الْفَاقَةُ.<br>
<br>{الْمُفْلِحُونَ} الْفَائِزُونَ بِالْخُلُودِ، الْفَلاَحُ الْبَقَاءُ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ عَجِّلْ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: {حَاجَةً} حَسَدًا.</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182260>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=409></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4889</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182260><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182260><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am suffering from fatigue and hunger." 
The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (somebody) to his wives (to get something), but the messenger found nothing with 
them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his companions). "Isn't there anybody who can entertain this man 
tonight so that Allah may be merciful to him?" An Ansari man got up and said, "I (will, entertain 
him), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" So he went to his wife and said to her, "This is the guest of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), 
so do not keep anything away from him." She said. "By Allah, I have nothing but the children's food." 
He said, "When the children ask for their dinner, put them to bed and put out the light; we shall not 
take our meals tonight," She did so. In the morning the Ansari man went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, 
"Allah was pleased with (or He bestowed His Mercy) on so-and-so and his wife (because of their good 
deed)." Then Allah revealed: 
'But give them preference over themselves even though they were in need of that.' (59.9)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَابَنِي الْجَهْدُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى نِسَائِهِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ عِنْدَهُنَّ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يُضَيِّفُ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ ضَيْفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ تَدَّخِرِيهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ قُوتُ الصِّبْيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ الصِّبْيَةُ الْعَشَاءَ فَنَوِّمِيهِمْ، وَتَعَالَىْ فَأَطْفِئِي السِّرَاجَ وَنَطْوِي بُطُونَنَا اللَّيْلَةَ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ ثُمَّ غَدَا الرَّجُلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ عَجِبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ أَوْ ضَحِكَ ـ مِنْ فُلاَنٍ وَفُلاَنَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q126" name="q126" href="javascript:openquran(58,9,9)"><c_q126>{‏وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ‏}</c_q126></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(60)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Mumtahinah (The Test of Faith)</div>
<div class=achapno>(60)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْمُمْتَحِنَةِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {لاَ تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً} لاَ تُعَذِّبْنَا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلاَءِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ هَذَا {بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ} أُمِرَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِفِرَاقِ نِسَائِهِمْ، كُنَّ كَوَافِرَ بِمَكَّةَ.</div>

<a name=C60.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"(O you who believe!) Take not My enemies and your enemies (i.e., disbelievers and polytheists) as friends..." (V.60:1) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q129" name="q129" href="javascript:openquran(59,1,1)"><c_q129>{‏لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ‏}</c_q129></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182270>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=410></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4890</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182270><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182270><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me along with AzZubair and Al-Miqdad and said, "Proceed till you reach a place 
called Raudat-Khakh where there is a lady travelling in a howda on a camel. She has a letter. Take the 
letter from her." So we set out, and our horses ran at full pace till we reached Raudat Khakh, and 
behold, we saw the lady and said (to her), "Take out the letter!" She said, "I have no letter with me." 
We said, "Either you take out the letter or we will strip you of your clothes." So she took the letter out 
of her hair braid. We brought the letter to the Prophet (ﷺ) and behold, it was addressed by Hatib bin Abi 
Balta'a to some pagans at Mecca, informing them of some of the affairs of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) 
said, "What is this, O Hatib?" Hatib replied, "Do not be hasty with me, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I am an 
Ansari man and do not belong to them (Quraish infidels) while the emigrants who were with you had 
their relatives who used to protect their families and properties at Mecca. So, to compensate for not 
having blood relation with them.' I intended to do them some favor so that they might protect my 
relatives (at Mecca), and I did not do this out of disbelief or an inclination to desert my religion." The 
Prophet then said (to his companions), "He (Hatib) has told you the truth." `Umar said, "O Allah's 
Apostle! Allow me to chop his head off?" The Apostle said, "He is one of those who witnessed 
(fought in) the Battle of Badr, and what do you know, perhaps Allah looked upon the people of Badr 
(Badr warriors) and said, 'Do what you want as I have forgiven you.' " (`Amr, a sub-narrator, said,: 
This Verse was revealed about him (Hatib): 
'O you who believe! Take not My enemies and your enemies as friends or protectors.' (60.1)

Narrated `Ali: Sufyan was asked whether (the Verse): 'Take not My enemies and your enemies...' was revealed in connection with Hatib. Sufyan replied, "This occurs only in the narration of the people. I memorized the Hadith from `Amr, not overlooking even a single letter thereof, and I do not know of anybody who remembered it by heart other than myself."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، كَاتِبَ عَلِيٍّ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَالزُّبَيْرَ وَالْمِقْدَادَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقُوا حَتَّى تَأْتُوا رَوْضَةَ خَاخٍ فَإِنَّ بِهَا ظَعِينَةً مَعَهَا كِتَابٌ فَخُذُوهُ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَهَبْنَا تَعَادَى بِنَا خَيْلُنَا حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا الرَّوْضَةَ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِالظَّعِينَةِ فَقُلْنَا أَخْرِجِي الْكِتَابَ فَقَالَتْ مَا مَعِي مِنْ كِتَابٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لَتُخْرِجِنَّ الْكِتَابَ أَوْ لَنُلْقِيَنَّ الثِّيَابَ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْهُ مِنْ عِقَاصِهَا فَأَتَيْنَا بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَاطِبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَلْتَعَةَ إِلَى أُنَاسٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِمَّنْ بِمَكَّةَ يُخْبِرُهُمْ بِبَعْضِ أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا يَا حَاطِبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ تَعْجَلْ عَلَىَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ امْرَأً مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ وَلَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَكَانَ مَنْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ لَهُمْ قَرَابَاتٌ يَحْمُونَ بِهَا أَهْلِيهِمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَحْبَبْتُ إِذْ فَاتَنِي مِنَ النَّسَبِ فِيهِمْ أَنْ أَصْطَنِعَ إِلَيْهِمْ يَدًا يَحْمُونَ قَرَابَتِي وَمَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ كُفْرًا وَلاَ ارْتِدَادًا عَنْ دِينِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ قَدْ صَدَقَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ دَعْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَأَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ ـ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَنَزَلَتْ فِيهِ ‏<A id="q130" name="q130" href="javascript:openquran(59,1,1)"><c_q130>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ‏}</c_q130></a>‏ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي الآيَةَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ أَوْ قَوْلُ عَمْرٍو‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ قِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ فِي هَذَا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q131" name="q131" href="javascript:openquran(59,1,1)"><c_q131>{‏لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي‏}</c_q131></a>‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ هَذَا فِي حَدِيثِ النَّاسِ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو وَمَا تَرَكْتُ مِنْهُ حَرْفًا وَمَا أُرَى أَحَدًا حَفِظَهُ غَيْرِي‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "...When believing women come to you as emigrants..." (V.60:10)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q132" name="q132" href="javascript:openquran(59,10,10)"><c_q132>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ‏}</c_q132></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182280>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=411></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4891</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182280><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182280><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Urwa:</div><div class=text_details><p>Aisha the wife of the Prophet, said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to examine the believing women who 
migrated to him in accordance with this Verse: 'O Prophet! When believing women come to you to 
take the oath of allegiance to you... Verily! Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful.' (60.12) `Aisha 
said, "And if any of the believing women accepted the condition (assigned in the above-mentioned 
Verse), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say to her. "I have accepted your pledge of allegiance." "He would only 
say that, for, by Allah, his hand never touched, any lady during that pledge of allegiance. He did not 
receive their pledge except by saying, "I have accepted your pledge of allegiance for that."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَمْتَحِنُ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ، بِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏<A id="q133" name="q133" href="javascript:openquran(59,12,12)"><c_q133>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ‏}</c_q133></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَمَنْ أَقَرَّ بِهَذَا الشَّرْطِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ بَايَعْتُكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ كَلاَمًا وَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا مَسَّتْ يَدُهُ يَدَ امْرَأَةٍ قَطُّ فِي الْمُبَايَعَةِ، مَا يُبَايِعُهُنَّ إِلاَّ بِقَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ قَدْ بَايَعْتُكِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ يُونُسُ وَمَعْمَرٌ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ وَعَمْرَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>"O Prophet! When believing women come to you to give you the Bai'a (pledge).. ." (V.60:12) </div>

<a name=412></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4892</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182290><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182290><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Um Atiya:</div><div class=text_details><p>We took the oath of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he recited to us: 
'They will not associate anything in worship with Allah,' and forbade us to bewail the dead. 
Thereupon a lady withdrew her hand (refrained from taking the oath of allegiance), and said, "But 
such-and-such lady lamented over one of my relatives, so I must reward (do the same over the dead 
relatives of) hers." The Prophet (ﷺ) did not object to that, so she went (there) and returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) 
so he accepted her pledge of allegiance.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ بَايَعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْنَا ‏<A id="q135" name="q135" href="javascript:openquran(59,12,12)"><c_q135>{‏أَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏}</c_q135></a>‏ وَنَهَانَا عَنِ النِّيَاحَةِ، فَقَبَضَتِ امْرَأَةٌ يَدَهَا فَقَالَتْ أَسْعَدَتْنِي فُلاَنَةُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَجْزِيَهَا‏.‏ فَمَا قَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فَانْطَلَقَتْ وَرَجَعَتْ فَبَايَعَهَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=413></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4893</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182300><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182300><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Regarding the saying of Allah: 
'And they will not disobey you in any just matter.' (60.12) That was one of the conditions which 
Allah imposed on The believing) women (who came to take the oath of allegiance to the Prophet).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ الزُّبَيْرَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q136" name="q136" href="javascript:openquran(59,12,12)"><c_q136>{‏وَلاَ يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ‏}</c_q136></a>‏ قَالَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَرْطٌ شَرَطَهُ اللَّهُ لِلنِّسَاءِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=414></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4894</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182310><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182310><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were with the Prophet, he said, "Will you swear to me the pledge of allegiance that you will 
not worship any thing besides Allah, will not commit illegal sexual intercourse, and will not steal?" 
Then he recited the Verse concerning the women. (Sufyan, the subnarrator, often said that the Prophet: 
added, "Whoever among you fulfills his pledge, will receive his reward from Allah, and whoever 
commits any of those sins and receives the legal punishment (in this life), his punishment will be an 
expiation for that sin; and whoever commits any of those sins and Allah screens him, then it is up to 
Allah to punish or forgive them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَاهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، سَمِعَ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُبَايِعُونِي عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلاَ تَزْنُوا وَلاَ تَسْرِقُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَرَأَ آيَةَ النِّسَاءِ ـ وَأَكْثَرُ لَفْظِ سُفْيَانَ قَرَأَ الآيَةَ ـ ‏"‏ فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَهْوَ إِلَى اللَّهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ فِي الآيَةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=415></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4895</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182320><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182320><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>I witnessed the `Id-al-Fitr prayer with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman; and all of 
them offered it before delivering the sermon... and then delivered the sermon. Once the Prophet (after 
completing the prayer and the sermon) came down, as if I am now looking at him waving at the men 
with his hand to sit down, and walked through them till he, along with Bilal, reached (the rows of) the 
women. Then he recited: 'O Prophet! When believing women come to you to take the oath of 
allegiance that they will not worship anything other than Allah, will not steal, will not commit illegal 
sexual intercourse, will not kill their children, and will not utter slander, intentionally forging 
falsehood (by making illegal children belonging to their husbands)'....(60.12) Having finished, he 
said, 'Do you agree to that?" One lady, other than whom none replied the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, O 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" (The, sub-narrator, Al-Hasan did not know who the lady was.) Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said 
to them: "Will you give alms?" Thereupon Bilal spread out his garment and the women started 
throwing big rings and small rings into Bilal's garment. (See Hadith No. 95 vol.2)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الصَّلاَةَ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ فَكُلُّهُمْ يُصَلِّيهَا قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ثُمَّ يَخْطُبُ بَعْدُ، فَنَزَلَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ حِينَ يُجَلِّسُ الرِّجَالَ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ يَشُقُّهُمْ حَتَّى أَتَى النِّسَاءَ مَعَ بِلاَلٍ فَقَالَ ‏<A id="q137" name="q137" href="javascript:openquran(59,12,12)"><c_q137>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يَسْرِقْنَ وَلاَ يَزْنِينَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلاَدَهُنَّ وَلاَ يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ‏}</c_q137></a>‏ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ الآيَةِ كُلِّهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حِينَ فَرَغَ ‏"‏ أَنْتُنَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَمْ يُجِبْهُ غَيْرُهَا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لاَ يَدْرِي الْحَسَنُ مَنْ هِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَصَدَّقْنَ ‏"‏ وَبَسَطَ بِلاَلٌ ثَوْبَهُ فَجَعَلْنَ يُلْقِينَ الْفَتَخَ وَالْخَوَاتِيمَ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(61)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat as-Saff (The Solid Ranks)</div>
<div class=achapno>(61)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الصَّفِّ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {مَنْ أَنْصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ} مَنْ يَتَّبِعُنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {مَرْصُوصٌ} مُلْصَقٌ بَعْضُهُ بِبَعْضٍ.<br>
<br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ بِالرَّصَاصِ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<a name=C61.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"[And (remember) when 'Isā (Jesus a.s.), son of Mary said: "O Children of Israel! I am the Messenger of Allāh unto you, confirming the Torah (which came) before me, and giving glad tidings of a Messenger to come] after me, whose name shall be Ahmad." (61:6)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q139" name="q139" href="javascript:openquran(60,6,6)"><c_q139>{‏مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ‏}</c_q139></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=416></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4896</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182330><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182330><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'I have several names: I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am Al- 
Mahi with whom Allah obliterates Kufr (disbelief), and I am Al-Hashir (gatherer) at whose feet (i.e. 
behind whom) the people will be gathered (on the Day of Resurrection), and I am Al-Aqib (i.e. who 
succeeds the other prophets in bringing about good).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ إِنَّ لِي أَسْمَاءً، أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ، وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِيَ الْكُفْرَ، وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدَمِي، وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah ta'ala: "And [He has sent him (Prophet Muḥammad pbuh) also to] others among them (Muslims) who have not yet joined them..." (V.62:3)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q140" name="q140" href="javascript:openquran(61,3,3)"><c_q140>{‏وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ‏}</c_q140></a>‏‏.‏ وَقَرَأَ عُمَرُ فَامْضُوا إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182340>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=417></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4897</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182340><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182340><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) Surat Al-Jumu'a was revealed to him, and when the Verse, 
"And He (Allah) has sent him (Muhammad) also to other (Muslims).....' (62.3) was recited by the 
Prophet, I said, "Who are they, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) did not reply till I repeated my 
question thrice. At that time, Salman Al-Farisi was with us. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put his hand on 
Salman, saying, "If Faith were at (the place of) Ath-Thuraiya (pleiades, the highest star), even then 
(some men or man from these people (i.e. Salman's folk) would attain it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏<A id="q141" name="q141" href="javascript:openquran(61,3,3)"><c_q141>{‏وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ‏}</c_q141></a>‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ يُرَاجِعْهُ حَتَّى سَأَلَ ثَلاَثًا، وَفِينَا سَلْمَانُ الْفَارِسِيُّ، وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ عَلَى سَلْمَانَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ كَانَ الإِيمَانُ عِنْدَ الثُّرَيَّا لَنَالَهُ رِجَالٌ ـ أَوْ رَجُلٌ ـ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And when they see some merchandise or some amusement..." (V.62:11) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q142" name="q142" href="javascript:openquran(61,11,11)"><c_q142>{‏وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً‏}</c_q142></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182360>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=419></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4899</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182360><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182360><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>A caravan of merchandise arrived at Medina on a Friday while we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) All the 
people left (the Prophet (ﷺ) and headed for the caravan) except twelve persons. Then Allah revealed:-- 
'But when they see some bargain or some amusement they disperse headlong to it.' ..(62.11)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَقْبَلَتْ عِيرٌ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَثَارَ النَّاسُ إِلاَّ اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q143" name="q143" href="javascript:openquran(61,11,11)"><c_q143>{‏وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا‏}</c_q143></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(63)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Munafiqun (The Hypocrites)</div>
<div class=achapno>(63)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْمُنَافِقِينَ - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=C63.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allāh the Most High:  "When the hypocrites come to you (O Muḥammad pbuh) they say: 'We bear witness that you are indeed the Messenger of Allah..." (V.63:1) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q144" name="q144" href="javascript:openquran(62,1,1)"><c_q144>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏}</c_q144></a>‏ إِلَى ‏{‏لَكَاذِبُونَ‏}‏‏.‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182370>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=420></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4900</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182370><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182370><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:</div><div class=text_details><p>While I was taking part in a Ghazwa. I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Abi Salul) saying. "Don't spend 
on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away from him. If we return (to 
Medina), surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner amongst them." I reported that (saying) to 
my uncle or to `Umar who, in his turn, informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of it. The Prophet (ﷺ) called me and I 
narrated to him the whole story. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his 
companions, and they took an oath that they did not say that. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disbelieved my 
saying and believed his. I was distressed as I never was before. I stayed at home and my uncle said to 
me. "You just wanted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to disbelieve your statement and hate you." So Allah revealed 
(the Sura beginning with) 'When the hypocrites come to you.' (63.1) The Prophet (ﷺ) then sent for me and 
recited it and said, "O Zaid! Allah confirmed your statement."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي غَزَاةٍ فَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ، يَقُولُ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَنْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِهِ وَلَوْ رَجَعْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا‏.‏ الأَذَلَّ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَمِّي أَوْ لِعُمَرَ فَذَكَرَهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَانِي فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ وَأَصْحَابِهِ فَحَلَفُوا مَا قَالُوا فَكَذَّبَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَدَّقَهُ فَأَصَابَنِي هَمٌّ لَمْ يُصِبْنِي مِثْلُهُ قَطُّ، فَجَلَسْتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ لِي عَمِّي مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلَى أَنْ كَذَّبَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَقَتَكَ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q145" name="q145" href="javascript:openquran(62,1,1)"><c_q145>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}</c_q145></a>‏ فَبَعَثَ إِلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ صَدَّقَكَ يَا زَيْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"They have made their oaths a screen (for their hypocrisy)." (1)  (63:2)                                (1): (Ch. 2) "An-Nifāq": (Hypocrisy is of two types, namely: A - Hypocrisy in Belief B - Hypocrisy in deeds and actions. )</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=421></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4901</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182380><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182380><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:</div><div class=text_details><p>I was with my uncle and I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul, saying, "Don't spend on those who are 
with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that they may disperse and go away from him." He also said, "If we return to 
Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner." So I informed my uncle of that and then 
my uncle informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thereof. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his 
companions. They swore that they did not say anything of that sort Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deemed their 
statement true and rejected mine. Thereof I became as distressed as I have never been before, and 
stayed at home. Then Allah revealed (Surat Al-Munafiqin): 
'When the hypocrites come to you.....(63.1) They are the ones who say: Spend nothing on those who 
are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ..(63.7) Verily the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner..' (63.7-8) 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for me and recited that Sura for me and said, "Allah has confirmed your 
statement."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ عَمِّي فَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ ابْنَ سَلُولَ يَقُولُ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَنْفَضُّوا‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَيْضًا لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَمِّي فَذَكَرَ عَمِّي لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ وَأَصْحَابِهِ، فَحَلَفُوا مَا قَالُوا، فَصَدَّقَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَذَّبَنِي، فَأَصَابَنِي هَمٌّ لَمْ يُصِبْنِي مِثْلُهُ، فَجَلَسْتُ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q147" name="q147" href="javascript:openquran(62,1,1)"><c_q147>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}</c_q147></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q148" name="q148" href="javascript:openquran(62,7,8)"><c_q148>{‏هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ‏}</c_q148></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q149" name="q149" href="javascript:openquran(62,8,8)"><c_q149>{‏لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏}</c_q149></a>‏ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَهَا عَلَىَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ صَدَّقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah ta'ala: "That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed, so they understand not." (V.63:3)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q150" name="q150" href="javascript:openquran(62,3,3)"><c_q150>{‏ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا فَطُبِعَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لاَ يَفْقَهُونَ‏}</c_q150></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=422></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4902</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182390><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182390><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:</div><div class=text_details><p>When `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "Do not spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)," and also said, 
"If we return to Medina," I informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of his saying. The Ansar blamed me for that, and 
`Abdullah bin Ubai swore that he did not say. I returned to my house and slept. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then 
called me and I went to him. He said, "Allah has confirmed your statement." The Verse: "They are the 
one who say: Spend nothing......(63.7) was revealed.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَيْضًا لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ أَخْبَرْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَمَنِي الأَنْصَارُ، وَحَلَفَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ مَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى الْمَنْزِلِ فَنِمْتُ فَدَعَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ صَدَّقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَنَزَلَ ‏<A id="q151" name="q151" href="javascript:openquran(62,7,7)"><c_q151>{‏هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا‏}</c_q151></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ زَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(63)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Munafiqun (The Hypocrites)</div>
<div class=achapno>(63)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْمُنَافِقِينَ - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182400>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=423></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4903</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182400><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182400><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:</div><div class=text_details><p>We went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) : on a journey and the people suffered from lack of provisions. So 
`Abdullah bin Ubai said to his companions, "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that 
they may disperse and go away from him." He also said, "If we return to Medina, surely, the more 
honorable will expel therefrom the meaner. So I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and informed him of that. He sent 
for `Abdullah bin Ubai and asked him, but `Abdullah bin Ubai swore that he did not say so. The 
people said, "Zaid told a lie to 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." What they said distressed me very much. Later Allah 
revealed the confirmation of my statement in his saying:-- 
'(When the hypocrites come to you.' (63.1) So the Prophet (ﷺ) called them that they might ask Allah to 
forgive them, but they turned their heads aside. (Concerning Allah's saying: 'Pieces of wood propped 
up,' Zaid said; They were the most handsome men.)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ فِيهِ شِدَّةٌ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ لأَصْحَابِهِ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَنْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ فَسَأَلَهُ، فَاجْتَهَدَ يَمِينَهُ مَا فَعَلَ، قَالُوا كَذَبَ زَيْدٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي مِمَّا قَالُوا شِدَّةٌ، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ تَصْدِيقِي فِي ‏<A id="q153" name="q153" href="javascript:openquran(62,1,1)"><c_q153>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}</c_q153></a>‏ فَدَعَاهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ فَلَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ‏.‏ وَقَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q154" name="q154" href="javascript:openquran(62,4,4)"><c_q154>{‏خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ‏}</c_q154></a>‏ قَالَ كَانُوا رِجَالاً أَجْمَلَ شَىْءٍ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182410>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=424></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4904</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182410><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182410><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:</div><div class=text_details><p>While I was with my uncle, I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul saying, "Do not spend on those who 
are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away (from him). And if we return to Medina, 
surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner. "I mentioned that to my uncle who, in 
turn, mentioned it to the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) called me and I told him about that. Then he sent for 
`Abdullah bin Ubai and his companions, and they swore that they did not say so. The Prophet (ﷺ) 
disbelieved my statement and believed theirs. I was distressed as I have never been before, and I 
remained in my house. My uncle said to me, "You just wanted the Prophet (ﷺ) to consider you a liar and 
hate you." Then Allah revealed:-- 
'When the hypocrites come to you, they say: 'We bear witness that you are indeed the Apostle of 
Allah." (63.1) So the Prophet (ﷺ) sent for me and recited it and said, "Allah has confirmed your 
statement."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ عَمِّي فَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ ابْنَ سَلُولَ، يَقُولُ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَنْفَضُّوا، وَلَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَمِّي، فَذَكَرَ عَمِّي لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏فَدَعَانِي فَحَدَّثْتُهُ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ وَأَصْحَابِهِ فَحَلَفُوا مَا قَالُوا، وَكَذَّبَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏}‏ وَصَدَّقَهُمْ، فَأَصَابَنِي غَمٌّ لَمْ يُصِبْنِي مِثْلُهُ قَطُّ، فَجَلَسْتُ فِي بَيْتِي وَقَالَ عَمِّي مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلَى أَنْ كَذَّبَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَقَتَكَ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q156" name="q156" href="javascript:openquran(62,1,1)"><c_q156>{‏إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏}</c_q156></a>‏ وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَهَا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ صَدَّقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "It is equal to them whether you (Muḥammad pbuh) ask for their forgiveness.. ." (V.63:6) </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q157" name="q157" href="javascript:openquran(62,6,6)"><c_q157>{‏سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ‏}</c_q157></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182420>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=425></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4905</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182420><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182420><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were in a Ghazwa (Sufyan once said, in an army) and a man from the emigrants kicked an Ansari 
man (on the buttocks with his foot). The Ansari man said, "O the Ansar! (Help!)" and the emigrant 
said. "O the emigrants! (Help!) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that and said, "What is this call for, which is 
characteristic of the period of ignorance?" They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! A man from the emigrants 
kicked one of the Ansar (on the buttocks with his foot)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Leave it (that call) as is 
a detestable thing." `Abdullah bin Ubai heard that and said, 'Have the (the emigrants) done so? By 
Allah, if we return Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner." When this 
statement reached the Prophet. `Umar got up an, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let me chop off the head of 
this hypocrite (`Abdullah bin Ubai)!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Leave him, lest the people say that 
Muhammad kills his companions." The Ansar were then more in number than the emigrants when the 
latter came to Medina, but later on the emigrant increased.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا فِي غَزَاةٍ ـ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً فِي جَيْشٍ ـ فَكَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرِيُّ يَا لَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ ذَاكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ دَعْوَى جَاهِلِيَّةٍ ‏"‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُنْتِنَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ فَقَالَ فَعَلُوهَا، أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَعْنِي أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّاسُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يَقْتُلُ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏"‏ وَكَانَتِ الأَنْصَارُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ كَثُرُوا بَعْدُ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَحَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->
