<div class=echapno></div><div class=englishchapter> "And to Allah belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites comprehend not." (63:7)</div>
<div class=achapno></div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic"> باب {‏وَلِلَّهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لاَ يَفْقَهُونَ‏}</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182430>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=426></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4906</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182430><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182430><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Musa bin `Uqba:</div><div class=text_details><p>`Abdullah bin Al-Fadl told me that Anas bin Malik said, "I was much grieve over those who had been 
killed in the Battle of Al-Harra. When Zaid bin Arqarr heard of my intense grief (over the killed 
Ansar), he wrote a letter to me saying that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, O Allah! Forgive the 
Ansar and the Ansar children. The subnarrator, Ibn Al-Fadl, is not sure whether the Prophet (ﷺ) also said, 
And their grand-children." Some of those who were present, asked Anas (about Zaid). He said, "He 
(Zaid) is the one about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'He is the one whose sound hearing Allah testified.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ حَزِنْتُ عَلَى مَنْ أُصِيبَ بِالْحَرَّةِ فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ وَبَلَغَهُ شِدَّةُ حُزْنِي يَذْكُرُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَلأَبْنَاءِ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏ ـ وَشَكَّ ابْنُ الْفَضْلِ فِي أَبْنَاءِ أَبْنَاءِ الأَنْصَارِ ـ فَسَأَلَ أَنَسًا بَعْضُ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَقُولُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذَا الَّذِي أَوْفَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بِأُذُنِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4906">Sahih al-Bukhari 4906</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 426</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 429</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(45840, 'h182430')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4906')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182440>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=427></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4907</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182440><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182440><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were in a Ghazwa and a man from the emigrants kicked an Ansari (on the buttocks with his foot). 
The Ansari man said, "O the Ansari! (Help!)" The emigrant said, "O the emigrants! (Help)." When 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that, he said, "What is that?" They said, "A man from the emigrants kicked a 
man from the Ansar (on the buttocks his foot). On that the Ansar said, 'O the Ansar!' and the emigrant 
said, 'O the emigrants!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said' "Leave it (that call) for it Is a detestable thing." The number 
of Ansar was larger (than that of the emigrants) at the time when the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, but 
later the number of emigrants increased. `Abdullah bin Ubai said, "Have they, (the emigrants) done 
so? By Allah, if we return to Medina, surely, the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner," 
`Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let me chop off the head of this hypocrite!" The 
Prophet said, "Leave him, lest the people say Muhammad kills his companions:"</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَفِظْنَاهُ مِنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ كُنَّا فِي غَزَاةٍ فَكَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرِيُّ يَا لَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ فَسَمَّعَهَا اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا كَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرِيُّ يَالَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُنْتِنَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ وَكَانَتِ الأَنْصَارُ حِينَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ، ثُمَّ كَثُرَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ بَعْدُ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ أَوَقَدْ فَعَلُوا، وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضى الله عنه دَعْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقِ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّاسُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يَقْتُلُ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(7)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah ta'ala: "They (hypocrites) say: 'If we return to Al- Madīna, indeed the more honourable will expel therefrom the meaner..." (V.63:8) </div>
<div class=achapno>(7)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏يَقُولُونَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: {وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ} هُوَ الَّذِي إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُ مُصِيبَةٌ رَضِيَ، وَعَرَفَ أَنَّهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter></div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182450>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=428></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4908</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182450><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182450><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Salim:</div><div class=text_details><p>That `Abdullah bin `Umar told him that he had divorced his wife while she was in her menses so 
`Umar informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
of that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became very angry at that and said, "(Ibn `Umar must return her to his house 
and keep her as his wife till she becomes clean and then menstruates and becomes clean again, 
whereupon, if he wishes to divorce her, he may do so while she is still clean and before having any 
sexual relations with her, for that is the legally prescribed period for divorce as Allah has ordered."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ، فَذَكَرَ عُمَرُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَغَيَّظَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ لِيُرَاجِعْهَا ثُمَّ يُمْسِكْهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ فَتَطْهُرَ، فَإِنْ بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَهَا فَلْيُطَلِّقْهَا طَاهِرًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمَسَّهَا فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>. "... And for those who are pregnant (whether they are divorced or their husbands are dead), their 'Idda (prescribed period) is until they lay down their burdens, and whoever keeps his duty to Allah and fears Him, He will make his matter easy for him." (V.65:4) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q3" name="q3" href="javascript:openquran(64,4,4)"><c_q3>{‏وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا‏}</c_q3></a>‏‏.‏ وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ وَاحِدُهَا ذَاتُ حَمْلٍ  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182460>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=429></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4909</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182460><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182460><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Salama:</div><div class=text_details><p>A man came to Ibn `Abbas while Abu Huraira was sitting with him and said, "Give me your verdict 
regarding a lady who delivered a baby forty days after the death of her husband." Ibn `Abbas said, 
"This indicates the end of one of the two prescribed periods." I said "For those who are pregnant, their 
prescribed period is until they deliver their burdens." Abu Huraira said, I agree with my cousin (Abu 
Salama)." Then Ibn `Abbas sent his slave, Kuraib to Um Salama to ask her (regarding this matter). 
She replied. "The husband of Subai'a al Aslamiya was killed while she was pregnant, and she 
delivered a baby forty days after his death. Then her hand was asked in marriage and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
married her (to somebody). Abu As-Sanabil was one of those who asked for her hand in marriage".</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ جَالِسٌ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ أَفْتِنِي فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَلَدَتْ بَعْدَ زَوْجِهَا بِأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ آخِرُ الأَجَلَيْنِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَنَا ‏<A id="q4" name="q4" href="javascript:openquran(64,4,4)"><c_q4>{‏وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ‏}</c_q4></a>‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَا مَعَ ابْنِ أَخِي ـ يَعْنِي أَبَا سَلَمَةَ ـ فَأَرْسَلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ غُلاَمَهُ كُرَيْبًا إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ يَسْأَلُهَا فَقَالَتْ قُتِلَ زَوْجُ سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةِ وَهْىَ حُبْلَى، فَوَضَعَتْ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً فَخُطِبَتْ فَأَنْكَحَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ فِيمَنْ خَطَبَهَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=430></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4910</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182470><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182470><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=text_details>See hadith 4909</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى وَكَانَ أَصْحَابُهُ يُعَظِّمُونَهُ، فَذَكَرَ آخِرَ الأَجَلَيْنِ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِحَدِيثِ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ قَالَ فَضَمَّزَ لِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَفَطِنْتُ لَهُ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي إِذًا لَجَرِيءٌ إِنْ كَذَبْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ وَهْوَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ فَاسْتَحْيَا وَقَالَ لَكِنَّ عَمَّهُ لَمْ يَقُلْ ذَاكَ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا عَطِيَّةَ مَالِكَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَذَهَبَ يُحَدِّثُنِي حَدِيثَ سُبَيْعَةَ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِيهَا شَيْئًا فَقَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَتَجْعَلُونَ عَلَيْهَا التَّغْلِيظَ وَلاَ تَجْعَلُونَ عَلَيْهَا الرُّخْصَةَ‏.‏ لَنَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ النِّسَاءِ الْقُصْرَى بَعْدَ الطُّولَى ‏<A id="q5" name="q5" href="javascript:openquran(64,4,4)"><c_q5>{‏وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ‏}</c_q5></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"O Prophet! Why do you forbid (for yourself) that which Allah has allowed to you?..." (V.66:1)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q6" name="q6" href="javascript:openquran(65,1,1)"><c_q6>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاةَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ‏}</c_q6></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=431></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4911</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182480><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182480><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>If someone says to his wife, "You are unlawful to me." he must make an expiation (for his oath). Ibn 
`Abbas added: There is for you in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), an excellent example to follow.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ فِي الْحَرَامِ يُكَفِّرُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏<A id="q7" name="q7" href="javascript:openquran(32,21,21)"><c_q7>{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}</c_q7></a>‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=432></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4912</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182490><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182490><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to drink honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and would stay 
there with her. So Hafsa and I agreed secretly that, if he come to either of us, she would say to him. "It 
seems you have eaten Maghafir (a kind of bad-smelling resin), for I smell in you the smell of 
Maghafir," (We did so) and he replied. "No, but I was drinking honey in the house of Zainab, the 
daughter of Jahsh, and I shall never take it again. I have taken an oath as to that, and you should not 
tell anybody about it."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَشْرَبُ عَسَلاً عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ وَيَمْكُثُ عِنْدَهَا فَوَاطَيْتُ أَنَا وَحَفْصَةُ عَنْ أَيَّتُنَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَلْتَقُلْ لَهُ أَكَلْتَ مَغَافِيرَ إِنِّي أَجِدُ مِنْكَ رِيحَ مَغَافِيرَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنِّي كُنْتُ أَشْرَبُ عَسَلاً عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ فَلَنْ أَعُودَ لَهُ وَقَدْ حَلَفْتُ لاَ تُخْبِرِي بِذَلِكِ أَحَدًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "... seeking to please your wives..." (V.66:1) "Allah has already ordained for you (O men), the dissolution of your oaths.. ." (V.66:2) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q8" name="q8" href="javascript:openquran(65,1,1)"><c_q8>{‏تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاةَ أَزْوَاجِكَ‏}</c_q8></a>‏ ‏<A id="q9" name="q9" href="javascript:openquran(65,2,2)"><c_q9>{‏قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ‏}</c_q9></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182500>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=433></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4913</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182500><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182500><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>For the whole year I had the desire to ask `Umar bin Al-Khattab regarding the explanation of a Verse 
(in Surat Al-Tahrim) but I could not ask him because I respected him very much. When he went to 
perform the Hajj, I too went along with him. On our return, while we were still on the way home. 
`Umar went aside to answer the call of nature by the Arak trees. I waited till he finished and then I 
proceeded with him and asked him. "O chief of the Believers! Who were the two wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) 
who aided one another against him?" He said, "They were Hafsa and `Aisha." Then I said to him, "By 
Allah, I wanted to ask you about this a year ago, but I could not do so owing to my respect for you." 
`Umar said, "Do not refrain from asking me. If you think that I have knowledge (about a certain 
matter), ask me; and if I know (something about it), I will tell you." Then `Umar added, "By Allah, in 
the Pre-lslamic Period of Ignorance we did not pay attention to women until Allah revealed regarding 
them what He revealed regarding them and assigned for them what He has assigned. Once while I was 
thinking over a certain matter, my wife said, "I recommend that you do so-and-so." I said to her, 
"What have you got to do with the is matter? Why do you poke your nose in a matter which I want to 
see fulfilled.?" 
She said, How strange you are, O son of Al-Khattab! You don't want to be argued with whereas your 
daughter, Hafsa surely, argues with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so much that he remains angry for a full day!" 
`Umar then reported; how he at once put on his outer garment and went to Hafsa and said to her, "O 
my daughter! Do you argue with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he remains angry the whole day?" H. afsa 
said, "By Allah, we argue with him." `Umar said, "Know that I warn you of Allah's punishment and 
the anger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . . . O my daughter! Don't be betrayed by the one who is proud of her 
beauty because of the love of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for her (i.e. `Aisha)." `Umar addled, "Then I went out to 
Um Salama's house who was one of my relatives, and I talked to her. She said, O son of Al-Khattab! It 
is rather astonishing that you interfere in everything; you even want to interfere between Allah's 
Apostle and his wives!' By Allah, by her talk she influenced me so much that I lost some of my anger. 
I left her (and went home). 
At that time I had a friend from the Ansar who used to bring news (from the Prophet) in case of my 
absence, and I used to bring him the news if he was absent. In those days we were afraid of one of the 
kings of Ghassan tribe. We heard that he intended to move and attack us, so fear filled our hearts 
because of that. (One day) my Ansari friend unexpectedly knocked at my door, and said, "Open 
Open!' I said, 'Has the king of Ghassan come?' He said, 'No, but something worse; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has 
isolated himself from his wives.' I said, 'Let the nose of `Aisha and Hafsa be stuck to dust (i.e. 
humiliated)!' Then I put on my clothes and went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)'s residence, and behold, he was 
staying in an upper room of his to which he ascended by a ladder, and a black slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 
was (sitting) on the first step. 
I said to him, 'Say (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) `Umar bin Al-Khattab is here.' Then the Prophet (ﷺ) admitted me and I 
narrated the story to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When I reached the story of Um Salama, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled 
while he was lying on a mat made of palm tree leaves with nothing between him and the mat. 
Underneath his head there was a leather pillow stuffed with palm fibres, and leaves of a saut tree were 
piled at his feet, and above his head hung a few water skins. On seeing the marks of the mat imprinted 
on his side, I wept. He said.' 'Why are you weeping?' I replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Caesar and 
Khosrau are leading the life (i.e. Luxurious life) while you, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) though you are, is living in 
destitute". The Prophet (ﷺ) then replied. 'Won't you be satisfied that they enjoy this world and we the 
Hereafter?' "</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَكَثْتُ سَنَةً أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ آيَةٍ، فَمَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ هَيْبَةً لَهُ، حَتَّى خَرَجَ حَاجًّا فَخَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ وَكُنَّا بِبَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ عَدَلَ إِلَى الأَرَاكِ لِحَاجَةٍ لَهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَوَقَفْتُ لَهُ حَتَّى فَرَغَ سِرْتُ مَعَهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَنِ اللَّتَانِ تَظَاهَرَتَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ فَقَالَ تِلْكَ حَفْصَةُ وَعَائِشَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ عَنْ هَذَا مُنْذُ سَنَةٍ، فَمَا أَسْتَطِيعُ هَيْبَةً لَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلاَ تَفْعَلْ مَا ظَنَنْتَ أَنَّ عِنْدِي مِنْ عِلْمٍ فَاسْأَلْنِي، فَإِنْ كَانَ لِي عِلْمٌ خَبَّرْتُكَ بِهِ ـ قَالَ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ عُمَرُ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنَّا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَا نَعُدُّ لِلنِّسَاءِ أَمْرًا، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِنَّ مَا أَنْزَلَ وَقَسَمَ لَهُنَّ مَا قَسَمَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا فِي أَمْرٍ أَتَأَمَّرُهُ إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتِي لَوْ صَنَعْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ـ قَالَ ـ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَالَكِ وَلِمَا هَا هُنَا فِيمَا تَكَلُّفُكِ فِي أَمْرٍ أُرِيدُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لِي عَجَبًا لَكَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ مَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُرَاجَعَ أَنْتَ، وَإِنَّ ابْنَتَكَ لَتُرَاجِعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يَظَلَّ يَوْمَهُ غَضْبَانَ‏.‏ فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ رِدَاءَهُ مَكَانَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ فَقَالَ لَهَا يَا بُنَيَّةُ إِنَّكِ لَتُرَاجِعِينَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يَظَلَّ يَوْمَهُ غَضْبَانَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنُرَاجِعُهُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ‏.‏ تَعْلَمِينَ أَنِّي أُحَذِّرُكِ عُقُوبَةَ اللَّهِ وَغَضَبَ رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا بُنَيَّةُ لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكِ هَذِهِ الَّتِي أَعْجَبَهَا حُسْنُهَا حُبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِيَّاهَا ـ يُرِيدُ عَائِشَةَ ـ قَالَ ثُمَّ خَرَجْتُ حَتَّى دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ لِقَرَابَتِي مِنْهَا فَكَلَّمْتُهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ عَجَبًا لَكَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ دَخَلْتَ فِي كُلِّ شَىْءٍ، حَتَّى تَبْتَغِي أَنْ تَدْخُلَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَزْوَاجِهِ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَتْنِي وَاللَّهِ أَخْذًا كَسَرَتْنِي عَنْ بَعْضِ مَا كُنْتُ أَجِدُ، فَخَرَجْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا، وَكَانَ لِي صَاحِبٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِذَا غِبْتُ أَتَانِي بِالْخَبَرِ، وَإِذَا غَابَ كُنْتُ أَنَا آتِيهِ بِالْخَبَرِ، وَنَحْنُ نَتَخَوَّفُ مَلِكًا مِنْ مُلُوكِ غَسَّانَ، ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسِيرَ إِلَيْنَا، فَقَدِ امْتَلأَتْ صُدُورُنَا مِنْهُ، فَإِذَا صَاحِبِي الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَدُقُّ الْبَابَ فَقَالَ افْتَحِ افْتَحْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ جَاءَ الْغَسَّانِيُّ فَقَالَ بَلْ أَشَدُّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ اعْتَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَزْوَاجَهُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ رَغَمَ أَنْفُ حَفْصَةَ وَعَائِشَةَ‏.‏ فَأَخَذْتُ ثَوْبِيَ فَأَخْرُجُ حَتَّى جِئْتُ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَشْرُبَةٍ لَهُ يَرْقَى عَلَيْهَا بِعَجَلَةٍ، وَغُلاَمٌ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسْوَدُ عَلَى رَأْسِ الدَّرَجَةِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ قُلْ هَذَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لِي ـ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ حَدِيثَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ تَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنَّهُ لَعَلَى حَصِيرٍ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ شَىْءٌ، وَتَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ وِسَادَةٌ مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ، وَإِنَّ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ قَرَظًا مَصْبُوبًا، وَعِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ أَهَبٌ مُعَلَّقَةٌ فَرَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ الْحَصِيرِ فِي جَنْبِهِ فَبَكَيْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُبْكِيكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ كِسْرَى وَقَيْصَرَ فِيمَا هُمَا فِيهِ وَأَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ لَهُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَنَا الآخِرَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And (remember) when the Prophet pbuh disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his wives (Ḥafsa) (up to) ... The All-Aware." (V.66:3)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q10" name="q10" href="javascript:openquran(65,3,3)"><c_q10>{‏وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنْبَأَكَ هَذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ‏}</c_q10></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=434></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4914</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182510><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182510><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>I intended to ask `Umar so I said, "Who were those two ladies who tried to back each other against 
the Prophet?" I hardly finished my speech when he said, They were `Aisha and Hafsa."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ حُنَيْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَنِ الْمَرْأَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ تَظَاهَرَتَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا أَتْمَمْتُ كَلاَمِي حَتَّى قَالَ عَائِشَةُ وَحَفْصَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "If you two (wives of the Prophet, namely, 'Aishah and Hafsa) turn in repentance to Allah, (it will be better for you), your hearts are indeed so inclined (to oppose what the Prophet likes)." (V.66:4)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q11" name="q11" href="javascript:openquran(65,4,4)"><c_q11>{‏إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا‏}</c_q11></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">صَغَوْتُ وَأَصْغَيْتُ مِلْتُ، <a href="javascript:openquran(5,113,113)" class="aya">{لِتَصْغَى}</a> لِتَمِيلَ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَإِنْ تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلاَهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ}</a> عَوْنٌ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(1,85,85)" class="aya">{تَظَاهَرُونَ}</a> تَعَاوَنُونَ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(65,6,6)" class="aya">{قُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ}</a> أَوْصُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَأَدِّبُوهُمْ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182520>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=435></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4915</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182520><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182520><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>I intended to ask `Umar about those two ladies who back each other against 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . For one 
year I was seeking the opportunity to ask this question, but in vain, until once when I accompanied 
him for Hajj. While we were in Zahran, `Umar went to answer the call of nature and told me to follow 
him with some water for ablution. So I followed him with a container of water and started pouring 
water for him. I found it a good opportunity to ask him, so I said, "O chief of the Believers! Who were 
those two ladies who had backed each other (against the Prophet)?" Before I could complete my 
question, he replied, "They were `Aisha and Hafsa."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ حُنَيْنٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ، عُمَرَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ، تَظَاهَرَتَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَكُثْتُ سَنَةً فَلَمْ أَجِدْ لَهُ مَوْضِعًا، حَتَّى خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ حَاجًّا، فَلَمَّا كُنَّا بِظَهْرَانَ ذَهَبَ عُمَرُ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَقَالَ أَدْرِكْنِي بِالْوَضُوءِ فَأَدْرَكْتُهُ بِالإِدَاوَةِ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَسْكُبُ عَلَيْهِ وَرَأَيْتُ مَوْضِعًا فَقُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَنِ الْمَرْأَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ تَظَاهَرَتَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَمَا أَتْمَمْتُ كَلاَمِي حَتَّى قَالَ عَائِشَةُ وَحَفْصَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter> "It may be, if he divorced you (all), that his Lord (Allah) will give him instead of you, wives better than you... (V.66:5)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q14" name="q14" href="javascript:openquran(65,5,5)"><c_q14>{‏عَسَى رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا‏}</c_q14></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182530>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=436></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4916</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182530><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182530><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) out of their jealousy, backed each other against the Prophet, so I said to 
them, "It may be, if he divorced you all, that Allah will give him, instead of you wives better than 
you." So this Verse was revealed. (66.5)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ اجْتَمَعَ نِسَاءُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغَيْرَةِ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُنَّ عَسَى رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة <a href="javascript:openquran(66,1,1)">{تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ}</a></div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">التَّفَاوُتُ الاِخْتِلاَفُ، وَالتَّفَاوُتُ وَالتَّفَوُّتُ وَاحِدٌ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(66,8,8)" class="aya">{تَمَيَّزُ}</a> تَقَطَّعُ <a href="javascript:openquran(66,15,15)" class="aya">{مَنَاكِبِهَا}</a> جَوَانِبِهَا.</br><a name='40,31,31wwwwww66,27,27wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَدَّعُونَ}</a> وَتَدْعُونَ مِثْلُ تَذَّكَّرُونَ وَتَذْكُرُونَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(66,19,19)" class="aya">{وَيَقْبِضْنَ}</a> يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِنَّ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='23,41,41wwwwww66,19,19wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{صَافَّاتٍ}</a> بَسْطُ أَجْنِحَتِهِنَّ، وَنُفُورٍ الْكُفُورُ.</div>

<div class=echapno>(68)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Qalam (The Pen)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة ن وَالْقَلَمِ  - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(67,25,25)" class="aya">{حَرْدٍ}</a> جِدٍّ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='67,26,26wwwwww82,32,32wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَضَالُّونَ}</a> أَضْلَلْنَا مَكَانَ جَنَّتِنَا.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(67,20,20)" class="aya">{كَالصَّرِيمِ}</a> كَالصُّبْحِ انْصَرَمَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، وَاللَّيْلِ انْصَرَمَ مِنَ النَّهَارِ، وَهْوَ أَيْضًا كُلُّ رَمْلَةٍ انْصَرَمَتْ مِنْ مُعْظَمِ الرَّمْلِ، وَالصَّرِيمُ أَيْضًا الْمَصْرُومُ، مِثْلُ قَتِيلٍ وَمَقْتُولٍ.</div>

<a name=C68.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Cruel, and moreover base-born (of illegitimate birth) ." (V.68:13)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q15" name="q15" href="javascript:openquran(67,13,13)"><c_q15>{‏عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ زَنِيمٍ‏}</c_q15></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182540>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=437></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4917</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182540><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182540><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(regarding the Verse):-- 'Cruel after all that, base-born (of illegitimate birth).' (68.13) It was revealed 
in connection with a man from Quaraish who had a notable sign (Zanamah) similar to the notable sign 
which usually-hung on the neck of a sheep (to recognize it).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q16" name="q16" href="javascript:openquran(67,13,13)"><c_q16>{‏عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ زَنِيمٍ‏}</c_q16></a>‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ لَهُ زَنَمَةٌ مِثْلُ زَنَمَةِ الشَّاةِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=438></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4918</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182550><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182550><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Haritha bin Wahb Al-Khuza`i:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying. "May I tell you of the people of Paradise? Every weak and poor obscure 
person whom the people look down upon but his oath is fulfilled by Allah when he takes an oath to do 
something. And may I inform you of the people of the Hell-Fire? They are all those violent, arrogant 
and stubborn people."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ كُلُّ ضَعِيفٍ مُتَضَعِّفٍ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ، أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ النَّارِ كُلُّ عُتُلٍّ جَوَّاظٍ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "(Remember) the Day when the Shin shalt be laid bare..." (V.68:42)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q17" name="q17" href="javascript:openquran(67,42,42)"><c_q17>{‏يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ‏}</c_q17></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182560>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=439></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4919</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182560><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182560><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Sa`id:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Our Lord Allah will lay bare His Shin, and then all the Believers, men and women, will prostrate themselves before Him, but there will remain those who used to prostrate in the world for showing off and for gaining good reputation. Such people will try to prostrate (on the Day of Judgment) but their back swill be as stiff as if it is one bone (a single vertebra).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ يَكْشِفُ رَبُّنَا عَنْ سَاقِهِ فَيَسْجُدُ لَهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ، وَيَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَسْجُدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا رِئَاءً وَسُمْعَةً، فَيَذْهَبُ لِيَسْجُدَ فَيَعُودُ ظَهْرُهُ طَبَقًا وَاحِدًا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْحَاقَّةِ - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ}</a> يُرِيدُ فِيهَا الرِّضَا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْقَاضِيَةَ}</a> الْمَوْتَةَ الأُولَى الَّتِي مُتُّهَا ثُمَّ أُحْيَا بَعْدَهَا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ}</a> أَحَدٌ يَكُونُ لِلْجَمْعِ وَلِلْوَاحِدِ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْوَتِينَ}</a> نِيَاطُ الْقَلْبِ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='19,24,24wwwwww19,43,43wwwwww52,17,17wwwwww78,17,17wwwwww78,37,37wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{طَغَى}</a> كَثُرَ، وَيُقَالُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(68,5,5)" class="aya">{بِالطَّاغِيَةِ}</a> بِطُغْيَانِهِمْ، وَيُقَالُ طَغَتْ عَلَى الْخَزَّانِ. كَمَا طَغَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى قَوْمِ نُوحٍ.</div>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(70)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Ma’arij (Pathways of Heavenly Ascent)</div>
<div class=achapno>(70)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">الْفَصِيلَةُ: أَصْغَرُ آبَائِهِ، الْقُرْبَى إِلَيْهِ يَنْتَمِي مَنِ انْتَمَى.<br>
<br><br>
{لِلشَّوَى} الْيَدَانِ وَالرِّجْلاَنِ وَالأَطْرَافُ وَجِلْدَةُ الرَّأْسِ يُقَالُ لَهَا شَوَاةٌ، وَمَا كَانَ غَيْرَ مَقْتَلٍ فَهُوَ شَوًى، وَالْعِزُونَ الْجَمَاعَاتُ، وَوَاحِدُهَا عِزَةٌ.</div>

<div class=achapno>(71)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة نُوحٍ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَطْوَارًا}</a> طَوْرًا كَذَا وَطَوْرًا كَذَا، يُقَالُ عَدَا طَوْرَهُ. أَيْ قَدْرَهُ، وَالْكُبَّارُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْكُبَارِ، وَكَذَلِكَ جُمَّالٌ وَجَمِيلٌ، لأَنَّهَا أَشَدُّ مُبَالَغَةً، وَكُبَّارٌ الْكَبِيرُ، وَكُبَارًا أَيْضًا بِالتَّخْفِيفِ، وَالْعَرَبُ تَقُولُ رَجُلٌ حُسَّانٌ وَجُمَّالٌ وَحُسَانٌ مُخَفَّفٌ وَجُمَالٌ مُخَفَّفٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{دَيَّارًا}</a> مِنْ دَوْرٍ وَلَكِنَّهُ فَيْعَالٌ مِنَ الدَّوَرَانِ كَمَا قَرَأَ عُمَرُ الْحَيُّ الْقَيَّامُ. وَهْيَ مِنْ قُمْتُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ دَيَّارًا أَحَدًا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{تَبَارًا}</a> هَلاَكًا.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مِدْرَارًا}</a> يَتْبَعُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضًا.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَقَارًا}</a> عَظَمَةً.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> "Nor shall you leave Wadd nor Suwā' nor Yagūth nor Ya'ūq nor Nasr'. . ." (V.71:23) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q20" name="q20" href="javascript:openquran(70,23,23)"><c_q20>{‏وَدًّا وَلاَ سُوَاعًا وَلاَ يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ‏}</c_q20></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182570>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=440></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4920</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182570><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182570><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>All the idols which were worshiped by the people of Noah were worshiped by the Arabs later on. 
As for the idol Wadd, it was worshiped by the tribe of Kalb at Daumat-al-Jandal; Suwa` was the idol 
of (the tribe of) Hudhail; Yaghouth was worshiped by (the tribe of) Murad and then by Bani Ghutaif at Al-Jurf near Saba; Ya`uq was the idol of Hamdan, 
and Nasr was the idol of Himyar, the branch of Dhi-al-Kala`. The names (of the idols) formerly 
belonged to some pious men of the people of Noah, and when they died Satan inspired their people to 
(prepare and place idols at the places where they used to sit, and to call those idols by their names. 
The people did so, but the idols were not worshiped till those people (who initiated them) had died 
and the origin of the idols had become obscure, whereupon people began worshiping them.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، وَقَالَ، عَطَاءٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ صَارَتِ الأَوْثَانُ الَّتِي كَانَتْ فِي قَوْمِ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَرَبِ بَعْدُ، أَمَّا وُدٌّ كَانَتْ لِكَلْبٍ بِدَوْمَةِ الْجَنْدَلِ، وَأَمَّا سُوَاعٌ كَانَتْ لِهُذَيْلٍ، وَأَمَّا يَغُوثُ فَكَانَتْ لِمُرَادٍ ثُمَّ لِبَنِي غُطَيْفٍ بِالْجُرُفِ عِنْدَ سَبَا، وَأَمَّا يَعُوقُ فَكَانَتْ لِهَمْدَانَ، وَأَمَّا نَسْرٌ فَكَانَتْ لِحِمْيَرَ، لآلِ ذِي الْكَلاَعِ‏.‏ أَسْمَاءُ رِجَالٍ صَالِحِينَ مِنْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ، فَلَمَّا هَلَكُوا أَوْحَى الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ أَنِ انْصِبُوا إِلَى مَجَالِسِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يَجْلِسُونَ أَنْصَابًا، وَسَمُّوهَا بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ فَفَعَلُوا فَلَمْ تُعْبَدْ حَتَّى إِذَا هَلَكَ أُولَئِكَ وَتَنَسَّخَ الْعِلْمُ عُبِدَتْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=achapno>(72)</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter></div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182580>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=441></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4921</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182580><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182580><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out along with a group of his companions towards `Ukaz Market. At that time 
something intervened between the devils and the news of the Heaven, and flames were sent down 
upon them, so the devils returned. Their fellow-devils said, "What is wrong with you? " They said, 
"Something has intervened between us and the news of the Heaven, and fires (flames) have been shot 
at us." Their fellow-devils said, "Nothing has intervened between you and the news of the Heaven, but 
an important event has happened. Therefore, travel all over the world, east and west, and try to find 
out what has happened." And so they set out and travelled all over the world, east and west, looking 
for that thing which intervened between them and the news of the Heaven. Those of the devils who 
had set out towards Tihama, went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Nakhla (a place between Mecca and Taif) 
while he was on his way to `Ukaz Market. (They met him) while he was offering the Fajr prayer with 
his companions. When they heard the Holy Qur'an being recited (by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), they listened to 
it and said (to each other). This is the thing which has intervened between you and the news of the 
Heavens." Then they returned to their people and said, "O our people! We have really heard a 
wonderful recital (Qur'an). It gives guidance to the right, and we have believed therein. We shall not 
join in worship, anybody with our Lord." (See 72.1-2) Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (Surat al- 
Jinn): 
'Say: It has been revealed to me that a group (3 to 9) of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an).' (72.1) The 
statement of the Jinns was revealed to him .</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ، وَقَدْ حِيلَ بَيْنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ، وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّهُبُ فَرَجَعَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ فَقَالُوا مَا لَكُمْ فَقَالُوا حِيلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْنَا الشُّهُبُ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ إِلاَّ مَا حَدَثَ، فَاضْرِبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا فَانْظُرُوا مَا هَذَا الأَمْرُ الَّذِي حَدَثَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا فَضَرَبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا يَنْظُرُونَ مَا هَذَا الأَمْرُ الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ الَّذِينَ تَوَجَّهُوا نَحْوَ تِهَامَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَخْلَةَ، وَهْوَ عَامِدٌ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ، وَهْوَ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا الْقُرْآنَ تَسَمَّعُوا لَهُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ رَجَعُوا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ، وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا‏.‏ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ‏}‏ وَإِنَّمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِ قَوْلُ الْجِنِّ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(74)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Muddathir (The One Covered up)</div>
<div class=achapno>(74)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الْمُدَّثِّرِ - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(73,9,9)" class="aya">{عَسِيرٌ}</a> شَدِيدٌ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(73,51,51)" class="aya">{قَسْوَرَةٍ}</a> رِكْزُ النَّاسِ وَأَصْوَاتُهُمْ.</br>وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ الأَسَدُ وَكُلُّ شَدِيدٍ قَسْوَرَةٌ، <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ}</a> نَافِرَةٌ مَذْعُورَةٌ.</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182590>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=442></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4922</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182590><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182590><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Yahya bin Abi Kathir:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Aba Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman about the first Sura revealed of the Qur'an. He replied "O 
you, wrapped-up (i.e. Al Muddaththir)." I said, "They say it was, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord 
Who created,' (i.e. Surat Al-`Alaq (the Clot)." On that, Abu Salama said, "I asked Jabir bin `Abdullah 
about that, saying the same as you have said, whereupon he said, 'I will not tell you except what 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had told us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I was in seclusion in the cave of Hiram', and after I 
completed the limited period of my seclusion. I came down (from the cave) and heard a voice calling 
me. I looked to my right, but saw nothing. Then I looked up and saw something. So I went to Khadija 
(the Prophet's wife) and told her to wrap me up and pour cold water on me. So they wrapped me up 
and poured cold water on me." Then, 'O you, (Muhammad) wrapped up! Arise and warn,' (Surat Al 
Muddaththir) was revealed." (74.1)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَوَّلِ، مَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏<A id="q23" name="q23" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,1)"><c_q23>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}</c_q23></a>‏ قُلْتُ يَقُولُونَ ‏<A id="q24" name="q24" href="javascript:openquran(95,1,1)"><c_q24>{‏اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ‏}</c_q24></a>‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضى الله عنهما عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَقُلْتُ لَهُ مِثْلَ الَّذِي قُلْتَ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ لاَ أُحَدِّثُكَ إِلاَّ مَا حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ جَاوَرْتُ بِحِرَاءٍ، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ جِوَارِي هَبَطْتُ فَنُودِيتُ فَنَظَرْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ عَنْ شِمَالِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ أَمَامِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ خَلْفِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَرَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا، فَأَتَيْتُ خَدِيجَةَ فَقُلْتُ دَثِّرُونِي وَصُبُّوا عَلَىَّ مَاءً بَارِدًا ـ قَالَ ـ فَدَثَّرُونِي وَصَبُّوا عَلَىَّ مَاءً بَارِدًا قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q25" name="q25" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,3)"><c_q25>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ * قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ * وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ‏}</c_q25></a>‏ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=443></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4923</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182600><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182600><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was in a seclusion in the cave of Hira........."(similar to the narration related by 
`Ali bin Al-Mubarak, 444 above).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، وَغَيْرُهُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رضى الله عنهما عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ جَاوَرْتُ بِحِرَاءٍ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=444></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4924</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182610><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182610><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Yahya:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked Aba Salama, "Which Sura of the Qur'an was revealed first?" He replied, "O you, wrapped-up' 
(Al-Muddaththir)." I said, "I have been informed that it was, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord who 
created (i.e. Surat Al-Alaq)...similar to the narration related by `Ali bin Al-Mubarak, 444 above).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ أَىُّ الْقُرْآنِ أُنْزِلَ أَوَّلُ فَقَالَ ‏<A id="q28" name="q28" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,1)"><c_q28>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}</c_q28></a>‏ فَقُلْتُ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّهُ ‏<A id="q29" name="q29" href="javascript:openquran(95,1,1)"><c_q29>{‏اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ‏}</c_q29></a>‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الْقُرْآنِ أُنْزِلَ أَوَّلُ فَقَالَ ‏<A id="q30" name="q30" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,1)"><c_q30>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}</c_q30></a>‏ فَقُلْتُ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّهُ ‏<A id="q31" name="q31" href="javascript:openquran(95,1,1)"><c_q31>{‏اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ‏}</c_q31></a>‏ فَقَالَ لاَ أُخْبِرُكَ إِلاَّ بِمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ جَاوَرْتُ فِي حِرَاءٍ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ جِوَارِي، هَبَطْتُ فَاسْتَبْطَنْتُ الْوَادِيَ فَنُودِيتُ، فَنَظَرْتُ أَمَامِي وَخَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي فَإِذَا هُوَ جَالِسٌ عَلَى عَرْشٍ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، فَأَتَيْتُ خَدِيجَةَ فَقُلْتُ دَثِّرُونِي وَصُبُّوا عَلَىَّ مَاءً بَارِدًا، وَأُنْزِلَ عَلَىَّ ‏<A id="q32" name="q32" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,3)"><c_q32>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ * قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ * وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ‏}</c_q32></a>‏‏"‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And purify your garments!" (V.74:4)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q33" name="q33" href="javascript:openquran(73,4,4)"><c_q33>{‏وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ‏}</c_q33></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182620>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=445></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4925</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182620><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182620><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) describing the period of pause of the Divine Inspiration. He said in his talk, 
"While I was walking, I heard voices from the sky. I looked up, and behold ! I saw the same Angel 
who came to me in the cave of Hira' sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I was too much 
afraid of him (so I returned to my house) and said, 'Fold me up in garments!' They wrapped me up. 
Then Allah revealed: 'O you wrapped...and desert the idols before the prayer became compulsory.' 
Rujz means idols.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ فَتْرَةِ الْوَحْىِ فَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي إِذْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَإِذَا الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي جَاءَنِي بِحِرَاءٍ جَالِسٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، فَجَئِثْتُ مِنْهُ رُعْبًا فَرَجَعْتُ فَقُلْتُ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي‏.‏ فَدَثَّرُونِي فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q34" name="q34" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,1)"><c_q34>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}</c_q34></a>‏ إِلَى ‏<A id="q35" name="q35" href="javascript:openquran(73,5,5)"><c_q35>{‏وَالرِّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ‏}</c_q35></a>‏ ـ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُفْرَضَ الصَّلاَةُ ـ وَهْىَ الأَوْثَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(5)</div><div class=englishchapter> "And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)" (V.74:5) </div>
<div class=achapno>(5)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q36" name="q36" href="javascript:openquran(73,5,5)"><c_q36>{‏وَالرِّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ‏}</c_q36></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ الرِّجْزُ وَالرِّجْسُ الْعَذَابُ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182630>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=446></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4926</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182630><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182630><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) describing the period of pause of the Divine Inspiration, and in his 
description he said, "While I was walking I heard a voice from the sky. I looked up towards the sky, 
and behold! I saw the same Angel who came to me in the Cave of Hira', sitting on a chair between the 
sky and the earth. I was so terrified by him that I fell down on the ground. Then I went to my wife and 
said, 'Wrap me in garments! Wrap me in garments!' They wrapped me, and then Allah revealed: 
"O you, (Muhammad) wrapped-up! Arise and warn...and desert the idols." (74.1-5) Abu Salama 
said....Rujz means idols." After that, the Divine Inspiration started coming more frequently and 
regularly.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ فَتْرَةِ الْوَحْىِ ‏"‏ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَرَفَعْتُ بَصَرِي قِبَلَ السَّمَاءِ، فَإِذَا الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي جَاءَنِي بِحِرَاءٍ قَاعِدٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، فَجَئِثْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى هَوَيْتُ إِلَى الأَرْضِ، فَجِئْتُ أَهْلِي فَقُلْتُ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي‏.‏ فَزَمَّلُونِي فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q37" name="q37" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,1)"><c_q37>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ‏}</c_q37></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏فَاهْجُرْ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ـ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَالرِّجْزَ الأَوْثَانَ ـ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ حَمِيَ الْوَحْىُ وَتَتَابَعَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=C75.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an, O Muḥammad pbuh) to make haste therewith." (V.75:16) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب وَقَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q38" name="q38" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,16)"><c_q38>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}</c_q38></a>‏  </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(74,5,5)" class="aya">{لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ}</a> سَوْفَ أَتُوبُ سَوْفَ أَعْمَلُ <a href="javascript:openquran(74,11,11)" class="aya">{لاَ وَزَرَ}</a> لاَ حِصْنَ. <a href="javascript:openquran(74,36,36)" class="aya">{سُدًى}</a> هَمَلاً</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182640>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=447></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4927</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182640><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182640><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his tongue when the divine Inspiration was being revealed to him. (Sufyan, 
a subnarrator, demonstrated (how the Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his lips) and added. "In order to memorize 
it." So Allah revealed: "Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith." 
(75.16)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ ـ وَكَانَ ثِقَةً ـ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ حَرَّكَ بِهِ لِسَانَهُ ـ وَوَصَفَ سُفْيَانُ ـ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَحْفَظَهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏<A id="q41" name="q41" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,16)"><c_q41>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}</c_q41></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1b)</div><div class=englishchapter> "It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muḥammad pbuh), the ability to recite it (the Qur'ān) ." (V.75:17) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1 م)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q42" name="q42" href="javascript:openquran(74,17,17)"><c_q42>{‏إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}</c_q42></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182650>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=448></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4928</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182650><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182650><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Musa bin Abi Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he asked Sa`id bin Jubair regarding (the statement of Allah). 'Move not your tongue concerning 
(the Qur'an) to make haste therewith.' He said, "Ibn `Abbas said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to move his lips 
when the Divine Inspiration was being revealed to him. So the Prophet (ﷺ) was ordered not to move his 
tongue, which he used to do, lest some words should escape his memory. 'It is for Us to collect it' 
means, We will collect it in your chest;' and its recitation' means, We will make you recite it. 'But 
when We recite it (i.e. when it is revealed to you), follow its recital; it is for Us to explain it and make 
it clear,' (i.e. We will explain it through your tongue).</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q43" name="q43" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,16)"><c_q43>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ‏}</c_q43></a>‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَانَ يُحَرِّكُ شَفَتَيْهِ إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ ‏<A id="q44" name="q44" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,16)"><c_q44>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ‏}</c_q44></a>‏ ـ يَخْشَى أَنْ يَنْفَلِتَ مِنْهُ ـ ‏<A id="q45" name="q45" href="javascript:openquran(74,17,17)"><c_q45>{‏إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}</c_q45></a>‏ أَنْ نَجْمَعَهُ فِي صَدْرِكَ، وَقُرْآنَهُ أَنْ تَقْرَأَهُ ‏<A id="q46" name="q46" href="javascript:openquran(74,18,18)"><c_q46>{‏فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ‏}</c_q46></a>‏ يَقُولُ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ‏<A id="q47" name="q47" href="javascript:openquran(74,18,19)"><c_q47>{‏فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ * ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ‏}</c_q47></a>‏ أَنْ نُبَيِّنَهُ عَلَى لِسَانِكَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4928">Sahih al-Bukhari 4928</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 448</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 450</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(46050, 'h182650')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4928')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><a name=C75.03></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>"And when We have recited it to you [O Muḥammad PBUH through Jibril (Gabriel) a.s.], then follow its (the Qur'an's) recital." (V.75:18) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q48" name="q48" href="javascript:openquran(74,18,18)"><c_q48>{‏فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}</c_q48></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {قَرَأْنَاهُ} بَيَّنَّاهُ {فَاتَّبِعْ} اعْمَلْ بِهِ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182660>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=449></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4929</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182660><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182660><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(as regards) Allah's Statement: 
"Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith." (75.16) 
When Gabriel revealed the Divine Inspiration in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , he (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) moved his 
tongue and lips, and that state used to be very hard for him, and that movement indicated that 
revelation was taking place. So Allah revealed in Surat Al-Qiyama which begins: 
'I do swear by the Day of Resurrection...' (75) the Verses:-- 
'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith. It is for Us to collect it 
(Qur'an) in your mind, and give you the ability to recite it by heart. (75.16-17) Ibn `Abbas added: It is 
for Us to collect it (Qur'an) (in your mind), and give you the ability to recite it by heart means, "When 
We reveal it, listen. Then it is for Us to explain it," means, 'It is for us to explain it through your 
tongue.' So whenever Gabriel came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ' he would keep quiet (and listen), and when the 
Angel left, the Prophet (ﷺ) would recite that revelation as Allah promised him.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q49" name="q49" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,16)"><c_q49>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}</c_q49></a>‏ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ بِالْوَحْىِ، وَكَانَ مِمَّا يُحَرِّكُ بِهِ لِسَانَهُ وَشَفَتَيْهِ فَيَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ يُعْرَفُ مِنْهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي ‏<A id="q50" name="q50" href="javascript:openquran(74,1,1)"><c_q50>{‏لاَ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ‏}</c_q50></a>‏ ‏<A id="q51" name="q51" href="javascript:openquran(74,16,17)"><c_q51>{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ * إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}</c_q51></a>‏ قَالَ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ نَجْمَعَهُ فِي صَدْرِكَ، وَقُرْآنَهُ ‏<A id="q52" name="q52" href="javascript:openquran(74,18,18)"><c_q52>{‏فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}</c_q52></a>‏ فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فَاسْتَمِعْ ‏<A id="q53" name="q53" href="javascript:openquran(74,19,19)"><c_q53>{‏ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ‏}</c_q53></a>‏ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ نُبَيِّنَهُ بِلِسَانِكَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَكَانَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَطْرَقَ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَرَأَهُ كَمَا وَعَدَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏ ‏<A id="q54" name="q54" href="javascript:openquran(74,34,34)"><c_q54>{‏أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى‏}</c_q54></a>‏ تَوَعُّدٌ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(76)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Insan (Humans)</div>
<div class=achapno>(76)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة {هَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ} - بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ مَعْنَاهُ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ، وَهَلْ تَكُونُ جَحْدًا وَتَكُونُ خَبَرًا، وَهَذَا مِنَ الْخَبَرِ، يَقُولُ: كَانَ شَيْئًا فَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَذْكُورًا، وَذَلِكَ مِنْ حِينِ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ إِلَى أَنْ يُنْفَخَ فِيهِ الرُّوحُ، <a href="javascript:openquran(75,2,2)" class="aya">{أَمْشَاجٍ}</a> الأَخْلاَطُ مَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ، وَمَاءُ الرَّجُلِ الدَّمُ وَالْعَلَقَةُ. وَيُقَالُ إِذَا خُلِطَ مَشِيجٌ كَقَوْلِكَ خَلِيطٌ. وَمَمْشُوجٌ مِثْلُ مَخْلُوطٍ، وَيُقَالَ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{سَلاَسِلاً وَأَغْلاَلاً}</a> وَلَمْ يُجْرِ بَعْضُهُمْ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْتَطِيرًا}</a> مُمْتَدًّا، الْبَلاَءُ وَالْقَمْطَرِيرُ الشَّدِيدُ، يُقَالَ يَوْمٌ قَمْطَرِيرٌ وَيَوْمٌ قُمَاطِرٌ، وَالْعَبُوسُ وَالْقَمْطَرِيرُ وَالْقُمَاطِرُ وَالْعَصِيبُ أَشَدُّ مَا يَكُونُ مِنَ الأَيَّامِ فِي الْبَلاَءِ.</br>وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(75,28,28)" class="aya">{أَسْرَهُمْ}</a> شِدَّةُ الْخَلْقِ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ شَدَدْتَهُ مِنْ قَتَبٍ فَهْوَ مَأْسُورٌ.</div>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(77)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Mursalat (Those Winds Sent Forth)</div>
<div class=achapno>(77)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{جِمَالاَتٌ}</a> حِبَالٌ.</br><a name='1,43,43wwwwww21,77,77wwwwww76,48,48wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{ارْكَعُوا}</a> صَلُّوا <a href="javascript:openquran(76,48,48)" class="aya">{لاَ يَرْكَعُونَ}</a> لاَ يُصَلُّونَ. وَسُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ يَنْطِقُونَ}</a>، <a href="javascript:openquran(5,23,23)" class="aya">{وَاللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ}</a>.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(35,65,65)" class="aya">{الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ}</a> فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ ذُو أَلْوَانٍ مَرَّةً يَنْطِقُونَ، وَمَرَّةً يُخْتَمُ عَلَيْهِمْ.</div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182670>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=450></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4930</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182670><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182670><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when Surat Wal-Mursalat was revealed to him. While we were receiving it 
from his mouth, a snake suddenly came and we ran to kill it, but it outstripped us and entered its hole 
quickly. Allah's le said, "It has escaped your evil, and you too, have escaped its evil."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ، وَإِنَّا لَنَتَلَقَّاهَا مِنْ فِيهِ فَخَرَجَتْ حَيَّةٌ، فَابْتَدَرْنَاهَا فَسَبَقَتْنَا فَدَخَلَتْ جُحْرَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ وُقِيَتْ شَرَّكُمْ، كَمَا وُقِيتُمْ شَرَّهَا ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=451></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4931</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182680><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182680><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>(Similarly--as no. 452 above.)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَعَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَفْصٌ وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ قَرْمٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ،‏.‏       
قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ.</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=452></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4931b</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182690><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182690><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a cave, Surat "Wal Mursalat" was revealed to him and we 
received it directly from his mouth as soon as he had received the revelation. Suddenly a snake came 
out and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Get at it and kill it!" We ran to kill it but it outstripped us. Allah's 
Apostle said, "It has escaped your evil, as you too, have escaped its."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بَيْنَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَارٍ إِذْ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ فَتَلَقَّيْنَاهَا مِنْ فِيهِ وَإِنَّ فَاهُ لَرَطْبٌ بِهَا إِذْ خَرَجَتْ حَيَّةٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمُ اقْتُلُوهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَابْتَدَرْنَاهَا فَسَبَقَتْنَا ـ قَالَ ـ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وُقِيَتْ شَرَّكُمْ، كَمَا وُقِيتُمْ شَرَّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->
