<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah ta'ala: "Verily! It (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (a fort or a huge log of wood) ." (V.77:32)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q60" name="q60" href="javascript:openquran(76,32,32)"><c_q60>{‏إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ‏}</c_q60></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182700>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=453></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4932</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182700><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182700><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(as regards the explanation of Hadith 454). 'Indeed, it (Hell) throws about sparks (huge) as Forts.' We 
used to collect wood in the form of logs, three cubits long or shorter. for heating purposes in winter., 
and we used to call such wood, the Qasr.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَابِسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ قَالَ كُنَّا نَرْفَعُ الْخَشَبَ بِقَصَرٍ ثَلاَثَةَ أَذْرُعٍ أَوْ أَقَلَّ، فَنَرْفَعُهُ لِلشِّتَاءِ فَنُسَمِّيهِ الْقَصَرَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="clear"></div><div class=bottomItems>
<table class=hadith_reference cellspacing=0 cellpadding=0><tr><td><b>Reference</b></td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;<a href="/bukhari:4932">Sahih al-Bukhari 4932</a></td></tr><tr><td>In-book reference</td><td>&nbsp;:&nbsp;Book 65, Hadith 453</td></tr><tr><td><span class="deprecated_reference">USC-MSA web (English) reference</span></td><td>&nbsp;: <span class="deprecated_reference">Vol. 6, Book 60, Hadith 455</span></td></tr> <tr><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="deprecated_reference"><i>(deprecated numbering scheme)</i></span></td></tr></table><div class="hadith_permalink"><span class=reportlink href="javascript: void(0);" onclick="reportHadith(46100, 'h182700')">Report Error</span> | <span class=sharelink onclick="share('/bukhari:4932')">Share</span> | <span class=copylink title="Copy hadith to clipboard">Copy</span> <span class=copycbcaret title="Change copy options">▼</span></div></div><div class=clear></div></div><!-- end actual hadith container --><div class=clear></div><a name=C77.03></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "As if they were yellow camels or bundles of ropes." (V.77:33)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالاَتٌ صُفْرٌ‏}‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182710>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=454></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4933</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182710><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182710><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated>Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>
(regarding) the explanation of "... It throws
sparks as Al-Qasr ..." (V. 77:32):
We used to collect logs of wood, three
cubits long or longer, to store for heating
purposes in winter, and we used to call it Al-
Qasr, it also means a castle or a fort.
"As if they were Jimalatun Sufr (yellow
camels or bundles of ropes)" (V.77:33):
means the ropes of a ship which are made in
bundles till it become as wide as men's waists.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَابِسٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏<A id="q61" name="q61" href="javascript:openquran(76,32,32)"><c_q61>{‏تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ‏}</c_q61></a>‏ كُنَّا نَعْمِدُ إِلَى الْخَشَبَةِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَذْرُعٍ وَفَوْقَ ذَلِكَ، فَنَرْفَعُهُ لِلشِّتَاءِ فَنُسَمِّيهِ الْقَصَرَ‏.‏ ‏{‏كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالاَتٌ صُفْرٌ‏}‏ حِبَالُ السُّفْنِ تُجْمَعُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ كَأَوْسَاطِ الرِّجَالِ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(4)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it) ." (V.77:35) </div>
<div class=achapno>(4)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q62" name="q62" href="javascript:openquran(76,35,35)"><c_q62>{‏هَذَا يَوْمُ لاَ يَنْطِقُونَ‏}</c_q62></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182720>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=455></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4934</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182720><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182720><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) in a cave, Surat wal-Mursalat was revealed to him and he recited it, 
and I heard it directly from his mouth as soon as he recited its revelation. Suddenly a snake sprang at 
us, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill it!" We ran to kill it but it escaped quickly. The Prophet (ﷺ) said. "It has 
escaped your evil, and you too have escaped its evil."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَارٍ إِذْ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَيَتْلُوهَا وَإِنِّي لأَتَلَقَّاهَا مِنْ فِيهِ وَإِنَّ فَاهُ لَرَطْبٌ بِهَا، إِذْ وَثَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا حَيَّةٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَابْتَدَرْنَاهَا فَذَهَبَتْ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وُقِيَتْ شَرَّكُمْ، كَمَا وُقِيتُمْ شَرَّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ أَبِي فِي غَارٍ بِمِنًى‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(78)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat an-Naba’ (The Momentous News)</div>
<div class=achapno>(78)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {لاَ يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا} لاَ يَخَافُونَهُ.<br>
<br><br>
{لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا} لاَ يُكَلِّمُونَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهُمْ.<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {وَهَّاجًا} مُضِيئًا.<br>
<br><br>
{عَطَاءً حِسَابًا} جَزَاءً كَافِيًا، أَعْطَانِي مَا أَحْسَبَنِي أَيْ كَفَانِي.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>"The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups after groups) ." (V.78:18)  </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q66" name="q66" href="javascript:openquran(77,18,18)"><c_q66>{‏يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا‏}</c_q66></a>‏ زُمَرًا  </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182730>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=456></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4935</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182730><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182730><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al--A`mash:</div><div class=text_details><p>Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Between the two sounds of the trumpet, there will be forty." 
Somebody asked Abu Huraira, "Forty days?" But he refused to reply. Then he asked, "Forty months?" 
He refused to reply. Then he asked, "Forty years?" Again, he refused to reply. Abu Huraira added. 
"Then (after this period) Allah will send water from the sky and then the dead bodies will grow like 
vegetation grows, There is nothing of the human body that does not decay except one bone; that is the 
little bone at the end of the coccyx of which the human body will be recreated on the Day of 
Resurrection." (See Hadith No. 338)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ النَّفْخَتَيْنِ أَرْبَعُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَرْبَعُونَ يَوْمًا قَالَ أَبَيْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرْبَعُونَ شَهْرًا قَالَ أَبَيْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرْبَعُونَ سَنَةً قَالَ أَبَيْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يُنْزِلُ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً‏.‏ فَيَنْبُتُونَ كَمَا يَنْبُتُ الْبَقْلُ لَيْسَ مِنَ الإِنْسَانِ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ يَبْلَى إِلاَّ عَظْمًا وَاحِدًا وَهْوَ عَجْبُ الذَّنَبِ، وَمِنْهُ يُرَكَّبُ الْخَلْقُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(79)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat an-Nazi’at (Those Angles Stripping out Souls)</div>
<div class=achapno>(79)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة {وَالنَّازِعَاتِ}</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {الآيَةَ الْكُبْرَى} عَصَاهُ وَيَدُهُ، يُقَالُ النَّاخِرَةُ وَالنَّخِرَةُ، سَوَاءٌ مِثْلُ الطَّامِعِ وَالطَّمِعِ وَالْبَاخِلِ وَالْبَخِيلِ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ النَّخِرَةُ <br><br>
الْبَالِيَةُ، وَالنَّاخِرَةُ الْعَظْمُ الْمُجَوَّفُ الَّذِي تَمُرُّ فِيهِ الرِّيحُ فَيَنْخَرُ.<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {الْحَافِرَةِ} الَّتِي أَمْرُنَا الأَوَّلُ إِلَى الْحَيَاةِ.<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: {أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا} مَتَى مُنْتَهَاهَا، وَمُرْسَى السَّفِينَةِ حَيْثُ تَنْتَهِي.</div>

<a name=457></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4936</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182740><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182740><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:</div><div class=text_details><p>I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pointing with his index and middle fingers, saying. "The time of my Advent and 
the Hour are like these two fingers."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ هَكَذَا بِالْوُسْطَى وَالَّتِي تَلِي الإِبْهَامَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ بُعِثْتُ وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(80)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat ‘Abasa (He Frowned)</div>
<div class=achapno>(80)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة عَبَسَ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ<br>
<br><br>
<a name='73,22,22wwwwww79,1,1wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{عَبَسَ}</a> كَلَحَ وَأَعْرَضَ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُطَهَّرَةٍ}</a> لاَ يَمَسُّهَا إِلاَّ الْمُطَهَّرُونَ وَهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ، وَهَذَا مِثْلُ قَوْلِهِ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا}</a> جَعَلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ وَالصُّحُفَ مُطَهَّرَةً، لأَنَّ الصُّحُفَ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا التَّطْهِيرُ، فَجُعِلَ التَّطْهِيرُ لِمَنْ حَمَلَهَا أَيْضًا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(79,15,15)" class="aya">{سَفَرَةٍ}</a> الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَاحِدُهُمْ سَافِرٌ، سَفَرْتُ أَصْلَحْتُ بَيْنَهُمْ، وَجُعِلَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ إِذَا نَزَلَتْ بِوَحْيِ اللَّهِ وَتَأْدِيَتِهِ كَالسَّفِيرِ الَّذِي يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(79,6,6)" class="aya">{تَصَدَّى}</a> تَغَافَلَ عَنْهُ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(79,23,23)" class="aya">{لَمَّا يَقْضِ}</a> لاَ يَقْضِي أَحَدٌ مَا أُمِرَ بِهِ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(79,41,41)" class="aya">{تَرْهَقُهَا}</a> تَغْشَاهَا شِدَّةٌ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مُسْفِرَةٌ}</a> مُشْرِقَةٌ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(79,15,15)" class="aya">{بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ}</a> وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَتَبَةٍ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَسْفَارًا}</a> كُتُبًا.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(79,10,10)" class="aya">{تَلَهَّى}</a> تَشَاغَلَ، يُقَالُ وَاحِدُ الأَسْفَارِ سِفْرٌ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=458></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4937</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182750><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182750><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Such a person as recites the Qur'an and masters it by heart, will be with the noble 
righteous scribes (in Heaven). And such a person exerts himself to learn the Qur'an by heart, and 
recites it with great difficulty, will have a double reward."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زُرَارَةَ بْنَ أَوْفَى، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَهْوَ حَافِظٌ لَهُ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ، وَمَثَلُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَهْوَ يَتَعَاهَدُهُ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ شَدِيدٌ، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(81)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat at-Takweer (Putting out the Sun)</div>
<div class=achapno>(81)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب سورة {إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ}</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly"><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{انْكَدَرَتْ}</a> انْتَثَرَتْ.</br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(80,6,6)" class="aya">{سُجِّرَتْ}</a> ذَهَبَ مَاؤُهَا فَلاَ يَبْقَى قَطْرَةٌ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ الْمَسْجُورُ الْمَمْلُوءُ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ سُجِرَتْ أَفْضَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ، فَصَارَتْ بَحْرًا وَاحِدًا، وَالْخُنَّسُ تَخْنِسُ فِي مُجْرَاهَا تَرْجِعُ وَتَكْنِسُ تَسْتَتِرُ كَمَا تَكْنِسُ الظِّبَاءُ <a href="javascript:openquran(80,18,18)" class="aya">{تَنَفَّسَ}</a> ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ. وَالظَّنِينُ الْمُتَّهَمُ وَالضَّنِينُ يَضَنُّ بِهِ.</br>وَقَالَ عُمَرُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(80,7,7)" class="aya">{النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ}</a> يُزَوَّجُ نَظِيرَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: <a href="javascript:openquran(36,22,22)" class="aya">{احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ}</a>.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(80,17,17)" class="aya">{عَسْعَسَ}</a> أَدْبَرَ.</div>

<div class=achapno>(82)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة {إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ}</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ <br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(81,3,3)" class="aya">{فُجِّرَتْ}</a> فَاضَتْ. وَقَرَأَ الأَعْمَشُ وَعَاصِمٌ <a href="javascript:openquran(81,7,7)" class="aya">{فَعَدَلَكَ}</a> بِالتَّخْفِيفِ، وَقَرَأَهُ أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ بِالتَّشْدِيدِ، وَأَرَادَ مُعْتَدِلَ الْخَلْقِ وَمَنْ خَفَّفَ، يَعْنِي فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ شَاءَ، إِمَّا حَسَنٌ وَإِمَّا قَبِيحٌ وَطَوِيلٌ وَقَصِيرٌ.</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">بَابٌ {يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ}</div><div class=clear></div>

<a name=459></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4938</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182760><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182760><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "On the Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds, some of 
them will be enveloped in their sweat up to the middle of their ears."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏<A id="q74" name="q74" href="javascript:openquran(82,6,6)"><c_q74>{‏يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}</c_q74></a>‏ حَتَّى يَغِيبَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(68,25,25)">{كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ}</a> يَأْخُذُ كِتَابَهُ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ظَهْرِهِ {وَسَقَ} جَمَعَ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ.<br>

<a name=C84.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> "He surely will receive an easy reckoning." (V.84:8) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب {فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا}</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182770>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=460></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4939</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182770><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182770><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," (On the Day of Resurrection) any one whose account will be taken will be 
ruined (i.e. go to Hell)." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! May Allah make me be sacrificed for you. Doesn't 
Allah say: 
"Then as for him who will be given his record in his right hand, he surely will receive an easy 
reckoning.?" (84.7-8) He replied, "That is only the presentation of the accounts; but he whose record 
is questioned, will be ruined."
<p>
<i>(This hadith is also narrated through two other chains)</i></b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ، حَاتِمِ بْنِ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُحَاسَبُ إِلاَّ هَلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جَعَلَنِي اللَّهُ فِدَاءَكَ، أَلَيْسَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q77" name="q77" href="javascript:openquran(83,7,8)"><c_q77>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ * فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا‏}</c_q77></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ الْعَرْضُ يُعْرَضُونَ، وَمَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ هَلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter)" (V.84:19)   </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q78" name="q78" href="javascript:openquran(83,19,19)"><c_q78>{‏لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ‏}</c_q78></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182780>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=461></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4940</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182780><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182780><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>(as regards the Verse):--'You shall surely travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).' 
(It means) from one state to another. That concerns your Prophet.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، جَعْفَرُ بْنُ إِيَاسٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏<A id="q79" name="q79" href="javascript:openquran(83,19,19)"><c_q79>{‏لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ‏}</c_q79></a>‏ حَالاً بَعْدَ حَالٍ، قَالَ هَذَا نَبِيُّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(84,4,4)" class="aya">{الأُخْدُودِ}</a> شَقٌّ فِي الأَرْضِ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(84,10,10)" class="aya">{فَتَنُوا}</a> عَذَّبُوا.<br>

<div class=surah>
<div class=echapno>(86)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat at-Tariq (The Nightly Star)</div>
<div class=achapno>(86)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة الطَّارِقِ</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">هو النجم، وما أتاك ليلا فهو طارق. {النجم الثاقب}: المضيء، وقال مجاهد: {الثاقب} الذي يتوهج.<br>
<br>
وقال مجاهد: <a href="javascript:openquran(85,11,11)">{ذات الرجع}</a>: سحاب يرجع بالمطر.<br>
<br><br>
<a href="javascript:openquran(85,12,12)">‏{‏ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ‏}</a>‏ تَتَصَدَّعُ بِالنَّبَاتِ ‏.‏<br>
<br><br>
وقال ابن عباس: {لقول فصل}: لحق. {لما عليها حافظ}: إلا عليها حافظ.</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وقال مجاهد: {قدر فهدى}: قدر الإنسان الشقاء والسعادة، وهدى الأنعام لمراتعها.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=462></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4941</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182790><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182790><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Al-Bara:</div><div class=text_details><p>The first of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) who came to us (in Medina), were Mus`ab bin `Umar and 
Ibn Um Maktum, and they started teaching us the Qur'an. Then came `Ammar, Bilal and Sa`d. 
Afterwards `Umar bin Al-Kkattab came along with a batch of twenty (men): and after that the Prophet (ﷺ) 
came. I never saw the people of Medina so pleased with anything as they were with his arrival, so that 
even the little boys and girls were saying, "This is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who has come." He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) 
did not come (to Medina) till I had learnt Surat Al-Ala and also other similar Suras.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَجَعَلاَ يُقْرِئَانِنَا الْقُرْآنَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ عَمَّارٌ وَبِلاَلٌ وَسَعْدٌ ثُمَّ جَاءَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فِي عِشْرِينَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَرِحُوا بِشَىْءٍ فَرَحَهُمْ بِهِ، حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ الْوَلاَئِدَ وَالصِّبْيَانَ يَقُولُونَ هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَدْ جَاءَ‏.‏ فَمَا جَاءَ حَتَّى قَرَأْتُ ‏<A id="q82" name="q82" href="javascript:openquran(86,1,1)"><c_q82>{‏سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى‏}</c_q82></a>‏ فِي سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة {هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ}</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ<br>
<br><br>
وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{عَامِلَةٌ نَاصِبَةٌ}</a> النَّصَارَى.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(87,5,5)" class="aya">{عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ}</a> بَلَغَ إِنَاهَا وَحَانَ شُرْبُهَا <a href="javascript:openquran(54,44,44)" class="aya">{حَمِيمٍ آنٍ}</a> بَلَغَ إِنَاهُ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لاَ تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لاَغِيَةً}</a> شَتْمًا. الضَّرِيعُ نَبْتٌ يُقَالَ لَهُ الشِّبْرِقُ، يُسَمِّيهِ أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ الضَّرِيعَ إِذَا يَبِسَ، وَهْوَ سَمٌّ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(87,22,22)" class="aya">{بِمُسَيْطِرٍ}</a> بِمُسَلَّطٍ، وَيُقْرَأُ بِالصَّادِ وَالسِّينِ.</br>وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(87,25,25)" class="aya">{إِيَابَهُمْ}</a> مَرْجِعَهُمْ.</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة {وَالْفَجْرِ}</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ الْوَتْرُ اللَّهُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ}</a> الْقَدِيمَةِ وَالْعِمَادُ أَهْلُ عَمُودٍ لاَ يُقِيمُونَ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(88,13,13)" class="aya">{سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ}</a> الَّذِي عُذِّبُوا بِهِ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَكْلاً لَمًّا}</a> السَّفُّ.</br>وَ<a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{جَمًّا}</a> الْكَثِيرُ وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ فَهْوَ شَفْعٌ، السَّمَاءُ شَفْعٌ وَالْوَتْرُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(88,13,13)" class="aya">{سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ}</a> كَلِمَةٌ تَقُولُهَا الْعَرَبُ لِكُلِّ نَوْعٍ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ يَدْخُلُ فِيهِ السَّوْطُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(88,14,14)" class="aya">{لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ}</a> إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(88,18,18)" class="aya">{تَحَاضُّونَ}</a> تُحَافِظُونَ، وَيَحُضُّونَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِإِطْعَامِهِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ}</a> الْمُصَدِّقَةُ بِالثَّوَابِ.</br>وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(88,27,27)" class="aya">{يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ}</a> إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَبْضَهَا اطْمَأَنَّتْ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَاطْمَأَنَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهَا، وَرَضِيَتْ عَنِ اللَّهِ، وَرَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، فَأَمَرَ بِقَبْضِ رُوحِهَا، وَأَدْخَلَهَا اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَجَعَلَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a name='2,172,172wwwwww12,18,18wwwwww34,14,14wwwwww41,38,38wwwwww88,9,9wwwwww' class='aya_multi_result'>{جَابُوا}</a> نَقَبُوا مِنْ جِيبَ الْقَمِيصُ قُطِعَ لَهُ جَيْبٌ. يَجُوبُ الْفَلاَةَ يَقْطَعُهَا <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَمًّا}</a> لَمَمْتُهُ أَجْمَعَ أَتَيْتُ عَلَى آخِرِهِ.</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ <br>
<br><br>
وقال مجاهد: ضحاها: ضوؤها. {إذا تلاها}: تبعها. و{طحاها}: دحاها. {دساها}: أغواها. {فألهمها}: عرفها الشقاء والسعادة. <br><br>
<a href="javascript:openquran(90,11,11)">{بطغواها}</a>: بمعاصيها. <a href="javascript:openquran(90,15,15)">{ولا يخاف عقباها}</a>: عقبى أحد.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=463></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4942</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182800><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182800><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Abdullah bin Zama:</div><div class=text_details><p>That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon, and he mentioned the shecamel and the one who 
hamstrung it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited:-- 
'When, the most wicked man among them went forth (to hamstrung the she-camel).' (91.12.) Then he 
said, "A tough man whose equal was rare and who enjoyed the protection of his people, like Abi 
Zama went forth to (hamstrung) it." The Prophet (ﷺ) then mentioned about the women (in his sermon). "It 
is not wise for anyone of you to lash his wife like a slave, for he might sleep with her the same 
evening." Then he advised them not to laugh when somebody breaks wind and said, "Why should 
anybody laugh at what he himself does?"</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ وَذَكَرَ النَّاقَةَ وَالَّذِي عَقَرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ‏<A id="q97" name="q97" href="javascript:openquran(90,1,1)"><c_q97>{‏إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا‏}</c_q97></a>‏ انْبَعَثَ لَهَا رَجُلٌ عَزِيزٌ عَارِمٌ، مَنِيعٌ فِي رَهْطِهِ، مِثْلُ أَبِي زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ النِّسَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَعْمِدُ أَحَدُكُمْ يَجْلِدُ امْرَأَتَهُ جَلْدَ الْعَبْدِ، فَلَعَلَّهُ يُضَاجِعُهَا مِنْ آخِرِ يَوْمِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ وَعَظَهُمْ فِي ضَحِكِهِمْ مِنَ الضَّرْطَةِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِمَ يَضْحَكُ أَحَدُكُمْ مِمَّا يَفْعَلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مِثْلُ أَبِي زَمْعَةَ عَمِّ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q98" name="q98" href="javascript:openquran(91,2,2)"><c_q98>{‏وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى‏}</c_q98></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182810>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=464></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4943</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182810><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182810><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Alqama:</div><div class=text_details><p>I went to Sham with a group of the companions of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud). Abu Ad-Darda' heard of 
our arrival so he came to us and said, "Is there anybody among you who can recite (Qur'an)" We 
replied in the affirmative. Then he asked, "Who is the best reciter?" They pointed at me. Then he told 
me to recite, so I recited the verse:-- 
'By the night as it envelops 'By the day as it appears in brightness; By (Him Who created) male and 
the female.' (92.1-3) Abu Ad-Darda' then said to me, "Did you hear it (like this) from the mouth of 
your friend (`Abdullah bin Mas`ud)?" I said, "Yes." He said, "I too, heard it (like this) from the mouth 
of the Prophet, but these people do not consider this recitation as the correct one."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الشَّأْمَ فَسَمِعَ بِنَا أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ فَأَتَانَا فَقَالَ أَفِيكُمْ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ فَقُلْنَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَيُّكُمْ أَقْرَأُ فَأَشَارُوا إِلَىَّ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهَا مِنْ فِي صَاحِبِكَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ فِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهَؤُلاَءِ يَأْبَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> "By Him Who created male and female." (V.92:3) </div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q99" name="q99" href="javascript:openquran(91,3,3)"><c_q99>{‏وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالأُنْثَى‏}</c_q99></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182820>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=465></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4944</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182820><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182820><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibrahim:</div><div class=text_details><p>The companions of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) came to Abu Darda', (and before they arrived at his 
home), he looked for them and found them. Then he asked them,: 'Who among you can recite (Qur'an) 
as `Abdullah recites it?" They replied, "All of us." He asked, "Who among you knows it by heart?" 
They pointed at 'Alqama. Then he asked Alqama. "How did you hear `Abdullah bin Mas`ud reciting 
Surat Al-Lail (The Night)?" Alqama recited: 
'By the male and the female.' Abu Ad-Darda said, "I testify that I heard me Prophet reciting it 
likewise, but these people want me to recite it:-- 
'And by Him Who created male and female.' but by Allah, I will not follow them."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فَطَلَبَهُمْ فَوَجَدَهُمْ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ كُلُّنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَيُّكُمْ يَحْفَظُ وَأَشَارُوا إِلَى عَلْقَمَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ كَيْفَ سَمِعْتَهُ يَقْرَأُ ‏<A id="q100" name="q100" href="javascript:openquran(91,1,1)"><c_q100>{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}</c_q100></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ ‏{‏وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ هَكَذَا، وَهَؤُلاَءِ يُرِيدُونِي عَلَى أَنْ أَقْرَأَ ‏<A id="q101" name="q101" href="javascript:openquran(91,3,3)"><c_q101>{‏وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالأُنْثَى‏}</c_q101></a>‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُتَابِعُهُمْ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=echapno>(3)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and fears Him." (V.92:5)</div>
<div class=achapno>(3)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q102" name="q102" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,5)"><c_q102>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى‏}</c_q102></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182830>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=466></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4945</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182830><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182830><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) in a funeral procession at Baqi Al-Gharqad. He said, "There is 
none of you but has his place written for him in Paradise or in the Hell- Fire." They said, "O Allah's 
Apostle! Shall we depend (on this fact and give up work)?" He said, "Carry on doing (good deeds), for 
every body will find it easy to do (what will lead him to his destined place)." Then he recited: 
'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best reward from 
Allah (i.e. Allah will compensate him for what he will spend in Allah's way). So, We will make 
smooth for him the path of ease. But he who is a greedy miser....for him, the path for evil.' (92.5-10)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ فِي جَنَازَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كُتِبَ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q103" name="q103" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,6)"><c_q103>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}</c_q103></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏لِلْعُسْرَى‏}‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(3b)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: '... and believes in Al-Ḥusnā." (1)(V.92:6)   (1):  (Ch.) The best (i.e., either Lā ilāha illallāh: none has the right to be worshipped but Allah) or a reward from Allah (i.e., Allah will compensate him for what he will spend in Allah's way or bless him with Paradise).</div>
<div class=achapno>(3 م)</div>

<a name=468></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4946</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182850><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182850><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession, he took a small stick and started scraping the earth 
with it and said, "There is none among you but has his place written for him, either in the Hell Fire or 
in Paradise." They (the people) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend on this (and leave work)?" He 
replied. "Carry on doing (good deeds), for everybody will find easy (to do) such deeds as will lead 
him to his destined place." The Prophet (ﷺ) then recited:-- 
'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best 
Reward.'.....(92.5-10)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي جَنَازَةٍ فَأَخَذَ عُودًا يَنْكُتُ فِي الأَرْضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كُتِبَ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ أَوْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ ‏<A id="q106" name="q106" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,6)"><c_q106>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}</c_q106></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ مَنْصُورٌ فَلَمْ أُنْكِرْهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=469></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4947</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182860><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182860><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "There is none among you but has his place 
written for him, either in Paradise or in the Hell-Fire." We said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend 
(on this fact and give up work)?" He replied, "No! Carry on doing good deeds, for everybody will find 
easy (to do) such deeds as will lead him to his destined place." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 'As for him 
who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah, and believes in the Best reward. We will make 
smooth for him the path of ease....the path for evil.' (92.5-10)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كُتِبَ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q108" name="q108" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,7)"><c_q108>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى * فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى‏}</c_q108></a>‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q109" name="q109" href="javascript:openquran(91,10,10)"><c_q109>{‏فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى‏}</c_q109></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(6)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Most High: "And belies Al-Ḥusnā ..." (V.92:9). </div>
<div class=achapno>(6)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q110" name="q110" href="javascript:openquran(91,9,9)"><c_q110>{‏وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}</c_q110></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182870>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=470></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4948</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182870><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182870><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>While we were in a funeral procession in Baqi Al-Gharqad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and sat down, and 
we sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand and he bent his head and started scraping the 
ground with it. He then said, "There is none among you, and no created soul but has his place written 
for him either in Paradise or in the Hell-Fire, and also has his happy or miserable fate (in the 
Hereafter) written for him." A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we depend upon what is written for 
us and give up doing (good) deeds? For whoever among us is destined to be fortunate (in the 
Hereafter), will join the fortunate peoples and whoever among us is destined to be miserable will do 
such deeds as are characteristic of the people who are destined to misery." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Those 
who are destined to be happy (in the Hereafter) will find it easy and pleasant to do the deeds 
characteristic of those destined to happiness, while those who are to be among the miserable (in the 
Hereafter), will find it easy to do the deeds characteristic of those destined to misery." Then he recited: 'As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and believes in the Best reward from Allah,' (92.5-6)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا فِي جَنَازَةٍ فِي بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ، فَأَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَعَدَ وَقَعَدْنَا حَوْلَهُ، وَمَعَهُ مِخْصَرَةٌ فَنَكَّسَ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ بِمِخْصَرَتِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ وَمَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ إِلاَّ كُتِبَ مَكَانُهَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، وَإِلاَّ قَدْ كُتِبَتْ شَقِيَّةً أَوْ سَعِيدَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ عَلَى كِتَابِنَا وَنَدَعُ الْعَمَلَ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنَّا مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنَّا مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاءِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى عَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q111" name="q111" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,6)"><c_q111>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}</c_q111></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب ‏<A id="q112" name="q112" href="javascript:openquran(91,10,10)"><c_q112>{‏فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى‏}</c_q112></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=471></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4949</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182880><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182880><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated `Ali:</div><div class=text_details><p>While the Prophet (ﷺ) was in a funeral procession. he picked up something and started scraping the 
ground with it, and said, "There is none among you but has his place written for him either in the Hell 
Fire or in Paradise." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we not depend upon what has been written 
for us and give up deeds? He said, "Carry on doing (good) deeds, for everybody will find easy to do 
such deeds as will lead him to his destined place for which he has been created. So he who is destined 
to be among the happy (in the Hereafter), will find it easy to do the deeds characteristic of such 
people, while he who is destined to be among the miserable ones, will find it easy to do the deeds 
characteristic of such people." Then he recited: 
'As for him who gives (in charity) and fears Allah, and believes in the best....' (92.5-10)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي جَنَازَةٍ فَأَخَذَ شَيْئًا فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ بِهِ الأَرْضَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كُتِبَ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ عَلَى كِتَابِنَا وَنَدَعُ الْعَمَلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ، أَمَّا مَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاءِ فَيُيَسَّرُ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏<A id="q113" name="q113" href="javascript:openquran(91,5,6)"><c_q113>{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}</c_q113></a>‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Most High: "Your Lord (O Muḥammad pbuh) has neither forsaken you nor hates you." (V.93:3)</div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q116" name="q116" href="javascript:openquran(92,3,3)"><c_q116>{‏مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}</c_q116></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182890>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=472></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4950</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182890><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182890><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Jundub bin Sufyan:</div><div class=text_details><p>Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became sick and could not offer his night prayer (Tahajjud) for two or three 
nights. Then a lady (the wife of Abu Lahab) came and said, "O Muhammad! I think that your Satan 
has forsaken you, for I have not seen him with you for two or three nights!" On that Allah revealed: 
'By the fore-noon, and by the night when it darkens, your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken 
you, nor hated you.' (93.1-3)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدُبَ بْنَ سُفْيَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اشْتَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، فَجَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ شَيْطَانُكَ قَدْ تَرَكَكَ، لَمْ أَرَهُ قَرِبَكَ مُنْذُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏<A id="q115" name="q115" href="javascript:openquran(92,1,3)"><c_q115>{‏وَالضُّحَى * وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى * مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}</c_q115></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(2)</div><div class=englishchapter> The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "Your Lord (O Muḥammad pbuh) has neither forsaken you nor hates you." (V.93:1-3)</div>
<div class=achapno>(2)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلُهُ ‏<A id="q116" name="q116" href="javascript:openquran(92,3,3)"><c_q116>{‏مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}</c_q116></a>‏ </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">تُقْرَأُ بِالتَّشْدِيدِ وَالتَّخْفِيفِ بِمَعْنًى وَاحِدٍ مَا تَرَكَكَ رَبُّكَ.<br>

<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4951</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182900><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182900><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>

there was revealed: 'Your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken you, not hated you.' (93.1-3)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، غُنْدَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبًا الْبَجَلِيَّ، قَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أُرَى صَاحِبَكَ إِلاَّ أَبْطَأَكَ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏<A id="q117" name="q117" href="javascript:openquran(92,3,3)"><c_q117>{‏مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}</c_q117></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(93,2,2)" class="aya">{وِزْرَكَ}</a> فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{أَنْقَضَ}</a> أَثْقَلَ <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا}</a> قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ أَيْ مَعَ ذَلِكَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا آخَرَ كَقَوْلِهِ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{هَلْ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَا إِلاَّ إِحْدَى الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ}</a> وَلَنْ يَغْلِبَ عُسْرٌ يُسْرَيْنِ.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{فَانْصَبْ}</a> فِي حَاجَتِكَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ. وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: <a href="javascript:openquran(93,1,1)" class="aya">{أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ}</a> شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلإِسْلاَمِ.</div>

<div class=echapno>(96)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-‘Alaq (The Clinging Clot of Blood)</div>

<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ </div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">وَقَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَتِيقٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ اكْتُبْ فِي الْمُصْحَفِ فِي أَوَّلِ الإِمَامِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ السُّورَتَيْنِ خَطًّا.</br>وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(95,17,17)" class="aya">{نَادِيَهُ}</a> عَشِيرَتَهُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(95,18,18)" class="aya">{الزَّبَانِيَةَ}</a> الْمَلاَئِكَةَ.</br>وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: <a href="javascript:openquran(95,8,8)" class="aya">{الرُّجْعَى}</a> الْمَرْجِعُ.</br><a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{لَنَسْفَعَنْ}</a> قَالَ لَنَأْخُذَنْ وَلَنَسْفَعَنْ بِالنُّونِ وَهْيَ الْخَفِيفَةُ، سَفَعْتُ بِيَدِهِ أَخَذْتُ.</div>

<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter></div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب </div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h182930>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=475></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4953</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182930><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182930><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>(the wife of the Prophet) The commencement (of the Divine Inspiration) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the 
form of true dreams in his sleep, for he never had a dream but it turned out to be true and clear as the 
bright daylight. Then he began to like seclusions, so he used to go in seclusion in the cave of Hira 
where he used to worship Allah continuously for many nights before going back to his family to take 
the necessary provision (of food) for the stay. He come back to (his wife) Khadija again to take his 
provision (of food) likewise, till one day he received the Guidance while he was in the cave of Hira. 
An Angel came to him and asked him to read. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I do not know how to read." 
The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "Then the Angel held me (forcibly) and pressed me so hard that I felt distressed. 
Then he released me and again asked me to read, and I replied, 'I do not know how to read.' 
Thereupon he held me again and pressed me for the second time till I felt distressed. He then released 
me and asked me to read, but again I replied. 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he held me for 
the third time and pressed me till I got distressed, and then he released me and said, 'Read, in the 
Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists), has created man out of a clot, Read! And your 
Lord is the Most Generous. Who has taught (the writing) by the pen, has taught man that which he 
knew not." (96.1-5). 
Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned with that experience; and the muscles between his neck and shoulders 
were trembling till he came upon Khadija (his wife) and said, "Cover me!" They covered him, and 
when the state of fear was over, he said to Khadija, "O Khadija! What is wrong with me? I was afraid 
that something bad might happen to me." Then he told her the story. Khadija said, "Nay! But receive 
the good tidings! By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you, for by Allah, you keep good relations with 
your Kith and kin, speak the truth, help the poor and the destitute, entertain your guests generously 
and assist those who are stricken with calamities." Khadija then took him to Waraqa bin Naufil, the 
son of Khadija's paternal uncle. Waraqa had been converted to Christianity in the Pre-lslamic Period 
and used to write Arabic and write of the Gospel in Arabic as much as Allah wished him to write. He 
was an old man and had lost his eyesight. Khadija said (to Waraqa), "O my cousin! Listen to what 
your nephew is going to say." Waraqa said, "O my nephew! What have you seen?" The Prophet (ﷺ) then 
described whatever he had seen. Waraqa said, "This is the same Angel (Gabriel) who was sent to 
Moses. I wish I were young." He added some other statement. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Will these 
people drive me out?" Waraqa said, "Yes, for nobody brought the like of what you have brought, but 
was treated with hostility. If I were to remain alive till your day (when you start preaching). then I 
would support you strongly." But a short while later Waraqa died and the Divine Inspiration was 
paused (stopped) for a while so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was very much grieved.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي رِزْمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، سَلْمَوَيْهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ أَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرُّؤْيَا الصَّادِقَةُ فِي النَّوْمِ، فَكَانَ لاَ يَرَى رُؤْيَا إِلاَّ جَاءَتْ مِثْلَ فَلَقِ الصُّبْحِ، ثُمَّ حُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلاَءُ فَكَانَ يَلْحَقُ بِغَارِ حِرَاءٍ فَيَتَحَنَّثُ فِيهِ ـ قَالَ وَالتَّحَنُّثُ التَّعَبُّدُ ـ اللَّيَالِيَ ذَوَاتِ الْعَدَدِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَيَتَزَوَّدُ لِذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى خَدِيجَةَ فَيَتَزَوَّدُ بِمِثْلِهَا، حَتَّى فَجِئَهُ الْحَقُّ وَهْوَ فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ فَجَاءَهُ الْمَلَكُ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجُهْدُ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّانِيِةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجُهْدُ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّالِثَةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجُهْدُ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏<A id="q122" name="q122" href="javascript:openquran(95,1,4)"><c_q122>{‏اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ * خَلَقَ الإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ * اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الأَكْرَمُ * الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ‏}</c_q122></a>‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ الآيَاتِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q123" name="q123" href="javascript:openquran(95,5,5)"><c_q123>{‏عَلَّمَ الإِنْسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ‏}</c_q123></a>‏ فَرَجَعَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرْجُفُ بَوَادِرُهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَزَمَّلُوهُ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الرَّوْعُ قَالَ لِخَدِيجَةَ ‏"‏ أَىْ خَدِيجَةُ مَا لِي، لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهَا الْخَبَرَ‏.‏ قَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ كَلاَّ أَبْشِرْ، فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ، وَتَصْدُقُ الْحَدِيثَ، وَتَحْمِلُ الْكَلَّ، وَتَكْسِبُ الْمَعْدُومَ، وَتَقْرِي الضَّيْفَ، وَتُعِينُ عَلَى نَوَائِبِ الْحَقِّ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ خَدِيجَةُ حَتَّى أَتَتْ بِهِ وَرَقَةَ بْنَ نَوْفَلٍ وَهْوَ ابْنُ عَمِّ خَدِيجَةَ أَخِي أَبِيهَا، وَكَانَ امْرَأً تَنَصَّرَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ الْكِتَابَ الْعَرَبِيَّ وَيَكْتُبُ مِنَ الإِنْجِيلِ بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ، وَكَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ عَمِيَ فَقَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ اسْمَعْ مِنِ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَرَقَةُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَاذَا تَرَى فَأَخْبَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَبَرَ مَا رَأَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَرَقَةُ هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُوسَى، لَيْتَنِي فِيهَا جَذَعًا، لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا‏.‏ ذَكَرَ حَرْفًا‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَمُخْرِجِيَّ هُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَرَقَةُ نَعَمْ لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ بِمَا جِئْتَ بِهِ إِلاَّ أُوذِيَ، وَإِنْ يُدْرِكْنِي يَوْمُكَ حَيًّا أَنْصُرْكَ نَصْرًا مُؤَزَّرًا‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْشَبْ وَرَقَةُ أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ، وَفَتَرَ الْوَحْىُ، فَتْرَةً حَتَّى حَزِنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=476></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4954</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182940><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182940><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated>Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:</div><div class=text_details>While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was talking about the period of pause in 
revelation. he said in his narration. "Once while I was walking, all of a sudden I heard a voice from 
the sky. I looked up and saw to my surprise, the same Angel as had visited me in the cave of Hira.' He 
was sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I got afraid of him and came back home and said, 
Wrap me! Wrap me!" So they covered him and then Allah revealed: 
'O you, wrapped up! Arise and warn and your Lord magnify, and your garments purify and dessert the 
idols.' (74.1-5) 
Abu Salama said, "(Rijz) are the idols which the people of the Pre-lslamic period used to worship." 
After this the revelation started coming frequently and regularly.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ فَتْرَةِ الْوَحْىِ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَرَفَعْتُ بَصَرِي، فَإِذَا الْمَلَكُ الَّذِي جَاءَنِي بِحِرَاءٍ جَالِسٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ فَفَرِقْتُ مِنْهُ فَرَجَعْتُ فَقُلْتُ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَدَثَّرُوهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q124" name="q124" href="javascript:openquran(73,1,5)"><c_q124>{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ * قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ * وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ * وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ * وَالرِّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ‏}</c_q124></a>‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَهْىَ الأَوْثَانُ الَّتِي كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَعْبُدُونَ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ تَتَابَعَ الْوَحْىُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<a name=480></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4958</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182980><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182980><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:</div><div class=text_details><p>Abu Jahl said, "If I see Muhammad praying at the Ka`ba, I will tread on his neck." When the Prophet (ﷺ) 
heard of that, he said, "If he does so, the Angels will snatch him away."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُ مُحَمَّدًا يُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الْكَعْبَةِ لأَطَأَنَّ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ لَوْ فَعَلَهُ لأَخَذَتْهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ‏.‏</span></div>
</div>

<div class=echapno>(97)</div><div class=englishchapter>Surat al-Qadr (The Night of Glory)</div>
<div class=achapno>(97)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">سورة إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ</div><div class=clear></div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ الْمَطْلَعُ هُوَ الطُّلُوعُ، وَالْمَطْلِعُ الْمَوْضِعُ الَّذِي يُطْلَعُ مِنْهُ.<br>
<br><br>
{أَنْزَلْنَاهُ} الْهَاءُ كِنَايَةٌ عَنِ الْقُرْآنِ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مَخْرَجَ الْجَمِيعِ وَالْمُنْزِلُ هُوَ اللَّهُ وَالْعَرَبُ تُوَكِّدُ فِعْلَ الْوَاحِدِ فَتَجْعَلُهُ بِلَفْظِ الْجَمِيعِ، لِيَكُونَ أَثْبَتَ وَأَوْكَدَ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>

{مُنْفَكِّينَ} زَائِلِينَ.<br>
<br><br>
<a href="javascript:openquran(97,3,3)">{قَيِّمَةٌ}</a> الْقَائِمَةُ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ، أَضَافَ الدِّينَ إِلَى الْمُؤَنَّثِ.</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=481></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4959</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc182990><div class="englishcontainer" id=t182990><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai (bin Ka`b). "Allah has ordered me to recite to you:--'Those who disbelieve 
among the people of the Scripture and among the idolators are not going to stop (from their disbelief.') 
(Sura 98) Ubai said, "Did Allah mention me by name?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." On that, Ubai wept.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُبَىٍّ‏.‏ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ ‏<A id="q131" name="q131" href="javascript:openquran(97,1,1)"><c_q131>{‏لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا‏}</c_q131></a>‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمَّانِي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَكَى‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<a name=482></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4960</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183000><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183000><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai, "Allah has ordered me recite Qur'an to you." Ubai asked, "Did Allah 
mention me by name to you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has mentioned your name to me." On that 
Ubai started weeping. (The sub-narrator) Qatada added: I have been informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited: 
'Those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture," ...to Ubai.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُبَىٍّ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ آللَّهُ سَمَّانِي لَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ سَمَّاكَ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَعَلَ أُبَىٌّ يَبْكِي‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَأُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ ‏<A id="q132" name="q132" href="javascript:openquran(97,1,1)"><c_q132>{‏لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ‏}</c_q132></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=483></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4961</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183010><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183010><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas bin Malik:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Prophet said to Ubai bin Ka`b, "Allah has ordered me to recite Qur'an to you." Ubai said, "Did 
Allah mention me by name to you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Ubai said, "Have I been mentioned by 
the Lord of the Worlds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Then Ubai burst into tears.</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي دَاوُدَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْمُنَادِي، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُقْرِئَكَ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ آللَّهُ سَمَّانِي لَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَدْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَذَرَفَتْ عَيْنَاهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>

<a name=C99.01></a>
<div class=chapter>
<div class=echapno>(1)</div><div class=englishchapter>The Statement of Allah the Exalted: "So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it." (V.99:7) </div>
<div class=achapno>(1)</div>
<div class="arabicchapter arabic">باب قَوْلِهِ ‏<A id="q133" name="q133" href="javascript:openquran(98,7,7)"><c_q133>{‏فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ‏}</c_q133></a>‏</div><div class=clear></div>
</div>
<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ أَوْحَى لَهَا أَوْحَى إِلَيْهَا، وَوَحَى لَهَا وَوَحَى إِلَيْهَا وَاحِدٌ.</div>
<div class=clear></div>
<div class="actualHadithContainer hadith_container_bukhari" id=h183020>
<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=484></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4962</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183020><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183020><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Horses are kept for one of three purposes: A man may keep them (for Allah's 
Cause) to receive a reward in the Hereafter; another may keep them as a means of protection; and a 
third may keep them to be a burden for him. As for the man for whom the horse is a source of reward, 
he is the one who ties it for Allah's Cause, and he ties it with a long rope in a pasture or a garden, then, 
whatever it eats or drinks in that pasture or garden will be added to his good deeds. And if it breaks its 
rope and jumps over one or two hills, then, for all its footsteps and its manure, good deeds will be 
written for him. And if it passes by a river and drinks of its water though its owner had no intention to 
water it from that river, even then he will have good deeds written for him. So that horse will be (a 
source of) reward for such a man. 
If a man ties a horse for earning his livelihood and abstaining from asking others for help and he does 
not forget Allah's right, i.e. pays its Zakat and gives it to be used in Allah's Cause, then that horse will 
be a means of protection for him. But if a man ties it out of pride and to show off and to excite others, 
then that horse will be a burden (of sins) for him." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked regarding donkeys. 
He replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me except this comprehensive Verse which includes 
everything: 
'So whoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it; and whoever 
does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it.' (99.7-8)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْخَيْلُ لِثَلاَثَةٍ، لِرَجُلٍ أَجْرٌ، وَلِرَجُلٍ سِتْرٌ، وَعَلَى رَجُلٍ وِزْرٌ، فَأَمَّا الَّذِي لَهُ أَجْرٌ فَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَأَطَالَ لَهَا فِي مَرْجٍ أَوْ رَوْضَةٍ، فَمَا أَصَابَتْ فِي طِيَلِهَا ذَلِكَ فِي الْمَرْجِ وَالرَّوْضَةِ، كَانَ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٍ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا قَطَعَتْ طِيَلَهَا فَاسْتَنَّتْ شَرَفًا أَوْ شَرَفَيْنِ كَانَتْ آثَارُهَا وَأَرْوَاثُهَا حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا مَرَّتْ بِنَهَرٍ فَشَرِبَتْ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُرِدْ أَنْ يَسْقِيَ بِهِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ حَسَنَاتٍ لَهُ فَهْىَ لِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ أَجْرٌ، وَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا تَغَنِّيًا وَتَعَفُّفًا وَلَمْ يَنْسَ حَقَّ اللَّهِ فِي رِقَابِهَا وَلاَ ظُهُورِهَا فَهْىَ لَهُ سِتْرٌ، وَرَجُلٌ رَبَطَهَا فَخْرًا وَرِئَاءً وَنِوَاءً فَهْىَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وِزْرٌ‏.‏ فَسُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحُمُرِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ فِيهَا إِلاَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ الْفَاذَّةَ الْجَامِعَةَ ‏<A id="q134" name="q134" href="javascript:openquran(98,7,7)"><c_q134>{‏فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ * وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ‏}</c_q134></a>‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=485></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4963</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183030><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183030><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Huraira:</div><div class=text_details><p>The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about donkeys and he replied, "Nothing has been revealed to me regarding 
donkeys except this comprehensive Verse which includes everything: 
"So whoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a smallest ant) shall see it; And whoever, 
does evil equal to the weight of an atom or a smallest ant) shall see it.' (99.7-8)</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحُمُرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَمْ يُنْزَلْ عَلَىَّ فِيهَا شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ الْجَامِعَةُ الْفَاذَّةُ ‏<A id="q136" name="q136" href="javascript:openquran(98,7,8)"><c_q136>{‏فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ * وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ‏}</c_q136></a>‏‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=486></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4964</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183040><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183040><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Anas:</div><div class=text_details><p>When the Prophet (ﷺ) was made to ascend to the Heavens, he said (after his return), "I came upon a river 
the banks of which were made of tents of hollow pearls. I asked Gabriel. What is this (river?) He replied, 'This is the Kauthar.'</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا عُرِجَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى السَّمَاءِ قَالَ ‏</span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">"‏ أَتَيْتُ عَلَى نَهَرٍ حَافَتَاهُ قِبَابُ اللُّؤْلُؤِ مُجَوَّفًا فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذَا يَا جِبْرِيلُ قَالَ هَذَا الْكَوْثَرُ ‏"</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic">‏‏.‏</span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=487></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4965</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183050><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183050><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Ubaida:</div><div class=text_details><p>I asked `Aisha 'regarding the verse:--'Verily we have granted you the Kauthar.' She replied, "The 
Kauthar is a river which has been given to your Prophet on the banks of which there are (tents of) 
hollow pearls and its utensils are as numberless as the stars."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْكَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَ سَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏<A id="q139" name="q139" href="javascript:openquran(107,1,1)"><c_q139>{‏إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ‏}</c_q139></a>‏ قَالَتْ نَهَرٌ أُعْطِيَهُ نَبِيُّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَاطِئَاهُ عَلَيْهِ دُرٌّ مُجَوَّفٌ آنِيَتُهُ كَعَدَدِ النُّجُومِ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ زَكَرِيَّاءُ وَأَبُو الأَحْوَصِ وَمُطَرِّفٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=488></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4966</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183060><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183060><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Abu Bishr:</div><div class=text_details><p>Sa`id bin Jubair said that Ibn `Abbas said about Al-Kauthar. "That is the good which Allah has 
bestowed upon His Apostle." I said to Sa`id bin Jubair. "But the people claim that it is a river in 
Paradise." Sa`id said, "The river in Paradise is part of the good which Allah has bestowed on His 
Apostle."</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْكَوْثَرِ هُوَ الْخَيْرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُ نَهَرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ النَّهَرُ الَّذِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>

<div class="arabic achapintro aconly">يُقَالُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(108,6,6)" class="aya">{لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ}</a> الْكُفْرُ.</br><a href="javascript:openquran(108,6,6)" class="aya">{وَلِيَ دِينِ}</a> الإِسْلاَمُ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ دِينِي، لأَنَّ الآيَاتِ بِالنُّونِ فَحُذِفَتِ الْيَاءُ كَمَا قَالَ يَهْدِينِ وَيَشْفِينِ.</br>وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: <a href="javascript:openquran(108,2,2)" class="aya">{لاَ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ}</a> الآنَ، وَلاَ أُجِيبُكُمْ فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَلاَ أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ}</a>. وَهُمُ الَّذِينَ قَالَ: <a name='' class='aya_multi_result'>{وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنْهُمْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا}</a>.</div>
<div class=clear></div>

<!-- Begin hadith -->

<a name=489></a>
<div class="hadith_reference_sticky">Sahih al-Bukhari 4967</div><div class="hadithTextContainers" id=htc183070><div class="englishcontainer" id=t183070><div class="english_hadith_full"><div class=hadith_narrated><p>
Narrated Aisha:</div><div class=text_details><p>"When the "Surat-An-Nasr", 'When comes the Help of Allah and the conquest,' had been revealed to 
the Prophet (ﷺ) he did not offer any prayer except that he said therein, "Subhanka Rabbana wa bihamdika; 
Allahumma ighfirli (I testify the Uniqueness of our Lord, and all the praises are for Him: O Allah, 
forgive me!")</b></div>
<div class=clear></div></div></div><div class="arabic_hadith_full arabic"><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span>
<span class="arabic_text_details arabic">حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ ‏<A id="q145" name="q145" href="javascript:openquran(109,1,1)"><c_q145>{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}</c_q145></a>‏ إِلاَّ يَقُولُ فِيهَا ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏</span><span class="arabic_sanad arabic"></span></div>
</div>
<!-- End hadith -->
